"Huh?" Polypus looked at Ye Qianyu in shock. "What do you mean by that? Are those evil people targeting Big Brother?"

"Those heretics are not only targeting him, but they are also targeting everyone in this realm." Both women then sat beside Polypus before Ye Qianyu continued. "They are minions of the demons from other realms, and they want to take over this realm.

Although Zhang Fei is young, he has so many connections in this realm, and the number of people in his inner circle is also very large, so he was forced to interfere in this matter to protect them. Moreover, he has many things that other cultivators don't have, including senior cultivators like me, so we put our hopes in him.

Anyway, he took them all into seclusion two weeks ago, and his little sister told us that they won't be coming out anytime soon, especially since he's aiming to break through to the Earth or Heaven Realms, so you might have to wait a long time to meet them again."

"I see." Polypus nodded in understanding upon hearing that. "Sigh! I want to help them, but I'm too weak, and my cultivation is having a difficult time breaking through, even though I've often eaten the precious herbs in this place."

Yue Lanxin immediately spoke to Polypus. "Actually, you don't have to think about that, especially since I'm sure that Zhang Fei and the others can take care of those bad guys. Although breaking through to the Earth or Heaven Realm is not easy, he might be able to do it faster than other cultivators like us.
After all, he is a dual cultivator, and Lin'er told me that he has numerous wives and partners, so they can help him with that."

Polypus nodded to Yue Lanxin, especially since Zhang Lingxue had already told him about Zhang Fei's relationship. "I hope big brother can really reach those stages soon, so he can clean up those bad guys."

"We also hope the same for you." Ye Qianyu then offered something to Polypus. "How about you go to our sect? Actually, our sect is a female-only sect, but I think it's okay if you go there, and you won't feel lonely anymore."
"No." Polypus immediately rejected Ye Qianyu's offer. "Big brother asked me to guard this valley, and I have promised him to take good care of these herbs, so I won't leave here."
Ye Qianyu nodded in understanding of Polypus's wishes. "Since you want it that way, I won't force you to accept my offer; however, Lanxin and I will come here more often to accompany you."
"Is that true? Do you two really want to accompany me?" Polypus asked with a look full of expectation.

'He's over 150 years old, but he's no different from a teenager.' Both women muttered to themselves before nodding to Polypus. "Yes, we will accompany you. Moreover, you are an oceanic beast, and you have the water element, so we will teach you various things about your element."
Polypus abruptly stood up from his seat and bowed to the two women. "Thank you for being willing to accompany and teach me."

sentences.text: 'Show my new status, Mei.'
[Aye, sir.]
Cultivation:
> 5 Star Soul Realm [Qi: 348,600/761,000]
Soul Cultivation
> Foundation Soul: Early Stage.
Demon Rank:
- Marquis Rank [Female Essence: 1,800,000/18,000,000]
Beast Rank:
- 5 Tails [Beast Essence: 2,156,000/10,000,000]
'Hahhh!' Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was lying beside Xenaya, let out a heavy breath after he read them. 'Sigh!
Duke rank is a high rank demon, so it's natural that I need so much female essence to achieve it.'
[That's right, master.
Reaching the Duke rank is indeed not easy, and Arbeola has already told you that you will evolve into a lust demon lord when you reach that rank, so you have to face obstacles in order to do so.
Achieving the Archduke and King Rank is even more challenging, and it will be even more challenging to reach the Emperor Realm.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] agreed with that and nodded. 'Hey, Mei, do you think there are more demon ranks after the emperor rank?
As a cultivator, my cultivation is still at the 10 mortal realms now, but there are still the seven divine realms, so I think there might be more demon ranks beyond that.'

[For now, I don't have any information about that because the data in the system about the demon rank maxes out at the Emperor rank, but I think there is a possibility that there are advanced ranks above that rank.
Perhaps we will know about it once you go to the middle or upper realms in the future, so you don't need to think too much about it, and you can focus on pursuing the Duke Rank first.]
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a nod. 'Moreover, gathering more than fifteen million female essences is not an easy task, and it will take a very long time.'
Mei immediately gave Zhang Xiaolong [3] an idea.
[Master, there are so many demons in this city, and you only need to pay them with demon coins, so I think you can hire their services.]
'No!

Even though I'm a dual cultivator, I won't have sex with those demon prostitutes, so you'd better throw that idea out of your mind.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly remembered something. 'Hey, I forgot that I left Ba Shuxiang in the Dryad Forest, and she should have turned into a demon by now, so I'll pick her up and bring her here.
I don't care about Chi Zhongguo; I'll let Oz take care of him.'
[I believe it's a good idea to bring Ba Shuxiang to this realm, as absorbing the demon aura in this realm will significantly increase her demon power.
Additionally, you can also move Feltia [2] and her partners here, and they will also become stronger.
Even though Eve, Fyr, Eve, and Ashreth have become cultivators, they are still demons, and the demon aura here will still be useful for them.]
'Hmm?' After hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] fell into thought, and he himself knew that Mei's idea was the best.

However, he was still a newcomer to the netherworld realm, and he still didn't have a permanent residence, so he thought the idea was difficult to implement, especially since the demons in the realm were too strong. 'Sigh!
Let Feltia [2] and her partner stay in the Diyu Realm for the time being, and I will move them here after I have become more adapted to this realm.'
[Master, I have a few questions for you.] Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows because Mei wasn't usually like that.
[What are your plans regarding your clones?
Will you withdraw them when you get really strong?
Will you take their partners as your main harem members?]

Mei's questions left Zhang Xiaolong [3] dumbfounded, especially since he hadn't thought that far ahead, and his focus now was solely on using his clones to increase his strength as a cultivator, demon, and beast.
After he thought about things for some time, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately answered Mei. 'Honestly, I have no thoughts of withdrawing my clones, and they will live with their respective partners.
Perhaps I will take them to different realms in the future, and they can live their lives in their respective realms.
Probably, I will not bring some of Feltia [2]'s current partners, such as the Amaris Twins and Nadea, as they cannot become cultivators.
However, my decision is not final, and I may change my mind depending on them.
As for Zhang Fei [1]'s current partners, I'll leave the decision in their hands.
If they want to go with me, I'll bring them to other realms, and if they don't want to go there, I'll let them stay in the Sky Jade Realm.'
[Hahaha!] Mei suddenly laughed after hearing that.
[Master, if you really take them with you, and you also have children with them, then the number of your descendants will truly be numerous.]
Mei's words actually made Zhang Xiaolong [3] smile. 'Isn't that great?
Actually, I always dreamed of having many descendants, and I can make my dream come true through all of them.
However, I must become the strongest first, so I have the power to protect all my future descendants.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] could hear Mei sigh softly, but two notifications suddenly popped out in his mind, surprising him, especially the second notification.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 7,200 Qi.]
[Reward: 72 green jewels.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 Demons at Marquis rank or above.]
[Reward: 50,000 female essences.]
'Hmm?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately raised his eyebrows. 'The daily quest related to demons has also undergone changes, huh?
Usually, I can kill all-level demons to complete it, but it now requires me to kill marquis-rank demons and above, so I have to work harder to complete it.
Even so, it's not a big deal for me, especially since Feltia [2] and I can do it together, which will save a lot of time to complete it.
Fortunately, the female essence rewards are also increasing, so I think it's a good thing.'
After removing the dream imprisonment effect from Xenaya the succubus, Zhang Xiaolong [3] got out of bed and dressed himself.
After Mei opened the gate to the Diyu Realm, he immediately went there before going to the Dryad Forest, and he took Ba Shuxiang to the netherworld realm.
In addition, he asked Oz to take Chi Zhongguo away, but he also asked him not to kill him, so he could feel the suffering of living as a demon for the rest of his life.

Afterwards, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought Ba Shuxiang to Arbeola's place, making her completely helpless with her situation, especially since she had to separate from her husband, and she was fully aware that they would never be able to meet again.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] discovered that Ursula, Virgil, and Angela were seriously absorbing demon aura in that realm, so he did not disturb them and hurried to another area to complete the daily quest.
However, he asked Arbeola to teach Ba Shuxiang the same thing as the others, so she would be more useful to him.
Feltia [2], who was satisfied after having fun with the Amaris Twins and Nadea, decided to leave the black castle to speed up the daily quest completion.
However, he first took Ashreth out of the training space, especially since she had become a demon cultivator, and he then brought her along with the other female demons to go with him.
The situation in the Amaris Twins' tower became chaotic, especially after Kyllia told the female demons living there about their rulers' betrayal.
Many of them, such as Naeth, didn't believe her words, but the gorgon immediately dropped another bomb that shocked them.
She told them that the second demon emperor had returned, and he was the one who captured the twins.
In addition, Kyllia also told them that Oz had punished Tauri, Avros, and Leon, so they were no longer rulers of their realms.
"Anyway, Feltia [2] is Lord Oz's confidant, and he appointed him the next ruler of this sub-realm."
"Huh?" They looked shocked to hear Kyllia mention Feltia [2] as a man, especially since he was previously a succubus, so Naeth asked her.
"Are you kidding us?
How can that succubus be a man?"

"Honestly, I was shocked to learn that Feltia [2] was actually an incubus rather than a succubus, but that's a fact we can't change." Kyllia's answer made Naeth and the others frown, especially since all of them had never liked male demons, so they had a hard time accepting the fact that he was a man, and he would also be their new ruler.
"I understand what you all think about him, but you should carefully consider your choice.
After all, he is Lord Oz's confidant, and he will surely punish you all if you guys dare to oppose his decision to appoint him as our ruler.
Moreover, the twins have completely submitted to him, and you should already understand their characters."
Naeth and the others trembled after Kyllia mentioned the last matter, especially since the Amaris Twins had led them for so long, but they had now submitted to Feltia [2].
If that was true, he could order them to do whatever he wanted, and both of them would do something really bad to them.
Kyllia immediately spoke to them again.
"Moreover, life in this tower is much better than the outside, right?
As long as you guys submit and obey Feltia [2]'s orders, I'm sure that he won't treat you badly.
Instead, under his leadership, all of you will enjoy many benefits, especially since I have already experienced some, which is why I have decided to bring my race members to follow him.
However, I won't go into detail about the benefits; you guys can discover them for yourselves when he comes here again."

After she said that, Kyllia immediately left them, leaving them to wonder on their own, especially since Feltia [2] ordered her to spread the news about the Amaris Twins' betrayal and the news about him to all corners of the sub-realm, so she didn't want to delay it.
Naeth immediately turned to several female demons.
"Follow me!
We have to find out the truth about Kyllia's words just now, and we will find out whether it is true that the second demon lords have returned to this realm or not."
They agreed with Naeth and hurriedly left the Amaris Twins' sub-realm to check out the other sub-realms, especially the sub-realms of Tauri, Avros, and Leon.

chapters.title: Chapter 404 Netherworld Realm Demon Emperor
paragraphs: In the Yin-Yang Pavilion, Zhiyu Fengzhi seemed overwhelmed to treat the members of the Shen Clan who were beaten by Tian Jiyuan two days ago, especially since he was the only healer in the sect. Moreover, some of them, including Shen Yang and Shen Hai, sustained serious injuries.
Although they had passed their critical period, their injuries were still quite severe, so he had to continue monitoring them.
Moreover, Zhiyu Fengzhi himself still had a patient with a strange condition, who was none other than Ba Yongshan, so his concentration was divided between them.

It had been a week since his parents brought Ba Yongzhan to the Yin-Yang Pavilion to get treatment from Zhiyu Fengzhi, especially since he was the best healer they knew. Unfortunately, he still hasn't managed to revert their son's condition back to normal, and their son's condition also continues to decline.

Just as Zhiyu Fengzhi was feeling exhausted, he was surprised by the sudden arrival of a woman in his medical hall, and he was even more surprised after he saw her appearance. 'A natural race? Why did she come here?' "How did you enter without being noticed by the sect members, my lady?"

"My name is Elmyra, the leader of the elves, and I came here because of these people." Zhiyu Fengzhi was confused by this, especially since he knew that the natural races never liked humans, but Elmyra immediately approached Shen Yang and the others. "I know that these people have a relationship with Zhang Fei, and those foxes beat them up because of him, so I came specifically to heal them."

Elmyra's explanation surprised Zhiyu Fengzhi once again, but he didn't ask her directly, especially since she had already activated her light element and enveloped the people in it, making the room brightly lit.

Zhiyu Fengzhi looked amazed when he saw Elmyra's light element, especially since it was pure white and strong compared to other people's. 'Amazing! Her light element is the purest I've ever seen! I've heard that the elves are one of the flawless races, and they have a profound bond with nature, but this is my first time meeting one of them.
Moreover, this woman is their leader, and her cultivation is much higher than that of the Shen Ancestor, so these guys should be able to recover in no time.'
After a few minutes, Elmyria withdrew her light element and turned to Zhiyu Fengzhi. "Even though I've healed their injuries, you must improve their body condition so as not to leave any sequela."

"Thank you for your help, Lady Elmyra." Zhiyu Fengzhi sincerely said. "Anyway, can you help me cure someone else? I treated him in this building, and his condition is really strange. His outer body is already petrified, and his inner organs are also gradually petrifying. I've tried everything to restore his condition, but all of them were useless, and I estimated that he would die within a month."

Elmyra raised her eyebrows after hearing that, but she immediately used her senses to check the medical hall in search of Ba Yongshan. She immediately checked his condition after finding him in another room, but she then refused Zhiyu Fengzhi's request. "I don't know for certain the identity of the person who did that to him, but I have my own guess about that person.
If that person did such a thing to him, then I'm sure there must have been some serious problems between them before, so I won't help you restore her condition."

"But-" Elmyra just shook her head and disappeared from that place, causing Zhiyu Fengzhi to sigh heavily. However, he remembered her previous words, which raised suspicions in his mind, and he turned to the members of the Shen Clan. "What exactly is her relationship with Zhang Fei?

Previously, she said that she came here because these guys had a relationship with him, and she cured them because of him. If my guess is correct, he was the one who did that to Ba Yongshan, but I don't understand how he could have such an ability.
Unfortunately, he has been in seclusion since two weeks ago; even Mistress Shen and the others joined him, and I don't know how to contact them, so I can't do anything to help that kid."

Once again, Zhiyu Fengzhi sighed heavily before going to Ba Yongshan's room, and he told his parents that he had no solution to restore his condition, so he asked them to take him back to the Ba Clan.

However, Ba Zhongtan and Ye Mingchen persistently pressed him to find a solution for their son, leaving Zhiyu Fengzhi completely powerless due to their attitude. He eventually agreed to their wishes, but he couldn't promise them anything.
In another area of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, a young woman sat on a stone chair, propped her head on a table, and her eyes kept looking towards a building.
Several other young men and women who were sitting around her shook their heads, especially since she kept grumbling non-stop, which she had been doing for almost two weeks.

"Hey! Dong'er! Why do I think that you have fallen for Zhang Fei [1]? You've been coming here and grumbling in annoyance ever since he brought Luo Yu and the others into seclusion, leading me to believe that his charms have captured your heart." She then turned to the others. "Don't you think the same as me, Lingshu?"
Mu Lingshu nodded at her. "I agree with you, Luoyue. Dong'er has been captivated by Zhang Fei [1] for a long time, especially after he-."

"Shut up, Lingshu!" Lin Dong'er shouted as she stood up, but her face was completely red as she remembered when Zhang Fei [1] touched her breasts two months ago, and she kept thinking about him after that incident because he was the first man who dared to do such a thing to her. "Do you think I don't know that you are starting to like him too?"

"No." Mu Lingshu immediately denied it. "Zhang Fei [1] is indeed good, and he's also handsome; even his cultivation has surpassed ours. However, we rarely meet, and our relationship is bland, especially since he's always busy with his personal affairs, so I've never had that kind of feeling for him.
Anyway, you were the one who teased him first, but you ran away like a rabbit after he returned your teasing."
Hearing that, Nanxuan Luoyue asked Mu Lingshu again. "What exactly did Zhang Fei [1] do to Dong'er? Why is she behaving as if she's deeply in love with him?"
"You can ask Dong'er yourself."

Nanxuan Luoyue and the others immediately turned to Lin Dong'er, but she quickly turned her face aside and did not want to tell them the truth, especially since the incident at the time was really embarrassing for her.

Suddenly, two people approached them, and the young man questioned them. "Are you guys still waiting for Cousin Fei? I think you guys shouldn't wait for him, especially since he won't be coming out of his seclusion anytime soon, and he probably won't come out in a few months."
"Huh?" They were all shocked to hear that, and Xia Bing then asked him. "What is your cousin's goal, Quan Xun? Why did he decide to enter seclusion for so long?"
"Tell us, Quan Xun." Lian Chengyu also spoke to him.

Quan Xun brought his partner, Tang Susu, to sit in front of them. "To tell you the truth, my cousin intended to break through to the Earth or Heaven Realms as quickly as possible, so he decided on that."
Quan Xun's answer left them all stunned, especially since Zhang Fei [1] had only recently broken through to the Soul Realm, but he was now already targeting two major stages ahead.

Xia Bing was the first to regain his senses and speak directly. "Since Brother Fei already has such an intention, we can't just stay in this sect; we have to work harder to reach the soul realm as soon as possible. Otherwise, we will fall further behind him, and the only way for us to do that is to go out to carry out new missions so that we can continue to improve our abilities."
"I agree with you." Lian Chengyu said as he nodded. "However, we can't just focus on our abilities, and we also have to think of other ways to improve our cultivation."
"Hahaha." Nanxuan Luoyue laughed at that. "I didn't think much about it because I have Xia Bing, and we can help each other to improve our cultivation."

"Humph!" Lian Chengyu snorted, then contacted someone. "In fact, I've already found a new partner to replace Lan Zhen, and I've called her to come here so we can go straight to the mission hall and look for new missions afterward."

They were surprised by Lian Chengyu's confession, but they didn't think too much about it, especially since his new partner would meet them soon. Nanxuan Luoyue then turned to Lin Dong'er and Mu Lingshu. "What about you two? Are you guys going to continue being single like this?"

"Humph!" Lin Dong'er answered Nanxuan Luoyue's question with a cold snort as she turned her face away, but her mind was filled with many questions, and she was fully aware that her cultivation would be slow to improve as long as she still didn't have a partner.

As for Zhang Fei [1], she did always think about him, but she did not have the mind to become his partner because the number of his wives and partners was too numerous, and her father did not want her to get a dual cultivator husband.
"I have an abnormality in my body, and Zhang Fei [1] told me that it is a stone body, which makes me unable to feel anything.

That's why I never thought about looking for a partner, and I'm still very young now, so I still have a lot of time to improve my cultivation manually." Nanxuan Luoyue and the others looked at Mu Lingshu with pity, but they were also at a loss to comfort her, especially since they didn't know anything about it. "Forget it; I'm already used to my situation, so I didn't think too much about it.
Moreover, he told me that my abnormality can still be cured, and he will help me find a cure, so I just need to be patient for now."

Quan Xun then spoke to comfort Mu Lingshu. "Senior Sister, if my cousin has said so, I believe that he will definitely cure you in the future, so you can live a new life as a normal woman and have a partner. However, he still has a lot of problems in his right hand now, so he probably won't be able to do it anytime soon."

Mu Lingshu nodded in understanding to Quan Xun before asking him. "Do you two want to join us? We will be taking on missions for inner disciples, but we can help you guys with outer disciple missions so you can both improve your abilities."

"What do you think about that? Do you want to go on missions with them?" Tang Susu was a shy girl, and she only nodded to Quan Xun. "In that case, the two of us will join you all. However, I don't know much about this realm yet, so I hope you can help us choose missions that are suitable for us and on the same route as your missions."
"Don't worry, we will help you two."
After they had waited for some time, Lian Chengyu's new partner finally arrived, but her identity was quite surprising to them, especially since she was a core disciple, and her name was Fu Lingshan.

They immediately gazed at him with strange looks, but Lian Chengyu responded by putting on a smug face and pulling his partner into an embrace. However, Fu Lingshan immediately smacked his head before speaking to them. "Actually, I accepted him as my partner because he looked lonely, and I also just split up with my old partner. Even though he is a junior, he is not bad, and I like him."

After that, they all rushed to the mission hall before taking on some missions for the outer and inner disciples. They decided to take on the slightly difficult missions, especially since Fu Lingshan had the ability to help them.

In a throne room lit by dim light emanating from countless black crystals, a middle-aged man wearing all black, combined with a black crown on his head, sat on his throne while looking at Elijah, who was kneeling with one leg beneath him.

The middle-aged man had a serious but sinister face. He had sharp, red eyes that were as red as blood. His long black hair was left loose and disorderly, and his face was covered by a thick black mustache and beard. In addition, there were many small demons constantly floating around him, and his aura was quite frightening, even for a high-ranking demon like the vampire lord.
"Why did you come late to answer my summons, Elijah?"

Elijah appeared to tremble, and he replied directly. "Demon Emperor, I met a beast cultivator on my way here and thought about gifting him to you, so I captured him first. Unfortunately, he suddenly died for no apparent reason when I brought him here, so I immediately threw away his body."

"Hmm?" The demon emperor frowned after he heard that, but he himself had already obtained information about the presence of those humans in their realm. However, he was not interested in ordinary humans like them, so he did not ask his subordinates to bring them to him. "Are you certain that this person is a beast cultivator?"

"Yes." Elijah then continued. "That person admitted that he was a beast cultivator, and he came to this realm with two of his friends. However, I was in a hurry to come here to fulfill your summons, so I didn't track the whereabouts of the two friends. Perhaps there were other high-ranking demons who met them, so you might want to ask them, Emperor."

The demon emperor wanted to contact the other high-rank demons to confirm Elijah's information, but two mysterious people wearing red robes suddenly appeared behind him, and one of them spoke directly to him.

"I think I know the identity of that beast cultivator, especially since there is only one beast race in this universe that can travel freely to different realms, and that race is the heavenly fox race. I know they're looking for something here since they came to this realm, so send those demons to investigate."
The demon emperor did not dare to refute that, and he took out several tools, which immediately flew away after he injected his demon power into them.
After that, another mysterious person asked him. "How is the progress of your efforts to break the seal on the portal? Are you still unsuccessful in doing so?"

Just as Zhiyu Fengzhi was feeling exhausted, he was surprised by the sudden arrival of a woman in his medical hall, and he was even more surprised after he saw her appearance. 'A natural race?
Why did she come here?' "How did you enter without being noticed by the sect members, my lady?"

"My name is Elmyra, the leader of the elves, and I came here because of these people." Zhiyu Fengzhi was confused by this, especially since he knew that the natural races never liked humans, but Elmyra immediately approached Shen Yang and the others.
"I know that these people have a relationship with Zhang Fei, and those foxes beat them up because of him, so I came specifically to heal them."

Elmyra's explanation surprised Zhiyu Fengzhi once again, but he didn't ask her directly, especially since she had already activated her light element and enveloped the people in it, making the room brightly lit.
Zhiyu Fengzhi looked amazed when he saw Elmyra's light element, especially since it was pure white and strong compared to other people's. 'Amazing!
Her light element is the purest I've ever seen!
I've heard that the elves are one of the flawless races, and they have a profound bond with nature, but this is my first time meeting one of them.
Moreover, this woman is their leader, and her cultivation is much higher than that of the Shen Ancestor, so these guys should be able to recover in no time.'
After a few minutes, Elmyria withdrew her light element and turned to Zhiyu Fengzhi.
"Even though I've healed their injuries, you must improve their body condition so as not to leave any sequela."
"Thank you for your help, Lady Elmyra." Zhiyu Fengzhi sincerely said.
"Anyway, can you help me cure someone else?
I treated him in this building, and his condition is really strange.
His outer body is already petrified, and his inner organs are also gradually petrifying.
I've tried everything to restore his condition, but all of them were useless, and I estimated that he would die within a month."
Elmyra raised her eyebrows after hearing that, but she immediately used her senses to check the medical hall in search of Ba Yongshan.
She immediately checked his condition after finding him in another room, but she then refused Zhiyu Fengzhi's request.
"I don't know for certain the identity of the person who did that to him, but I have my own guess about that person.
If that person did such a thing to him, then I'm sure there must have been some serious problems between them before, so I won't help you restore her condition."
"But-" Elmyra just shook her head and disappeared from that place, causing Zhiyu Fengzhi to sigh heavily.
However, he remembered her previous words, which raised suspicions in his mind, and he turned to the members of the Shen Clan.
"What exactly is her relationship with Zhang Fei?
Previously, she said that she came here because these guys had a relationship with him, and she cured them because of him.
If my guess is correct, he was the one who did that to Ba Yongshan, but I don't understand how he could have such an ability.
Unfortunately, he has been in seclusion since two weeks ago; even Mistress Shen and the others joined him, and I don't know how to contact them, so I can't do anything to help that kid."

Once again, Zhiyu Fengzhi sighed heavily before going to Ba Yongshan's room, and he told his parents that he had no solution to restore his condition, so he asked them to take him back to the Ba Clan.
However, Ba Zhongtan and Ye Mingchen persistently pressed him to find a solution for their son, leaving Zhiyu Fengzhi completely powerless due to their attitude.
He eventually agreed to their wishes, but he couldn't promise them anything.
In another area of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, a young woman sat on a stone chair, propped her head on a table, and her eyes kept looking towards a building.
Several other young men and women who were sitting around her shook their heads, especially since she kept grumbling non-stop, which she had been doing for almost two weeks.
"Hey!
Dong'er!
Why do I think that you have fallen for Zhang Fei [1]?

You've been coming here and grumbling in annoyance ever since he brought Luo Yu and the others into seclusion, leading me to believe that his charms have captured your heart." She then turned to the others.
"Don't you think the same as me, Lingshu?"
Mu Lingshu nodded at her.
"I agree with you, Luoyue.
Dong'er has been captivated by Zhang Fei [1] for a long time, especially after he-."

"Shut up, Lingshu!" Lin Dong'er shouted as she stood up, but her face was completely red as she remembered when Zhang Fei [1] touched her breasts two months ago, and she kept thinking about him after that incident because he was the first man who dared to do such a thing to her.
"Do you think I don't know that you are starting to like him too?"
"No." Mu Lingshu immediately denied it.
"Zhang Fei [1] is indeed good, and he's also handsome; even his cultivation has surpassed ours.
However, we rarely meet, and our relationship is bland, especially since he's always busy with his personal affairs, so I've never had that kind of feeling for him.
Anyway, you were the one who teased him first, but you ran away like a rabbit after he returned your teasing."
Hearing that, Nanxuan Luoyue asked Mu Lingshu again.
"What exactly did Zhang Fei [1] do to Dong'er?
Why is she behaving as if she's deeply in love with him?"
"You can ask Dong'er yourself."

Nanxuan Luoyue and the others immediately turned to Lin Dong'er, but she quickly turned her face aside and did not want to tell them the truth, especially since the incident at the time was really embarrassing for her.
Suddenly, two people approached them, and the young man questioned them.
"Are you guys still waiting for Cousin Fei?
I think you guys shouldn't wait for him, especially since he won't be coming out of his seclusion anytime soon, and he probably won't come out in a few months."
"Huh?" They were all shocked to hear that, and Xia Bing then asked him.
"What is your cousin's goal, Quan Xun?
Why did he decide to enter seclusion for so long?"
"Tell us, Quan Xun." Lian Chengyu also spoke to him.
Quan Xun brought his partner, Tang Susu, to sit in front of them.
"To tell you the truth, my cousin intended to break through to the Earth or Heaven Realms as quickly as possible, so he decided on that."
Quan Xun's answer left them all stunned, especially since Zhang Fei [1] had only recently broken through to the Soul Realm, but he was now already targeting two major stages ahead.
Xia Bing was the first to regain his senses and speak directly.
"Since Brother Fei already has such an intention, we can't just stay in this sect; we have to work harder to reach the soul realm as soon as possible.
Otherwise, we will fall further behind him, and the only way for us to do that is to go out to carry out new missions so that we can continue to improve our abilities."
"I agree with you." Lian Chengyu said as he nodded.
"However, we can't just focus on our abilities, and we also have to think of other ways to improve our cultivation."
"Hahaha." Nanxuan Luoyue laughed at that.
"I didn't think much about it because I have Xia Bing, and we can help each other to improve our cultivation."
"Humph!" Lian Chengyu snorted, then contacted someone.
"In fact, I've already found a new partner to replace Lan Zhen, and I've called her to come here so we can go straight to the mission hall and look for new missions afterward."
They were surprised by Lian Chengyu's confession, but they didn't think too much about it, especially since his new partner would meet them soon.
Nanxuan Luoyue then turned to Lin Dong'er and Mu Lingshu.
"What about you two?
Are you guys going to continue being single like this?"

"Humph!" Lin Dong'er answered Nanxuan Luoyue's question with a cold snort as she turned her face away, but her mind was filled with many questions, and she was fully aware that her cultivation would be slow to improve as long as she still didn't have a partner.

As for Zhang Fei [1], she did always think about him, but she did not have the mind to become his partner because the number of his wives and partners was too numerous, and her father did not want her to get a dual cultivator husband.
"I have an abnormality in my body, and Zhang Fei [1] told me that it is a stone body, which makes me unable to feel anything.

That's why I never thought about looking for a partner, and I'm still very young now, so I still have a lot of time to improve my cultivation manually." Nanxuan Luoyue and the others looked at Mu Lingshu with pity, but they were also at a loss to comfort her, especially since they didn't know anything about it.
"Forget it; I'm already used to my situation, so I didn't think too much about it.
Moreover, he told me that my abnormality can still be cured, and he will help me find a cure, so I just need to be patient for now."
Quan Xun then spoke to comfort Mu Lingshu.
"Senior Sister, if my cousin has said so, I believe that he will definitely cure you in the future, so you can live a new life as a normal woman and have a partner.
However, he still has a lot of problems in his right hand now, so he probably won't be able to do it anytime soon."
Mu Lingshu nodded in understanding to Quan Xun before asking him.
"Do you two want to join us?
We will be taking on missions for inner disciples, but we can help you guys with outer disciple missions so you can both improve your abilities."
"What do you think about that?
Do you want to go on missions with them?" Tang Susu was a shy girl, and she only nodded to Quan Xun.
"In that case, the two of us will join you all.
However, I don't know much about this realm yet, so I hope you can help us choose missions that are suitable for us and on the same route as your missions."
"Don't worry, we will help you two."
After they had waited for some time, Lian Chengyu's new partner finally arrived, but her identity was quite surprising to them, especially since she was a core disciple, and her name was Fu Lingshan.
They immediately gazed at him with strange looks, but Lian Chengyu responded by putting on a smug face and pulling his partner into an embrace.
However, Fu Lingshan immediately smacked his head before speaking to them.
"Actually, I accepted him as my partner because he looked lonely, and I also just split up with my old partner.
Even though he is a junior, he is not bad, and I like him."
After that, they all rushed to the mission hall before taking on some missions for the outer and inner disciples.
They decided to take on the slightly difficult missions, especially since Fu Lingshan had the ability to help them.

In a throne room lit by dim light emanating from countless black crystals, a middle-aged man wearing all black, combined with a black crown on his head, sat on his throne while looking at Elijah, who was kneeling with one leg beneath him.
The middle-aged man had a serious but sinister face.
He had sharp, red eyes that were as red as blood.
His long black hair was left loose and disorderly, and his face was covered by a thick black mustache and beard.
In addition, there were many small demons constantly floating around him, and his aura was quite frightening, even for a high-ranking demon like the vampire lord.
"Why did you come late to answer my summons, Elijah?"
Elijah appeared to tremble, and he replied directly.
"Demon Emperor, I met a beast cultivator on my way here and thought about gifting him to you, so I captured him first.
Unfortunately, he suddenly died for no apparent reason when I brought him here, so I immediately threw away his body."
"Hmm?" The demon emperor frowned after he heard that, but he himself had already obtained information about the presence of those humans in their realm.
However, he was not interested in ordinary humans like them, so he did not ask his subordinates to bring them to him.
"Are you certain that this person is a beast cultivator?"
"Yes." Elijah then continued.
"That person admitted that he was a beast cultivator, and he came to this realm with two of his friends.
However, I was in a hurry to come here to fulfill your summons, so I didn't track the whereabouts of the two friends.
Perhaps there were other high-ranking demons who met them, so you might want to ask them, Emperor."

The demon emperor wanted to contact the other high-rank demons to confirm Elijah's information, but two mysterious people wearing red robes suddenly appeared behind him, and one of them spoke directly to him.

"I think I know the identity of that beast cultivator, especially since there is only one beast race in this universe that can travel freely to different realms, and that race is the heavenly fox race.
I know they're looking for something here since they came to this realm, so send those demons to investigate."
The demon emperor did not dare to refute that, and he took out several tools, which immediately flew away after he injected his demon power into them.
After that, another mysterious person asked him.
"How is the progress of your efforts to break the seal on the portal?
Are you still unsuccessful in doing so?"

chapters.title: Chapter 405 The Mysterious Cultivators
paragraphs: The demon emperor and the two mysterious people were already in a large field, where the portal connecting to the Sky Jade Realm was located. "I have tried many times to break the seal on this portal, but it has become much stronger than before, and my strength is not enough to break it, so I decided to wait for you two to come back to this realm.
Moreover, I've tried to contact Heltia, but it turns out she's dead, so I no longer know the situation in that realm."

"Hmm?" The two mysterious people looked at the demon emperor with a frown before exchanging glances with each other. They then crouched at the side of the portal and touched it, causing their expressions to change when they sensed something unusual from the seal.
"Can you feel it, brother?" One of the mysterious people questioned the other, and her voice revealed that she was a woman.

"If I'm not mistaken, the qi we sense in this seal should belong to a beast cultivator." The man answered while nodding. "Before humans inhabited the Sky Jade Realm, it was the residence of beast cultivators and natural races, and the ten-tailed fox was their ruler, so it was natural for them to help each other to strengthen this seal."

The woman agreed with that. "However, I find the Qi peculiar, brother." It is clearly not owned by a beast cultivator with cultivation in ten mortal realms, but it belongs to a beast cultivator with cultivation in the seven divine realms. The Sky Jade Realm is located in the lower realms, making it impossible for living beings there to reach that stage.
If my guess is correct, the beast cultivator who helped them should have come from the middle or upper realms, but I can't figure out what kind of beast it is."

"I myself cannot confirm the identity of the beast cultivator from its Qi, so we have no choice but to contact our uncle to come to this realm, and I believe he can recognize the identity of the beast." The man then stood up, took out a token from his storage ring, and injected his qi into it.

The moment the man did that, the token immediately soared into the sky and spun there, and many red lights began to emerge from it. In a few seconds, they gathered into one and formed the figure of a man, and he immediately asked the two mysterious people. "Why did you two suddenly summon my avatar, Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin?"

Shang Guangming immediately cupped his hands in front of him. "Uncle Chenguang, there has been a slight change to this seal. We thought that a powerful beast cultivator from the middle or upper realms was helping the people from the Sky Jade Realm strengthen it, and its cultivation was in the seven divine realms.

We can break this seal with our current strength, but we don't know the identity of the beast cultivator, and we don't have much information about that realm either, so I was forced to summon your avatar."

"That's true, Uncle." Shang Yaolin also cupped her hand to Shang Chenguang. "Based on the strength and purity of its Qi, I believe the beast cultivator is not just any ordinary beast, but likely a divine or even mythical beast. Therefore, we need your assistance to confirm this first, and we will help this foolish demon emperor destroy this seal after that.
That way, we can take over that realm, and we will force those natural races to hand over the ten-tailed fox's inheritance to us."

Without uttering a word, Shang Chenguang descended from the sky and directly touched the portal. However, after he sensed the Qi within the seal, his expression was slightly surprised, and he repeatedly nodded his head. "I will leave our realm right now, and I will arrive here in a week.

The beast cultivator is undoubtedly a mythical rank beast, but I can't determine what kind of mythical beast it is solely based on its Qi. For the time being, you two can wait for me here, but you guys don't need to try to break this seal, and I will do it myself later."
"Yes, uncle."

Shang Guangming then spoke to him again. "Uncle, one of the duke rank demons in this realm encountered a fox beast cultivator who possesses a light qi. His cultivation seems to be only in the ten mortal realms, especially since that demon could defeat him easily. Unfortunately, he suddenly died for no apparent reason when he brought him here, so we cannot confirm his identity.
However, we suspect that he came from the heavenly fox race, especially since they are the only beasts that can move realms easily."

"Moreover, he didn't come alone, but he came with two companions. However, we couldn't detect their presence in this realm, so we thought that they had already left by now." Shang Yaolin added to her brother's words.

"The heavenly fox race?" Shang Chenguang muttered to himself with a frown. "I must leave now, and I will report the presence of the fox race in this realm to our patriarch first. After that, I will immediately rush to this realm, and you can investigate other areas of this realm for the time being."
After he said that, Shang Chenguang turned into a red light again before entering the token, and it immediately returned to Shang Guangming's hand by itself.

"Contact us immediately if any of the demons manage to find traces of those fox beasts." The demon emperor nodded to Shang Guangming. "In addition, summon all the duke, archduke, and king rank demons to gather in this city immediately. Once our uncle arrives in this realm, he will destroy the seal on this portal directly, so you guys can invade the Sky Jade Realm once again."

After he said that, Shang Guangming immediately took Shang Yaolin to leave the city, and the demon emperor immediately summoned the duke, archduke, and king rank demons who had not yet arrived at the demon emperor city.

As they flew side by side, Shang Yaolin turned her head towards the south before asking Shang Guangming. "Hey, brother, why didn't you tell our uncle about that white wolf demon? Alder's cultivation is above ours, but his strength is still below our uncle's, so I'm sure he can kill him."

"You don't need to worry about Alder." Shang Guangming then looked towards the south. "That white wolf is a demon from the Blackthorn Abyss Realm, and the demons there are much stronger than us. Even the mythical beast races, including the Heavenly Fox Race, don't dare underestimate them, so it would be better if we didn't mess with them."

"I see." Shang Yaolin then asked him again. "In your opinion, why did those heavenly foxes come to this realm? This demon realm is in the middle realms, so it is impossible for these demons to have any problems with them. Moreover, they are beasts with light elements, so everything in this realm should be useless to them."

"You're not wrong with that." Shang Guangming replied with a nod. "At first, I thought they were searching for items in this realm, but it was impossible, leading me to believe they were chasing their fleeing enemy.

However, I am perplexed as to why they sent only heavenly foxes with cultivation in the ten mortal realms, especially considering that they could easily capture their enemy if they dispatched those who had reached the seven divine realms to chase after him or her. Since they couldn't stay in this realm long, they should send stronger race members to do it."

Shang Yaolin nodded in agreement with that. "Do you think their enemies are still in this realm? If they dare to take the risk to chase that person here, I think he or she might know a lot about them, so I think we can look for him or her to find out information about them.

Moreover, our patriarch has long wanted to defeat those foxes, but he has not succeeded in doing so, especially since Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are too strong for him, and they have defeated him too many times."

"You're right." Shang Guangming then looked in several directions. "The enemy of our enemies is our friend, and I think that person is still hiding in this realm. Since those foxes are quite vengeful, I'm pretty sure they won't let him or her off just like that, and they may still continue to monitor his or her movements, so we should split up to look for him or her."

After that, the two of them immediately parted ways, with Shang Guangming heading east and Shang Yaolin going west. Moreover, the demons in the netherworld realm knew that the two of them were behind the demon emperor, so they didn't need to worry that the demons would attack them.

"Mhmm." Xenaya, who had previously fallen asleep, finally opened her eyes. However, she felt confused about her situation, and she felt that her body was so weak. She then looked around the room, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] was nowhere to be found. "What the hell happened to me?

I clearly remember that I gave Elion the lullaby demon powder and used my demon imprisonment, so he shouldn't have been able to wake up before I removed both effects, but he's not here now. Moreover, I feel so tired now, as if I've been having sex for a long time, and the pleasure I experienced when I had sex with him still lingers in my body."

Xenaya then got out of bed, but she almost stumbled forward because her legs were too weak, so she immediately held on to the headrest. She then turned towards the bed, and her expression was a little surprised after seeing the traces of her repeated orgasms. "How can he free himself from my dream imprisonment? Is it possible that he possesses the ability to counter it?

His demon rank is still at the Earl rank, so he shouldn't be able to do it. As far as I remember, only the Incubus Lord has such an ability; that means he is no less than Yhrer if he really has such an ability."

After that, Xenaya immediately got dressed and left the room, but she saw the male demons at the Lust Inn continuing to stare at her with strange looks, causing her to frown. "Why are you guys looking at me like that?"
"Ha ha ha!" Instead, they burst into laughter, prompting one of the male demons to immediately question the succubi. "Do you really not remember anything, Miss Xenaya?"

However, the male demons immediately covered their mouths as their bodies trembled at Xenaya's sharp glare, and the succubi quickly moved towards them before sprinkling the lullaby demon powder. Additionally, she also used the dream imprisonment to imprison their subconscious, causing them to fall to the floor one by one.

The female demons who worked at the Lust Inn laughed upon witnessing her actions, especially since those male demons had made a big mistake by saying something like that to Xenaya. Even though she is a succubus, she will not sleep with all male demons, and she will only do it with male demons who interest her, like Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Furthermore, her status in Lust City is quite high, and she is one of the three succubi duchesses' trusted confidants.

"Call the city guards and order them to throw these idiots into the eastern swamp." The female demons froze in their places after hearing Xenaya's order, especially since that place was too scary with many carnivorous demons living there, and those male demons would definitely die if thrown there. "Why don't you all move? Do it now, or I'll send you all there too."

When they heard that, the two of them hurriedly left the Lust Inn, fearing that Xenaya would really send them to the eastern swamp if she said so, and they didn't want to end up tragically eaten alive by those carnivorous demons.

Xenaya then went to her private room with many questions in her mind, but her expression clearly showed that she couldn't wait to meet Zhang Xiaolong [3] again, especially after she heard the words of those male demons earlier. '"Did I really moan that loudly when I had sex with Elion? How could he make me not remember any of it? Tch!
I'll wait for him to return to interrogate him, and then I'll use my other abilities to teach him a lesson."
*Slash... Slash...*

"Acho!" Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was watching the demon extermination sword slaughter those demon beasts, suddenly sneezed. He immediately rubbed his nose while turning his head towards Lust City. "Xenaya seems to be awake, and she must be talking about me now. Hehe! I still have three days here, and I will continue to have fun with her, so I can get a lot of female essence from her."
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 7,200 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 72 green jewels sent to the inventory.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 Demons at Marquis rank or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 50,000 female essences are added to the balance.]
The two notifications immediately appeared as soon as Zhang Fei [4] and the demon extermination sword completed their task, causing Zhang Xiaolong [3] to let out a soft sigh.
"Return!" The demon extermination sword immediately flew back into Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hand, and he rubbed it gently. "You really enjoy slaughtering these beasts, huh?"
*Zing... Zing...*

The demon extermination sword answered Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a strong vibration, as it was indeed enjoying It's time to slaughter the demon beasts, especially since it can absorb their demon power and essences, which can make it stronger.

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "Don't worry, you still have plenty of time to do it again, and you can absorb everything to your heart's content. However, I have to go back now, and I'll bring you back here later."
After that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately looked for demon beast cores from the corpses of those beasts, and he found quite a lot, so he immediately stored them all in the system inventory.
[You obtained 300 normal demon cores.]
[You obtained 100 intermediate demon cores.]
After everything was settled, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately returned to Arbeola's place to check on the female demons, but they were still preoccupied with their own affairs, including Ba Shuxiang.
However, Arbeola suddenly told Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "The two mysterious people behind the demon emperor are in this realm, and one of them is on his way here."

"That white wolf is a demon from the Blackthorn Abyss Realm, and the demons there are much stronger than us.
Even the mythical beast races, including the Heavenly Fox Race, don't dare underestimate them, so it would be better if we didn't mess with them."
"I see." Shang Yaolin then asked him again.
"In your opinion, why did those heavenly foxes come to this realm?
This demon realm is in the middle realms, so it is impossible for these demons to have any problems with them.
Moreover, they are beasts with light elements, so everything in this realm should be useless to them."
"You're not wrong with that." Shang Guangming replied with a nod.
"At first, I thought they were searching for items in this realm, but it was impossible, leading me to believe they were chasing their fleeing enemy.

However, I am perplexed as to why they sent only heavenly foxes with cultivation in the ten mortal realms, especially considering that they could easily capture their enemy if they dispatched those who had reached the seven divine realms to chase after him or her.
Since they couldn't stay in this realm long, they should send stronger race members to do it."
Shang Yaolin nodded in agreement with that.
"Do you think their enemies are still in this realm?
If they dare to take the risk to chase that person here, I think he or she might know a lot about them, so I think we can look for him or her to find out information about them.

Moreover, our patriarch has long wanted to defeat those foxes, but he has not succeeded in doing so, especially since Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are too strong for him, and they have defeated him too many times."
"You're right." Shang Guangming then looked in several directions.
"The enemy of our enemies is our friend, and I think that person is still hiding in this realm.

Since those foxes are quite vengeful, I'm pretty sure they won't let him or her off just like that, and they may still continue to monitor his or her movements, so we should split up to look for him or her."
After that, the two of them immediately parted ways, with Shang Guangming heading east and Shang Yaolin going west.
Moreover, the demons in the netherworld realm knew that the two of them were behind the demon emperor, so they didn't need to worry that the demons would attack them.
"Mhmm." Xenaya, who had previously fallen asleep, finally opened her eyes.
However, she felt confused about her situation, and she felt that her body was so weak.
She then looked around the room, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] was nowhere to be found.
"What the hell happened to me?
I clearly remember that I gave Elion the lullaby demon powder and used my demon imprisonment, so he shouldn't have been able to wake up before I removed both effects, but he's not here now.
Moreover, I feel so tired now, as if I've been having sex for a long time, and the pleasure I experienced when I had sex with him still lingers in my body."
Xenaya then got out of bed, but she almost stumbled forward because her legs were too weak, so she immediately held on to the headrest.
She then turned towards the bed, and her expression was a little surprised after seeing the traces of her repeated orgasms.
"How can he free himself from my dream imprisonment?
Is it possible that he possesses the ability to counter it?
His demon rank is still at the Earl rank, so he shouldn't be able to do it.
As far as I remember, only the Incubus Lord has such an ability; that means he is no less than Yhrer if he really has such an ability."
After that, Xenaya immediately got dressed and left the room, but she saw the male demons at the Lust Inn continuing to stare at her with strange looks, causing her to frown.
"Why are you guys looking at me like that?"
"Ha ha ha!" Instead, they burst into laughter, prompting one of the male demons to immediately question the succubi.
"Do you really not remember anything, Miss Xenaya?"
However, the male demons immediately covered their mouths as their bodies trembled at Xenaya's sharp glare, and the succubi quickly moved towards them before sprinkling the lullaby demon powder.
Additionally, she also used the dream imprisonment to imprison their subconscious, causing them to fall to the floor one by one.
The female demons who worked at the Lust Inn laughed upon witnessing her actions, especially since those male demons had made a big mistake by saying something like that to Xenaya.
Even though she is a succubus, she will not sleep with all male demons, and she will only do it with male demons who interest her, like Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Furthermore, her status in Lust City is quite high, and she is one of the three succubi duchesses' trusted confidants.

"Call the city guards and order them to throw these idiots into the eastern swamp." The female demons froze in their places after hearing Xenaya's order, especially since that place was too scary with many carnivorous demons living there, and those male demons would definitely die if thrown there.
"Why don't you all move?
Do it now, or I'll send you all there too."

When they heard that, the two of them hurriedly left the Lust Inn, fearing that Xenaya would really send them to the eastern swamp if she said so, and they didn't want to end up tragically eaten alive by those carnivorous demons.

Xenaya then went to her private room with many questions in her mind, but her expression clearly showed that she couldn't wait to meet Zhang Xiaolong [3] again, especially after she heard the words of those male demons earlier. '"Did I really moan that loudly when I had sex with Elion?
How could he make me not remember any of it?
Tch!
I'll wait for him to return to interrogate him, and then I'll use my other abilities to teach him a lesson."
*Slash...
Slash...*

He immediately rubbed his nose while turning his head towards Lust City.
"Xenaya seems to be awake, and she must be talking about me now.
Hehe!
I still have three days here, and I will continue to have fun with her, so I can get a lot of female essence from her."

[Reward: 50,000 female essences are added to the balance.]
The two notifications immediately appeared as soon as Zhang Fei [4] and the demon extermination sword completed their task, causing Zhang Xiaolong [3] to let out a soft sigh.
"Return!" The demon extermination sword immediately flew back into Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hand, and he rubbed it gently.
"You really enjoy slaughtering these beasts, huh?"
*Zing...
Zing...*

The demon extermination sword answered Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a strong vibration, as it was indeed enjoying It's time to slaughter the demon beasts, especially since it can absorb their demon power and essences, which can make it stronger.
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that.
"Don't worry, you still have plenty of time to do it again, and you can absorb everything to your heart's content.
However, I have to go back now, and I'll bring you back here later."
After that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately looked for demon beast cores from the corpses of those beasts, and he found quite a lot, so he immediately stored them all in the system inventory.
[You obtained 300 normal demon cores.]
[You obtained 100 intermediate demon cores.]
After everything was settled, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately returned to Arbeola's place to check on the female demons, but they were still preoccupied with their own affairs, including Ba Shuxiang.
However, Arbeola suddenly told Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"The two mysterious people behind the demon emperor are in this realm, and one of them is on his way here."

chapters.title: Chapter 406 Four People
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the map to search for the location of the two mysterious cultivators, and he found one of them flying very quickly towards the northeast, which was his current location. 'Shang Guangming? Where did they come from exactly? Why did they use this realm's demons to invade other realms?
Moreover, I have never met a cultivator who could fly that fast; even Tian Jiyuan could not fly as fast as him, which means he is a cultivator in the seven divine realms.'

[That's right, Master. You shouldn't be surprised by Shang Guangming's speed, as he is indeed a cultivator in the seven divine realms. However, I'm not sure that he was the one who subdued the demon emperor of this realm, and he might have been helped by his seniors to do so.
Anyway, since the demon emperor city is in the north and this area is in the northeast, he will arrive here faster than you might expect—at most, five hours.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding, and he then looked for the location of another mysterious cultivator. He found Shang Yaolin flying towards the west, so he didn't think much of him. "Old Demon, do you know where to hide them? They are currently busy absorbing the demon aura in this realm to strengthen themselves, so I don't want to disturb them."

"Hahaha." Arbeola laughed before shifting slightly from his spot, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw an underground staircase appear below him. "As I said three days ago, the deceased fourth demon emperor deliberately planted me in this forest to protect it, and the area below was his private quarter, which was also his final resting place.

Even the fifth and current demon emperors knew nothing about this place, and we tree demons deliberately moved his corpse here underground, which was according to his request when he was still alive."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a little surprised to hear that. "It seems that the deceased fourth demon emperor was very loved by the demons in this realm, huh?"

"That's right, kid." Arbeola answered with a nod. "The deceased fourth demon emperor was the best emperor this realm has ever had, and he loved his people very much, unlike the current demon lord. Even people from other realms, including human and beast cultivators, respected him greatly, especially since he treated everyone equally.

However, he can also be very cruel, and he will not hesitate to kill anyone, especially those who have malicious intentions towards this realm and its inhabitants. Unfortunately, he is the emperor with the shortest life, and he only lives for ten thousand years."

Arbeola's last sentence made Zhang Xiaolong [3] smile bitterly, especially since ten thousand years is not a short time, and it is certainly very long. However, he wasn't surprised by that either, especially since Oz had also lived that long; even Zygoz and Ursula had lived more than fifty thousand years. "Is it okay if I take them inside?
After all, the place below is the resting place of the deceased fourth demon emperor, so I don't want to disturb his rest."
"You can bring these little girls down, and those mysterious cultivators won't be able to detect their presence."

Following Arbeola's statement, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately lifted the four female demons with his aura and brought them to the room below. There was nothing there except a golden coffin containing the deceased fourth demon emperor's skeleton, and he immediately placed them there before kowtowing in front of the coffin as a sign of respect.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided not to accompany the female demons, but he left a note for them before rushing out again, especially since he had many abilities to escape from Shang Guangming.

Moreover, he was curious about their purpose in using the demons from the Netherworld Realm to invade the Sky Jade Realm, which he suspected was related to the ten-tailed fox, so he wanted to take the opportunity to find out information about it.

"Are you sure you want to stay here, Kid?" As he returned to his original spot, Arbeola asked, making the stairs leading to the lower room disappear beneath him again. "That guy is stronger than us, so I can't protect you if he actually comes here, and he might kill you."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at Arbeola as he spoke to reassure him. "Old Demon, I admit that my strength is still too weak, but I have a few tricks up my sleeves, and I am confident that I can escape from that man if he really wants to kill me, so you don't have to worry about me.
Moreover, they are using the demons of this realm to invade my realm, so I want to dig up information about their purpose there."

In fact, Arbeola himself was curious about Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin's purpose, especially since no other living being had ever dared to suppress the demon emperor of the Netherworld Realm before. However, the two of them dared to do so, and they could even make him so obedient to their orders.
"All right, you should prepare yourself from now on in case that man comes here, so you can run away immediately if he has bad intentions towards you."

In a faraway realm, a middle-aged man who was none other than Shang Chenguang hurriedly ran into a large and spacious residence, and there were various kinds of beasts living in the residence, some of which were red dragons.

A while later, Shang Chenguang had arrived at the back of the residence, where two middle-aged men were playing a board game similar to Go, and they were accompanied by two middle-aged women, who were busy joking with each other.

One of the men had a fierce face with three claw marks on his left eye, and he had spiky red hair. His figure was tall and bulky, resembling a bodybuilder, yet it was evident from his appearance that he only had a right arm, particularly because the left sleeve of his robe was hung empty.

The other man looked like men in general, and his face was slightly handsome with his long grayish-black hair tied back with a ribbon. His figure is also tall but slim, but his appearance is a little strange, especially since the robe he wears is more like a woman's long dress, which is pink.
Both middle-aged women have equally mature and charming faces, even though their faces are devoid of make-up, and their appearances are no less elegant than each other.

One of them had a slightly short and somewhat plump figure, and her shoulder-length pink hair was adorned with a tiara with small jade balls. Everything about her was pink, including her eyes, eyebrows, lips, and dress. Her breasts weren't that big, but they weren't that small either; her curves were not too visible because of her figure and loose dress, but her hips looked wide.

The other woman had a tall and slender figure; her body was covered by a dress with a dragon embroidered on the back, and her long red hair was braided down her back. Her breasts are a bit bigger, and her hourglass curves are clearly visible, but her hips are not as wide as the other woman.

Hearing Shang Chenguang's rapid footsteps, the two middle-aged men immediately turned to him, and the man with three claw marks on his left eye immediately asked. "What happened? Why are you in such a hurry?"

Shang Chenguang immediately kneeled down in front of them and explained the situation. "Patriach Shang Huaqiang, I came here to report something to you, and it is very important. Those two kids had previously summoned my avatar to the Netherworld Realm, and I noticed something unusual about the portal seal.

There was a mythical beast that helped the cultivators from the Sky Jade Realm to strengthen the seal, and I am sure it is a beast from the upper realms. Judging from the strength of the Qi, its cultivation should be at the high level of the seven divine realms.

That's why I plan to leave for that realm right now, so I can help them to destroy that seal, especially since they're clearly not an opponent for that mythical beast, and they will probably die if they face it."

"Are you sure that the Qi you feel in the seal belongs to a mythical beast?" Shang Chenguang replied with a firm nod, but Shang Huaqiang then asked the other man, "Have you ever heard of mythical beasts in the lower realms, Brother Zhuang Qiaoming? As I recall, you often go to the lower realms, so I thought you'd know something about that."

"No." Zhuang Qiaoming answered Shang Huaqiang with a shake of his head, and his voice sounded feminine, like a transvestite. "The Qi in the lower realms is too low and thin for mythical beasts, so I've never heard of any of them roaming around there.
Moreover, they have high pride, so I don't believe that any of them are willing to help those weaklings, especially since that would only waste their time."

Shang Huaqiang nodded in agreement, but a moment later, the woman in the red dress spoke. "Brother Qiaoming, you're not wrong about that, but you forgot that the ten-tailed fox used to live in the Sky Jade Realm, which was once called the Heavenly Wilderness Realm, and many beasts thought that he left his legacy there.

According to history, he was a powerful beast, and he single-handedly freed all the fox race from oppression by defeating the other powerful beasts, including all the ancestors of the mythical beasts.

That's why I think it's natural that some of the mythical beasts went to realm, but I'm sure that beast wasn't there to help them, and it may have had another agenda in doing so, which may have something to do with that legacy."
"You are right, Fei Qinyuan." Zhuang Qiaoming said that while nodding several times.

The pink-haired woman suddenly spoke to Zhuang Qiaoming. "Husband, I wouldn't have remembered this matter if you guys hadn't brought it up, but I've heard that there are some mythical beasts who have sent their people to that realm, including the four virtue mythical beasts."
"Hmm?" Zhuang Qiaoming immediately turned to his wife. "Ying Wu, where did you hear that news? Why have I never heard about that matter?"

"Haha." Ying Wu giggled before telling them. "Zhu Sanniang is a member of the Vermilion bird race, and I have a good relationship with her, so she told me about it. However, the people of her race and the other three virtue mythical beasts never found anything related to the ten-tailed fox in that realm, and they only discovered an old statue of the fox, which they considered to be useless."

"A statue?" Ying Wu nodded to both men, but Zhuang Qiaoming had other thoughts. "I don't believe that the statue is useless, and I think it is the key to finding the ten-tailed fox's legacy, so you must get it in order to find it, Brother Huaqiang."

"I agree with you." Shang Huaqiang immediately turned his head towards Shang Chenguang before issuing an order. "Go to the Netherworld Realm now, and bring Shang Xishun with you. I don't want to fail again, so you two must help those foolish demons invade the Sky Jade Realm.
As for the mythical beast, I'm sure it's not fully grown yet, or they wouldn't have sent it there, so I want you two to capture it and bring it here to tame."
"Yes, Patriarch."

After Shang Chenguan left, Zhuang Qiaoming immediately asked Shang Huaqiang. "Brother, how did you manage to control the demon emperor of the Netherworld Realm? As far as I can remember, that old guy was really stubborn, and he never submitted to anyone. Moreover, I've fought him once before, and he was quite powerful, even though he wasn't a demon cultivator."
"Hahahaha!" Shang Huaqiang burst out laughing after hearing that. "Brother, their current demon emperor is not the real one, and he is my puppet."
"Oh?" Zhuang Qiaoming and Ying Wu were shocked by Shang Huaqiang's confession.

Fei Qinyuan then told them. "Actually, that guy was a demon from another realm, and he suddenly appeared in this realm out of nowhere, so my husband immediately captured him. After some investigation, we learned that he came from the lower realms, and his rank had already reached the emperor rank, but his demon power is too low compared to the demon emperors from the middle and upper realms.

After careful consideration, we decided to brainwash him and send him to one of the demon realms in the upper realms. Additionally, we provided him with demon-related items, which significantly enhanced his demon power. After that, he took him to the Netherworld Realm to replace their demon emperor, and he also imprisoned that old stubbornness in a place that demons couldn't reach."
"Hmm?" Zhuang Qiaoming immediately turned to Shang Huaqiang again. "Where did you imprison that old stubborn? Is he still alive now?"

Shang Huaqiang nodded to Zhuang Qiaoming before proceeding with his explanation. "He is still alive, but I used something to seal his demon power and aura, so no one will be able to tell that he is a demon emperor. As for his imprisonment, I moved him to another realm, and I also left a powerful dog guard to monitor him."
"A place that the demons can't reach?" Zhuang Qiaoming wondered to himself with a frown, but then he remembered a place. "Don't tell me that you sent him to that realm."
"Hahaha." Shang Huaqiang once again burst out laughing. "That's right, I sent that stubborn old man to that realm, and he is no different from an ordinary human there."
Ying Wu then asked Fei Qinyuan. "Did you two use the demons from the Netherworld Realm to avoid those people's eyes?"

"Isn't that the obvious answer?" Fei Qingyuan smiled in response. "Humans and beasts are eager to obtain the ten-tailed fox's legacy, so we can't act openly. If we succeed in obtaining it and they find out about it, they will flock to attack us, especially those two heavenly fox ancestors, which will be our downfall.
That's why we use such a method, and our puppet will take care of everything, so we don't have to worry about our safety."

"Unfortunately, we don't know for sure whether the ten-tailed fox's legacy truly exists, especially since Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are his direct descendants." The three of them nodded in agreement with Zhuang Qiaoming. "For several millennia, many humans, demons, and beasts believed that his legacy was in their hands, and they repeatedly attacked the Heavenly Moon Realm to conquer them.
Unfortunately, those two were truly powerful, and no one had ever succeeded in defeating them."

Shang Huaqiang smirked faintly at that. "That's why I thought about finding another way to obtain the ten-tailed fox's legacy, and I am absolutely certain that the key lies in the Sky Jade Realm. Back then, my puppet and those demons failed to invade that realm, so I don't want to fail a second time, and I will use all means to do so."
