After Shang Chenguan left, Zhuang Qiaoming immediately asked Shang Huaqiang.
"Brother, how did you manage to control the demon emperor of the Netherworld Realm?
As far as I can remember, that old guy was really stubborn, and he never submitted to anyone.
Moreover, I've fought him once before, and he was quite powerful, even though he wasn't a demon cultivator."
"Hahahaha!" Shang Huaqiang burst out laughing after hearing that.
"Brother, their current demon emperor is not the real one, and he is my puppet."
"Oh?" Zhuang Qiaoming and Ying Wu were shocked by Shang Huaqiang's confession.
Fei Qinyuan then told them.
"Actually, that guy was a demon from another realm, and he suddenly appeared in this realm out of nowhere, so my husband immediately captured him.

After some investigation, we learned that he came from the lower realms, and his rank had already reached the emperor rank, but his demon power is too low compared to the demon emperors from the middle and upper realms.
After careful consideration, we decided to brainwash him and send him to one of the demon realms in the upper realms.
Additionally, we provided him with demon-related items, which significantly enhanced his demon power.
After that, he took him to the Netherworld Realm to replace their demon emperor, and he also imprisoned that old stubbornness in a place that demons couldn't reach."
"Hmm?" Zhuang Qiaoming immediately turned to Shang Huaqiang again.
"Where did you imprison that old stubborn?
Is he still alive now?"
Shang Huaqiang nodded to Zhuang Qiaoming before proceeding with his explanation.
"He is still alive, but I used something to seal his demon power and aura, so no one will be able to tell that he is a demon emperor.
As for his imprisonment, I moved him to another realm, and I also left a powerful dog guard to monitor him."
"A place that the demons can't reach?" Zhuang Qiaoming wondered to himself with a frown, but then he remembered a place.
"Don't tell me that you sent him to that realm."
"Hahaha." Shang Huaqiang once again burst out laughing.
"That's right, I sent that stubborn old man to that realm, and he is no different from an ordinary human there."
Ying Wu then asked Fei Qinyuan.
"Did you two use the demons from the Netherworld Realm to avoid those people's eyes?"
"Isn't that the obvious answer?" Fei Qingyuan smiled in response.
"Humans and beasts are eager to obtain the ten-tailed fox's legacy, so we can't act openly.
If we succeed in obtaining it and they find out about it, they will flock to attack us, especially those two heavenly fox ancestors, which will be our downfall.
That's why we use such a method, and our puppet will take care of everything, so we don't have to worry about our safety."

"Unfortunately, we don't know for sure whether the ten-tailed fox's legacy truly exists, especially since Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are his direct descendants." The three of them nodded in agreement with Zhuang Qiaoming.
"For several millennia, many humans, demons, and beasts believed that his legacy was in their hands, and they repeatedly attacked the Heavenly Moon Realm to conquer them.
Unfortunately, those two were truly powerful, and no one had ever succeeded in defeating them."
Shang Huaqiang smirked faintly at that.
"That's why I thought about finding another way to obtain the ten-tailed fox's legacy, and I am absolutely certain that the key lies in the Sky Jade Realm.
Back then, my puppet and those demons failed to invade that realm, so I don't want to fail a second time, and I will use all means to do so."

chapters.title: Chapter 407 A Black Key
paragraphs: After he finished the daily quest, Feltia [2] did not immediately return to Ursula's black castle but instead went to the Endless Death, especially since he still had a quest to find the missing relic.

Sometime ago, Ashreth told Feltia [2] that there were two missing relics in the Amaris Twins' sub-realm. One is inside the black castle, which he believes is Ursula's orb, but it does not complete the quest. That's why he decided to go to the Endless Death, especially since she told him that the second relic was there, and he believed that it was in Tharnon's hands.

After he met Tharnon once, Feltia [2] no longer felt afraid of the Endless Death, and he immediately flew down into the abyss. Even so, he didn't use his light element, especially since the ancient demon beast hated it so much, and he used his fire element to light up the place.
"Hmm?" Tharnon immediately looked up as soon as he saw that. "Why did you come to my place, human?"

"Tharnon, I came here to ask about the relic, and I believe that it is in your hands now." Tharnon scowled in response to Feltia [2]'s words. "I have no intention of taking it from you, especially since it's not that useful to me. However, there is something I can't explain to you, so I hope you can show it to me."
Tharnon nodded before spitting out something from his mouth, which was a black key, and two notifications immediately appeared in Feltia [2]'s mind.
[Ding]
[Quest: Finding a missing relic.]
[Quest rank: Medium.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Medium Gift Pack x1 is sent to the inventory.]
[Ding]
[Quest: Finding one of the ten demon lord seeds.]
[Quest rank: Medium.]
[Reward: Medium Gift Pack x1.]

'One of the demon seeds?' Feltia [2] muttered with a frown. 'Lillea found one of them by chance, and those demon rulers have repeatedly searched for the rest, but they couldn't find them, yet the system assigned me such a task.'

[Master, Lillea managed to obtain one of the ten demon lord seeds, despite her lack of desire or effort to find them. That's why you don't need to think about it, and one of them might summon you by itself later.]
'Yeah, you're right.' Feltia [2] then took the key and questioned Tharnon. "What exactly is this black key? Why is it considered a lost relic?"

Instead, Tharnon let out a heavy sigh. "To tell you the truth, I myself do not know the use of this black key, and the first demon lord gave it to me before he disappeared, but he did not give me any explanation at all.
Since then, I have tried searching all over this realm for a place that only this key can open, but I couldn't find any such place, so I decided to give up and keep it inside my body."

"The first demon lord?" Tharnon nodded to Feltia [2]. "Have you ever tried checking the ancient castle? After all, that castle was his original residence, so I think this key is related to that place."

"I have checked the entire area of the ancient castle, but I can't find anything there." Tharnon's answer caused Feltia [2] to fall into deep thought, and she felt certain that the black key must be used to open one of the places in the Diyu Realm.

"Actually, I don't want to give this key to anyone, including Oz, but I think it would be useless if I kept it, and the mystery of this key would never be solved. I don't know how you can tell that I have it, but you are clearly not an ordinary living being with your three identities, and you might be able to solve the mystery, so you can take it with you.
However, after you solve it, I want you to tell me the result, and I want you to take me to that place."

"All right, I will try to solve the mystery behind this key first, and I will take you to that place immediately after I solve it." Feltia [2] then asked Tharnon again. "Have you ever tried to find one of the ten demon lord seeds?"

"No." Tharnon immediately shook his head at Feltia [2]. "The ten demon lord seeds belonged to my master, and I am his mount, so I am not worthy of any of them. Furthermore, those seeds are not ordinary seeds; they have their own will. Even the first demon lord never looked for them, and they summoned him on their own, so I think it would be a waste if I tried looking for them."
Feltia [2] nodded in understanding and stored the black key into the system inventory. 'Mei, try analyzing that key, and I want you to recheck the entire area of the Diyu realm.'
[Yes, Master.]
"I will take my leave now, Old Demon." After Tharnon nodded to him, Feltia[2] immediately flew out of the abyss.

The ancient demon continued to look at Feltia [2] until he disappeared from his sight, and Tharnon then curled up at the bottom of the abyss again. 'Master, only that human is worthy to replace you as the demon emperor of this realm, and I will pledge my loyalty to him if only he is willing to become the ruler of this realm.
Unfortunately, he doesn't have such an ambition to lead this realm, and his ambition lies in realms far beyond, so I will continue to wait here until someone else worthy appears.'

After she left the Endless Death, Feltia [2] immediately left the Amaris Twins' sub-realm and headed towards the Taurus's sub-realm, especially since Oz had told her that the berserk cockatrice demon's nest was in the eastern part of his sub-realm. Since the demon was only a marquis, and he had reached that rank, he wouldn't have much trouble dealing with it.

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was already in his fox form, but he was using his black fox form with one tail, especially since it would be strange if he used his white fox form with five tails in the Netherworld Realm. His eyes kept on the map, looking at the name Shang Guangming, who was already approaching the east region.
In addition, he continues to absorb the demon aura in that realm, according to Arbeola's teachings. 'Mei, open the medium gift pack.'
[Yes.]
{You got Hellfire Chains x1}
[Hellfire Chains: Chains that burn with the hottest flames of the underworld, capable of binding every living being and burning them to ashes. Grade: Earth Grade]

'Hmm?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows slightly. 'Bind every living creature and burn them to ashes, huh? The effect sounds terrifying, but I didn't believe that I could use it on a cultivator in the seven divine realms, like Shang Guangming.
However, I think I can use it on those who have cultivation in the ten mortal realms like mine, so I will try it later after I return to the Sky Jade Realm.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked up at Arbeola. "Old Demon, what is the current demon emperor's identity? Why can't I track him down?"

"Since the first demon lord, they have always used the name Azaroth, and the current demon lord originally used the name Azaroth the sixth." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a little surprised to hear the name from Arbeola's mouth. "However, he suddenly decided to change his name, and he told us that his current name was a sign of a new era for this realm. Anyway, his current name is Oz the first, and-"

"Are you serious about that?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked in a high voice as he looked at Arbeola with a look of shock, confusing the old tree demon. "As you already know, Angela and the others came from the demon realm in the lower realms, and Oz the first was the demon emperor from the Diyu Realm. However, he disappeared from that realm thousands of years ago, and it was the work of one of his aides.

According to the white Amaris's memories, she used an artifact on him, which sent him randomly to another realm. Since then, none of them, including their current demon emperor, Oz the second, have been able to find his whereabouts."

Arbeola fell silent after he listened to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s explanation, which made him think that all the events were connected to each other. The old demon tree then looked towards the center of the realm, specifically towards the dead forest.

"To tell you the truth, that mysterious living being was sealed in that forest a few days after the current demon emperor announced his new name, and he then changed various orders and rules in this realm afterward. Back then, not a single demon questioned his decision, especially since his face and appearance were no different from usual.

However, his demon power and aura had become much stronger, and he demonstrated his supremacy by eliminating several old demons, such as Yhrer's ancestors and the three succubi duchesses. If your explanation just now is correct, I think that he is an impostor who was deliberately brought to this realm by those two human cultivators, and they sealed the real demon emperor in that forest."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately observed the heart of the dead forest from his map, but the red dot still did not show any information. 'Do you think Arbeola's guess is correct, Mei?'

[Master, this matter is too strange to be a coincidence, so the two may indeed be related to each other, and you can only investigate this matter by going to the demon emperor city. Anyway, you shouldn't go to that city now because the demons there are too strong for you, and Arbeola can't protect you.

Perhaps you can use another method to investigate this matter, which is to establish a relationship with Shang Guangming. However, he is too strong for you, so you have to be careful and alert, lest he suspect you and kill you instantly.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally already understands that. "Old Demon, I want you to ask all the tree demons in the demon emperor city to dig deeper information about the current demon lord, and I will also think of other ways to investigate his true identity. However, I can't do it in a hurry, and it might take me a while to dig out the truth."

"All right." Arbeola nodded in agreement and immediately ordered all the tree demons in demon emperor city to carry out Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s idea, especially since it was the only solution they had for the time being.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked Arbeola again. "Old Demon, do you know anything about the blood demon tree?"

"Hmm?" Arbeola immediately looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately explained to him about the five blood demon trees in the Sky Jade Realm. "The blood demon tree doesn't have a consciousness like me or other tree demons, and the five trees you find in that realm are only a small part of the original.

The original demon tree lives under the demon emperor city, and only the current demon emperor can enter that place. However, he granted the high-ranking demons permission to absorb the demon miasma from that tree, leading to a significant increase in their demon power in recent years. In fact, the tree is not the tree demon of this realm, and the two human cultivators brought it from other realms."

"So those high-ranking demons also use the demon miasma from the blood demon tree to increase their demon power and strength, huh?" Arbeola nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Actually, I have absorbed a lot of that demon miasma, but I didn't get any increase in my demon power, so I feel a little strange about that."

"That's weird." Arbeola was also perplexed by this, until he suddenly recalled something. "Kid, you are indeed a full incubus, but you have two other identities. Moreover, your fox form has pure and strong light power, and it is the eternal enemy of the darkness, so I think it directly purified it so that you can't use the demon miasma to strengthen your demon power."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a heavy sigh upon hearing Arbeola's answer, particularly since he and Mei had also made the same guess. "If only I could use the demon miasma to strengthen my demon power, then I would be strong enough now."

"Hahaha." That made Arbeola laugh. "Kid, you don't have to feel disappointed by that little thing, right? You can't use demon miasma to strengthen your demon power, but you have many extraordinary things in your possession that you can use to improve yourself."

"Well, that's true." Then, Zhang Xiaolong [3] warned Arbeola. "Old Demon, that guy has already arrived in this eastern region, and he seems to have sensed your powerful demon aura, so he's heading over here now."
Arbeola nodded understandingly and alerted all the tree demons in the ghostveil forest, while Zhang Xiaolong [3] also prepared himself to face the worst possibility.

In a few minutes, Shang Guangming finally landed in front of them, but he didn't speak to them right away and scanned the entire forest with his senses. Unfortunately, he couldn't find anything there other than demons, but he was slightly surprised when he sensed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s cultivation. 'A soul realm fox demon?
Could it be that those heavenly foxes came here to chase this weak demon beast cultivator?' "Hey! Did you see some white foxes in this area a while ago?"

"No." Arbeola replied to Shang Guangming with a head shake. "I can't leave this forest; therefore, I've never seen those white foxes, but I learned about their arrival from other tree demons. They came here specifically to chase this little black fox, and I gave him protection because he is a demon fox."

"Hmm?" Shang Guangming frowned after hearing that; he immediately approached Zhang Xiaolong [3] and crouched down in front of him. "Can you understand me? Where did you come from? What exactly is your relationship with those heavenly foxes? Why are they chasing a weak demon fox like you?
They even risk being exposed to the demon aura in this realm just to capture you, so I am sure that you are not an ordinary demon fox."

'Should I answer this guy, Mei? What kind of answers should I give him? We don't have any information about the middle and upper realms, so I'm at a loss as to what to say to him.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked the AI while glancing worriedly at Shang Guangming.

chapters.title: Chapter 408 Talk
paragraphs: Seeing that Zhang Xiaolong [3] seemed to be afraid of him, Shang Guangming immediately spoke to him again. "Hey! You are merely a weakling in my eyes, and I can kill you directly if I want. However, you're lucky because my parents strictly forbid me from killing cultivators in the ten mortal realms, and I also have no interest in killing people weaker than me, so you don't need to be afraid of me.
Instead, I might be able to help you fight those arrogant foxes, but I want to know the reason they chased you to this realm first."

'Tch! Two-faced man! Do you think I don't know about the rotten things deep in your soul?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly grumbled because he had already checked Shang Guangming's soul with his demon eyes. Arbeola could only shake his head at that, so he immediately pointed north. "The Demon Emperor City is in that region, so you guys can go there directly. However, all of you should act low-key, or your presence will be detected by the demon emperor and his personal guards, and you guys will suffer if you get caught by them.
Moreover, those two human cultivators are much stronger than them, and they can kill you guys easily."
They nodded in understanding to Arbeola, but Zygoz immediately grabbed Tharnon and Ursula by the shoulders, and he immediately took them north through the portals he created repeatedly.

"A sorcerer demon, huh? His race is quite rare, and there are only a handful of them in this realm." Arbeola muttered as he watched Zygoz's portals quickly disappear by themselves. "Even though his demon rank has already reached the emperor rank, he is just as weak as Ursula, and his abilities will probably be useless against them.
Fortunately, that ancient demon beast is by their side, and he seems to have unsual abilities, so they should be fine there."
Although he was confident in Tharnon's abilities, Arbeola still ordered the other tree demons to watch over them, as well as to save them if they faced danger in the demon emperor city.

Her bright purple eyes, her shoulder-length curly purplish black hair, and her wide lips covered in purple give her a menacing appearance.
Additionally, she has two black wings on her back, which are similar to a crow's wings.

"Why are you here, Morgana? Didn't I forbid you to show yourself?" The demon emperor asked as he frowned. "Moreover, the two human cultivators are in this realm right now, and they will surely capture you if they realize you are here."

"Hey, I've been keeping you company ever since those people sent you to my realm, remember? Morgana then moved in front of the demon emperor in the blink of an eye, and she immediately embraced his arm as she pulled him to the edge of the balcony.

"You are a celestial demon race, which is one of the strongest demon races in this universe, but your situation is truly miserable, and you can't even go against the orders of those humans. Back then, you had already reached the emperor rank, but your demon power was too weak compared to the demon emperor of my realm, and those people sent you to my realm to strengthen yourself.

The first time I met you, I immediately realized that you had lost your true self, and you were always confused about your situation. You knew that your name was Oz the 1st, but you couldn't remember anything about yourself. At that time, I suspected that they had erased your past memories, so I decided to accompany you to assess your situation, and the result was true that they did that to you.

They even brainwashed you, but I managed to reverse it, so you can return to being you. Unfortunately, I couldn't help you to restore your past memories, and several thousand years have passed, but I still haven't managed to do it."

Oz the 1st took a deep breath and hugged Morgana's waist before planting a gentle kiss on her lips. "I am truly grateful to have met you; if not for your help, I would have continued to live as their puppet. Unfortunately, they have implanted their slave mark in my soul, so I can never defy their orders, even though I have returned to being myself."

"Yeah." Morgana nodded and laid her head on Oz the first's shoulder. "Don't worry, I will keep trying to find a way to remove their slave mark from you, and I will free you from their clutches, so we can leave this realm and enjoy our lives together."

"All right, I leave that to you, my lady demon witch." Morgana smiled at that, and Oz the 1st told her about the strange feeling he had just felt, causing her to look up at him in surprise. "Do you think my strange feeling has something to do with my past memories?
For the past thousand years, I have never felt such a feeling, but it suddenly came out on its own today, and it's causing me a little unease."

"Yes." Morgana nodded to Oz first before looking far away, and she immediately stretched her right hand forward. Instantly, a few black crows appeared in her palm, and they immediately flew away at full speed after she whispered a few things to them.

"If my guess is right, there is something or someone related to your past memories in this realm, and that something or someone may have just arrived here today, so you are just experiencing that feeling now."
"I see." Oz the 1st nodded in understanding to Morgana.

"Those two have contacted their seniors, and they will arrive in this realm in a week, so I have to move quickly." Morgana then kissed Oz the 1st's lips first before getting out of his embraces. "My crows won't necessarily be able to find that something or someone, so I will also move on my own to look for it, and you can go back inside to take care of those foolish demons."

"All right." Morgana instantly disappeared from the beam, and Oz the first rushed back inside, but his mind was preoccupied by the feeling from earlier, which kept making him wonder about his true identity. 'I hope she can help me find it so I can return to being my complete self.'

"Stop!" Tharnon suddenly shouted at Zygoz, making him immediately stop creating the portal, and the three of them floated in the air. "Hey! I think Zhang Fei's guess is correct: the demon emperor of this realm is my master."
"Are you sure about that?" Zygoz and Ursula asked Tharnon at the same time.

"Yes." Tharnon nodded to them. "My master and I have something special in our souls that ties us to each other. The closer we get to the Demon Emperor City, the more I can feel his presence, so I am completely certain that guy is him. Moreover, I also sensed a strong demon aura coming from that city, and its owner has already left the place.
Perhaps that person has already noticed our presence, and he or she seems to intend to look for us, so we should hide for now, especially since we are not his or her match.
Ursula immediately said to Zygoz. "Take us into hiding, Old Man."

Zygoz nodded in agreement and used his other abilities, and a special portal appeared in front of them. "Let's go in! This portal connects us to my sub-dimension, but we don't know the identity or demon race of the owner of the aura, and that person might be able to see through it, so we still have to be careful of that person."

Tharnon and Ursula nodded at him before they entered the portal, and Zygoz immediately closed it. However, they did not realize that one of Morgana's black crows had already noticed them, and it immediately informed her of their presence.

chapters.title: Chapter 410 Talk With Morgana
paragraphs: A while later, Morgana had arrived at the place where the three demons disappeared, and she smiled faintly as she looked at where Zygoz had created his portal earlier.

Despite being separated by a different dimension, the demons hiding inside Zygoz's sub-dimension instantly froze as they sensed that Morgana could see them. Her next words shocked them, especially the Libra. "A sorcerer demon and a devourer demon, huh? As for the other one, you should be an archdemon boar, right?
Your demon races are truly unusual, and there are only a few of your kind in this universe."

Zygoz, Ursula, and Tharnon were completely shocked by Morgana's words, especially since the other demons weren't supposed to be able to see them, yet she could see them and recognize their identities at a glance.

"Since you guys don't want to come out, then I'll go in there." Morgana then pulled out a dagger with a black hilt and a purple blade, slicing through the air to reveal the three demons who appeared terrified of her. She then stepped straight into the hole before it vanished. "Are you three surprised by my abilities?
I'm not an ordinary demon; I'm a mix of a demon and a witch, and I'm also a demon cultivator, so I have many abilities that other demons don't have."
Tharnon and Zygoz were surprised to hear that, but the case was different with Ursula because they could feel that Morgana was indeed a demon cultivator, especially since they were demon cultivators.

"Moreover, one of my black crows has been watching you three since earlier, so it's too easy for me to find you guys." Morgana spoke again, as they continued to remain silent. "Anyway, I came to meet you three not because I wanted to capture you guys, but because I wanted to confirm something."

Tharnon was the first to react, and he replied directly to Morgana. "I've heard of those witches, but they usually live in their own sub-realm and rarely show themselves. However, I've never heard of a mixed breed of a witch and a demon, especially since they also hate demons."
"Haha." Morgana laughed softly when she heard that. "The pureblood witch has long been extinct, so only mixed-breeds like me are left in this universe, but there are only a few of us."
"Hmm?" Morgana's answer made Tharnon raise his eyebrows.

"You seem to have lived in the lower realms for too long, so you don't know many things that happen in the upper realms." Morgana then pointed her finger at Tharnon's chest as she chanted something, causing his soul to leave his body by itself.
Ursula and Zygoz wanted to move to help their friend, but Morgana immediately restricted their movements, rendering them unable to move or speak, especially since she was much stronger than them.
"So it's true, huh? I had suspected that something in this realm was causing my husband to be restless, and it turns out you were the source.

Otherwise, this black mark from the celestial demon race wouldn't be in your soul, proving his trust to you." Zygoz and Ursula were even more shocked by that, but Morgana immediately returned Tharnon's soul into his body, causing him to become even more frightened of her, especially since he couldn't do anything when she took out his soul. "What is your relationship with Oz the 1st?"
"Huh?" The three demons looked at Morgana in surprise. "How do you know that name?"

Morgana sighed softly while shaking her head, but she immediately told them. "Oz the 1st is my husband, and I met him in the upper realms. However, I met him in bad condition because someone had erased his memories, and that guy had also brainwashed him. Even so, he returned to normal after I reversed it, but he couldn't remember his past, and he only remembered his name."
Unlike Ursula and Zygoz, who looked excited after listening to Morgana's explanation, Tharnon instead stood frozen in his spot because his feelings became mixed after hearing that.

For thousands of years, Tharnon always thought that Oz the 1st had died, but some time ago Zhang Fei told him that there was a possibility that his master was still alive and living somewhere out there. Even so, he didn't dare to hope too much at that time because he couldn't leave the Diyu Realm to go look for him, especially since he was too weak for that.

Unconsciously, blood dripped from Tharnon's eyes, but his expression transformed into relief upon discovering that Oz the 1st was still alive. "Where... where is my master now? Is... is he really the person disguised as the demon emperor of this realm? I am his mount, and I have sworn allegiance to him.
Even so, he never treated me as a mount, and he always treated me like his own brother, so we planted our marks in each other's souls as a sign of our brotherhood."

"I already knew that." Morgana nodded in response to Tharnon. "Just as his mark is in your soul, I have long been aware of the presence of your mark in his soul. Unfortunately, he couldn't remember about it, and he was always in pain whenever he tried to remember his past, so I never forced him to remember it again.

However, your arrival in this realm changed the situation, and he could feel your presence from afar, which made him restless. Anyway, how did you know that he disguised himself as the demon emperor of this realm? How did the three of you come to this realm?
Since all of you are demons from the lower realms, and the strength of the three of you is also still too low, so you guys should not have been able to come here."
"That's-"

Ursula immediately stopped Tharnon, and they answered Morgana's questions. "A powerful demon came to our home realm, and he has helped us a lot, including finding out that the first demon emperor is still alive.

However, he only knew that Oz the 1st had been sent to other realms by someone, and he couldn't track his whereabouts, especially since that person used an artifact to send him away randomly. For thousands of years, we all thought he was dead, but he is still alive, and he even has a powerful wife like you. As for the demon's identity, we cannot tell you about it, or he will punish us."

"That's true." Zygoz joined in to confirm Ursula's words. "That demon came from other realms, and his strength even exceeds that of an emperor or empress like us, so I hope you won't force us to reveal his identity to you, or he will punish us. Anyway, he was the one who brought us to this realm, especially after he got information about Oz the 1st impersonating the demon emperor of this realm.
However, he had urgent business, so he left us in this realm, and he asked us to investigate the truth ourselves."

"All right, I don't want to put you guys in trouble, so I won't ask anything, even though I'm curious about the demon's identity." Morgana then told them about what happened to Oz the 1st. "The artifact sent my husband to the Red Sun Realm, one of the realms in the upper realms, and the leader of that realm immediately captured him.

Anyway, his name is Shang Huaqiang, and he is a powerful cultivator; even I couldn't defeat him because he was too strong. After he erased my husband's past memories and brainwashed him, he sent him to my realm to strengthen him. Fortunately, I found him when he wandered around my private place, and I realized his situation immediately, so I decided to help him.
Since then, I have accompanied him for thousands of years, and I decided to become his wife."
"Thank... you... for saving my master."
"You don't need to do such a thing with me." Morgana immediately stopped Tharnon, who wanted to kneel before her. "Since my husband regards you as his brother, then you are also my brother.

Unfortunately, his situation is still not too good, especially since Shang Huaqiang also planted a slave mark into his soul, and I have tried many times to remove it, but it is too strong, and my efforts have always been in vain."

Tharnon, Ursula, and Zygoz were shocked by Morgana's confession that Oz the 1st was enslaved by a human. Instantly, their anger overflowed because he was their emperor, and he had brought great changes to their realm in the past, including stopping people who intended to invade their realm, which made their lives safer and more orderly.

Morgana immediately spoke to them again. "I understand the feelings of the three of you, but you guys can't do anything to help my husband. In fact, I never appear directly by his side, and I always protect him from behind the darkness.

Moreover, you guys can't fight me with my cultivation at the lower level of the seven divine realms, let alone if you want to face Shang Huaqiang with his cultivations at the upper level of the seven divine realms, and you will definitely die before you can even blink your eyes.

For the time being, we can only wait for the right time to save him from his hands, and you guys shouldn't approach the demon emperor city, especially since two of his men are in this realm now, and they will kill you immediately if they find out about your relationship with my husband."

They naturally understood that because Zhang Fei had told them about it, so they did not refute Morgana's words. Nevertheless, Tharnon spoke directly to her. "Can you take me with you? Since you have the witch abilities, I'm sure you can turn me into something else, and they definitely won't be able to detect my presence.

Furthermore, you stated that my master reacted to my presence in this realm, so I might be able to help him regain his past memories if I'm living nearby, especially since the bond between us is very strong."

"Haha." Morgana laughed, twirling her index finger at Tharnon, who quickly transformed into a black crow, stunning Ursula and Zygoz. She pulled him to her before perching him on her shoulders, and she then said to the other two. "I'll take your friend with me, and you two should hurry away from this area to hide."

"Wait a minute!" When Morgana was about to cut through the air, Zygoz immediately stopped her. "Can you tell us about Shang Huaqiang's purpose in sending your husband here to impersonate the demon emperor of this realm?"

Morgana nodded and gave them a direct explanation. "Shang Huaqiang has sky-high ambitions, and he wants to rule the upper realms. However, there were many cultivators stronger than him there, so he needed cannon fodders to help him fight them, and the demons from this realm were one of his targets.

That's why he sent my husband here to take over this realm, and he sealed the real demon emperor in a place that only he knows. Additionally, he also ordered him to use these demons to invade other realms, and my husband was unable to refuse his order due to the slave mark in his soul. Many of their plans ended in success, and many also failed, but they still haven't given up."
Ursula wanted to ask Morgana something, but she swallowed it back immediately, and she wanted to discuss with Zhang Fei first, especially since it was related to him and the Sky Jade Realm.

"Anyway, those two brats have already asked their seniors for help, and I heard that they will arrive in this realm in a few days, so you two should be more careful." After she said that, Morgana immediately slashed the air, and she swiftly took Tharnon to leave Zygoz's sub-dimension for the demon emperor city.
She couldn't wait to reunite the ancient demon beast with Oz the 1st, and she hoped that his presence could gradually restore her husband's past memories.

Zygoz also immediately took Ursula out of his sub-dimension. "We can't do anything right now, so I think it would be better if we go back to the forest and wait for Zhang Fei there, and we can discuss this matter with him later."

"Yeah, you're right." Ursula then looked towards the demon emperor city. "Even though Oz the 1st's situation is very bad, at least he is still alive now, and this is very good news for us. I believe Zhang Fei can help us recover his past memories and free him from Shang Huaqiang's control, so we will go back there now and wait for him.

Moreover, Old Demon Arbeola can help you absorb the demon aura in this realm, which will increase your demon power by severalfold. If our strength increases further and the first demon lord returns to our side, then we will no longer need to be afraid of facing the people from the Xian and Tian Realms, and we will destroy them all in the future."

"Hahaha!" Zygoz laughed at that. "You're right, I myself can't wait to destroy them, especially the Throne. Fortunately, Zhang Fei is on our side and has given us so much help, or else our strength will continue to be stuck, and we will have to continue to live on high alert against those people."

Ursula nodded in agreement with that. "We dare not imagine if Zhang Fei was sided with our enemies, and he would definitely be a terrifying scourge for us. Although he is still weaker than us, his progress is too terrifying, and his demon rank has even reached the marquis rank in just nearly three months.
Sooner or later, he will definitely surpass us all, so we are truly grateful that he is on our side. Anyway, let's return now, and I want to continue absorbing this demon aura."
"All right." Zygoz then grabbed Ursula's shoulder, and he repeatedly created portals to return to the ghostveil forest.
Meanwhile, Morgana had brought Tharnon to the demon emperor city, but she forbade him from approaching Oz the 1st.

Tharnon didn't mind it because he was aware of the situation, and he was happy to see Oz the 1st, who was sitting in front of the high-ranking demons from a distance. Even tears kept falling from his eyes as he spoke softly. "Thousands of years have passed since I last saw him, but he still looks the same as in the past, and his appearance is the same as before.
However, his attitude is much colder than before, and I think he acted like that on purpose because he didn't want to make Shang Huaqiang suspicious of him."

"That's right." Morgana nodded in agreement with Tharnon. "At first, he was also cold to me, but his attitude warmed up after I reversed his condition, and I really enjoyed my time with him. However, our situation changed again because Shang Huaqiang brought him here, and I deliberately followed him here to look after him, especially since he's such a baby boy."

"Hahaha!" Tharnon laughed when he heard Morgana call Oz the 1st like that. "He's actually too gentle, and he always treats all of the demons in our realm equally. However, he can also be very cruel when facing our enemies, and he single-handedly slaughters hundreds or even thousands of enemies who try to invade our realm."
Morgana then turned to Tharnon. "Since he has no memories of his past, I don't know much about his past, so I want you to tell me all about it."
"Sure."

sentences.text: A while later, Morgana had arrived at the place where the three demons disappeared, and she smiled faintly as she looked at where Zygoz had created his portal earlier.
Despite being separated by a different dimension, the demons hiding inside Zygoz's sub-dimension instantly froze as they sensed that Morgana could see them.
Her next words shocked them, especially the Libra.
"A sorcerer demon and a devourer demon, huh?
As for the other one, you should be an archdemon boar, right?
Your demon races are truly unusual, and there are only a few of your kind in this universe."

Zygoz, Ursula, and Tharnon were completely shocked by Morgana's words, especially since the other demons weren't supposed to be able to see them, yet she could see them and recognize their identities at a glance.

"Since you guys don't want to come out, then I'll go in there." Morgana then pulled out a dagger with a black hilt and a purple blade, slicing through the air to reveal the three demons who appeared terrified of her.
She then stepped straight into the hole before it vanished.
"Are you three surprised by my abilities?
I'm not an ordinary demon; I'm a mix of a demon and a witch, and I'm also a demon cultivator, so I have many abilities that other demons don't have."
Tharnon and Zygoz were surprised to hear that, but the case was different with Ursula because they could feel that Morgana was indeed a demon cultivator, especially since they were demon cultivators.
"Moreover, one of my black crows has been watching you three since earlier, so it's too easy for me to find you guys." Morgana spoke again, as they continued to remain silent.
"Anyway, I came to meet you three not because I wanted to capture you guys, but because I wanted to confirm something."
Tharnon was the first to react, and he replied directly to Morgana.
"I've heard of those witches, but they usually live in their own sub-realm and rarely show themselves.
However, I've never heard of a mixed breed of a witch and a demon, especially since they also hate demons."
"Haha." Morgana laughed softly when she heard that.
"The pureblood witch has long been extinct, so only mixed-breeds like me are left in this universe, but there are only a few of us."
"Hmm?" Morgana's answer made Tharnon raise his eyebrows.

"You seem to have lived in the lower realms for too long, so you don't know many things that happen in the upper realms." Morgana then pointed her finger at Tharnon's chest as she chanted something, causing his soul to leave his body by itself.
Ursula and Zygoz wanted to move to help their friend, but Morgana immediately restricted their movements, rendering them unable to move or speak, especially since she was much stronger than them.
"So it's true, huh?
I had suspected that something in this realm was causing my husband to be restless, and it turns out you were the source.

Otherwise, this black mark from the celestial demon race wouldn't be in your soul, proving his trust to you." Zygoz and Ursula were even more shocked by that, but Morgana immediately returned Tharnon's soul into his body, causing him to become even more frightened of her, especially since he couldn't do anything when she took out his soul.
"What is your relationship with Oz the 1st?"
"Huh?" The three demons looked at Morgana in surprise.
"How do you know that name?"
Morgana sighed softly while shaking her head, but she immediately told them.
"Oz the 1st is my husband, and I met him in the upper realms.
However, I met him in bad condition because someone had erased his memories, and that guy had also brainwashed him.
Even so, he returned to normal after I reversed it, but he couldn't remember his past, and he only remembered his name."
Unlike Ursula and Zygoz, who looked excited after listening to Morgana's explanation, Tharnon instead stood frozen in his spot because his feelings became mixed after hearing that.

For thousands of years, Tharnon always thought that Oz the 1st had died, but some time ago Zhang Fei told him that there was a possibility that his master was still alive and living somewhere out there.
Even so, he didn't dare to hope too much at that time because he couldn't leave the Diyu Realm to go look for him, especially since he was too weak for that.
Unconsciously, blood dripped from Tharnon's eyes, but his expression transformed into relief upon discovering that Oz the 1st was still alive.
"Where... where is my master now?
Is... is he really the person disguised as the demon emperor of this realm?
I am his mount, and I have sworn allegiance to him.
Even so, he never treated me as a mount, and he always treated me like his own brother, so we planted our marks in each other's souls as a sign of our brotherhood."
"I already knew that." Morgana nodded in response to Tharnon.
"Just as his mark is in your soul, I have long been aware of the presence of your mark in his soul.
Unfortunately, he couldn't remember about it, and he was always in pain whenever he tried to remember his past, so I never forced him to remember it again.
However, your arrival in this realm changed the situation, and he could feel your presence from afar, which made him restless.
Anyway, how did you know that he disguised himself as the demon emperor of this realm?
How did the three of you come to this realm?
Since all of you are demons from the lower realms, and the strength of the three of you is also still too low, so you guys should not have been able to come here."
"That's-"
Ursula immediately stopped Tharnon, and they answered Morgana's questions.
"A powerful demon came to our home realm, and he has helped us a lot, including finding out that the first demon emperor is still alive.
However, he only knew that Oz the 1st had been sent to other realms by someone, and he couldn't track his whereabouts, especially since that person used an artifact to send him away randomly.
For thousands of years, we all thought he was dead, but he is still alive, and he even has a powerful wife like you.
As for the demon's identity, we cannot tell you about it, or he will punish us."
"That's true." Zygoz joined in to confirm Ursula's words.
"That demon came from other realms, and his strength even exceeds that of an emperor or empress like us, so I hope you won't force us to reveal his identity to you, or he will punish us.
Anyway, he was the one who brought us to this realm, especially after he got information about Oz the 1st impersonating the demon emperor of this realm.
However, he had urgent business, so he left us in this realm, and he asked us to investigate the truth ourselves."
"All right, I don't want to put you guys in trouble, so I won't ask anything, even though I'm curious about the demon's identity." Morgana then told them about what happened to Oz the 1st.
"The artifact sent my husband to the Red Sun Realm, one of the realms in the upper realms, and the leader of that realm immediately captured him.
Anyway, his name is Shang Huaqiang, and he is a powerful cultivator; even I couldn't defeat him because he was too strong.
After he erased my husband's past memories and brainwashed him, he sent him to my realm to strengthen him.
Fortunately, I found him when he wandered around my private place, and I realized his situation immediately, so I decided to help him.
Since then, I have accompanied him for thousands of years, and I decided to become his wife."
"Thank... you... for saving my master."
"You don't need to do such a thing with me." Morgana immediately stopped Tharnon, who wanted to kneel before her.
"Since my husband regards you as his brother, then you are also my brother.

Unfortunately, his situation is still not too good, especially since Shang Huaqiang also planted a slave mark into his soul, and I have tried many times to remove it, but it is too strong, and my efforts have always been in vain."
Tharnon, Ursula, and Zygoz were shocked by Morgana's confession that Oz the 1st was enslaved by a human.

Instantly, their anger overflowed because he was their emperor, and he had brought great changes to their realm in the past, including stopping people who intended to invade their realm, which made their lives safer and more orderly.
Morgana immediately spoke to them again.
"I understand the feelings of the three of you, but you guys can't do anything to help my husband.
In fact, I never appear directly by his side, and I always protect him from behind the darkness.

Moreover, you guys can't fight me with my cultivation at the lower level of the seven divine realms, let alone if you want to face Shang Huaqiang with his cultivations at the upper level of the seven divine realms, and you will definitely die before you can even blink your eyes.

For the time being, we can only wait for the right time to save him from his hands, and you guys shouldn't approach the demon emperor city, especially since two of his men are in this realm now, and they will kill you immediately if they find out about your relationship with my husband."
They naturally understood that because Zhang Fei had told them about it, so they did not refute Morgana's words.
Nevertheless, Tharnon spoke directly to her.
"Can you take me with you?
Since you have the witch abilities, I'm sure you can turn me into something else, and they definitely won't be able to detect my presence.

Furthermore, you stated that my master reacted to my presence in this realm, so I might be able to help him regain his past memories if I'm living nearby, especially since the bond between us is very strong."
"Haha." Morgana laughed, twirling her index finger at Tharnon, who quickly transformed into a black crow, stunning Ursula and Zygoz.
She pulled him to her before perching him on her shoulders, and she then said to the other two.
"I'll take your friend with me, and you two should hurry away from this area to hide."
"Wait a minute!" When Morgana was about to cut through the air, Zygoz immediately stopped her.
"Can you tell us about Shang Huaqiang's purpose in sending your husband here to impersonate the demon emperor of this realm?"
Morgana nodded and gave them a direct explanation.
"Shang Huaqiang has sky-high ambitions, and he wants to rule the upper realms.
However, there were many cultivators stronger than him there, so he needed cannon fodders to help him fight them, and the demons from this realm were one of his targets.
That's why he sent my husband here to take over this realm, and he sealed the real demon emperor in a place that only he knows.
Additionally, he also ordered him to use these demons to invade other realms, and my husband was unable to refuse his order due to the slave mark in his soul.
Many of their plans ended in success, and many also failed, but they still haven't given up."
