chapters.title: Chapter 411 Hu Qiaomu - Xing Mei
paragraphs: After they had searched for the heavenly fox for a day and had no results, the two men from the Shang Clan decided to return to the Demon Emperor City, and Shang Guangming immediately informed Shang Yaolin about his encounter with Zhang Xiaolong [3], which surprised his sister. "Why didn't you bring him here, brother?

If that kid is really a descendant of those foxes, then you should have brought him here. That way, Uncle Chenguang can do something to him when he arrives in this realm, and our patriarch will definitely reward us handsomely if we can do that, especially since he has always wanted to defeat Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, and our family's status will also rise because of it."

"I understand, but that child is still too young, and bringing him to this city, especially with so many powerful demons here, will cause him stress. Therefore, I have decided to let him stay in the ghostveil forest for the time being." Shang Yaolin frowned for a moment, but she did not refute her brother, and Shang Guangming spoke to her again.

"He is indeed their descendant, but he is still weak, and we can find him easily, so you don't need to think too much about it. After we successfully invade the Sky Jade Realm, we will bring him back with us to our realm and hand him over to our patriarch to get our rewards."
Shang Yaolin nodded in agreement with that. "All right, we'll finish our business in this realm first, and then we'll bring him back to our realm."

After that, Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin immediately entered the castle to join Oz the 1st, especially since their patriarch was increasingly losing patience to control the Sky Jade Realm, so they had to speed up their plans to invade that realm.

The two demons from The Diyu Realm had arrived at the ghostveil forest, and they explained to Arbeola about their encounter with Morgana. However, the old tree demon had already gotten information about the matter from the tree demons living in that area, but he was still shocked by their story about Oz the 1st and the demon emperor of the Netherworld Realm.
"I didn't expect the situation to be so complicated, but that kid might have the ability to restore your emperor's old memories."

"Yeah." Ursula nodded in agreement with Arbeola. "We also believe that Zhang Fei can do it, but it's not easy because we have to face cultivators from the upper realms, and all of them are much stronger than Morgana."

Zygoz then also spoke to Arbeola. "Old demon, I feel a little dilemma regarding this matter, especially since those people used our emperor to invade the Sky Jade Realm, where Zhang Fei and his closest people reside. If he knew about this matter, he probably wouldn't be willing to help us, and he might turn against us."

"Hahaha!" Arbeola laughed at Zygoz's words. "Do you think that kid is that kind of person? I've only known him for a few days, but I can tell you that your worries are unwarranted, and I'm sure that he can distinguish between right and wrong.
Moreover, he has a special relationship with these little girls, and he must have considered all of you as his close friends, so you don't need to worry about that."

Zygoz sighed softly and nodded at Arbeola. "Zhang Fei seems to be busy right now, so I will wait for him to come here and tell him everything later, and I hope he will be willing to help us restore our emperor's memories."

"I will teach you how to absorb the demon aura in this realm, like these little girls, so you can rely more on yourself to help your emperor." Zygoz immediately put on a serious expression as he listened to Arbeola's explanation about it, which surprised him a little, especially since it was a little different from the way he had he usually does to absorb the demon aura in the diyu realm.

After he finished explaining everything, Arbeola immediately asked Ursula and Zygoz to enter the room below him so they could focus on absorbing the demon aura without any disturbance. Moreover, other powerful cultivators from the upper realms would also arrive in the realm soon, and he didn't want those people to discover their presence in the forest.

After two days of travel, Hu Qiaomu finally arrived in the western region, so she immediately rushed to meet Hu Hong and Hu Qianli, but she was angry because she couldn't find Hu Xiufu there. "Where is he going?"

"Elder, Xiufu has been missing for several days, and we've been looking for her everywhere, but we couldn't find her. We've also tried to contact her through voice transmission, but she didn't respond to our calls at all." Hu Qianli's response even infuriated Hu Qiaomu.

Hu Hong also provided a detailed explanation to Hu Qiaomu. "Elder, as soon as we arrived in this region, we immediately went to the Chu Clan to look for Zhang Fei, but the clan's protectors blocked us, and nobody answered us.
That's why we decided to stay in this hotel while monitoring the clan, but Xiufu didn't join us, and she wanted to wait for him in front of the clan, yet we didn't see her again after that."

"Hmm?" Hu Qiaomu immediately looked out the window, towards the Chu Clan, and she used her senses to check the clan. However, she was surprised to see that the clan's protection was gone since it had been destroyed by Tian Jiyuan a few days ago, and she also couldn't find any clan members there except for maids and guards. "Have you two tried going to the clan again?"

"Yes." Both female moon foxes nodded to Hu Qiaomu. "We have been there for the past few days, but the guards informed us that the clan members have been absent for a little over a week, and none of them were aware of their departure. Since then, we have continued to monitor the clan, but they still haven't returned."

"That's weird." Hu Qiaomu muttered to herself before checking the other two major clans, but she was even more confused after she couldn't find Yan Huan'er in the Ye Clan, and the clan was also so quiet, especially since the guards had yet to recover from the injuries they received from Tian Gongzhu.
Hu Qiaomu then checked into the Gu Clan and found Xing Mei sitting alone in the garden, but she looked anxious, and she seemed to be waiting for someone. "I will go to the Gu Clan now."

"Wait a minute, elder." Hu Qiaomu immediately turned to Hu Hong, who then explained to her about the strange situation he and Hu Qianli experienced while they were under the influence of Tian Gongzhu's ability. "Don't you two remember anything about that?"

Both of them responded by shaking their heads. Hu Qianli then spoke. "We have tried to remember everything that happened during those five days, but we still can't remember anything. At first, we thought that it was Zhang Fei who did that to us, but we seemed to have guessed wrong because he hadn't come back for a long time.
We thought someone else had done it to us, and that person probably also kidnapped Xiufu."

'Who did that to them? Why did that person kidnap Xiufu? Could it be that the person was Zhang Fei's person? Why didn't that person kidnap these two girls as well?' Hu Qiaomu then said to them. "I will go to the Gu Clan, and I will check out this region to investigate the matter afterwards."
"Yes, Elder."

After their elder disappeared, Hu Qianli asked Hu Hong. "Do you feel something strange in your body? I've been experiencing strange sensations in my body since I woke up three days ago, and I often feel like someone is groping my body."

"Yes." Hu Hong nodded in agreement with that. "I've personally experienced the same thing as you, and I can feel a strange sensation lingering in my body, which makes me really uncomfortable. At first, I thought Zhang Fei came to us, and he secretly used his dual-cultivation abilities on us. However, the Chu Clan's guard said that he hasn't returned, so I have my doubts about it.
Forget it; we don't need to think too much about it, and it will definitely disappear by itself soon."
Hu Qianli sighed heavily after hearing that. "I hope Elder Qiaomu can find Xiufu because she is very kind, and I don't want anything bad to happen to her."

Hu Qiaomu had arrived at the Chu Clan, and her sudden arrival surprised Xing Mei, who immediately asked her, "Why have you come to this region all of a sudden, Elder? Has there been a change in plans?"
"No." Hu Qiaomu then sat in front of Xing Mei and asked her. "Did anything happen in this city a week ago? Why can't I find Liu Qingyu and Yan Huan'er in the Chu and Ye Clans?"
"Honestly, I don't know Huan'er's whereabouts, especially since she left alone without telling me her destination, and she still hasn't returned." Xing Mei's answer made Hu Qiaomu raise her eyebrows.

"As for Qingyu and the others, Zhang Fei probably hid them in a special place because there were some people looking for him, and they wanted to capture him, so he must have done that to keep them safe."

"Oh?" Hu Qiaomu was surprised that there were people who wanted to capture Zhang Fei, especially since his relationship with those powerful clans had already become public knowledge. "Do you know the identities of those people?"

Xing Mei nodded to Hu Qiaomu before explaining. "Qingyu told me that they are heavenly foxes that came from another realm, and one of them told me that Zhang Fei's fox race is also a heavenly fox like them."
"What?" Hu Qiaomu exclaimed in shock after hearing that. "Are you sure that they are heavenly foxes?"
"Yes." Xing Mei nodded to Hu Qiaomu once again. "One of them was called Tian Gongzhu, and she told me that Zhang Fei was the mastermind behind her brother's death, so she wanted to capture him."

However, Hu Qiaomu felt strange about Xing Mei's attitude, especially since she was very close to the people from the Chu and Ye Clan, who were Zhang Fei's family, so she shouldn't have told her about the matter. "Why did you tell me about the matter?"
"Haha." Xing Mei laughed softly and told Hu Qiaomu everything, especially about Gu Zhan's death. "You should already understand my intentions, right?"

'This woman is already blinded by revenge, huh? However, I didn't expect that Zhang Fei also had a divine beast by his side, but he was a heavenly fox, so it was easy for him to do that. I think those people were the ones who did that to Hu Hong and Hu Qianli, and they were probably the ones who kidnapped Hu Xiufu.' Hu Qiaomu then questioned Xing Mei once more.
"Are you telling me this matter because you hope that we will help you take revenge on them?"

"Yes." Xing Mei immediately admitted it. "At first, I leaked information about Zhang Fei to Tian Gongzhu in hopes that she could help me kill Boitata, but my hopes seemed to be in vain because she didn't come here again after that, and they seemed to have left this realm. Moreover, you seemed to want to do something to him as well, so I was hoping that you could help me."

"You are right; we do have certain goals for Zhang Fei." Hu Qiaomu nodded to Xing Mei. "We had already guessed that his bloodline was higher than ours, and my leader sent me to the region to investigate his identity. However, I never expected that he was a heavenly fox, and his presence in the realm would threaten us, so we had to do something about him to ensure our safety."

Xing Mei smiled and propped her chin up. "I don't care about Zhang Fei, and you can do whatever you want with him. However, I hope you will hand over his contract beast to me, so I can avenge my son's death on her."
"Sure." Hu Qiaomu immediately agreed with that. "I will convey this matter to my leader, and I will convince him to hand over Zhang Fei's contract beast to you in exchange for this information."
After they talked about some other things, Hu Qiaomu immediately left the Gu Clan to return to the inn, and Xing Mei smiled in satisfaction at her decision.
Since they were all busy with their own affairs, time passed quite quickly in the Sky Jade Realm and the Netherworld Realm, and three days had passed since the demons met Morgana.

For the past three days, Zhang Fei has been dual cultivating with all his wives in the cloud manor, and his first clone has never stopped to dual-cultivate his partners in the portable mansion, which made his cultivation break through to 6-Star Soul Realm.
Meanwhile, his fourth clone has been completing the daily quests that appear every day, and he has not forgotten to practice and learn all the things he has not mastered perfectly.
The flow of time in the training space, which is two times faster than the outside world, has a significant impact on everyone, including Zhang Chen and the others who almost never stop training.
Unlike them, Ye Lian and Zhao Ziqin decided to join Zhang Fei after they were stuck with their training, but they still have not dual-cultivated with him, and they only do intimate things with him.

In the black castle, Feltia [2] spent his time with the Amaris Twins and Nadea to increase his demon power, causing the three of them to always be overwhelmed to serve him. He did not forget to dual-cultivate with Eve, Fyr, Leora, and Ashreth, which made the cultivation of the four female demons continue to increase.

In the Lust Inn, Zhang Xiaolong [3] also repeatedly had fun with Xenaya, but they did not do it continuously because the succubus had many responsibilities, and he also had to repeatedly go to the Succubi Tower to do other things.

Even so, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still satisfied with it, especially since Xenaya's female essence was the strongest compared to the other female demons by her side, including the Amaris Twins. Unfortunately, the female essence he needed to advance to the Duke Rank was simply too much, and those female demons were still not enough to help him.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 8,700 Qi.]
[Reward: 87 green jewels.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 650 demons at Marquis rank or above.]
[Reward: 65,000 female essences.]

The two notifications woke Zhang Xiaolong [3] up from his sleep, but he immediately got out of bed and left his room, and he went to see Xenaya in his private room to say goodbye. After all, he had been in the Netherworld Realm for a few days, and he was going to bring the demons back to the Diyu realm, so he wanted to finish the daily quest first.

Although Xenaya was disappointed with his decision, she still let Zhang Xiaolong [3] go, but she asked him to come see her again later, which he agreed to because he still needed a lot of female essence.

sentences.text: After they had searched for the heavenly fox for a day and had no results, the two men from the Shang Clan decided to return to the Demon Emperor City, and Shang Guangming immediately informed Shang Yaolin about his encounter with Zhang Xiaolong [3], which surprised his sister.
"Why didn't you bring him here, brother?
If that kid is really a descendant of those foxes, then you should have brought him here.

That way, Uncle Chenguang can do something to him when he arrives in this realm, and our patriarch will definitely reward us handsomely if we can do that, especially since he has always wanted to defeat Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, and our family's status will also rise because of it."
"I understand, but that child is still too young, and bringing him to this city, especially with so many powerful demons here, will cause him stress.
Therefore, I have decided to let him stay in the ghostveil forest for the time being." Shang Yaolin frowned for a moment, but she did not refute her brother, and Shang Guangming spoke to her again.
"He is indeed their descendant, but he is still weak, and we can find him easily, so you don't need to think too much about it.
After we successfully invade the Sky Jade Realm, we will bring him back with us to our realm and hand him over to our patriarch to get our rewards."
Shang Yaolin nodded in agreement with that.
"All right, we'll finish our business in this realm first, and then we'll bring him back to our realm."

After that, Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin immediately entered the castle to join Oz the 1st, especially since their patriarch was increasingly losing patience to control the Sky Jade Realm, so they had to speed up their plans to invade that realm.
The two demons from The Diyu Realm had arrived at the ghostveil forest, and they explained to Arbeola about their encounter with Morgana.

However, the old tree demon had already gotten information about the matter from the tree demons living in that area, but he was still shocked by their story about Oz the 1st and the demon emperor of the Netherworld Realm.
"I didn't expect the situation to be so complicated, but that kid might have the ability to restore your emperor's old memories."
"Yeah." Ursula nodded in agreement with Arbeola.
"We also believe that Zhang Fei can do it, but it's not easy because we have to face cultivators from the upper realms, and all of them are much stronger than Morgana."
Zygoz then also spoke to Arbeola.
"Old demon, I feel a little dilemma regarding this matter, especially since those people used our emperor to invade the Sky Jade Realm, where Zhang Fei and his closest people reside.
If he knew about this matter, he probably wouldn't be willing to help us, and he might turn against us."
"Hahaha!" Arbeola laughed at Zygoz's words.
"Do you think that kid is that kind of person?
I've only known him for a few days, but I can tell you that your worries are unwarranted, and I'm sure that he can distinguish between right and wrong.
Moreover, he has a special relationship with these little girls, and he must have considered all of you as his close friends, so you don't need to worry about that."
Zygoz sighed softly and nodded at Arbeola.
"Zhang Fei seems to be busy right now, so I will wait for him to come here and tell him everything later, and I hope he will be willing to help us restore our emperor's memories."

"I will teach you how to absorb the demon aura in this realm, like these little girls, so you can rely more on yourself to help your emperor." Zygoz immediately put on a serious expression as he listened to Arbeola's explanation about it, which surprised him a little, especially since it was a little different from the way he had he usually does to absorb the demon aura in the diyu realm.
After he finished explaining everything, Arbeola immediately asked Ursula and Zygoz to enter the room below him so they could focus on absorbing the demon aura without any disturbance.
Moreover, other powerful cultivators from the upper realms would also arrive in the realm soon, and he didn't want those people to discover their presence in the forest.
After two days of travel, Hu Qiaomu finally arrived in the western region, so she immediately rushed to meet Hu Hong and Hu Qianli, but she was angry because she couldn't find Hu Xiufu there.
"Where is he going?"
"Elder, Xiufu has been missing for several days, and we've been looking for her everywhere, but we couldn't find her.
We've also tried to contact her through voice transmission, but she didn't respond to our calls at all." Hu Qianli's response even infuriated Hu Qiaomu.
Hu Hong also provided a detailed explanation to Hu Qiaomu.
"Elder, as soon as we arrived in this region, we immediately went to the Chu Clan to look for Zhang Fei, but the clan's protectors blocked us, and nobody answered us.
That's why we decided to stay in this hotel while monitoring the clan, but Xiufu didn't join us, and she wanted to wait for him in front of the clan, yet we didn't see her again after that."
"Hmm?" Hu Qiaomu immediately looked out the window, towards the Chu Clan, and she used her senses to check the clan.

However, she was surprised to see that the clan's protection was gone since it had been destroyed by Tian Jiyuan a few days ago, and she also couldn't find any clan members there except for maids and guards.
"Have you two tried going to the clan again?"
"Yes." Both female moon foxes nodded to Hu Qiaomu.
"We have been there for the past few days, but the guards informed us that the clan members have been absent for a little over a week, and none of them were aware of their departure.
Since then, we have continued to monitor the clan, but they still haven't returned."

"That's weird." Hu Qiaomu muttered to herself before checking the other two major clans, but she was even more confused after she couldn't find Yan Huan'er in the Ye Clan, and the clan was also so quiet, especially since the guards had yet to recover from the injuries they received from Tian Gongzhu.
Hu Qiaomu then checked into the Gu Clan and found Xing Mei sitting alone in the garden, but she looked anxious, and she seemed to be waiting for someone.
"I will go to the Gu Clan now."

"Wait a minute, elder." Hu Qiaomu immediately turned to Hu Hong, who then explained to her about the strange situation he and Hu Qianli experienced while they were under the influence of Tian Gongzhu's ability.
"Don't you two remember anything about that?"
Both of them responded by shaking their heads.
Hu Qianli then spoke.
"We have tried to remember everything that happened during those five days, but we still can't remember anything.
At first, we thought that it was Zhang Fei who did that to us, but we seemed to have guessed wrong because he hadn't come back for a long time.
We thought someone else had done it to us, and that person probably also kidnapped Xiufu."
'Who did that to them?
Why did that person kidnap Xiufu?
Could it be that the person was Zhang Fei's person?
Why didn't that person kidnap these two girls as well?' Hu Qiaomu then said to them.
"I will go to the Gu Clan, and I will check out this region to investigate the matter afterwards."
"Yes, Elder."
After their elder disappeared, Hu Qianli asked Hu Hong.
"Do you feel something strange in your body?
I've been experiencing strange sensations in my body since I woke up three days ago, and I often feel like someone is groping my body."
"Yes." Hu Hong nodded in agreement with that.
"I've personally experienced the same thing as you, and I can feel a strange sensation lingering in my body, which makes me really uncomfortable.
At first, I thought Zhang Fei came to us, and he secretly used his dual-cultivation abilities on us.
However, the Chu Clan's guard said that he hasn't returned, so I have my doubts about it.
Forget it; we don't need to think too much about it, and it will definitely disappear by itself soon."
Hu Qianli sighed heavily after hearing that.
"I hope Elder Qiaomu can find Xiufu because she is very kind, and I don't want anything bad to happen to her."
Hu Qiaomu had arrived at the Chu Clan, and her sudden arrival surprised Xing Mei, who immediately asked her, "Why have you come to this region all of a sudden, Elder?
Has there been a change in plans?"
"No." Hu Qiaomu then sat in front of Xing Mei and asked her.
"Did anything happen in this city a week ago?
Why can't I find Liu Qingyu and Yan Huan'er in the Chu and Ye Clans?"
"Honestly, I don't know Huan'er's whereabouts, especially since she left alone without telling me her destination, and she still hasn't returned." Xing Mei's answer made Hu Qiaomu raise her eyebrows.

"As for Qingyu and the others, Zhang Fei probably hid them in a special place because there were some people looking for him, and they wanted to capture him, so he must have done that to keep them safe."
"Oh?" Hu Qiaomu was surprised that there were people who wanted to capture Zhang Fei, especially since his relationship with those powerful clans had already become public knowledge.
"Do you know the identities of those people?"
Xing Mei nodded to Hu Qiaomu before explaining.
"Qingyu told me that they are heavenly foxes that came from another realm, and one of them told me that Zhang Fei's fox race is also a heavenly fox like them."
"What?" Hu Qiaomu exclaimed in shock after hearing that.
"Are you sure that they are heavenly foxes?"
"Yes." Xing Mei nodded to Hu Qiaomu once again.
"One of them was called Tian Gongzhu, and she told me that Zhang Fei was the mastermind behind her brother's death, so she wanted to capture him."

However, Hu Qiaomu felt strange about Xing Mei's attitude, especially since she was very close to the people from the Chu and Ye Clan, who were Zhang Fei's family, so she shouldn't have told her about the matter.
"Why did you tell me about the matter?"
"Haha." Xing Mei laughed softly and told Hu Qiaomu everything, especially about Gu Zhan's death.
"You should already understand my intentions, right?"
'This woman is already blinded by revenge, huh?
However, I didn't expect that Zhang Fei also had a divine beast by his side, but he was a heavenly fox, so it was easy for him to do that.
I think those people were the ones who did that to Hu Hong and Hu Qianli, and they were probably the ones who kidnapped Hu Xiufu.' Hu Qiaomu then questioned Xing Mei once more.
"Are you telling me this matter because you hope that we will help you take revenge on them?"
"Yes." Xing Mei immediately admitted it.

"At first, I leaked information about Zhang Fei to Tian Gongzhu in hopes that she could help me kill Boitata, but my hopes seemed to be in vain because she didn't come here again after that, and they seemed to have left this realm.
Moreover, you seemed to want to do something to him as well, so I was hoping that you could help me."
"You are right; we do have certain goals for Zhang Fei." Hu Qiaomu nodded to Xing Mei.
"We had already guessed that his bloodline was higher than ours, and my leader sent me to the region to investigate his identity.
However, I never expected that he was a heavenly fox, and his presence in the realm would threaten us, so we had to do something about him to ensure our safety."
Xing Mei smiled and propped her chin up.
"I don't care about Zhang Fei, and you can do whatever you want with him.
However, I hope you will hand over his contract beast to me, so I can avenge my son's death on her."
"Sure." Hu Qiaomu immediately agreed with that.
"I will convey this matter to my leader, and I will convince him to hand over Zhang Fei's contract beast to you in exchange for this information."
After they talked about some other things, Hu Qiaomu immediately left the Gu Clan to return to the inn, and Xing Mei smiled in satisfaction at her decision.
Since they were all busy with their own affairs, time passed quite quickly in the Sky Jade Realm and the Netherworld Realm, and three days had passed since the demons met Morgana.

For the past three days, Zhang Fei has been dual cultivating with all his wives in the cloud manor, and his first clone has never stopped to dual-cultivate his partners in the portable mansion, which made his cultivation break through to 6-Star Soul Realm.
Meanwhile, his fourth clone has been completing the daily quests that appear every day, and he has not forgotten to practice and learn all the things he has not mastered perfectly.
The flow of time in the training space, which is two times faster than the outside world, has a significant impact on everyone, including Zhang Chen and the others who almost never stop training.
Unlike them, Ye Lian and Zhao Ziqin decided to join Zhang Fei after they were stuck with their training, but they still have not dual-cultivated with him, and they only do intimate things with him.
In the black castle, Feltia [2] spent his time with the Amaris Twins and Nadea to increase his demon power, causing the three of them to always be overwhelmed to serve him.
He did not forget to dual-cultivate with Eve, Fyr, Leora, and Ashreth, which made the cultivation of the four female demons continue to increase.

In the Lust Inn, Zhang Xiaolong [3] also repeatedly had fun with Xenaya, but they did not do it continuously because the succubus had many responsibilities, and he also had to repeatedly go to the Succubi Tower to do other things.
Even so, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still satisfied with it, especially since Xenaya's female essence was the strongest compared to the other female demons by her side, including the Amaris Twins.
Unfortunately, the female essence he needed to advance to the Duke Rank was simply too much, and those female demons were still not enough to help him.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 8,700 Qi.]
[Reward: 87 green jewels.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 650 demons at Marquis rank or above.]
[Reward: 65,000 female essences.]
The two notifications woke Zhang Xiaolong [3] up from his sleep, but he immediately got out of bed and left his room, and he went to see Xenaya in his private room to say goodbye.
After all, he had been in the Netherworld Realm for a few days, and he was going to bring the demons back to the Diyu realm, so he wanted to finish the daily quest first.

Although Xenaya was disappointed with his decision, she still let Zhang Xiaolong [3] go, but she asked him to come see her again later, which he agreed to because he still needed a lot of female essence.

chapters.title: Chapter 412 Return
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already arrived at the ghostveil forest, and he immediately asked Arbeola to bring out the demons. After they woke up from their trance in absorbing the demon aura in the realm, they immediately told him about Oz the 1st and Azroth the 6th, as well as about Morgana.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn't expect that Arbeola's guess was correct, but he didn't expect that they could discover it so quickly, which was thanks to Morgana coming to them.

Additionally, Zygoz and Ursula also told Zhang Xiaolong [3] about the planned arrival of other powerful cultivators from the upper realms, which caused his expression to become serious, especially after he realized that they planned to destroy the seal.
"Can you restore his past memories, kid?" Zygoz suddenly asked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Zygoz. "I can't be sure about that for now, and I have to check on the demon emperor's condition first. Unfortunately, Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin stay by his side to watch over him, so we can't act rashly.

As for the slave mark in his soul, even Morgana can't do anything about it with her cultivation having reached the low level of the seven divine realms, let alone me with my cultivation still at the ten mortal realms. For now, we can only be patient and wait until the right time to free him from their clutches; otherwise, we will only die in vain if we force ourselves to free him now."

Zygoz nodded in understanding with Zhang Xiaolong [3] before asking again. "Are you going to take us back to the Diyu Realm? For now, the situation there is still safe with Oz the 2nd around, so I decided to stay in this realm, and I will take advantage of this demon aura to strengthen myself as soon as possible."

"You can take these three little girls back there, and I'll stay here." Zhang Xiaolong [3] wasn't surprised by Ursula's decision, especially since they were in the same generation as Zygoz and Tharnon, so they also had a special relationship with Oz the 1st.

"All right, you can stay in this realm with Zygoz, and Arbeola will protect you both." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the map to check the demon emperor city, where he found Oz the 1st at the portal location along with Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin. Additionally, he discovered Morgana and Tharnon in the vicinity, but they were evidently concealed from the Shang siblings. "Let's go back.
I want to talk to Oz the 2nd about this matter."

Angela and Virgil consented, as they had been absent for a considerable amount of time and no one managed their sub-realms. As for Ba Shuxiang, she could only resign herself to their fate of being prisoners, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately brought them back to the Diyu Realm after Mei opened the gate.

After they disappeared, Zygoz and Ursula immediately returned to the room below Arbeola, and they thought of nothing but focusing on absorbing the demon aura; only then could they help Zhang Xiaolong [3] to free Oz the 1st.

After they arrived at the Diyu Realm, Virgil rushed back to his sub-realm, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] would send them to his training space later. After all, she was now a demon cultivator, so she couldn't just focus on her demon power; she also had to improve her cultivation, which was still rock bottom.

Angela also returned to her own sub-realm to meet Nauvia the siren, particularly since she had decided to enter seclusion for two reasons. The first reason was because she wanted to strengthen herself, and the second reason was because she had promised Zhang Xiaolong [3] to build relationships with those closest to him.

After he summoned Oz the 2nd to meet him via his token, Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Ba Shuxiang and pulled her into a hug. "Are you enjoying your new life as a swan demon? You used to be ordinary, and there was nothing interesting about you. However, your appearance changed significantly after you became a demon, and you have become quite attractive now."

If only Ba Shuxiang had not met Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s partners and wives, and if only she was not his prisoner, then she would have been furious because of his words. After all, she was quite narcissistic, and she always felt that not many women could match her beauty, but he said that she was just ordinary.

"You can forget about your husband because he will never be able to escape from Oz's custody, and he will continue to live in this realm for the rest of his life." Ba Shuxiang became gloomy as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned her husband, but she herself was fully aware of their situation, and she also believed that she would never be able to meet Chi Zhongguo again.
"I will never force you to serve me, but you should know what's good for you, right?"

Ba Shuxiang did not refute Zhang Xiaolong's words, as he had previously imprisoned her and the other prisoners in the portable mansion for a considerable amount of time, so she was aware of his proficiency in dual cultivation.

In fact, they were tempted to try to do it with him, especially since they could hear the satisfaction and pleasure in those women's moans, which continued to echo in the mansion for several whole days.

'Sigh! I don't want to be in this kind of situation, but it was too late for me to regret everything. I had become a demon and lost my husband, and I couldn't commit suicide because of his mark in my soul.

It would be better if I accepted my situation, and I might have a better future if I faithfully served him.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled faintly as he watched her expression closely, but Ba Shuxiang suddenly hugged him and briefly kissed him. "Master, I don't like this, but I have decided to be your servant, and I will serve you for the rest of my life."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled at that, then squeezed Ba Shuxiang's buttocks. "You have made the right decision, and I will make sure that you will never regret your decision. Even though you still think about your husband now, you will definitely forget him soon."
"Mhm." Ba Shuxiang only nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Suddenly, Oz the 2nd appeared in front of them, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told him about Oz the 1st and his complicated situation, as well as his predecessor's relationship with Morgana.

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s explanation caused Oz the 2nd to freeze for quite a while, but he then came back to his senses and became furious, and his demon aura also exploded, causing Ba Shuxiang and the demons around them to tremble in horror.

Immediately, Oz the 2nd calmed down and withdrew his demon aura, bringing a sense of relief to everyone. "I never imagined my predecessor would suffer such a terrible fate, and he even had to live as a slave to those people. Even so, I feel happy because he is still alive, and he even has such a powerful wife."

"Yeah." Zhang Xialong [3] nodded to Oz the 2nd. "What are your next plans? Do you want to go to the Netherworld Realm? Although you hold the title of demon emperor in this realm, your demon power pales in comparison to the demons in that realm, especially when compared to the demon power of your predecessor.

If you want to save the first demon emperor, then you have no other choice but to go there, so you can increase your strength together with Ursula and Zygoz. As for this realm, I don't think the Throne will move anytime soon, especially since I've already controlled the four angels, so he still doesn't know the situation here, which gives you a lot of time to strengthen yourself."

Oz the 2nd nodded in agreement with that. "There are a few demon rulers left, and Feltia [2] also lives in this realm, so my best option is to go to the Netherworld Realm for the time being. That way, my power can surpass the Throne, and we can devise new plans about them after we successfully free my predecessor.
Moreover, with my predecessor's return and his wife's presence, our strength will increase severalfold, and we can definitely reverse the situation between us and those birds."

"That's right." Mei immediately opened the gate to the Netherworld realm, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Oz the 2nd to enter it. "You can focus on increasing your strength in that realm, and Feltia [2] will help the remaining demon rulers to watch over this realm."
"All right, I leave this realm to you."

After Oz the 2nd disappeared into the gate, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his map because Mei had finished mapping the ancient places in the Diyu Realm, and he thought that the black key might be related to one of them.
'Feltia [2] can rest for the time being, so he can take the Amaris Twins and the others to check those places, and I hope to find something valuable behind that locked place.'

After they had waited for some time, Virgil had returned to them, especially since her sub-realm was the smallest and the number of demons living there were not too many, so she could take care of everything quickly. "Did Oz go to the Netherworld Realm?"

"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded to Virgil's question with a nod. "The situation in this realm has become more stable, and I believe those winged races will not invade this place anytime soon, so you guys can focus more on further increasing your strength."
A few minutes later, Angela had returned to the place, but she came with Nauvia. "She really enjoyed living in my sub-realm, so she agreed to be my deputy, and I will focus on my training."

"That's good." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Nauvia. "Your mother has agreed to let you live freely, so you don't need to think about her anymore, and you can enjoy your freedom in Angela's sub-realm."
"Eh?" Nauvia gazed in disbelief at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Is my mother really not going to bother me anymore? How did you manage to convince her?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his nose as he told Nauvia the truth. "Kyllia has pledged allegiance to me, and she has spread the news of the Amaris Twins' betrayal to all of them, so I'm the new ruler of their sub-realm. Thus, the twins, your mother, and all the inhabitants are my subordinates now."

Nauvia looked genuinely shocked to hear that, especially since the Amaris Twins were clearly stronger than Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he had managed to subdue and take over their sub-realm to become the new ruler of that place.
However, she was sure that his path would not be easy because the residents of that place were all women, and they never liked male demons, so there would be many of them who would oppose him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled seeing Nauvia's reaction. "Do you think those demons will dare to reject me as their new ruler? The Amaris Twins have completely submitted to me, and they will help me to deal with them. Moreover, I still have Kyllia and your mother, so I'm sure that everything will work out smoothly."

"I see." Nauvia nodded in understanding before asking Zhang Xiaolong [3] once again. "Have you done anything unusual with my mother? Even though she gave birth to me, she doesn't really like male demons, and she wants to have a child just to fulfill her dream."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] had no intention of covering up Feltia [2]'s relationship with Nadea. "To tell you the truth, I've slept with your mother, and she always enjoys herself with me."

"So it's true, huh?" Nauvia mumbled softly. "Forget it; I don't care about my mother's personal affairs, and she can do whatever she wants. Since she has decided to serve you, I leave her to you, and I will live my own life in Ruler Angela's sub-realm."

Nauvia immediately turned around and wanted to fly away, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly grabbed her hand, so she turned to him with a frown. However, he suddenly pulled her closer and planted a kiss on her sweet lips, causing her eyes to widen in shock, and she reflexively pushed him back before wiping her lips. "Why did you do that to me?
I don't hate you, but I don't like you either, so you shouldn't do it."
"Haha." Virgil laughed and spoke to Nauvia. "Little girl, this guy has his eyes set on you, and you should remember that he is an incubus, so you shouldn't be surprised if he wants you for himself."

Angela nodded in agreement with Virgil. "If he wants something, he'll go to great lengths to get it. Since you're already on his radar, you should prepare yourself, and I am sure you will fall for him sooner or later."
"No! I don't need a man, and I want to enjoy my life in freedom, so I will never fall for him." After she said that, Nauvia hurriedly left the place.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled and didn't stop Nauvia from leaving, but Virgil and Angela shook their heads at his smile, and they were sure that he had already made plans for the siren.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then sent Virgil and Angela into the training space, and he used his invisibility ability to bring Ba Shuxiang into an invisible state. After that, he brought her back to the Sky Jade Realm, especially since he wanted to find out the movements of the heretics of his slaves.

Once he arrived at the Chu Clan, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his map to confirm the whereabouts of the heavenly foxes, but he couldn't find them because they had already returned to the Heavenly Moon Realm, which relieved him.
'Even though they have returned to the Heavenly Moon Realm, I am sure they will not give up so easily and will return to this realm again, so I still have to be careful.'

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned as soon as he saw the two red dots on his map, so he checked them both, and he frowned even more after seeing the names that appeared on them. 'Hu Qiaomu? Why is she in this city? Why is she turning hostile towards me now? Furthermore, Xing Mei's name, which was previously displayed as green on my map, has now changed to red.'

[What are you going to do about that moon fox, master? Since she came to this region by herself, I'm sure you can subdue her with your bloodline superiority. However, you still have to be careful of her, especially since her cultivation at 2-Star Sovereing Realm, and she is no less cunning than you.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with Mei, but he then closed the map and took Ba Shuxiang to leave the Chu Clan, and he took her away to the western forest directly.

After he summoned Oz the 2nd to meet him via his token, Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Ba Shuxiang and pulled her into a hug.
"Are you enjoying your new life as a swan demon?
You used to be ordinary, and there was nothing interesting about you.
However, your appearance changed significantly after you became a demon, and you have become quite attractive now."
If only Ba Shuxiang had not met Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s partners and wives, and if only she was not his prisoner, then she would have been furious because of his words.
After all, she was quite narcissistic, and she always felt that not many women could match her beauty, but he said that she was just ordinary.

"You can forget about your husband because he will never be able to escape from Oz's custody, and he will continue to live in this realm for the rest of his life." Ba Shuxiang became gloomy as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned her husband, but she herself was fully aware of their situation, and she also believed that she would never be able to meet Chi Zhongguo again.
"I will never force you to serve me, but you should know what's good for you, right?"

Ba Shuxiang did not refute Zhang Xiaolong's words, as he had previously imprisoned her and the other prisoners in the portable mansion for a considerable amount of time, so she was aware of his proficiency in dual cultivation.

In fact, they were tempted to try to do it with him, especially since they could hear the satisfaction and pleasure in those women's moans, which continued to echo in the mansion for several whole days.
'Sigh!
I don't want to be in this kind of situation, but it was too late for me to regret everything.
I had become a demon and lost my husband, and I couldn't commit suicide because of his mark in my soul.

It would be better if I accepted my situation, and I might have a better future if I faithfully served him.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled faintly as he watched her expression closely, but Ba Shuxiang suddenly hugged him and briefly kissed him.
"Master, I don't like this, but I have decided to be your servant, and I will serve you for the rest of my life."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled at that, then squeezed Ba Shuxiang's buttocks.
"You have made the right decision, and I will make sure that you will never regret your decision.
Even though you still think about your husband now, you will definitely forget him soon."
"Mhm." Ba Shuxiang only nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Suddenly, Oz the 2nd appeared in front of them, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told him about Oz the 1st and his complicated situation, as well as his predecessor's relationship with Morgana.

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s explanation caused Oz the 2nd to freeze for quite a while, but he then came back to his senses and became furious, and his demon aura also exploded, causing Ba Shuxiang and the demons around them to tremble in horror.
Immediately, Oz the 2nd calmed down and withdrew his demon aura, bringing a sense of relief to everyone.
"I never imagined my predecessor would suffer such a terrible fate, and he even had to live as a slave to those people.
Even so, I feel happy because he is still alive, and he even has such a powerful wife."
"Yeah." Zhang Xialong [3] nodded to Oz the 2nd.
"What are your next plans?
Do you want to go to the Netherworld Realm?
Although you hold the title of demon emperor in this realm, your demon power pales in comparison to the demons in that realm, especially when compared to the demon power of your predecessor.
If you want to save the first demon emperor, then you have no other choice but to go there, so you can increase your strength together with Ursula and Zygoz.

As for this realm, I don't think the Throne will move anytime soon, especially since I've already controlled the four angels, so he still doesn't know the situation here, which gives you a lot of time to strengthen yourself."
Oz the 2nd nodded in agreement with that.
"There are a few demon rulers left, and Feltia [2] also lives in this realm, so my best option is to go to the Netherworld Realm for the time being.
That way, my power can surpass the Throne, and we can devise new plans about them after we successfully free my predecessor.
Moreover, with my predecessor's return and his wife's presence, our strength will increase severalfold, and we can definitely reverse the situation between us and those birds."
"That's right." Mei immediately opened the gate to the Netherworld realm, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Oz the 2nd to enter it.
"You can focus on increasing your strength in that realm, and Feltia [2] will help the remaining demon rulers to watch over this realm."
"All right, I leave this realm to you."

After Oz the 2nd disappeared into the gate, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his map because Mei had finished mapping the ancient places in the Diyu Realm, and he thought that the black key might be related to one of them.
'Feltia [2] can rest for the time being, so he can take the Amaris Twins and the others to check those places, and I hope to find something valuable behind that locked place.'

After they had waited for some time, Virgil had returned to them, especially since her sub-realm was the smallest and the number of demons living there were not too many, so she could take care of everything quickly.
"Did Oz go to the Netherworld Realm?"
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded to Virgil's question with a nod.
"The situation in this realm has become more stable, and I believe those winged races will not invade this place anytime soon, so you guys can focus more on further increasing your strength."
A few minutes later, Angela had returned to the place, but she came with Nauvia.
"She really enjoyed living in my sub-realm, so she agreed to be my deputy, and I will focus on my training."
"That's good." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Nauvia.
"Your mother has agreed to let you live freely, so you don't need to think about her anymore, and you can enjoy your freedom in Angela's sub-realm."
"Eh?" Nauvia gazed in disbelief at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Is my mother really not going to bother me anymore?
How did you manage to convince her?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his nose as he told Nauvia the truth.
"Kyllia has pledged allegiance to me, and she has spread the news of the Amaris Twins' betrayal to all of them, so I'm the new ruler of their sub-realm.
Thus, the twins, your mother, and all the inhabitants are my subordinates now."

Nauvia looked genuinely shocked to hear that, especially since the Amaris Twins were clearly stronger than Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he had managed to subdue and take over their sub-realm to become the new ruler of that place.
However, she was sure that his path would not be easy because the residents of that place were all women, and they never liked male demons, so there would be many of them who would oppose him.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled seeing Nauvia's reaction.
"Do you think those demons will dare to reject me as their new ruler?
The Amaris Twins have completely submitted to me, and they will help me to deal with them.
Moreover, I still have Kyllia and your mother, so I'm sure that everything will work out smoothly."
"I see." Nauvia nodded in understanding before asking Zhang Xiaolong [3] once again.
"Have you done anything unusual with my mother?
Even though she gave birth to me, she doesn't really like male demons, and she wants to have a child just to fulfill her dream."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] had no intention of covering up Feltia [2]'s relationship with Nadea.
"To tell you the truth, I've slept with your mother, and she always enjoys herself with me."
"So it's true, huh?" Nauvia mumbled softly.
"Forget it; I don't care about my mother's personal affairs, and she can do whatever she wants.
Since she has decided to serve you, I leave her to you, and I will live my own life in Ruler Angela's sub-realm."
Nauvia immediately turned around and wanted to fly away, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly grabbed her hand, so she turned to him with a frown.
However, he suddenly pulled her closer and planted a kiss on her sweet lips, causing her eyes to widen in shock, and she reflexively pushed him back before wiping her lips.
"Why did you do that to me?
I don't hate you, but I don't like you either, so you shouldn't do it."
"Haha." Virgil laughed and spoke to Nauvia.
"Little girl, this guy has his eyes set on you, and you should remember that he is an incubus, so you shouldn't be surprised if he wants you for himself."
Angela nodded in agreement with Virgil.
"If he wants something, he'll go to great lengths to get it.
Since you're already on his radar, you should prepare yourself, and I am sure you will fall for him sooner or later."
"No!
I don't need a man, and I want to enjoy my life in freedom, so I will never fall for him." After she said that, Nauvia hurriedly left the place.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled and didn't stop Nauvia from leaving, but Virgil and Angela shook their heads at his smile, and they were sure that he had already made plans for the siren.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then sent Virgil and Angela into the training space, and he used his invisibility ability to bring Ba Shuxiang into an invisible state.
After that, he brought her back to the Sky Jade Realm, especially since he wanted to find out the movements of the heretics of his slaves.

Once he arrived at the Chu Clan, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his map to confirm the whereabouts of the heavenly foxes, but he couldn't find them because they had already returned to the Heavenly Moon Realm, which relieved him.
'Even though they have returned to the Heavenly Moon Realm, I am sure they will not give up so easily and will return to this realm again, so I still have to be careful.'
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned as soon as he saw the two red dots on his map, so he checked them both, and he frowned even more after seeing the names that appeared on them. 'Hu Qiaomu?
Why is she in this city?
Why is she turning hostile towards me now?
Furthermore, Xing Mei's name, which was previously displayed as green on my map, has now changed to red.'
[What are you going to do about that moon fox, master?
Since she came to this region by herself, I'm sure you can subdue her with your bloodline superiority.
However, you still have to be careful of her, especially since her cultivation at 2-Star Sovereing Realm, and she is no less cunning than you.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with Mei, but he then closed the map and took Ba Shuxiang to leave the Chu Clan, and he took her away to the western forest directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 413 Lure Hu Qiaomu
paragraphs: Upon arriving at the western forest, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately contacted Sabina the Dryad's leader, asking her to meet him at the fairy forest. He then brought Ba Shuxiang there, using the green pendant Zefyr had given him.

The natural races looked surprised by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s sudden arrival, but Oliver had already told them about him, so they immediately welcomed him happily. However, they looked hostile towards Ba Shuxiang, especially since he was now a demon, and they did not particularly like demons except for Lillea and her kin, whose appearances did not look like demons.
Even though the natural races did not say anything about Ba Shuxiang because it was Zhang Xiaolong [3] who brought her to their forest, they still showed hostility towards her.

Ba Shuxiang looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with shock and admiration, especially since not all humans could form relationships with natural races, let alone that he also had the identity of an incubus. However, she remembered that she still had another identity, which was a fox-beast, leading her to believe that she could have a relationship with them because of her beast identity.
Oliver, who noticed Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Ba Shuxiang's presence, immediately appeared in front of them. "Why did you come here suddenly? Is there anything we can do to help you?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then explained to Oliver about the demons of the Netherworld Realm as well as the cultivators from the upper realms who were helping them from behind, causing him to frown in shock.

"Grandpa, they intend to break the seal on the portal from that realm in a few days, and I'm sure that the senior cultivators in the demon cave will not be able to deal with them, especially since those people are too strong, and their cultivation has reached the seven divine realms.
That's why I came here to discuss this matter with you, and I hope you are willing to mobilize the natural races to help them because the risk is too great if they succeed in invading this realm."

After all, Oliver was very old, and he was the leader of all races in the fairy forest. He naturally understood the situation, and he immediately asked the leaders of the natural races, who were still in seclusion, to come out.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened a portal to the training space, and he asked Liu Qingyu to come out so that she could warn Liu Rong and the others about those people's plans.

Liu Qingyu had heard everything from Zhang Fei herself, so she immediately sent a transmission voice to Liu Rong and Chu Hong, asking them to convey the matter to the other senior cultivators. She also asked them to be on guard against attacks from the heretic cultivators in the northern region, especially since they did not have definite information regarding their plans.
"Long time no see, Little Girl." Oliver said to Liu Qingyu after she finished contacting them.
Liu Qingyu smiled and nodded to Oliver. "Long time no see, Senior. The last time I came here was when I just got married to my husband, and almost three decades have passed since then."

Oliver then looked at Liu Qingyu with a playful smile on his face, causing her to smile awkwardly as she understood the meaning behind his smile, but he didn't say anything because he knew that it would make her feel uncomfortable.

Suddenly, Sabina walked into the fairy forest together with Persix the centaur, and the dryad leader immediately told Zhang Xiaolong [3] about Xing Mei's conversation with Tian Gongzhu and Hu Qiaomu, causing him to frown.
After hearing that, Liu Qingyu was shocked, not expecting Xing Mei to make a fatal mistake by selling them to Tian Gongzhu and Hu Qiaomu. "What are you going to do to her?"

"What else?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked back while shaking his head. "I know that Xing Mei did that out of grudge over Gu Zhan's death, and I warned her not to do such a thing, yet she did not heed my warnings. She chose to side with my two enemies, which meant she is also my enemy, and you knew that I would never spare my enemy.
Even so, I won't kill her; I will imprison her, along with Chu Youqian and the others in my prison."
"Your prison?" Liu Qingyu looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in confusion, especially since he had not told them about the Yin-Yang Prison.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Liu Qingyu. "I got it some time ago, and it has the same function as the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackles. That way, I can use them as my qi reserves, and I will absorb their qi if I need it to break through."
"Will it make them suffer?" Liu Qingyu asked seriously. "Even though Xing Mei has done that, we've been very close for a long time, so I don't want her to suffer that much."

Not only was Liu Qingyu curious about it, but even Oliver and the two leaders of the Dryad and Centaur Races looked intrigued about it, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately asked Mei to open the portal to the Yin-Yang space before bringing them in.

"Huh?" Liu Qingyu and the others were stunned when they arrived inside, especially since there was nothing there except for ten prison rooms and a large tube in the middle of the room, and they could see the flow of qi coming out of the five rooms towards the tube.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then guided them to Wang Xiaoyi's room, where they found her soundly asleep. "As you guys can see, this woman didn't suffer in the slightest because I only confined her subconscious using one of my demon abilities, and she was having a sweet dream in there, which helped me to harvest her yin qi for my benefit."
They immediately checked the other four rooms, where they saw Mo Xuanxing, Chu Youqian, Shen Shixi, and Shen Xiwu, who were also fast asleep.

"Won't they die if they keep sleeping like this?" Sabina, the Dryad leader, inquired as she watched the flow of qi in the glass pipe. "Moreover, these rooms keep absorbing their qi, so I thought they would die from the depletion of the qi in their bodies."

Liu Qingyu answered Sabina directly. "Fei'er won't let them die, and he must have used pills to restore their stamina and Qi, so the Qi in their bodies will never run low, even though these glass pipes continue to absorb it."
"I see." Sabina nodded in understanding.

Oliver then asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Where did you find such a scary place? Unfortunately, there are only ten rooms here, and five of them are already in use, meaning you can only imprison five more people."

"Grandpa, I'm sorry, but I can't tell you about the origin of this place." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at the other five rooms. "Even though the number of these rooms is limited, I'm satisfied with this, and I can use the remaining ones to lock up my other enemies, including Xing Mei.
Moreover, I can get rid of them if they are no longer useful to me, and I will replace them with stronger cultivators in the future."

"Hahaha!" Persix, the Centaur leader, suddenly laughed as he patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder. "I admire your character, especially since you care for your loved ones but are merciless to your enemies. In this cruel world, we have to live with that kind of mindset, or we will suffer if we are too kind to our enemies."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with Persix before leading them out of the Yin-Yang Prison, but the other leaders of the other natural races were already waiting for them outside, so Oliver led them all to his house to discuss the matter of the demons and heretics of both realms.

However, they seemed in a dilemma after Oliver told them that the demons from the Netherworld Realm were working together with people from the upper realms, especially since their strength was clearly no match for theirs. "Why are you all acting so cowardly now? They are strong, but there aren't many of them, and they won't necessarily come to this realm themselves.

Otherwise, they won't use and sacrifice those demons to invade our realm, so I think we still have a chance to fight them. Moreover, this realm is our home, and our ancestors have lived here since it existed, so we must fight to defend it from their attacks."

After hearing that and considering everything carefully, they finally agreed to help humans defend their home realm, and Oliver immediately asked them all to go to the Northern Region as soon as possible. After all, that region, particularly the demon cave area, would be the battle arena for determining their future.
Oliver then led them all to leave the fairy forest, and he decided to go to the central region, especially since Zuhe, the Undine leader, was alone there.

Unlike them, Sabina and Persix decided to stay in the western region in case any of their enemies escaped and attacked their region, so they could immediately move to protect the people who lived there.
They immediately scattered as soon as they arrived outside the western forest, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the map to look for Hu Qiaomu, and he found her with the two young female foxes in an inn.
"What are you planning to do with the three female moon foxes?" Liu Qingyu asked with a raised eyebrow after seeing the grin on Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face.

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "Hu Qiaomu obviously wanted to kill me after she found out my beast identity, so I had to do something about her, right? So I wanted to lure her here, and I would use her to do something against her race. As for those two young moon foxes, they're just their pawns, so I won't do anything to them."
"Do you intend to take Hu Qiaomu as your slave?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Liu Qingyu. "Then what do you want to do to him?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled and pulled Ba Shuxiang closer, but his next action shocked Liu Qingyu and the two people from the natural races, especially since he pulled her soul out of her body.

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately returned Ba Shuxiang's soul to her body, followed by an explanation. "I got this technique from Oz the 2nd, and I will use it on Hu Qiaomu, but I need your help to weaken her first. Even if I don't enslave her, she won't be able to do anything to me, and I can restrict her movements easily, so I think this is the best punishment for her."

"Sigh." Liu Qingyu sighed heavily while massaging her forehead. "Do you realize that your abilities are getting more and more absurd? At first, you were just a lust demon, but you now have many other demon abilities, and I thought you were the only demon who could do that."

The two people from the natural races nodded in agreement with Liu Qingyu, but Sabina then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "In that case, you can lure Hu Qiaomu now, and the two of us will help you capture her, so you can do that to her."

"Since that female moon fox's cultivation is only at 2-Star Sovereign Realm, she won't be able to escape from me and Sabina." Persix said as he entered the forest to hide his presence, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Liu Qingyu and Ba Shuxiang to follow him.

Sabina casually stood beside Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately released his heavenly fox aura after the three of them entered the forest, directing it towards the Heavenly Sword City. "She should be able to sense my aura, so she should be here soon."
"Yes." Sabina then made some gestures with her right hand, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] could feel a lot of movement from underground, which he believed were the roots of the trees in the western forest.

"Hmm?" Hu Qiaomu, who was talking to Hu Hong and Hu Qianli, immediately frowned as soon as she sensed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s aura. She immediately stood up from her seat before speaking to them. "That guy is back, and I will go see him now. However, you two must stay here, and you must contact the other elders if I don't come back here for a long time."
"Yes, Elder Qiaomu."

After that, Hu Qiaomu hurriedly left the inn for the western forest, and she also informed her leader about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s return. Hu Gao immediately ordered her to capture him, and he also ordered her to kill him on the spot, including killing the people closest to him, if she had difficulty capturing him.

With her speed, Hu Qiaomu quickly arrived at the western forest and landed in front of them, but she was really surprised to see the presence of Sabina on Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s side. 'Tch! The natural races are indebted to the ten-tailed fox, and the heavenly foxes are his direct descendants, so it is natural that they side with him.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smirked faintly before speaking to Hu Qiaomu. "At first, we didn't have any problems with each other, but you suddenly became hostile towards me, and you didn't even try to hide your intention to kill me.
Anyway, you don't need to deny it because I am a heavenly fox, and I have my own arrogance, but I would never think of suppressing or killing other foxes like you and your race members."

Hu Qiaomu immediately glanced at Sabina, but the Dryad leader only smiled in response. She then checked the surrounding forest area for other members of the natural races, and she was sure that their other members were hiding there.

However, Hu Qiaomu could not find anyone there, especially since Persix used a special artifact to conceal his and the two women's presence. 'Damn it! This dryad's cultivation is on par with mine, but this area is her territory, and I will lose if we fight here.
I must go now and report this to Hu Gao, especially since this brat has a good relationship with the natural races, which complicates things.'

Just as she was thinking about it, an arrow shot towards Hu Qiaomu after Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Persix to attack her, but she deftly dodged it immediately, causing it to stab the ground at her original spot.

Sabina also made a move immediately, and many tree roots came out of the ground to attack Hu Qiaomu. However, their movements were too slow compared to hers, so she was able to avoid them without much difficulty.

Hu Qiaomu then took out two weapons similar to pinwheels with several small blades on the sides, and she threw them at the roots, cutting them into several pieces. 'This bitch! She is completely obedient to this brat! Moreover, one of their members is still in the forest, so I have to be careful.'
