They are strong, but there aren't many of them, and they won't necessarily come to this realm themselves.
Otherwise, they won't use and sacrifice those demons to invade our realm, so I think we still have a chance to fight them.
Moreover, this realm is our home, and our ancestors have lived here since it existed, so we must fight to defend it from their attacks."

After hearing that and considering everything carefully, they finally agreed to help humans defend their home realm, and Oliver immediately asked them all to go to the Northern Region as soon as possible.
After all, that region, particularly the demon cave area, would be the battle arena for determining their future.
Oliver then led them all to leave the fairy forest, and he decided to go to the central region, especially since Zuhe, the Undine leader, was alone there.

Unlike them, Sabina and Persix decided to stay in the western region in case any of their enemies escaped and attacked their region, so they could immediately move to protect the people who lived there.
They immediately scattered as soon as they arrived outside the western forest, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the map to look for Hu Qiaomu, and he found her with the two young female foxes in an inn.
"What are you planning to do with the three female moon foxes?" Liu Qingyu asked with a raised eyebrow after seeing the grin on Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face.
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that.
"Hu Qiaomu obviously wanted to kill me after she found out my beast identity, so I had to do something about her, right?
So I wanted to lure her here, and I would use her to do something against her race.
As for those two young moon foxes, they're just their pawns, so I won't do anything to them."
"Do you intend to take Hu Qiaomu as your slave?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Liu Qingyu.
"Then what do you want to do to him?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled and pulled Ba Shuxiang closer, but his next action shocked Liu Qingyu and the two people from the natural races, especially since he pulled her soul out of her body.
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately returned Ba Shuxiang's soul to her body, followed by an explanation.
"I got this technique from Oz the 2nd, and I will use it on Hu Qiaomu, but I need your help to weaken her first.
Even if I don't enslave her, she won't be able to do anything to me, and I can restrict her movements easily, so I think this is the best punishment for her."
"Sigh." Liu Qingyu sighed heavily while massaging her forehead.
"Do you realize that your abilities are getting more and more absurd?
At first, you were just a lust demon, but you now have many other demon abilities, and I thought you were the only demon who could do that."
The two people from the natural races nodded in agreement with Liu Qingyu, but Sabina then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"In that case, you can lure Hu Qiaomu now, and the two of us will help you capture her, so you can do that to her."

"Since that female moon fox's cultivation is only at 2-Star Sovereign Realm, she won't be able to escape from me and Sabina." Persix said as he entered the forest to hide his presence, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Liu Qingyu and Ba Shuxiang to follow him.
Sabina casually stood beside Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately released his heavenly fox aura after the three of them entered the forest, directing it towards the Heavenly Sword City.
"She should be able to sense my aura, so she should be here soon."
"Yes." Sabina then made some gestures with her right hand, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] could feel a lot of movement from underground, which he believed were the roots of the trees in the western forest.
"Hmm?" Hu Qiaomu, who was talking to Hu Hong and Hu Qianli, immediately frowned as soon as she sensed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s aura.
She immediately stood up from her seat before speaking to them.
"That guy is back, and I will go see him now.
However, you two must stay here, and you must contact the other elders if I don't come back here for a long time."
"Yes, Elder Qiaomu."
After that, Hu Qiaomu hurriedly left the inn for the western forest, and she also informed her leader about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s return.
Hu Gao immediately ordered her to capture him, and he also ordered her to kill him on the spot, including killing the people closest to him, if she had difficulty capturing him.
With her speed, Hu Qiaomu quickly arrived at the western forest and landed in front of them, but she was really surprised to see the presence of Sabina on Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s side. 'Tch!
The natural races are indebted to the ten-tailed fox, and the heavenly foxes are his direct descendants, so it is natural that they side with him.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smirked faintly before speaking to Hu Qiaomu.
"At first, we didn't have any problems with each other, but you suddenly became hostile towards me, and you didn't even try to hide your intention to kill me.
Anyway, you don't need to deny it because I am a heavenly fox, and I have my own arrogance, but I would never think of suppressing or killing other foxes like you and your race members."
Hu Qiaomu immediately glanced at Sabina, but the Dryad leader only smiled in response.
She then checked the surrounding forest area for other members of the natural races, and she was sure that their other members were hiding there.
However, Hu Qiaomu could not find anyone there, especially since Persix used a special artifact to conceal his and the two women's presence. 'Damn it!
This dryad's cultivation is on par with mine, but this area is her territory, and I will lose if we fight here.
I must go now and report this to Hu Gao, especially since this brat has a good relationship with the natural races, which complicates things.'

Just as she was thinking about it, an arrow shot towards Hu Qiaomu after Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Persix to attack her, but she deftly dodged it immediately, causing it to stab the ground at her original spot.
Sabina also made a move immediately, and many tree roots came out of the ground to attack Hu Qiaomu.
However, their movements were too slow compared to hers, so she was able to avoid them without much difficulty.
Hu Qiaomu then took out two weapons similar to pinwheels with several small blades on the sides, and she threw them at the roots, cutting them into several pieces. 'This bitch!
She is completely obedient to this brat!
Moreover, one of their members is still in the forest, so I have to be careful.'

chapters.title: Chapter 414 Against Two Women
paragraphs: *Swosh... Swosh...*

Two arrows shot towards Hu Qiaomu, but she immediately used her aura to block them before grabbing them both and swiftly shooting them back in the direction they came from. However, two other arrows immediately shot out and collided with the two, causing them to explode at the same time.
*Swosh... Swosh...*

Once again, countless tree roots attacked Hu Qiaomu, but she dodged their attacks again and again. She continued to use her weapon to destroy them, but she did not take her eyes off Sabina and Zhang Xiaolong [3]. 'What the hell are they thinking? Why are they using weak attacks to attack me? Could they be setting up a trap for me?

Zhang Xiaolong [3] faintly smiled and used the forest manipulation ability, shocking Hu Qiaomu as countless trees suddenly burst out of the ground and surrounded her, quickly forming a small man-made forest. He also used plant manipulation, which he mimicked from Lillea, and those trees immediately came out of the ground and walked like humans.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then used the plant generation, an ability he mimicked from Milia, to create some man-eating plants. He also created some poisonous plants, but not ones with deadly poisons.

Although she had seen it before when Zhang Xiaolong [3] trapped Pang De, Sabina was still amazed by his ability to create all of that. However, she remembered his previous explanation about his soul manipulation ability that he mimicked from Oz the 2nd, leading her to believe that he had mimicked the abilities of the other dryads.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

'Damn it!' Hu Qiaomu cursed as she continued to dodge the trees' attacks, but they continued to regenerate no matter how fast she destroyed them. She also protected her face with qi, especially after some of those poisonous plants released poisonous gas, filling the man-made forest. 'Shit! That dryad's ability is really annoying!
I have to get rid of her first, or I'll never be able to catch that brat, and I'll run out of Qi because of these damn trees.'
Unfortunately, Hu Qiaomu misunderstood Sabina, especially since all those things were Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s creation, and he was deliberately stalling for time to exhaust her.
Sabina then ordered the trees to continue attacking Hu Qiaomu, and Persix also repeatedly shot many arrows at the female moon fox, making her even more overwhelmed by her situation.

'Tch!' Hu Qiaomu gritted her teeth before returning to her beast form, a moon fox with five tails, similar to Hu Lili and Hu Yue. She used her tails to deflect those trees' attacks, and she also used her two weapons to destroy them. Unfortunately, she made a fatal mistake in doing so, and the poisonous plants' thorns repeatedly scratched her tails, causing their poison to start invading her body.

Seeing that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately released his heavenly fox aura and directed it at Hu Qiaomu, making her feel even more pressured by his action. However, he did not immediately suppress his bloodline with all of his strength; he gradually increased the pressure.

No matter how strong Hu Qiaomu was, a moon fox was still a divine beast, and her bloodline was inferior compared to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s heavenly fox bloodline, which was a mythical beast. Moreover, Sabina and Persix continued to help him, so she gradually lost her momentum and speed, giving the trees a chance to attack her.

'Fuck! These bastards! They're toying with me on purpose!' Hu Qiaomu cursed after she noticed the changes in her body, and she felt that her nerves were starting to go haywire, making her movements even more sluggish.
*Boom*

Using all her strength, Hu Qiaomu's aura suddenly exploded, pushing the trees and plants away from her. She immediately flew towards Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Sabina, and she quickly destroyed all the trees that tried to block her path.'
After a prolonged struggle, Hu Qiaomu successfully emerged from the man-made forest, swooped towards Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Sabina, and swung her front claws towards them.
However, they suddenly disappeared from Hu Qiaomu's sight as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] took Sabina away from their spot using his teleportation, and her attacks landed on the empty ground.
*Boom*
Hu Qiaomu's full attack sparked a loud explosion, scattering dust and leaving two claw marks in the area.

"Hmm?" Hu Qiaomu immediately looked up as soon as she felt something coming down on her, and her expression was quite shocked when she saw a huge ethereal demon claw trying to squash her. Without thinking twice, she opened her mouth and shot a giant light ball towards it, and the two immediately collided with each other.
*Boom*

Instantly, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s demon claw disappeared because his strength was indeed much weaker than Hu Qiaomu's, and her light Qi ball shot high into the sky, but he and Sabina were not in that direction, so her attack only hit an empty air.
*Roar*

"Ugh!" Hu Qiaomu staggered backward as a loud roar was directed at her, and her fox body trembled quite strongly from the effect of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s demon king's roar, which also caused her mind to go muddled.

Hu Qiaomu repeatedly shook her head to clear her thoughts, but billows of black smoke quickly surrounded her after Zhang Xiaolong [3] used the demon corruption ability, which shocked her once again after she realized that they were imbued with darkness elements.
She immediately released her light qi to the maximum limit to protect herself from those smokes, and she also released her aura to repel them.

In fact, Sabina and Persix could capture Hu Qiaomu quickly if they moved together, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to weaken her physically and mentally before he could use the soul manipulation on her, so they held back and followed his plans.
"Hah... Hah..." After she did all that, Hu Qiaomu panted heavily, especially since she had used too much of her qi to escape the man-made forest.
*Tap... Tap...*

Hu Qiaomu immediately turned her head back to see Persix walking out of the western forest while pointing his bow at her. Sabina also appeared above him with a faint smile on her face, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not with her. "What cowards! You guys only dare to gang up on me!"

"Hehe." Sabina chuckled at Hu Qiaomu's words. "Aren't you a hypocrite? Our brother's cultivation is in the soul realm, and your cultivation is in the sovereign realm, like us, yet you want to kill him."

"We don't want to fight you because we are born from nature, but you made a big mistake in wanting to kill our brother." Hu Qiaomu moved back as Persix walked closer, but she remained wary of their surroundings, especially since she still couldn't sense Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s presence.

"Even though he is still young, all of our natural races have acknowledged him as our leader, so we will never allow you to do such a thing to him, and we will confront your race members directly if they insist on killing him."
"What?" Hu Qiaomu screamed softly as she was shocked by Persix's confession. "You must-."

"Are you surprised by our relationship?" Hu Qiaomu froze as soon as she heard Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s voice from behind. She wanted to jump away, but he had already grabbed her tail and used a demon-absorbing technique on her.

"Argh!" Hu Qiaomu instantly collapsed onto the ground and screamed in pain, especially after Zhang Xiaolong [3] started absorbing her soul power and life force, and he was absorbing both of them very quickly. "Argh! Stop it! I'll die if you do that to me!"

"Do you think I intend to kill you?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] posed this question as he continued his actions. "If I wanted to kill you, I wouldn't have held Sabina and Persix back. With their cultivations on par with yours, they could capture you, and I could kill you with their assistance."

"You-" Before Hu Qiaomu could finish cursing, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already used the soul manipulation ability and pulled her soul out of her body, causing her to look at him in horror. "What... what are you going to do to me? Please! Don't enslave me! I don't want to be your slave, even if you are a havenly fox."

"I don't need to enslave you in order to make you submit to me; you will obey me for the rest of your life." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then released his soul from his body, and his soul form made Hu Qiaomu even more frightening of him, especially since it's shape was a combination of his three bloodlines.

"You-" Hu Qiaomu immediately swallowed her words back as soon as her other soul appeared in front of her, and her eyes widened as she watched Zhang Xiaolong [3] merge her second soul with his. A while later, she could feel something from deep within her soul, making her realize her fate.

"This way, you won't be able to do anything to me, and your life will be tied to me for the rest of your life." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then returned their souls into their respective bodies, and Hu Qiaomu immediately returned to her human form as she looked at him in terror. "I don't usually spare my enemies, but you are a moon fox, and you still have some use for me, so I only did this to you.
However, you should already be aware that you won't survive if something happens to me, and you will also die if I die, so you should know what to do, right?"

After hearing that, Hu Qiaomu's face turned deathly pale, and the realization that her life was tied to Zhang Xiaolong [3] caused her arrogance to slowly crumble. That way, she would not be able to attack him, let alone kill him, especially since she herself would suffer the consequences, and she naturally could not allow others to do bad things to him. 'Damn it!
Why do I have to suffer such an unfortunate fate? Even though I still have my freedom, my life lies in his hands.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Hu Qiaomu again. "You can go back to your sub-realm and take those two young female foxes with you, and I want you to protect Hu Yue from anyone, including Hu Gao and Hu Dong."
"What?" Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s order shocked Hu Qiaomu, and she had a hard time understanding how he knew Hu Yue, so she asked him. "How did you know her?"

"I won't explain it in detail to you, but I will tell you that Hu Yue is my woman now, and I will snatch her from Hu Dong's hands soon." Hu Qiaomu was stunned by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer, but she then sighed heavily after remembering his relationship with the natural races, and they even acknowledged him as their leader.

"Anyway, Hu Xiufu is with me now, and she doesn't want to stay in your sub-realm because you are using her as a tool. You even ordered her to use her body to seduce me, so she wants to separate herself from you guys, and I've promised to protect her."
'Tch! That little bitch! So she's in this bastard's hands, and she's already leaked my orders to him!'

"Hey! I can hear your thoughts, you know?" Hu Qiaomu frowned at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "As I said before, your soul is tied to mine, so you don't need to be surprised if I can do it, right? If I find out that you have bad thoughts about the people around me, I will kill you instantly by destroying your soul, and you better not doubt my words. Now go back and take them with you."
"Tch!" Hu Qiaomu gritted her teeth and flew away with her remaining strength. She then took some pills to restore her condition, but she kept looking at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Are you sure that she couldn't do anything to you?" Sabina questioned Zhang Xiaolong [3] as she looked at Hu Qiaomu, who was flying further and further away.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to the dryad leader. "Oz's soul manipulation ability is very terrifying, so Hu Qiaomu won't be able to do anything to me or anyone close to me, and she won't be able to tell Hu Gao anything about me either."

Persix, the centaur race leader, spoke directly to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "However, Hu Gao will probably punish Hu Qiaomu if she doesn't follow his orders because of you, and he might even kill her, especially considering that guy is too overbearing, so she won't be of any use to you."

"You're right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately agreed with Persix. "For now, Hu Gao is still in the demon cave and focused on the seal, so he won't be able to do anything to Hu Qiaomu. Actually, I don't care if he wants to punish or kill her, but I don't think he will make such a stupid decision, especially since she is one of the important elders in their race."
"I see." Perix nodded in understanding and asked again. "Do you need our help to capture Xing Mei?"

"No need." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately asked Liu Qingyu and Ba Shuxiang to come out of their hiding place. "Qingyu is more than enough to help me handle Xing Mei, so you two don't need to do anything to her, and you guys can monitor this region again."
The two nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he immediately brought the two women back to the Heavenly Sword City before going to the Gu Clan.

Perix let out a soft sigh and spoke to Sabina. "Somehow, I feel that that kid would be a terrifying enemy if he were our enemy, especially since he has too many strange abilities up his sleeve, such as his soul manipulation ability."

"Haha." Sabina laughed at that. "Fortunately, he is not our enemy, so we don't need to worry about him or his abilities, and I am sure that he will lead our races back to our past glory, so we just need to protect him and wait for the time to come."

Xing Mei, who was sitting alone in the garden, was startled by the sudden appearance of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women. She frowned for a moment when she saw Ba Shuxiang's demon form, but she immediately smiled and asked Liu Qingyu. "When did you come back? Why did the three of you suddenly come here?"

Liu Qingyu glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3] before answering Xing Mei. "Don't you already know our purpose for coming here? I am truly disappointed in you, and you've already made a big mistake by selling us out to Tian Gongzhu and Hu Qiaomu."
Xing Mei froze after he mentioned that, but Liu Qingyu immediately moved behind her and restriected her, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately brought them into the Yin-Yang Space.

"Tch!" Hu Qiaomu gritted her teeth and flew away with her remaining strength.
She then took some pills to restore her condition, but she kept looking at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Are you sure that she couldn't do anything to you?" Sabina questioned Zhang Xiaolong [3] as she looked at Hu Qiaomu, who was flying further and further away.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to the dryad leader.
"Oz's soul manipulation ability is very terrifying, so Hu Qiaomu won't be able to do anything to me or anyone close to me, and she won't be able to tell Hu Gao anything about me either."
Persix, the centaur race leader, spoke directly to Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"However, Hu Gao will probably punish Hu Qiaomu if she doesn't follow his orders because of you, and he might even kill her, especially considering that guy is too overbearing, so she won't be of any use to you."
"You're right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately agreed with Persix.
"For now, Hu Gao is still in the demon cave and focused on the seal, so he won't be able to do anything to Hu Qiaomu.
Actually, I don't care if he wants to punish or kill her, but I don't think he will make such a stupid decision, especially since she is one of the important elders in their race."
"I see." Perix nodded in understanding and asked again.
"Do you need our help to capture Xing Mei?"
"No need." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately asked Liu Qingyu and Ba Shuxiang to come out of their hiding place.
"Qingyu is more than enough to help me handle Xing Mei, so you two don't need to do anything to her, and you guys can monitor this region again."
The two nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he immediately brought the two women back to the Heavenly Sword City before going to the Gu Clan.
Perix let out a soft sigh and spoke to Sabina.
"Somehow, I feel that that kid would be a terrifying enemy if he were our enemy, especially since he has too many strange abilities up his sleeve, such as his soul manipulation ability."
"Haha." Sabina laughed at that.

"Fortunately, he is not our enemy, so we don't need to worry about him or his abilities, and I am sure that he will lead our races back to our past glory, so we just need to protect him and wait for the time to come."
Xing Mei, who was sitting alone in the garden, was startled by the sudden appearance of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women.
She frowned for a moment when she saw Ba Shuxiang's demon form, but she immediately smiled and asked Liu Qingyu.
"When did you come back?
Why did the three of you suddenly come here?"
Liu Qingyu glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3] before answering Xing Mei.
"Don't you already know our purpose for coming here?
I am truly disappointed in you, and you've already made a big mistake by selling us out to Tian Gongzhu and Hu Qiaomu."
Xing Mei froze after he mentioned that, but Liu Qingyu immediately moved behind her and restriected her, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately brought them into the Yin-Yang Space.

chapters.title: Chapter 415 Informations
paragraphs: "Qingyu! Please! Forgive me!" Xing Mei kept screaming after Zhang Xiaolong [3] put her in one of the prison rooms. "I... I did that because his contract beast killed my son! I...
I will never be at peace before avenging his death!"

"Have you forgotten the reason behind Gu Zhan's death? Boitata killed your son because he wanted to kill Ye Lian, and she would have died at his hands if she didn't kill him, remember?" Liu Qingyu's question left Xing Mei's mouth open without being able to say a word.

"Your son brought disaster upon himself by repeatedly cheating on his fiancée, and she had warned him to stop multiple times, but he always ignored her. So it's natural for her to break off their engagement after she met a better man, right? Unfortunately, he is too arrogant and unmanly, intending to kill her from behind.
Therefore, you shouldn't blame others for his death, and you should be ashamed of having such a disgraceful son."
"But-"

"Even though we have been friends since we were young, Zhang Fei is my son-in-law. My daughters will be devastated if he dies in their hands, so I will never forgive your betrayal of us." Liu Qingyu then turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Are you going to lock up Xing Mei's subconscious like them?"

"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] answered with a shake of his head as he looked at Xing Mei. "I won't use that on her for a while, and I want her to suffer being locked up in this place with no one to talk to. I want to see how long she can last in solitude, and I'll use that on her if her mental state experiences a breakdown.
Anyway, I want to go to the northern region now, so I'll send you back to the training space, but I'll take Ba Shuxiang with me."

"All right." Liu Qingyu immediately agreed to that, then turned to Xing Mei. "Huan'er and I have advised you many times to accept Gu Zhan's death, but you are as stubborn as your son, so you can blame yourself for your fate."
"Qingyu! No! Please! Let me go!"

Liu Qingyu turned deaf ears at Xing Mei's shout, and she immediately disappeared into the training space after the portal opened. Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at his new prisoner, causing her to take a few steps back. "Hey, I'm not as depraved as your son, and I won't do anything to you. That's why you don't need to be afraid like this, and you can enjoy your time here alone."

After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took Ba Shuxiang to leave the Yin-Yang Space. Xing Mei instantly collapsed on the floor and cried loudly, and she kept calling her husband's name in hopes that Gu Tong could save her.

On the flying artifact, Hu Hong and Hu Qianli looked confused because Hu Qiaomu suddenly decided to bring them back to the central region, especially since she didn't explain anything to them. Moreover, she still hadn't found Hu Xiufu, but none of them dared to ask her, especially since her face looked so angry, so they were afraid that she would punish them.

Hu Qiaomu stood at the front of the artifact with her fists clenched tightly, making her palms completely red, and she kept pondering the situation. 'Damn it! What should I say to Hu Gao? He would definitely punish me for not carrying out his orders properly, and I even fell into a pathetic situation like this. How could he make those natural races obey him?

How did he use techniques with dark elements? Could it be that he is a demon? His cultivation soul clearly has the characteristics of a demon, so I believe that he is indeed a demon, but I'm confused about the reason those people obey him.'

Hu Hong and Hu Qianli responded to her with repeated nods, and Hu Qiaomu then told them that the identities of the cultivators were heavenly foxes, which confused them because they had never heard of that race before.

Observing their situation, Hu Qiaomu provided a detailed explanation of the relationship between the ten-tailed fox and the heavenly fox race. "Their race is the strongest among all fox races, especially since they were born as mythical beasts, so divine beasts like us are not their opponents at all."
"Does that mean Zhang Fei is also a heavenly fox like them, Elder? Otherwise, they wouldn't have come to this realm specifically to hunt him, right?" Hu Qianli asked Hu Qiaomu with a curious look.
Hu Qiaomu could only nod to them. "So you guys understand what you have to say to them, right?"
"Yes, Elder."

However, Hu Qianli and Hu Hong seemed curious about Zhang Fei after they heard all that, and they thought that he might be able to help them gain power and a freer life without having to be tied to their race, especially since their senior only regarded them as tools.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already taken Ba Shuxiang to his hideout in the Northern Region, so he immediately contacted Xie Jingxian, Mo Zifeng, Pang Hong, and Pang Gui, asking them to come see him right away.
"I didn't expect you to venture into this region by yourself, master." Bai Shuxiang suddenly said to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Do you dare to do so because you are a demon?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not deny Ba Shuxiang's guess. "If I didn't have the darkness element, then I would think twice about coming to this region, especially since they might be able to sense my presence. Moreover, the situation in this realm is extremely serious due to the presence of a demon portal in the demon cave.
If they manage to break the seal, the situation could spiral out of control, so I must take action to prevent this from happening."
Ba Shuxiang released a heavy sigh because she had never thought about such matters before, especially since her strength was too weak to help her seniors.

However, she started to learn many things after Zhang Xiaolong [3] took her to the Diyu Realm and the Netherworld Realm, especially after she listened to his conversation with Oz and the others before, so she realized that many powerful people from other realms could threaten their realm. "Are you sure you can stop them, Master?"

"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately shook his head. "You know that my cultivation is only in the soul realm, and I am no opponent for a senior like Chang Wuhan. Those people are much stronger than her, so I am just a speck of dust in their eyes, and I will die if I confront them with my current strength.
However, all of my wives, family, and friends live in this realm, so I can't turn a blind eye to this matter, or they will become victims if the demons manage to return."
Ba Shuxiang nodded in understanding at that. "Isn't that actually simple for you? You can take them to another realm so they don't have to face those demons, and they can live safely there."

"You are correct; I can indeed save them by moving them to another realm." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately looked at Ba Shuxiang. "Many of them, such as Qingyu, Lingxue, and Hua'er, have strong ties to this realm, especially since they were born and raised here, and their families also live here.
Furthermore, they are not cowardly, so I believe they would not be willing to leave this realm just to save themselves; they would want to help their seniors defend it."

"How about you bring some powerful demons from the Diyu Realm here, Master?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows at Bai Shuxiang. "It's true that the people in this realm don't like demons, but all of the major clans here know you and seem to respect you, so I don't think they will do anything to them.
Some of them, like Oz the 2nd, Zygoz, and Ursula, are quite powerful, so they will be valuable reinforcements for you in facing the demons of the Netherworld Realms."

"They are indeed strong for the Diyu Realm, but their current strength is still not enough to fight with the demons from the Netherworld Realm, and Chang Wuhen might be able to defeat Oz the 2nd, so I have to think twice about bringing them here.

Moreover, I don't know for sure about the characters of those senior cultivators, and human hearts are hard to predict, so they might attack them after we defeat those demons." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then sat on the floor and pulled Ba Shuxiang into his lap.

"At least, I have a little knowledge of the plans of the demons from that realm, but I still have no information about the plans of the ancestors of those heretics. I just need to wait for my slaves to come here, and then I will think of my next plan to deal with them after they tell me everything."

Ba Shuxiang was actually still embarrassed to be in such a position, especially since she was someone else's wife. However, she still tried to adjust to her situation, and she then put her arm around Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s neck. "Who exactly are your slaves, master? Are they members of those heretic clans?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed and told Ba Shuxiang. "I enslaved Pang Hong because he once made Hua'er his puppet, and I sent him to monitor the Gu Clan. As for Pan Gui, I enslaved him to help me eliminate the clans in the Eastern Region, and those clans have been destroyed by him now.

Unfortunately, Pang Liyuan has already died at the hands of Mu Xuanqing, so I don't have any spies in the Pang Clan. However, his wife, Xie Jingxian, is my slave, so I ordered her to spy on the Xie Clan."

"Eh? Did Pang Liyuan really die at his mother's hands?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at Ba Shuxiang. "Honestly, he wasn't too bad, and his techniques, especially his shadow techniques, were quite handy, but it's a shame he had to die too soon. Fortunately, he already gave you his techniques, and they will be useful to you against those demons from the Netherworld Realm."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked outside because Pang Hong and Pang Gui had already arrived there, and they immediately informed him about the Gu Clan's movements. "Hmm? They're already in the Pang Clan, huh? Does that mean they're going to move soon?"

"Master, we can't confirm that, especially now that Pang Wachun has come out of his isolation and continues to monitor our clan." Pang Gui then handed a bottle to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Master, they use this liquid to enhance the abilities of their Gu insects, and their abilities become more and more potent.
Moreover, some of them cannot die, and they continue to live again, even though they have been killed repeatedly."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the bottle cap, but a pungent smell came from inside, so he closed it again. "Do you know what materials they use to concoct this liquid?"

Pang Hong immediately answered Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "We don't know about the materials because we didn't witness them concocting this liquid. We infiltrated the Gu Clan after Gu Changsheng and Gu Jinglin led many of their clan members to the Pang Clan.
However, we found many corpses under the clan, both humans and beasts, so we think that Gu Changsheng and Gu Jinglin sacrificed them to concoct this liquid."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at them with a frown. 'Is it possible to concoct a potion by sacrificing living creatures, Mei?'

[Master, I don't have much information about alchemy, but I think something like that is possible. It would be better if you asked Zhang Lingxue, especially since she is an experienced alchemist, so she might know something about this potion.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately put the potion bottle into the system inventory, so his real body could take it out and show it to Zhang Lingxue. "All right, I want you two to go to the Pang Clan right now, and you must report to me immediately if they start moving."
"Yes, Master."

Both men immediately left the place, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned after he received a voice transmission from Mo Zifeng, who told him that he could not leave the Mo Clan, especially since Mo Jingyun was gathering them.
In addition, Mo Zifeng told Zhang Xiaolong [3] that Mo Changqiong and Gu Sanxi had already left for the Pang Clan a few days ago, and Mo Jingyun would lead them there soon.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately ordered Mo Zifeng to keep an eye on the people from the Mo Clan, and he then asked Xie Jingxian, who had just arrived at his place. "What about your clan? Have they also gone to the Pang Clan?"

"Yes, Master." Xie Jingxian then sat in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3], but she glanced at Ba Shuxiang in confusion, especially since there should be no more demons in the Sky Jade Realm. "Actually, my parents asked me to join them in going to that clan, but I refused their request because I couldn't possibly come to you if I went there, so I waited in my clan for you to return.

Anyway, my ancestor ordered them to bring an object, but I don't know anything about it because my father hid it from me. However, he didn't seem to prepare it to fight Chang Wuhen and the others, and they might use it for other purposes."

"Does Xie Zhengwu want to use that thing to suppress the other heretics?" Xie Jingxian answered Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a nod. "He doesn't seem to trust Pang Wachun and the others, huh? However, that's a good thing, and I might be able to seize the opportunity to immobilize them."
"Does that mean you'll move there now, Master?" Xie Jingxian inquired curiously.
"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at her. "I'm not their opponent, so I won't make a move by myself, and I'll monitor their movements from here."

Following this, Zhang Xiaolong [3] promptly contacted his acquaintances, relaying the information to his acquaintances. He then instructed them to relay this information to the senior cultivators in the Demon Cave, urging them to remain vigilant against the movements of the heretics.

In addition, he also ordered Hu Qiaomu to return to her sub-realm immediately, so she could gather the members of her race to help those seniors. He didn't forget to contact Oliver and the others, especially since they needed a lot of people to deal with their enemies, some of whom were even stronger than Chang Wuhen.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Xie Jingxian. "Since your parents and ancestors are in the Pang Clan, you do not need to return to the Xie Clan for the time being, and the two of you will help me to improve my cultivation."
Xie Jingxian did not refuse Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s order, especially since her husband had died at the hands of her mother-in-law, and she also needed a man to satisfy her lust.

Luo Yigang and Dong Fuxiang, caretakers of the Luo and Dong Clan, immediately sought their leader's approval to mobilize their clansmen. Once they received this approval, they promptly led a significant number of people from both clans towards the demon cave.

The people from the Heavenly Sword Sect in the western continent also did the same thing; Su Qingshi and Yang Ye directly selected the best people from their sect, whether they were elders or core disciples.

After they made some preparations, they immediately led those people to leave their sect for the demon cave, and several members from the Ba Clan also joined them, especially since their patriarch was the leader of the sect.
Even though Ye Yuan had forbidden her, Yan Huan'er decided to leave for the northern region, but she did not go there alone; she went with several strong cultivators from the demon fox group.

At the Yin-Yang Pavilion, Shen Yang, who had just recovered from his injuries, immediately gathered all the members of the Shen Clan and the elders of the sect. They immediately set off in a large entourage, and they also brought disciples who had the qualifications for such a fight.

Since their region was relatively safe because the vassals of the Pang Clan had been destroyed, the people from the Liu, Meng, Ding, Ying, Wei, and Ni Clans also moved quite a lot of their members towards the northern region.

From the Hidden Sea Palace, Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin decided to go to the demon cave, but elders such as Ye Qianyu and some others also went with the two. Additionally, they chose some core disciples to join them, one of which was Yue Lanxin.
Two seniors of the Hai Clan, Hai Ziwan and Hai Furong, decided to come out of their seclusion after hearing the news about the movement of the heretics, and join their juniors.

Although they had not been involved in external affairs for a long time, Shen Huang and Shen Xinya also decided to leave their underwater cave to help them all fight those heretics. Furthermore, their cultivation had already reached the 1-Star Sovereign Realm, so they were the strongest in the southern region.
Unlike them, Elmyra, the elf leader, decided to stay in the southern region to monitor the region, especially since the region would be vulnerable to surprise attacks with their departure.

In a few minutes, they had arrived at the tower area, but the Amaris Twins' immediately looked at Feltia [2] in shock, especially since the distance from the death valley was quite far.

Feltia [2] just smiled and brought them to land, but the other demon rulers were already waiting for him, and Aries was the first to greet him. "Hahaha! I didn't expect you to subdue these twins so quickly, and they look so docile now.
Moreover, your demon rank has reached marquis rank now, but I'm sure that you still can't face me, so you better reach the duke rank soon, and we'll fight with all our strength then."
"Is it just a fight in your brain?" Feltia [2] asked Aries while shaking his head. "For now, there are many serious matters waiting for me, so I don't want to think about such a thing."
"Feltia, I want to thank you." Kinos, the cancer, said as he glanced at the black Amaris. "If it weren't for you, I would still be trapped in her illusion."

"What do you want to tell us?" Scorpius asked Feltia [2].

Even so, they didn't dare to say anything, especially since the Amaris Twins and the other demon rulers were with him, and he seemed to have a good relationship with them.

Naeth and several female demon seniors also watched Feltia [2] from a distance, but they were confused by his closeness to the demon rulers; even the Amaris Twins seemed obedient to him, even though they still maintained their cold expressions.

Feltia [2] didn't think much of them and ordered them to meet him later after he finished talking with the demon rulers, and the Amaris Twins helped him to pressure them, so none of them dared to refuse his order.

After they arrived at the throne room, Feltia [2] immediately told them about the departure of Oz the 2nd and the two ancestors to the netherworld realm, which shocked them. However, his following words shocked them even more, especially since he told them that Oz the 1st was still alive, and he was in that realm now.

As for the other realms, those demon rulers were no longer surprised by it, especially since their realm was also connected to other realms, and they also already knew that Feltia [2] could traverse between realms from Oz the 2nd.

"Are you serious about that? Is the fist demon emperor really still alive?" Lycus asked with an incredulous look, especially since Oz the 1st had been missing for too long, and they always thought that he was dead.

After learning the truth, the white Amaris's expression turned deathly pale, especially since she was the one who sent Oz the 1st to another realm, and she was afraid that he would punish her after he returned later.

Feltia [2] nodded to them before continuing her explanation. "Currently, Tharnon is around Oz the 1st to keep an eye on him, but he can only watch him from a distance. After all, the first demon emperor's situation is not good because he doesn't have his past memories, so he can't remember all of you.
Besides, there are many powerful people controlling him from behind, so we can't save him yet, and we have to wait for the right time to do that."

Kyllia, the gorgon, immediately joined Ashreth and the others, and she waited for Feltia [2], who was observing Naeth and the others.

"I know what you all think, and I know everyone must find it hard to accept me because I'm an incubus. However, you guys must have heard about their betrayal, right? They've lost their status because of that, and Oz the 2nd appointed me as the ruler of this sub-realm to replace them. I'm not a difficult person, and I won't make things difficult for you; therefore, the choice is up to you.

First, if you are willing to submit and obey me, I will assist you in becoming stronger. If you don't believe me, feel free to ask them. Second, you guys can leave this tower if you really don't want to do it, and I won't stop anyone who wants to go." Feltia [2] then unleashed his demon power and killing intent, causing the others to retreat several steps and shiver.
"Even though I am an easygoing person, I will not spare anyone who chooses to be my enemy, and I will mercilessly kill those who intend to attack or kill me, whether they are men or women."

Feltia [2] immediately withdrew his demon power and killing intent, especially since he only wanted to warn those senior female demons. He then took out bottles containing his Yang Qi based on their numbers, confusing them. "Kyllia and the others have already experienced the effects of its contents, and I dare to guarantee that all of you will gradually become stronger if you drink it often.
However, I will only give it to those who are willing to submit and obey me, so the choice is yours."
The female demons became confused and wondered in their hearts about it, especially since Kyllia had already told them that Feltia [2] gave her something that helped her become strong.

Nadea then spoke to them. "Hey! Lord Feltia is not lying to you because I myself have drunk it many times in the past few days, and I can tell you that its effects will be helpful to you, so you don't need to think too much and submit to him. Moreover, many of you used to live in misery like me before the Twins brought us here, and I believe you don't want to go back to those times again, right?
That's why the best choice for all of you is to accept him as your new ruler, and you no longer need to suffer like in the past."

Several female demon seniors immediately agreed to stay, so Feltia [2] immediately gave them his yang qi and asked them to go. Some decided to leave the tower, especially since they did not want to be led by a male demon, and he did not stop them as promised.
Naeth appeared to be grappling with a difficult decision, especially since she was ambitious to become strong, but she did not like Feltia [2].

Feltia [2] then spoke to Naeth. "I will give you three days to think about it, and you can come to me to get it if you decide to submit to me. If you still don't want to accept me, then you can leave this tower three days later."

Naeth nodded and exited the throne room, while Feltia [2] handed Kyllia a paper containing the location of the ancient places in the Diyu Realm. "I want you to form several groups of demons to check all these places, and all of you must look for the place that has the mysterious keyhole."

paragraphs: In the Pang Clan, the ancestors of those heretic clans finally came out of their seclusion, and they immediately gathered their juniors who had arrived at the clan.
"Hey, Fengyi! The people from your clan haven't arrived yet." Pang Xiuwen immediately spoke to the ancestor of the Mo Clan.

Mo Fengyi immediately contacted Mo Changqiong and Mo Jingyun. "They are already on their way here, but they have to find something first, so they will be a little late. Moreover, our armies haven't arrived yet, so we don't need to rush."

"Xie Fanjing and Lai Rouyu will arrive soon, along with the people from my Xie Clan, so we just need to wait for the others." Xie Zhengwu then turned to the Gu Clan's two ancestors. "How about your Gu insects? Did the liquid strengthen them?"

Gu Changseng immediately took out a wooden box and opened it, revealing a black larva covered in black aura. "This is the newest type of our Gu insect, and it is almost unkillable. Every time it dies, it will immediately come back to life. Moreover, once I send it into the bodies of humans or beasts, it will immediately lay eggs.
Those eggs will become the most deadly poison, quickly dissolving their internal organs."

Seeing that they didn't believe her brother's explanation, Gu Jinglin immediately stretched his hand out. A guard from the Pang Clan soon entered the room, his expression clearly revealing her control over him. "Brother."
"Yeah." Gu Changseng immediately stood up before stuffing the black larva into the guard's mouth, and no one stopped him because they were curious about the effect.

As a result, the guard's skin started to turn purplish black, and numerous blisters quickly appeared all over his body, followed by a pungent odor. Soon, they could see that blood began to flow out of his orifices, causing him to fall to the ground and convulse violently, but he quickly met his end.
"Hahahaha!" Gu Changsheng laughed at their silly expressions, but he then took the gu insect and put it back into the box.

Gu Jinglin smirked slightly before asking them. "Do you still doubt us? paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to give Gu Jinglin a few qi recovery pills, and she swallowed them immediately after he told her the effects, which made her yin qi recover quite quickly.

[You obtained the Gu Creation Technique.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed his eyes to read the technique, but he immediately frowned because the Gu creation technique could not be used by just anyone, and there was one condition that had to be met in order to learn it, which was a Gu's heart.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his eyes and asked Gu Jinglin. "Where did you obtain the Gu's heart?" Did you get it from the demons of the netherworld realm?"

As for his purpose to teach them about the technique as well as the way to create the Gu's heart, my ancestors didn't explain it in detail, or rather they couldn't say anything about it, especially since he implanted a special Gu insect in them, and our Gu clan cultivates Gu insects since then."

'Do you think that person came here because of the ten-tailed fox, Mei?'

[That's possible, master. Gu insects are still beasts, and the ten-tailed fox was one of the strongest beasts in the past, so that person probably wanted to obtain his legacy to improve them. So far, we have only found his soul, and it has merged with yours.
There may still be his other legacies in this realm, but that's just my guess, especially since I haven't found anything else related to him, even though I've scanned it several times.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with Mei before asking Gu Jinglin again. "Do you still have a spare of the Gu's heart?"

"No." Gu Jinglin answered with a shake of her head. "To create one Gu's heart takes several years, and not all human bodies can accommodate it. If their bodies are not compatible with it, then they will die immediately, and it will also be destroyed. In fact, many of my clan members died because of the process, and only a few managed to accommodate it."

"That technique requires such a vicious process, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself as he reconsidered learning the Gu technique, especially since he had so many people by his side who would be miserable if he died.

Moreover, Mei didn't know whether the system could help him contain the Gu's heart, and there wasn't much information about Gu insects in the system, so he decided to ignore the technique for now. "Show me all your Gu insects."

Gu Jinglin immediately took out several wooden boxes of different sizes, and there were various types of Gu insects inside, which piqued Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s curiosity. She then explained to him the abilities of each Gu insect, starting with tracking Gu, poison Gu, blood Gu, soul Gu, and so on.
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took the last Gu insect, especially since it was different from the other ones, and its form was a black larva. "Is this the unkillable Gu insect?"

"Yes." Gu Jinglin nodded to him. "We created this Gu insect using the souls of many living creatures, including humans and beasts. We call it the immortal golden Gu, especially since it will revive continuously even if you kill it again and again. It took too many sacrifices to develop, so we can only make two. One in my hand, and the other in my brother's hand."
With his heavenly fox aura suppressing the larva, Zhang Xiaolong [3] faintly smiled as he observed it curled up and shaking in his palm. "Anyway, how can you store your Gu insects in your body?"

"I find it difficult to explain to you, but they don't actually live inside my body; instead, they reside in a separate space within my body. That person calls it a Gu cage, and you can learn it from that technique." Gu Jinglin's answer made Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a low sigh as he thought that Gu technique was too complicated to learn. "Aren't you going to take me out?
They'll be moving soon, so it'll be too late for you if they set off for the demon cave."

Oz the 1st then turned to the black crow, but he immediately realized that it was not Morgana's black crow, and he also felt something unusual between them. "Who are you? Why are you here?"

"Master." Oz the 1st raised his eyebrows after the black crow, who was none other than Tharnon, addressed him as such. "You may not have memories of your past, but I still remember all our memories. You are my master, and I am your mount, Tharnon."
"Tharnon?" Oz the 1st mumbled as he looked at the black crow seriously, but he couldn't remember the name. "Did we really know each other before?"

"That's for sure!" Tharnon then told Oz the 1st about the Diyu Realm and all the events they had gone through in the past, especially their battle with the winged race from the Xian Realm, and he also told him about the actions of the white Amaris towards him.
"For thousands of years, I always thought that you were dead, but someone found you here, so I asked him to bring me here to prove the truth, and here we are now."
Even though he had heard all that, Oz the 1st still didn't seem to believe Tharnon, especially since he couldn't remember anything of it. "Who is that person? What does he have to do with us?"

Tharnon shook his head at Oz the 1st. "Master, I'm sorry, but I can't tell you his identity. In fact, he has nothing to do with us, and he came to our realm because of a personal matter. However, your successor approached him and requested his cooperation, to which he acquiesced. Since then, he has greatly assisted us in eliminating those traitors.
Currently, the situation there is more under control now, but our enemies are still stalking our realm, so we are thinking of a way to free you from those traitors."

However, he suddenly received a voice transmission from Pang Xiuwen, who told him that all the main members of their clans had arrived, and they would soon move to the demon cave, so he asked him to return to the Pang Clan.

"What else?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] answered while grabbing Gu Jinglin's shoulder. They're going to the demon cave soon, so we should go there now to get ahead of them."

Gu Jinglin just nodded and rushed towards that location, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his map to look for other cultivators. However, not all of them had arrived in that region, especially those from the southern region, particularly since the distance between the two regions was end to end. "I hope everything will go smoothly."

sentences.text: Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to give Gu Jinglin a few qi recovery pills, and she swallowed them immediately after he told her the effects, which made her yin qi recover quite quickly.
Gu Jinglin sat in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and asked a question.
"What do you want from me?"

"Teach me your Gu technique." Gu Jinglin frowned for a moment at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s request, but she couldn't refuse him with his slave mark in her soul, so she directly shared her clan technique with him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed his eyes to read the technique, but he immediately frowned because the Gu creation technique could not be used by just anyone, and there was one condition that had to be met in order to learn it, which was a Gu's heart.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with Mei before asking Gu Jinglin again.

Gu Jinglin immediately took out several wooden boxes of different sizes, and there were various types of Gu insects inside, which piqued Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s curiosity.

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took the last Gu insect, especially since it was different from the other ones, and its form was a black larva.
"Is this the unkillable Gu insect?"
"Yes." Gu Jinglin nodded to him.
"We created this Gu insect using the souls of many living creatures, including humans and beasts.
We call it the immortal golden Gu, especially since it will revive continuously even if you kill it again and again.
It took too many sacrifices to develop, so we can only make two.
One in my hand, and the other in my brother's hand."
With his heavenly fox aura suppressing the larva, Zhang Xiaolong [3] faintly smiled as he observed it curled up and shaking in his palm.
"Anyway, how can you store your Gu insects in your body?"
"I find it difficult to explain to you, but they don't actually live inside my body; instead, they reside in a separate space within my body.
That person calls it a Gu cage, and you can learn it from that technique." Gu Jinglin's answer made Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a low sigh as he thought that Gu technique was too complicated to learn.
"Aren't you going to take me out?
They'll be moving soon, so it'll be too late for you if they set off for the demon cave."
"Not now." Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned the immortal Gu to its box before standing up.
"I only have one portal in the northern region, and your brother is still waiting for me there, so I will wait for him to leave first."
"How did you know that my brother was waiting for you there?" Gu Jinglin asked in confusion because they were in his private space.

"You are my slave now, but you are just a cannon fodder, so I won't tell you anything." Gu Jinglin looked annoyed by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer, especially since he clearly intended to sacrifice her.
"Moreover, the other cultivators from the other four regions are heading towards this region now, and some members of the natural races are following them.
That's why I'm not worried about being late, especially since your brother and the others have to deal with them first, so I just need to wait for the right time to bring you out."
Gu Jinglin was completely shocked after hearing that, especially about the members of the natural races.
"So it's true, huh?
You've known about our plans for a long time, and you deliberately stayed in this region just to keep an eye on us."
"My cultivation is much lower than you guys, so I have to use my brain to fight you all, right?

Because I have many powerful connections, I just need to share all the information with them so they can prepare to face them." Zhang Xiaolong then left Gu Jinglin and went to check on Xing Mei, especially since he could hear her moans when he dual-cultivated with Ba Shuxian and Xie Jingxian, and they did it for quite a while, so she was affected by their activities.
Gu Jinglin continued to look at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s back as she repeatedly sighed and muttered. 'Where did he actually come from?
He's still so young, but he's already ruined all the plans we've made for years, and our final plan will fail miserably because those people already know everything.'

As he expected, Zhang Xiaolong [3] found Xing Mei lying on the floor completely naked, but her appearance did not tempt him in the slightest, especially since her body was too ordinary despite her pretty face.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately crouched down beside Xing Mei, stuffed a Qi recovery pill into her mouth, and channeled his light Qi into his body to wake her up.
In a few minutes, Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw Xing Mei's eyelids tremble, and her eyes slowly opened.
However, her mind was still muddled by her previous masturbation, so she looked at him in confusion.
Xing Mei's expression turned to fear after she regained her composure, and the memories of their previous actions came rushing back.
In that instant, she realized that she was naked, causing her face to turn extremely red with embarrassment.
Suddenly, Zhang Xiaolong [3] covered her with her dress, confusing Xing Mei, as she thought that he would force her to serve him.
"To tell you the truth, I never had such an intention towards you, especially since we never really had any problems before, and your son's death was his own fault.

That's why I will keep you locked up in this place forever, so you can forget about your freedom."

Come back quickly and save me from this place; I don't want to rot to death here.'
