chapters.title: Chapter 421 Gathered
paragraphs: "Have they moved here?" Zi'er inquired immediately upon the appearance of Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told them about the heretics' latest plan, especially about the Gu insects of the Gu Clan. After that, he handed them several small bottles. "Gu Jinglin has already fallen into my hands, and I obtained these antidotes from her, so you guys don't need to be afraid of their poison Gu.
However, you guys still have to be careful of their other Gu insects, especially the heart-controlling Gu and the soul-devouring Gu."
"What are the abilities of those two insects?" It was Di Xingjie who asked Zhang Xiaolong[3].

"If the heart-controlling Gu invades your bodies, then you guys will completely fall into Gu Changsheng's control, and he can use you to kill each other." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer caused them to frown, but his next explanation frightened them even more.

"The soul-devouring Gu's ability is even more terrifying, especially since it will slowly devour your soul, and all of you will experience extremely terrifying torture. Unfortunately, there is no item that can repel both of them, and the only way to get rid of them is by using light qi.

Moreover, both insects are small and difficult to see with the naked eye, so it's crucial that you always shield yourself with Qi. Otherwise, none of you will notice if both insects enter your body, which would be detrimental to us."
They solemnly nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3], followed by a question from Feng Xiaogang. "What about the demons in the Netherworld realm? Do you have any information about their movements?"

"Not yet." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked Mei to open a portal to the training space. "I haven't been to that realm for three days, but those cultivators have probably arrived there by now, so I'll go there now to check on them, and my fourth clone will help you guys monitor those heretics."

Feng Xiaogang and the others were surprised when the gate leading to the Netherworld realm opened before their eyes, and they could feel such a powerful demon aura from it. Zhang Xiaolong[3] immediately entered it, and it disappeared from their sight in that instant.

"You kid! You are our junior, but all of your abilities always amaze us." Di Xingjie then questioned Zhang Fei [4]. "How have you progressed in studying the formation arrays I gave you previously? Don't tell me that you have already understood them all in just three weeks."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed before nodding to Di Xingjie. "I already understand them all, Senior. However, I am still busy with my cultivation, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] is occupied with various matters, so I haven't had time to look for materials to install them."

Di Xingjie massaged his forehead after listening to Zhang Fei [4]'s answer, especially since studying and understanding formation arrays was never easy, even if they were basic formation arrays, yet he could understand all five formations in a short time. "You're a freak kid! It took me three months to fully comprehend everything.

Anyway, after we have cleared out these heretics and repelled those demons, you can visit our Di Clan, and our patriarch will surely be happy to help you if he knows of your talent in formation arrays."

Zhang Fei [4] suddenly turned in another direction and saw several flying artifacts moving towards them quickly. "The people from the eastern and western regions have already arrived, so we just need to wait for the people from the southern region."
"Who are they?" Chang Liangjun asked while pointing at a flying artifact that was still quite far from their location.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] immediately checked the identities of the flying artifact's passengers on his map. "They are the moon foxes."

Several people suddenly appeared before them, but their presence caused the atmosphere in the place to become silent as they were completely surprised by their presence, especially the ordinary members of those clans, and they looked at Zhang Fei [4] with questions in their minds.

"You have arrived in this region for a long time, but you only appear now, Grandpa Oliver." Zhang Fei [4] uttered these words as he approached the group of natural races, then turned his attention to the people from those clans. "I don't need to explain their identities to all of you, right?"

Oliver just smiled at the people. "Just like you, I also monitor the movements of those heretics, so I know that you have caused a stir among them by kidnapping Gu Jinglin, and your action was very good for us because their strength was reduced quite a bit. Anyway, I deliberately left Elmyra and some of them in the four regions, so they could help protect them."

"It's not a problem, Grandpa. They are also as strong as Sabina and the others, so they are enough to help us." Zhang Fei [4] then looked at the people who had just arrived before speaking to them. "I know that all of you are powerful cultivators, and the majority of you are much stronger than me.

I can also understand your desire to protect this realm, but our opponents are not only those heretics and demons, and it is possible that we will also face those cultivators from the upper realms. That's why I hope all of you will not force yourselves to fight them if that happens, especially since you will only die in vain in their hands.
If you die, then this realm will completely fall into their hands, but you still have a chance to reclaim it if you are still alive."

"Do you think we can hide from them?" Lian Xiang immediately asked Zhang Fei [4]. "You yourself said that they are too strong, and their cultivation has already surpassed the ten mortal realms, so there will be no safe place in this realm if they really help those demons to attack us."

"That's right." Luo Yigang, the caretaker of the Luo Clan, nodded in agreement with that. "Since their cultivation is already that high, they will definitely be able to find us without breaking a sweat, so I think there is no point in us running away and hiding, and it would be better if we fought them to the death."

"Haha." Dong Fuxiang laughed as he patted Luo Yigang on the shoulder. "I agree with you, Brother Luo. In the past, our ancestors also did the same, and they sacrificed themselves to seal those demons. We are descendants of brave warriors, so we will not cower, let alone run away from the fight, and we will use all our strength to eliminate the enemies."
"This realm is our ancestral land, so we must protect it with our lives." Chu Liuxiang then looked at Zhang Fei [4]. "We are old now, so it doesn't matter if we have to die to defend this realm.

However, I hope that you can bring our descendants away from this realm if we fail to stop them; only then will our descendants not be wiped out, and they can strengthen themselves to take back this realm from their hands in the future."
*Zing... Zing...*

As soon as they heard the sound of sword vibrations, they immediately turned to Yang Ye, who then spoke to them. "As you guys can see, my sword is thirsting for blood, so I will use their blood to satisfy it, especially the blood of the remaining traitors of our realm."
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Dozens of women suddenly appeared before them, and all of them immediately kneeled before Zhang Fei [4]. "Master."

'Master?' Yang Ye and the others were shocked to hear that. 'Since when did he have so many subordinates? Furthermore, all of them are women, and their cultivation is not bad either; most of them have reached the earth realm.'
Zhang Fei [4] just nodded to the members of the demon fox group, and Mei immediately opened the gate to the training ground, which shocked them again.

Boitata was the first to walk out from inside while glancing at the cultivators with a playful smile on her face, and several other women followed behind her, such as Zhang Lingxue, Liu Qingyu, Liu Hua, Shen Yu, Shen Xueyi, the Wen Twins, Qiao Ran, and Mei Xiang.
Not only them, but even some of Zhang Fei [1]'s partners, such as Yan Luan'er, Xi Zihua, and Shi Yue, also joined them.

Additionally, Zhang Fei himself decided to end his seclusion for the time being, especially since the women insisted on participating in the fight; there was no way he would let them fight on their own. However, he strictly forbade those whose cultivation was still below the Earth Realm from joining them, especially since they would not be able to withstand the pressure from their enemies.

They were no longer surprised to see that, especially since most of them had seen Zhang Fei and his two clones at the Yin-Yang Pavilion during his wedding with Shen Yu. Instead, they were curious about Qiao Ran and Mei Xiang's presence, especially since their Qiao and Mei clans were vassals of the Pang Clan.

However, they remembered that the Mei Clan had been destroyed, and they had also heard rumors that the Qiao Clan had undergone significant changes, which coincided with the destruction of the Huan Clan.

After that, his fourth clone immediately returned to the training space, so he could complete the daily quest and others. Zhang Fei smiled as he looked at them one by one, and he felt amazed by their determination to defend their ancestral realm. "Seniors, all of you are extraordinary cultivators with strong determination, and I still have a lot to learn from all of you."

"You don't need to be humble like that, Kid." Luo Yigang spoke with a shake of his head. "If not for you, we wouldn't be here, and we'd never know about those demons and heretics' plans, let alone the powerful cultivators behind them."
"If we manage to win this battle, then you will be a hero for this realm, Kid." Zhu Xuejun said it with an admiring look.

"Haha." Instead, Zhang Fei laughed at Zhu Xuejun's words. "Senior, I am not a hero, and I never wanted to be one. I did everything just to protect the people closest to me, so they could live in peace without having to be haunted by threatening dangers.

Anyway, it would be better for all of you to spread out now, especially since those people are getting closer to this area, and they might notice your presence, so you must suppress it as much as possible."
All of them nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei, and they immediately scattered in various directions after dividing their people into several small groups.
As usual, Liu Hua and the Wen Twins led the members of the demon fox group. Meanwhile, Liu Qingyu went with Qiao Ran and Mei Xiang to another area, as did Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu, who went together.
Yan Luan'er, Xi Zihua, and Shi Yue also left together while they waited for the people from the Yin-Yang Pavilion to arrive.
Zhang Lingxue joined the members of the Zhang Clan, and she divided them into two groups, with Zi'er leading half of them.
Oliver and several leaders from the natural races also left their meeting location, but they stood guard around the entrance to the demon cave.

Boitata did not leave the place, and she accompanied Zhang Fei, who was watching the movements of those heretics from the map. She then looked towards the members of the moon fox races who had just arrived, and he could see the hostility in Hu Peiwu and Hu Dahai's eyes, especially since Hu Gao had given them specific orders.
Unlike them, Hu Qiaomu looks frustrated with herself, especially since her life is in Zhang Fei's hands with the fusion of their souls, so she no longer has her freedom anymore.

Boitata brought her head to Zhang Fei's ear before whispering to him. 'Husband, the cultivation of those two old men is a level above mine, and the other three are on par with me. Even so, I am confident that we can still face them, especially with Hu Qiaomu's help. Moreover, you can borrow half of my strength, so you can suppress them with your bloodline power, and we can defeat them directly.'

'You are right.' Zhang Fei nodded to Boitata as he looked at those people with a faint smile. 'We won't make a move on them for now, especially since those heretics are getting closer. However, we'll make a move right away if they attack us first, and I'll use them to pressure Hu Gao so I can take Hu Yue from them faster.'
'In that case, I will monitor them closely.' Boitata replied while nodding in agreement.

Zhang Fei then spoke to Hu Qiaomu. "It's good that you guys have arrived here, as those heretics are on their way to this area. I hope you can spread out to block them, and if you have the chance, kill them."
"Humph!" Some of them snorted coldly before leading the rest of their members to disappear from the place, but Zhang Fei didn't pay much attention to their behavior.
"What is your plan exactly? Are we going to fight those heretics head-on?" Hu Qiaomu immediately questioned Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei smiled in response. "Your race members are too arrogant and overconfident, you know? Those heretics are not as weak as they think, and they have also prepared a lot of things to face us. But meh, I don't care if something happens to them, and it would be better for me if they died by their hands, so Hu Gau will think again to find trouble with me."
"What do you mean by that?" Hu Qiaomu inquired with a frown, as she could not possibly let her race members die at the hands of those heretics.
Instead, Zhang Fei shrugged his shoulders. "I won't tell you anything, and you can find a place to hide for now."
"Tch!" Hu Qiaomu gritted her teeth and flew away directly, but she also warned her clansmen to be careful, especially since Zhang Fei's previous words gave her a bad feeling.

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was sitting leisurely on one of the Arbeola branches, and his eyes kept watching the situation in the Demon Emperor City, but he had not found any cultivators from the upper realm, which confused him.

Arbeola suddenly told Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Hey, that female cultivator came here three days ago, and she came here specifically to look for you, so I told her that you went to another area because you were bored of staying here."
"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised to hear Shang Yaolin looking for him. "Do you know the purpose of her looking for me, Old Demon?"

"No." Arbeola answered with a slight shake of his head. "After she couldn't find you here, that woman immediately went to look for you, and she also didn't want to tell me her reason, so you have to be careful of her."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding at Arbeola's warning, but his expression immediately changed when he felt a powerful aura coming from the sky, so he immediately looked up and found a red flying artifact flying quickly towards the Demon Emperor City. "They've finally arrived, Old Demon. There are quite a few of them, and two among them are truly powerful."

sentences.text: "Have they moved here?" Zi'er inquired immediately upon the appearance of Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told them about the heretics' latest plan, especially about the Gu insects of the Gu Clan.
After that, he handed them several small bottles.
"Gu Jinglin has already fallen into my hands, and I obtained these antidotes from her, so you guys don't need to be afraid of their poison Gu.
However, you guys still have to be careful of their other Gu insects, especially the heart-controlling Gu and the soul-devouring Gu."
"What are the abilities of those two insects?" It was Di Xingjie who asked Zhang Xiaolong[3].

"If the heart-controlling Gu invades your bodies, then you guys will completely fall into Gu Changsheng's control, and he can use you to kill each other." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer caused them to frown, but his next explanation frightened them even more.
"The soul-devouring Gu's ability is even more terrifying, especially since it will slowly devour your soul, and all of you will experience extremely terrifying torture.
Unfortunately, there is no item that can repel both of them, and the only way to get rid of them is by using light qi.
Moreover, both insects are small and difficult to see with the naked eye, so it's crucial that you always shield yourself with Qi.
Otherwise, none of you will notice if both insects enter your body, which would be detrimental to us."
They solemnly nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3], followed by a question from Feng Xiaogang.
"What about the demons in the Netherworld realm?
Do you have any information about their movements?"
"Not yet." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked Mei to open a portal to the training space.

"I haven't been to that realm for three days, but those cultivators have probably arrived there by now, so I'll go there now to check on them, and my fourth clone will help you guys monitor those heretics."
Feng Xiaogang and the others were surprised when the gate leading to the Netherworld realm opened before their eyes, and they could feel such a powerful demon aura from it.
Zhang Xiaolong[3] immediately entered it, and it disappeared from their sight in that instant.
"You kid!
You are our junior, but all of your abilities always amaze us." Di Xingjie then questioned Zhang Fei [4].
"How have you progressed in studying the formation arrays I gave you previously?
Don't tell me that you have already understood them all in just three weeks."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed before nodding to Di Xingjie.
"I already understand them all, Senior.
However, I am still busy with my cultivation, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] is occupied with various matters, so I haven't had time to look for materials to install them."

Di Xingjie massaged his forehead after listening to Zhang Fei [4]'s answer, especially since studying and understanding formation arrays was never easy, even if they were basic formation arrays, yet he could understand all five formations in a short time.
"You're a freak kid!
It took me three months to fully comprehend everything.

Anyway, after we have cleared out these heretics and repelled those demons, you can visit our Di Clan, and our patriarch will surely be happy to help you if he knows of your talent in formation arrays."
Zhang Fei [4] suddenly turned in another direction and saw several flying artifacts moving towards them quickly.
"The people from the eastern and western regions have already arrived, so we just need to wait for the people from the southern region."
"Who are they?" Chang Liangjun asked while pointing at a flying artifact that was still quite far from their location.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] immediately checked the identities of the flying artifact's passengers on his map.
"They are the moon foxes."

Several people suddenly appeared before them, but their presence caused the atmosphere in the place to become silent as they were completely surprised by their presence, especially the ordinary members of those clans, and they looked at Zhang Fei [4] with questions in their minds.

"You have arrived in this region for a long time, but you only appear now, Grandpa Oliver." Zhang Fei [4] uttered these words as he approached the group of natural races, then turned his attention to the people from those clans.
"I don't need to explain their identities to all of you, right?"
Oliver just smiled at the people.

"Just like you, I also monitor the movements of those heretics, so I know that you have caused a stir among them by kidnapping Gu Jinglin, and your action was very good for us because their strength was reduced quite a bit.
Anyway, I deliberately left Elmyra and some of them in the four regions, so they could help protect them."
"It's not a problem, Grandpa.
They are also as strong as Sabina and the others, so they are enough to help us." Zhang Fei [4] then looked at the people who had just arrived before speaking to them.
"I know that all of you are powerful cultivators, and the majority of you are much stronger than me.
I can also understand your desire to protect this realm, but our opponents are not only those heretics and demons, and it is possible that we will also face those cultivators from the upper realms.
That's why I hope all of you will not force yourselves to fight them if that happens, especially since you will only die in vain in their hands.
If you die, then this realm will completely fall into their hands, but you still have a chance to reclaim it if you are still alive."
"Do you think we can hide from them?" Lian Xiang immediately asked Zhang Fei [4].

"You yourself said that they are too strong, and their cultivation has already surpassed the ten mortal realms, so there will be no safe place in this realm if they really help those demons to attack us."
"That's right." Luo Yigang, the caretaker of the Luo Clan, nodded in agreement with that.

"Since their cultivation is already that high, they will definitely be able to find us without breaking a sweat, so I think there is no point in us running away and hiding, and it would be better if we fought them to the death."
"Haha." Dong Fuxiang laughed as he patted Luo Yigang on the shoulder.
"I agree with you, Brother Luo.
In the past, our ancestors also did the same, and they sacrificed themselves to seal those demons.
We are descendants of brave warriors, so we will not cower, let alone run away from the fight, and we will use all our strength to eliminate the enemies."
"This realm is our ancestral land, so we must protect it with our lives." Chu Liuxiang then looked at Zhang Fei [4].
"We are old now, so it doesn't matter if we have to die to defend this realm.

However, I hope that you can bring our descendants away from this realm if we fail to stop them; only then will our descendants not be wiped out, and they can strengthen themselves to take back this realm from their hands in the future."
*Zing...
Zing...*
As soon as they heard the sound of sword vibrations, they immediately turned to Yang Ye, who then spoke to them.
"As you guys can see, my sword is thirsting for blood, so I will use their blood to satisfy it, especially the blood of the remaining traitors of our realm."
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
Dozens of women suddenly appeared before them, and all of them immediately kneeled before Zhang Fei [4].
"Master."
'Master?' Yang Ye and the others were shocked to hear that. 'Since when did he have so many subordinates?
Furthermore, all of them are women, and their cultivation is not bad either; most of them have reached the earth realm.'
Zhang Fei [4] just nodded to the members of the demon fox group, and Mei immediately opened the gate to the training ground, which shocked them again.

Boitata was the first to walk out from inside while glancing at the cultivators with a playful smile on her face, and several other women followed behind her, such as Zhang Lingxue, Liu Qingyu, Liu Hua, Shen Yu, Shen Xueyi, the Wen Twins, Qiao Ran, and Mei Xiang.
Not only them, but even some of Zhang Fei [1]'s partners, such as Yan Luan'er, Xi Zihua, and Shi Yue, also joined them.

Additionally, Zhang Fei himself decided to end his seclusion for the time being, especially since the women insisted on participating in the fight; there was no way he would let them fight on their own.
However, he strictly forbade those whose cultivation was still below the Earth Realm from joining them, especially since they would not be able to withstand the pressure from their enemies.
They were no longer surprised to see that, especially since most of them had seen Zhang Fei and his two clones at the Yin-Yang Pavilion during his wedding with Shen Yu.
Instead, they were curious about Qiao Ran and Mei Xiang's presence, especially since their Qiao and Mei clans were vassals of the Pang Clan.

However, they remembered that the Mei Clan had been destroyed, and they had also heard rumors that the Qiao Clan had undergone significant changes, which coincided with the destruction of the Huan Clan.
After that, his fourth clone immediately returned to the training space, so he could complete the daily quest and others.
Zhang Fei smiled as he looked at them one by one, and he felt amazed by their determination to defend their ancestral realm.
"Seniors, all of you are extraordinary cultivators with strong determination, and I still have a lot to learn from all of you."
"You don't need to be humble like that, Kid." Luo Yigang spoke with a shake of his head.
"If not for you, we wouldn't be here, and we'd never know about those demons and heretics' plans, let alone the powerful cultivators behind them."
"If we manage to win this battle, then you will be a hero for this realm, Kid." Zhu Xuejun said it with an admiring look.
"Haha." Instead, Zhang Fei laughed at Zhu Xuejun's words.
"Senior, I am not a hero, and I never wanted to be one.
I did everything just to protect the people closest to me, so they could live in peace without having to be haunted by threatening dangers.

Anyway, it would be better for all of you to spread out now, especially since those people are getting closer to this area, and they might notice your presence, so you must suppress it as much as possible."
All of them nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei, and they immediately scattered in various directions after dividing their people into several small groups.
As usual, Liu Hua and the Wen Twins led the members of the demon fox group.
Meanwhile, Liu Qingyu went with Qiao Ran and Mei Xiang to another area, as did Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu, who went together.
Yan Luan'er, Xi Zihua, and Shi Yue also left together while they waited for the people from the Yin-Yang Pavilion to arrive.
Zhang Lingxue joined the members of the Zhang Clan, and she divided them into two groups, with Zi'er leading half of them.
Oliver and several leaders from the natural races also left their meeting location, but they stood guard around the entrance to the demon cave.
Boitata did not leave the place, and she accompanied Zhang Fei, who was watching the movements of those heretics from the map.
She then looked towards the members of the moon fox races who had just arrived, and he could see the hostility in Hu Peiwu and Hu Dahai's eyes, especially since Hu Gao had given them specific orders.
Unlike them, Hu Qiaomu looks frustrated with herself, especially since her life is in Zhang Fei's hands with the fusion of their souls, so she no longer has her freedom anymore.
Boitata brought her head to Zhang Fei's ear before whispering to him. 'Husband, the cultivation of those two old men is a level above mine, and the other three are on par with me.
Even so, I am confident that we can still face them, especially with Hu Qiaomu's help.
Moreover, you can borrow half of my strength, so you can suppress them with your bloodline power, and we can defeat them directly.'
'You are right.' Zhang Fei nodded to Boitata as he looked at those people with a faint smile. 'We won't make a move on them for now, especially since those heretics are getting closer.
However, we'll make a move right away if they attack us first, and I'll use them to pressure Hu Gao so I can take Hu Yue from them faster.'
'In that case, I will monitor them closely.' Boitata replied while nodding in agreement.
Zhang Fei then spoke to Hu Qiaomu.
"It's good that you guys have arrived here, as those heretics are on their way to this area.
I hope you can spread out to block them, and if you have the chance, kill them."
"Humph!" Some of them snorted coldly before leading the rest of their members to disappear from the place, but Zhang Fei didn't pay much attention to their behavior.
"What is your plan exactly?
Are we going to fight those heretics head-on?" Hu Qiaomu immediately questioned Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei smiled in response.

There are quite a few of them, and two among them are truly powerful."

chapters.title: Chapter 422 Shang Clan Members
paragraphs: Although he wasn't a cultivator, Arbeola himself was very strong, and he could feel the powerful pressure coming from the flying artifact, so he immediately asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "So what are you going to do, kid? Your invisibility is indeed perfect, but they are too strong for you, and you will only be courting death if you go to the demon emperor city now."

"You are indeed right, Old Demon." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with an approval nod. "Some of my wives and close people are natives from the Sky Jade Realm, and they are there preparing to stop these people, so I can't just sit idly by, right? They are indeed too strong for me, but I am confident in my invisibility, so I must go to the demon Emperor City to monitor them."

After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately left the ghostveil forest for the demon emperor city using his nine cloud steps, and he also didn't forget to use his invisibility so that the cultivators from the upper realms couldn't detect his presence.
Arbeola let out a heavy sigh and immediately ordered all the tree demons to protect Zhang Xiaolong [3] with all their strength. "Kid, I hope you won't take any rash actions against those people."
Given his ability to travel 200 km quickly and the proximity of the demon emperor city to the ghostveil forest, Zhang Xiaolong [3] could reach the city in a matter of minutes.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately rushed towards the portal to the Sky Jade Realm upon his arrival at the demon emperor city, but a protective barrier stopped him. Moreover, there were so many demons with duke rank and above already present at the place, but Oz the 1st and the cultivators from the upper realms still hadn't arrived yet, so he waited outside the barrier to wait.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then touched the barrier and frowned. 'How strong is this barrier, Mei?'

[Master, this barrier is a high-grade advanced formation array that can stop attacks from cultivators in the seven divine realms. I detected a counterattack mechanism from this barrier, so you better not try to do anything to it, or you will die from the counterattack.]

'They're so cautious, huh? This realm is just one of the middle realms, yet they have squandered resources to create such a powerful formation array." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at the male demon, who was flirting with three female demons. He immediately recognized the identities of the four demons, especially since their demon forms were similar.
'That guy must be the incubus lord, Yhrer, and he looks much stronger than me, even though he's not a demon cultivator. Hey, Mei, check their status.'
[All right, I will display their status now.]

'Hmm?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows slightly as he read their statuses. 'The three succubi duchesses have similar abilities, but Ilsath has super speed, Orith has super stamina, and Thish has super strength. However, Yhrer's abilities are much more complete than theirs, and I think I can obtain all his abilities when I evolve into a lust demon lord like him.'

[I think the same as you, master. I believe that the number of your incubus abilities will increase, and your previous abilities will also be enhanced if you evolve into a lust demon lord later. Unfortunately, your demon rank is still far from the duke rank, so you have to think of ways to increase it faster.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s lips twitched at that, as he himself also wanted to reach the duke rank and evolve as soon as possible, but the number of female demons by his side was not as many as his human partners, so he could only be patient with it.

'Hmm? They're here.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered as he saw Oz the 1st, Shang Guangming, and Shang Yaolin land at that place. There were five cultivators from the supreme realm behind them, and their presence caused his body to shiver, especially the middle-aged woman with long blackish-green hair and green eyes beside Shang Chenguang.

The middle-aged woman looked serious, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] could see the cruelty in her eyes; even the aura radiating from her body seemed to pierce into his soul, causing him to feel terrified of her. 'Check their status, Mei.'
[Wait a minute.]

Age: 10,000+ years old

Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: Above mortal realms

Core: Peak-Rank Poison Core

Special physique: poison dragon physique
Special bloodline: poison dragon bloodline

Like: None
Dislike: All males

'Fuck!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately cursed after reading Shang Xishun's status. 'Not only is her cultivator already in the seven divine realms, but her poison element and core are at the highest level. Moreover, she possesses the physique and bloodline of a poison dragon, indicating that her status in their clan is certainly not ordinary, and she is likely one of the strongest in their clan.'

Shang Xishun raised her eyebrows as she turned towards Zhang Xiaolong [3], causing his heart to tighten because he was afraid that she would be able to detect his presence even though he was in the invisible state.

However, Shang Xishun immediately averted her gaze and walked over to the portal, and she squatted beside it before touching it. "Hmm? Your guess is correct, Chenguang. The beast that helps those humans in the sky jade realm is indeed a mythical beast, and I suspect that it is a phoenix."
"A phoenix?" Shang Chenguang and their two juniors were shocked by that.

Shang Xishun nodded to them. "Although my poison dragon bloodline comes from a divine beast rank, I gained quite a bit of information about other beasts from it, and I am certain that the beast is indeed a phoenix."

"Why did the Phoenix race send one of their members to that realm, Aunt Xishun?" Shang Yaolin inquired as she crouched down alongside Shang Xishun. "As far as I can remember, they never interfere in the affairs of other people or beasts, and they almost never leave their celestial flame realm."

Shang Xishun immediately turned to Shan Yaolin. "Isn't their goal obvious? The ten-tailed fox is one of the strongest beasts that ever existed in our universe, and he once defeated all of the mythical beasts' ancestors, including the phoenix race. Since he lived in the Sky Jade Realm, he definitely left a lot of legacies there, so it's natural that they want to get them, right?"
"Well, that's true." Shang Yaolin then asked her again. "Are you confident in breaking the seal on this portal?"

"Are you looking down on me?" Shang Xishu inquired with squinted eyes, causing Shang Yaolin to shiver. "This seal is indeed strong because their ancestors created it by sacrificing their lives, but their sacrifices were not many, so it's just a mere child's toy for me, and I can break it without breaking a sweat."
Shang Chenguang immediately walked beside them. "These demons are ready, so I think you can break the seal now, and they will immediately move into the Sky Jade Realm."

"Yeah." Shang Xishu stood up and took out a whip made of blackish-green dragon bone, and Shang Chenguang immediately pulled Shang Yaolin away from her, especially since he was familiar with her techniques. "Anyway, it will be best if I weaken those people first, so these demons have no trouble breaking through their guard."
"Yes, you can do it."

In an instant, Shang Xishu's body was enveloped in a blackish-green aura, and she stabbed the tip of her whip into the seal on the portal. Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was watching from outside the barrier, immediately raised his eyebrows, especially when he saw her poison qi flowing into the seal. 'Crap! I have to warn those senior cultivators!
Otherwise, the poison will expose them and cause their death.'

"What happened, husband? Why did you suddenly panic?" After she noticed the change in his expression, Boitata immediately asked Zhang Fei. However, he did not respond to her and instead took off towards the demon cave, simultaneously activating his invisibility. She immediately rushed to follow him, suppressing her presence, but she did not enter the cave and waited outside.
'Did something happen in the netherworld realm? Otherwise, he wouldn't be that serious, let alone forcing himself to enter this cave.'
Once he arrived inside, Zhang Fei immediately spoke to Chang Wuhen and the others through telepathy, which shocked them, especially since none of them could feel his presence.

'Don't make any moves! Otherwise, Huang Shitian and the others will notice.' All of them nodded slightly, and Zhang Fei immediately explained Shang Xishun's plan to them. 'I can't do anything to stop her, especially since her cultivation is at the seven divine realms, and the place is also protected by a powerful barrier that can stop attacks from cultivators at that level.
I don't know the strength of her poison, but she has poison dragon bloodline, so you better be alert, or you will be affected by it.'

'Poison dragon, huh?' Zhang Fei immediately turned to Feng Yao, who frowned slightly. 'The poison of a poison dragon is quite lethal, but it won't kill us straight away. It will first attack and paralyze our nerves, then attack our internal organs until we die in agony.'
'Can you stop the poison?' Zhang Fei questioned Feng Yao.
Feng Yao did not nod or shake her head. 'I can use my phoenix flames to neutralize it, but it will weaken this seal and possibly destroy it, and those demons will invade this realm right away.'

'I think you can do that.' Feng Yao raised her eyebrows slightly at Zhang Fei's response. 'Shang Xishun didn't come alone; she came together with Shang Chenguang and three others, and their cultivation is also in the seven divine realms, so this seal will definitely be destroyed in their hands. Therefore, it would be better if we prevented her poison from affecting you guys.'

Zhang Fei's explanation caused them to look gloomy, especially since none of them could fight those cultivators except for Feng Yao. Unfortunately, there were quite a lot of them, so there was no way she could stop them by herself.
Feng Yao released a heavy sigh before speaking to Zhang Fei. 'I will neutralize Shang Xishun's poison first, and after that, I want you to take me to the netherworld realm.'
'Do you know the risks if you are exposed to the demon aura in that realm?'

'Kid, I have lived much longer than you, and I have much more experience than you, so I naturally understand the risks.' Feng Yao's answer left Zhang Fei speechless. 'Anyway, you don't need to worry about me because I am a phoenix, and the demon aura in that realm won't directly affect me, so you can take me there immediately once I neutralize her poison.
If I don't stop those cultivators, then this realm will fall into their hands, and all of its inhabitants will suffer greatly.'
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. 'All right, you can do it now, and I'll take you there directly.'
After that, Feng Yao released a little seal on her cultivation and used her phoenix flame, and her action made the cold temperature in the cave quickly turn hot, making them all sweat.

After Feng Yao did that, Hu Gao frowned and looked at her questioningly, especially since her action was too sudden. 'What is this woman thinking? Doesn't she realize that her actions will destroy this seal?'

Huan Shitian, Huan Jingtian, Qiao Fei, Zhao Feng, Guan Peng, Guan Long, and Lan Tze also looked at Feng Yao in surprise. However, her actions didn't bother any of them, and they found joy in breaking the seal. They then informed Pang Xiuwen about her actions, and he ordered them to attack the others once the seal was broken.
*Crack... Crack...*
Chang Wuhen and the others tensed up as cracks began to appear on the seal, but Shang Xishun's poison quickly faded as soon as it came into contact with Feng Yao's phoenix flames.

Feng Yao suddenly maneuvered, allowing a small amount of Shang Xishun's poison to flow towards the traitorous cultivators. The poison directly entered their bodies through their own qi, causing them to experience an uncomfortable sensation.

However, Feng Yao deliberately did not kill them immediately, especially since she thought that she needed time to destroy the barrier at the location of the portal in the Netherworld Realm, so they could still help the others to maintain the seal for the time being.
After she confirmed that Shang Xishun's poison had disappeared, Feng Yao immediately withdrew her qi and spoke with Zhang Fei. 'Let's go out and bring me directly to the netherworld realm.'
"Hmm?" Hu Gao and the others frowned as Feng Yao hurriedly flew out of the cave. They turned to look at the others, but Chang Wuhen and the others simply shook their heads at them.
When they arrived outside, Zhang Fei immediately sent Feng Yao into his training space, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took her out to the netherworld realm.

'Your ability to clone yourself and traverse to other realms makes me jealous, you know?' Feng Yao spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3] while obverving Shang Xishun, who looked furious after her poison was neutralized.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled at that. 'Can you break this barrier?'
'Yes.' Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei. 'Anyway, you should leave this city now, especially since your cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms, or else you will be suppressed by our battle.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not argue with Feng Yao and immediately left her alone. However, he then contacted Tharnon and asked him to relay their plan to Morgana, so the witch demon could assist her in attacking those people.

"Hmm?" Shang Xishun and the others immediately looked up at the sky when they sensed Feng Yao's presence, and their expressions were filled with shock as they recognized her identity. "The princess of the phoenix race?"

"So what are you going to do, kid?
Your invisibility is indeed perfect, but they are too strong for you, and you will only be courting death if you go to the demon emperor city now."
"You are indeed right, Old Demon." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with an approval nod.
"Some of my wives and close people are natives from the Sky Jade Realm, and they are there preparing to stop these people, so I can't just sit idly by, right?
They are indeed too strong for me, but I am confident in my invisibility, so I must go to the demon Emperor City to monitor them."

After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately left the ghostveil forest for the demon emperor city using his nine cloud steps, and he also didn't forget to use his invisibility so that the cultivators from the upper realms couldn't detect his presence.
Arbeola let out a heavy sigh and immediately ordered all the tree demons to protect Zhang Xiaolong [3] with all their strength.
"Kid, I hope you won't take any rash actions against those people."
Given his ability to travel 200 km quickly and the proximity of the demon emperor city to the ghostveil forest, Zhang Xiaolong [3] could reach the city in a matter of minutes.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately rushed towards the portal to the Sky Jade Realm upon his arrival at the demon emperor city, but a protective barrier stopped him.

Moreover, there were so many demons with duke rank and above already present at the place, but Oz the 1st and the cultivators from the upper realms still hadn't arrived yet, so he waited outside the barrier to wait.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then touched the barrier and frowned. 'How strong is this barrier, Mei?'
[Master, this barrier is a high-grade advanced formation array that can stop attacks from cultivators in the seven divine realms.
I detected a counterattack mechanism from this barrier, so you better not try to do anything to it, or you will die from the counterattack.]
'They're so cautious, huh?

This realm is just one of the middle realms, yet they have squandered resources to create such a powerful formation array." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at the male demon, who was flirting with three female demons.
He immediately recognized the identities of the four demons, especially since their demon forms were similar.
'That guy must be the incubus lord, Yhrer, and he looks much stronger than me, even though he's not a demon cultivator.
Hey, Mei, check their status.'
[All right, I will display their status now.]
Name: Orith
Age: 4000+ years old
Gender: Female
Race: Lust Demon Lord
Rank: Duchess Rank
Element: Darkness
Physique: Lust Demon Lord Physique
Abilities: semi-immortality, lust empowerment, shapeshifting, kiss of death, super stamina, gender transformation, hormone manipulation, and so on.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light

Age: 5000+ years old
Gender: Female
Race: Lust Demon Lord
Rank: Duchess Rank
Element: Darkness
Physique: Lust Demon Lord
Abilities: semi-immortality, lust empowerment, shapeshifting, kiss of death, super speed, gender transformation, hormone manipulation, and so on.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light

Age: 3000+ years old
Gender: Female

Rank: Duchess Rank

Physique: Lust Demon Lord
Abilities: semi-immortality, lust empowerment, shapeshifting, kiss of death, super strength, gender transformation, hormone manipulation, and so on.

Gender: Female
Race: Lust Demon Lord
Rank: Duke Rank

Physique: Lust Demon Lord

Abilities: semi-immortality, familiar manipulation, hybrid creation, soul absorption, indomitable sexuality, sex magic, lust empowerment, shapeshifting, death by sex, absolute condition, gender transformation, hormone manipulation, and so on.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light

'Hmm?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows slightly as he read their statuses. 'The three succubi duchesses have similar abilities, but Ilsath has super speed, Orith has super stamina, and Thish has super strength.
However, Yhrer's abilities are much more complete than theirs, and I think I can obtain all his abilities when I evolve into a lust demon lord like him.'
[I think the same as you, master.
I believe that the number of your incubus abilities will increase, and your previous abilities will also be enhanced if you evolve into a lust demon lord later.
Unfortunately, your demon rank is still far from the duke rank, so you have to think of ways to increase it faster.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s lips twitched at that, as he himself also wanted to reach the duke rank and evolve as soon as possible, but the number of female demons by his side was not as many as his human partners, so he could only be patient with it.
'Hmm?
They're here.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered as he saw Oz the 1st, Shang Guangming, and Shang Yaolin land at that place.

There were five cultivators from the supreme realm behind them, and their presence caused his body to shiver, especially the middle-aged woman with long blackish-green hair and green eyes beside Shang Chenguang.

The middle-aged woman looked serious, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] could see the cruelty in her eyes; even the aura radiating from her body seemed to pierce into his soul, causing him to feel terrified of her. 'Check their status, Mei.'
[Wait a minute.]
Name: Shang Chenguang
Age: 10,000+ years old
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation: Above mortal realms
Element: Earth [Advanced stage]
Core: Middle-Rank Earth Core
Physique: Human physique
Special physique: None
Special bloodline: None
Partner: Helian Qing
Like: Helian Qing, Shang Chenhong, Shang Chenyu
Dislike: Jiang Chen, Jiang Wei, Jiang Nan
Name: Shang Xishun
Age: 10,000+ years old
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: Above mortal realms
Element: Poison [Peak stage]
Core: Peak-Rank Poison Core
Physique: Human physique
Special physique: poison dragon physique
Special bloodline: poison dragon bloodline
Partner: None
Like: None
Dislike: All males

'Fuck!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately cursed after reading Shang Xishun's status. 'Not only is her cultivator already in the seven divine realms, but her poison element and core are at the highest level.
Moreover, she possesses the physique and bloodline of a poison dragon, indicating that her status in their clan is certainly not ordinary, and she is likely one of the strongest in their clan.'

Shang Xishun raised her eyebrows as she turned towards Zhang Xiaolong [3], causing his heart to tighten because he was afraid that she would be able to detect his presence even though he was in the invisible state.
However, Shang Xishun immediately averted her gaze and walked over to the portal, and she squatted beside it before touching it.
"Hmm?
Your guess is correct, Chenguang.
The beast that helps those humans in the sky jade realm is indeed a mythical beast, and I suspect that it is a phoenix."
"A phoenix?" Shang Chenguang and their two juniors were shocked by that.
Shang Xishun nodded to them.
"Although my poison dragon bloodline comes from a divine beast rank, I gained quite a bit of information about other beasts from it, and I am certain that the beast is indeed a phoenix."
"Why did the Phoenix race send one of their members to that realm, Aunt Xishun?" Shang Yaolin inquired as she crouched down alongside Shang Xishun.
"As far as I can remember, they never interfere in the affairs of other people or beasts, and they almost never leave their celestial flame realm."
Shang Xishun immediately turned to Shan Yaolin.
"Isn't their goal obvious?
The ten-tailed fox is one of the strongest beasts that ever existed in our universe, and he once defeated all of the mythical beasts' ancestors, including the phoenix race.
Since he lived in the Sky Jade Realm, he definitely left a lot of legacies there, so it's natural that they want to get them, right?"
"Well, that's true." Shang Yaolin then asked her again.
"Are you confident in breaking the seal on this portal?"
"Are you looking down on me?" Shang Xishu inquired with squinted eyes, causing Shang Yaolin to shiver.

"This seal is indeed strong because their ancestors created it by sacrificing their lives, but their sacrifices were not many, so it's just a mere child's toy for me, and I can break it without breaking a sweat."
Shang Chenguang immediately walked beside them.
"These demons are ready, so I think you can break the seal now, and they will immediately move into the Sky Jade Realm."

"Yeah." Shang Xishu stood up and took out a whip made of blackish-green dragon bone, and Shang Chenguang immediately pulled Shang Yaolin away from her, especially since he was familiar with her techniques.
"Anyway, it will be best if I weaken those people first, so these demons have no trouble breaking through their guard."
"Yes, you can do it."
In an instant, Shang Xishu's body was enveloped in a blackish-green aura, and she stabbed the tip of her whip into the seal on the portal.
Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was watching from outside the barrier, immediately raised his eyebrows, especially when he saw her poison qi flowing into the seal. 'Crap!
I have to warn those senior cultivators!
Otherwise, the poison will expose them and cause their death.'
"What happened, husband?
Why did you suddenly panic?" After she noticed the change in his expression, Boitata immediately asked Zhang Fei.
However, he did not respond to her and instead took off towards the demon cave, simultaneously activating his invisibility.
She immediately rushed to follow him, suppressing her presence, but she did not enter the cave and waited outside.
'Did something happen in the netherworld realm?
Otherwise, he wouldn't be that serious, let alone forcing himself to enter this cave.'
Once he arrived inside, Zhang Fei immediately spoke to Chang Wuhen and the others through telepathy, which shocked them, especially since none of them could feel his presence.
'Don't make any moves!

Otherwise, Huang Shitian and the others will notice.' All of them nodded slightly, and Zhang Fei immediately explained Shang Xishun's plan to them. 'I can't do anything to stop her, especially since her cultivation is at the seven divine realms, and the place is also protected by a powerful barrier that can stop attacks from cultivators at that level.
I don't know the strength of her poison, but she has poison dragon bloodline, so you better be alert, or you will be affected by it.'
'Poison dragon, huh?' Zhang Fei immediately turned to Feng Yao, who frowned slightly. 'The poison of a poison dragon is quite lethal, but it won't kill us straight away.
It will first attack and paralyze our nerves, then attack our internal organs until we die in agony.'
'Can you stop the poison?' Zhang Fei questioned Feng Yao.
Feng Yao did not nod or shake her head. 'I can use my phoenix flames to neutralize it, but it will weaken this seal and possibly destroy it, and those demons will invade this realm right away.'

'I think you can do that.' Feng Yao raised her eyebrows slightly at Zhang Fei's response. 'Shang Xishun didn't come alone; she came together with Shang Chenguang and three others, and their cultivation is also in the seven divine realms, so this seal will definitely be destroyed in their hands.
Therefore, it would be better if we prevented her poison from affecting you guys.'
Zhang Fei's explanation caused them to look gloomy, especially since none of them could fight those cultivators except for Feng Yao.
Unfortunately, there were quite a lot of them, so there was no way she could stop them by herself.
Feng Yao released a heavy sigh before speaking to Zhang Fei. 'I will neutralize Shang Xishun's poison first, and after that, I want you to take me to the netherworld realm.'
'Do you know the risks if you are exposed to the demon aura in that realm?'

'Kid, I have lived much longer than you, and I have much more experience than you, so I naturally understand the risks.' Feng Yao's answer left Zhang Fei speechless. 'Anyway, you don't need to worry about me because I am a phoenix, and the demon aura in that realm won't directly affect me, so you can take me there immediately once I neutralize her poison.
If I don't stop those cultivators, then this realm will fall into their hands, and all of its inhabitants will suffer greatly.'
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. 'All right, you can do it now, and I'll take you there directly.'
After that, Feng Yao released a little seal on her cultivation and used her phoenix flame, and her action made the cold temperature in the cave quickly turn hot, making them all sweat.
After Feng Yao did that, Hu Gao frowned and looked at her questioningly, especially since her action was too sudden. 'What is this woman thinking?
Doesn't she realize that her actions will destroy this seal?'
Huan Shitian, Huan Jingtian, Qiao Fei, Zhao Feng, Guan Peng, Guan Long, and Lan Tze also looked at Feng Yao in surprise.
However, her actions didn't bother any of them, and they found joy in breaking the seal.
They then informed Pang Xiuwen about her actions, and he ordered them to attack the others once the seal was broken.
*Crack...
Crack...*
Chang Wuhen and the others tensed up as cracks began to appear on the seal, but Shang Xishun's poison quickly faded as soon as it came into contact with Feng Yao's phoenix flames.
Feng Yao suddenly maneuvered, allowing a small amount of Shang Xishun's poison to flow towards the traitorous cultivators.
The poison directly entered their bodies through their own qi, causing them to experience an uncomfortable sensation.

However, Feng Yao deliberately did not kill them immediately, especially since she thought that she needed time to destroy the barrier at the location of the portal in the Netherworld Realm, so they could still help the others to maintain the seal for the time being.
After she confirmed that Shang Xishun's poison had disappeared, Feng Yao immediately withdrew her qi and spoke with Zhang Fei. 'Let's go out and bring me directly to the netherworld realm.'
"Hmm?" Hu Gao and the others frowned as Feng Yao hurriedly flew out of the cave.
They turned to look at the others, but Chang Wuhen and the others simply shook their heads at them.
When they arrived outside, Zhang Fei immediately sent Feng Yao into his training space, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took her out to the netherworld realm.

'Your ability to clone yourself and traverse to other realms makes me jealous, you know?' Feng Yao spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3] while obverving Shang Xishun, who looked furious after her poison was neutralized.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled at that. 'Can you break this barrier?'
'Yes.' Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei. 'Anyway, you should leave this city now, especially since your cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms, or else you will be suppressed by our battle.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not argue with Feng Yao and immediately left her alone.
However, he then contacted Tharnon and asked him to relay their plan to Morgana, so the witch demon could assist her in attacking those people.
"Hmm?" Shang Xishun and the others immediately looked up at the sky when they sensed Feng Yao's presence, and their expressions were filled with shock as they recognized her identity.
"The princess of the phoenix race?"

chapters.title: Chapter 423 The Seal Broken
paragraphs: "What are you going to do? Are you going to help that woman?" Tharnon asked Morgana, who had been watching Feng Yao from a distance.

Morgana shook her head slightly. "You are not a cultivator, so you do not know that woman's strength. I can tell you that she is much stronger than those human cultivators, and her status in the upper realms is not ordinary; even the demon emperor of my realm bows his head to her."
Upon hearing that, Tharnon gazed at Feng Yao with seriousness. "What is her true identity?"

"Haha." Morgana laughed, then turned to Tharnon. "She is not a human woman but a female mythical beast; to be precise, she is the princess of the Phoenix race, Feng Yao. You are indeed an ancient demon beast, but you will not be able to move if she releases her beast aura."
After learning Feng Yao's identity, Tharnon was shocked. He naturally knew about the phoenix, but he did not expect that the woman in front of them was the princess of the phoenix race.

Morgana then propped her chin up while her eyes glanced around the area. 'How could the princess of the phoenix race appear in a realm out of nowhere? Who exactly is the demon that brought them to this realm? How could he hide his presence from my eyes and senses?'
Shang Chenguang and Shen Xishun exchanged glances as they spoke via voice transmission, and they immediately drew their weapons, followed by five other people from their clan.
*Boom... Boom...*

Several explosions like fireworks lit up the demon emperor city and the surrounding area after Feng Yao shot her fire qi into the air several times, which created a giant fire phoenix figure in the dark sky.

Shang Xishun and the other senior frowned after they saw that, especially since they knew for sure the reason behind the giant fire phoenix figure, which was usually used by the phoenix race to mark their location, and the members of the race could easily find out the whereabouts of their members with it.
If they fought with Feng Yao, they would know about it, and her parents would lead their race to their realm.

Feng Yao smiled faintly at their reaction. "Shang Clan from the Red Sun Realm, right? I know that Shang Huaqiang is ambitious to obtain the ten-tailed fox's legacies in the Sky Jade Realm, but that realm is under the protection of my phoenix race.
Moreover, you guys should remember the rules in the upper realms, and your clan must bear the consequences if you dare to violate them by attacking that realm."

Their expressions turned ugly after Feng Yao mentioned the rules, and they were fully aware of the consequences. This is why they refrained from directly entering the Sky Jade Realm, instead opting to use the demons from the Netherworld Realm to infiltrate it.
*Zing...Zing...*
They all heard a strong vibration as soon as Feng Yao took out her long sword, which was completely red from the blade to the hilt, and several phoenix tails decorated the tip of the hilt.
Feng Yao immediately slashed his sword in a crisscross forward, causing a red qi cross to shoot out and hit the barrier, and it instantly crumbled into pieces.

The hearts of the people from the Shang Clan tightened after seeing that, especially since the materials needed to create the protective formation array were quite rare and exorbitantly priced, but it was destroyed by him with just one slash. 'Fuck! The strength of the Phoenix Princess is indeed impressive!
Even all the clans in the upper realms admit that she is the best among all our young generations.'
The demons from the Netherworld Realm, standing behind Oz the 1st, instinctively took several steps back, their gazes solely focused on Feng Yao, unlike their demon emperor, who still appeared calm.

Feng Yao then landed in front of them as she glanced towards Oz the 1st, especially after she received a voice transmission from Zhang Xiaolong [3] regarding him. Unfortunately, she couldn't help him remove Shang Huaqiang's slave mark in his soul, and she herself had no intention of helping a demon like him.

Feng Yao then pointed her sword at people from the Shang Clan. "I don't care about your desire to obtain the ten-tailed fox's legacies, but if you guys insist on attacking the Sky Jade Realm, I will stop you all, and I can assure you that other cultivators from the upper realms will go straight to your clan to demand their accountability."
'What should we do now, Aunt Xishun and Uncle Chenguang?' Shang Yaolin asked her seniors as she held her two short spears.
Sheng Guangming also grasped his long spear as he glanced at the two seniors, especially since they were the strongest among them, and he was confident that they should be able to stop Feng Yao.
"Tch!" Shang Xishun gritted her teeth before lashing his dragon bone whip towards Feng Yao, but the princess of the phoenix race casually swung her sword to deflect her whip.

"Destroy the seal now, Xishun! We will stop her!" Shang Chenguang shouted as he led three other seniors from their clan to attack Feng Yao, but she immediately flew into the sky to escape their encirclement, and they quickly started fighting in the dark sky.
Shang Xishun wanted to lash her dragon bone whip towards the portal, but several crescent-shaped light qi suddenly shot towards them, so she immediately pulled her two juniors to avoid the attacks.

However, Shang Xishun frowned as she realized that the attacks just now were too weak, and she was sure that the mysterious attacker's strength was still in the ten mortal realms, so she quickly scanned the surrounding area to find the source of the attacks.
Just as she thought that, two ethereal demon claws suddenly descended from the sky, followed by a loud roar.
*Roar.*

Unilke Oz the 1st and Shang Xishun, the other demons and the two juniors of the Shang Clan felt nauseous and dizzy by the effects of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s demon king's roar, causing them to stagger backwards.

"Who-" Shan Xishun hadn't finished asking Oz the 1st, but a large scale of black flames had already rained down on their location, so she immediately threw an artifact to protect herself and her two juniors. "Protect them!"

Oz the 1st immediately moved and protected those demons from Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hellflame incantation, but the area around them was immediately burned by his dark flames, causing the temperature in the area to heat up rapidly. However, the demon emperor immediately absorbed his flames into his body, bringing the situation back under control. 'Was that demon the one who sent Tharnon to this realm?
How could he have mastered all the sub-techniques of the netherworld demon scripture?'
After that, Shang Xishun immediately released his full strength and lashed his dragon bone whip towards the portal, which caused the seal on the portal to break instantly. "Go!"
*Boom*

After Shang Xishun destroyed the demon seal, there was a loud explosion inside the demon cave, which threw Chang Wuhen and the other cultivators back, causing them to hit the cave wall. All of them vomited a lot of blood due to the backlash, and they suffered quite severe injuries.

'Damn it! It seems that Feng Yao and Zhang Fei failed to stop those cultivators, and the seal that we have maintained for so long has finally been broken.' Chang Wuhen said so in his heart as he swallowed a healing pill, and she tried to stabilize her injuries while watching the demon portal.
Liu Rong and the other cultivators followed suit, swallowing healing pills to stabilize their serious injuries while maintaining their focus on Huang Jingtian and the others.

Only one of them seemed to be less affected by it, who was none other than Hu Gao. He had expected that the seal would break sooner or later, especially after Feng Yao used her phoenix flames to neutralize Shang Xishun's dragon poison, so he immediately restrained his qi before the seal broke.

Wasting no time, Hu Gao immediately flew out of the cave and ordered his race members to retreat, causing Chang Wuhen and the others to panic, especially since he was the only one among them who had light Qi. 'Haha! Foolish people! I'm sure they won't recover any time soon, so I can come up with another plan after this.
However, I must first find a way to stop those demons, or they will hinder my plan to rule this realm.'

Despite the backlash from the portal's destruction, the traitors took the initiative to move and attack Chang Wuhen and the others. They took out some items given by the Pang Clan towards them, which immediately exploded and caused black smoke to fill the place, and the black smoke contained quite strong poison.

"Bastards!" As she charged at those traitors, Chang Wuhen immediately enveloped her body with her Qi, followed by Liu Rong and the other senior cultivators. However, they were a few seconds too late, as the poison had already invaded their bodies, causing their nerves to stiffen and their movements to slow down.

"Hahahaha! Useless!" Lan Tze laughed as she and the others took out a talisman, which immediately formed a barrier between them. The barrier instantly reflected their attacks, causing them to slam into the cave wall once more, exacerbating their injuries.
After that, the traitors shot out several small needles at Chang Wuhen and the others, which instantly penetrated their protective Qi and pierced their bodies, causing them to vomit blood once more.

"Hehehe." Lan Tze laughed and threw another talisman toward the cave's mouth, sealing it from inside. "None of you can escape from this place now, and only the people of the Pang Clan can enter. Moreover, those demons will invade this realm soon, and they will help us gain the power that we have long dreamed of."
"As for you guys, all of you will become their slaves, and you will not be able to do anything to stop them." Huang Shitian spoke as she moved towards Chang Wuhen and sealed his cultivation.

Qiao Fei and the others also moved to seal the cultivation of Liu Rong and the others, which put them in a tight spot. "The poison from the Pang Clan is extremely strong, and no one but them can remove it. Even so, the poison won't kill you because the demons still need you, so you can wait here until they arrive."

"You traitors!" Liu Rong shouted at them as she clutched her chest. "Your actions have disgraced your ancestors! In the past, they sacrificed their lives to save this realm from destruction, but you brought those demons back here instead."
"So what?" Guan Long replied with an indifferent shrug. "They've been dead for so long, but we're still alive now. We'll do anything to gain greater power, and the demons can help us with that."

"Hahaha!" Zhang Long suddenly laughed and smiled mockingly at them. "You may have defeated us, but you were really stupid to side with the Pang Clan, and they didn't seem to tell you anything, so you were just their sacrifices."
Huan Jingtian immediately moved in front of Zhang Long and tamed his chest. "What do you mean by that, Old Long?"
"Hahaha!" Zhang Long just laughed and did not answer Huang Jingtian's question. "There is another sky above the sky, and your decision today will mark the end of your life. You-Guah!"
"Stop it!" Lan Tze immediately stopped Huan Jingtian, who was about to kill Zhang Long. "They will punish you if you kill him, and they might kill you, so you better stop it."
"Tch!" Huan Jingtian gritted his teeth and looked towards the demon portal. "Why haven't those demons moved yet? They ought to be aware that we have already destroyed this portal."

"I don't know because Pang Xiuwen didn't say anything, so we just have to wait for them to appear." Lan Tze then looked outside the cave because Zhang Long's words gave him a bad feeling, and he used his senses to check outside but found nothing outside. 'Could it be just my feeling?'

Oz the 1st immediately ordered the demons to move, but an item suddenly floated above the portal, and a barrier right away enveloped it. In a split second, the first demon emperor disappeared from their sight, so they immediately stopped and looked at Shang Xishun, especially since they would only move at the command of their emperor.

Shang Xishun herself looked at the item with narrow eyes. 'How did that item appear here? Could the mysterious person be part of that clan? Only people from that clan could create such an item, but it should be impossible. They never go to the middle realm, and they only focus on the upper realms. If that person was from that clan, things would get really complicated.
We already dealt with the princess of the phoenix race, so we can't deal with that clan too.'
"Aunt Xishun, that item belongs to that clan, right?" Shang Yaolin inquired as she pointed her index finger upwards.

Shang Xishun nodded to Shang Yaolin before taking out a token and activating it, especially since he couldn't make a decision on his own regarding the matter, which surprised Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin.

In the following seconds, Shang Huaqiang's avatar appeared above them, so Shang Xishun and the two juniors immediately knelt before him. Shang Chenguang and the other three who were fighting Feng Yao also immediately stopped their fight, and they joined the three of them in kneeling before him.

Feng Yao herself immediately floated in front of Shang Huaqiang's avatar, causing him to be shocked by her presence. "Heh! This is my first and last warning: Withdraw the people of your clan from this realm, or I will inform all the cultivators in the upper realms that you intend to attack a realm in the lower realm."

Shang Huaqiang's avatar frowned upon hearing Feng Yao's threat, but he did not respond to her directly. Instead, he gazed at the items floating above the portal, pondering in his heart. However, he swiftly waved his hand, sucked the items in, and caused the barrier to vanish. He then looked at her and shot a red light at her, which immediately confined her.

"Young Miss Feng, I will not send my people to the Sky Jade Realm, but I will not allow you to thwart the plan that I have been preparing for hundreds of years. You are indeed strong, but you are not my opponent, and even with just my avatar, I can still kill you. However, I do not want to look for trouble with your race, so I will only keep you here until they have completed their task."

Feng Yao did not try to free herself, especially since she knew that her efforts would be in vain. After all, the difference in strength at each level of the seven divine realms was a stark contrast, and Shang Huaqiang's cultivation was several major levels above hers, which was on par with her parents.

"My job is only to stop cultivators from the upper realms, like us, from invading the Sky Jade Realm, so I don't care about the invasion of these demons. However, I can tell you that your efforts will not succeed, and your hundreds of years of planning will end in vain."
"Is that so?" Shang Huaqiang then turned to the demons. "Go to that realm now, or I will slaughter you all."
