They all heard a strong vibration as soon as Feng Yao took out her long sword, which was completely red from the blade to the hilt, and several phoenix tails decorated the tip of the hilt.
Feng Yao immediately slashed his sword in a crisscross forward, causing a red qi cross to shoot out and hit the barrier, and it instantly crumbled into pieces.

The hearts of the people from the Shang Clan tightened after seeing that, especially since the materials needed to create the protective formation array were quite rare and exorbitantly priced, but it was destroyed by him with just one slash. 'Fuck!
The strength of the Phoenix Princess is indeed impressive!
Even all the clans in the upper realms admit that she is the best among all our young generations.'
The demons from the Netherworld Realm, standing behind Oz the 1st, instinctively took several steps back, their gazes solely focused on Feng Yao, unlike their demon emperor, who still appeared calm.
Feng Yao then landed in front of them as she glanced towards Oz the 1st, especially after she received a voice transmission from Zhang Xiaolong [3] regarding him.
Unfortunately, she couldn't help him remove Shang Huaqiang's slave mark in his soul, and she herself had no intention of helping a demon like him.
Feng Yao then pointed her sword at people from the Shang Clan.

"I don't care about your desire to obtain the ten-tailed fox's legacies, but if you guys insist on attacking the Sky Jade Realm, I will stop you all, and I can assure you that other cultivators from the upper realms will go straight to your clan to demand their accountability."
'What should we do now, Aunt Xishun and Uncle Chenguang?' Shang Yaolin asked her seniors as she held her two short spears.
Sheng Guangming also grasped his long spear as he glanced at the two seniors, especially since they were the strongest among them, and he was confident that they should be able to stop Feng Yao.
"Tch!" Shang Xishun gritted her teeth before lashing his dragon bone whip towards Feng Yao, but the princess of the phoenix race casually swung her sword to deflect her whip.
"Destroy the seal now, Xishun!

We will stop her!" Shang Chenguang shouted as he led three other seniors from their clan to attack Feng Yao, but she immediately flew into the sky to escape their encirclement, and they quickly started fighting in the dark sky.
Shang Xishun wanted to lash her dragon bone whip towards the portal, but several crescent-shaped light qi suddenly shot towards them, so she immediately pulled her two juniors to avoid the attacks.

However, Shang Xishun frowned as she realized that the attacks just now were too weak, and she was sure that the mysterious attacker's strength was still in the ten mortal realms, so she quickly scanned the surrounding area to find the source of the attacks.
Just as she thought that, two ethereal demon claws suddenly descended from the sky, followed by a loud roar.
*Roar.*

Unilke Oz the 1st and Shang Xishun, the other demons and the two juniors of the Shang Clan felt nauseous and dizzy by the effects of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s demon king's roar, causing them to stagger backwards.

"Who-" Shan Xishun hadn't finished asking Oz the 1st, but a large scale of black flames had already rained down on their location, so she immediately threw an artifact to protect herself and her two juniors.
"Protect them!"

Oz the 1st immediately moved and protected those demons from Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hellflame incantation, but the area around them was immediately burned by his dark flames, causing the temperature in the area to heat up rapidly.
However, the demon emperor immediately absorbed his flames into his body, bringing the situation back under control. 'Was that demon the one who sent Tharnon to this realm?
How could he have mastered all the sub-techniques of the netherworld demon scripture?'
After that, Shang Xishun immediately released his full strength and lashed his dragon bone whip towards the portal, which caused the seal on the portal to break instantly.
"Go!"
*Boom*
After Shang Xishun destroyed the demon seal, there was a loud explosion inside the demon cave, which threw Chang Wuhen and the other cultivators back, causing them to hit the cave wall.
All of them vomited a lot of blood due to the backlash, and they suffered quite severe injuries.
'Damn it!

It seems that Feng Yao and Zhang Fei failed to stop those cultivators, and the seal that we have maintained for so long has finally been broken.' Chang Wuhen said so in his heart as he swallowed a healing pill, and she tried to stabilize her injuries while watching the demon portal.
Liu Rong and the other cultivators followed suit, swallowing healing pills to stabilize their serious injuries while maintaining their focus on Huang Jingtian and the others.
Only one of them seemed to be less affected by it, who was none other than Hu Gao.

He had expected that the seal would break sooner or later, especially after Feng Yao used her phoenix flames to neutralize Shang Xishun's dragon poison, so he immediately restrained his qi before the seal broke.

Wasting no time, Hu Gao immediately flew out of the cave and ordered his race members to retreat, causing Chang Wuhen and the others to panic, especially since he was the only one among them who had light Qi. 'Haha!
Foolish people!
I'm sure they won't recover any time soon, so I can come up with another plan after this.
However, I must first find a way to stop those demons, or they will hinder my plan to rule this realm.'
Despite the backlash from the portal's destruction, the traitors took the initiative to move and attack Chang Wuhen and the others.
They took out some items given by the Pang Clan towards them, which immediately exploded and caused black smoke to fill the place, and the black smoke contained quite strong poison.
"Bastards!" As she charged at those traitors, Chang Wuhen immediately enveloped her body with her Qi, followed by Liu Rong and the other senior cultivators.
However, they were a few seconds too late, as the poison had already invaded their bodies, causing their nerves to stiffen and their movements to slow down.
"Hahahaha!
Useless!" Lan Tze laughed as she and the others took out a talisman, which immediately formed a barrier between them.
The barrier instantly reflected their attacks, causing them to slam into the cave wall once more, exacerbating their injuries.
After that, the traitors shot out several small needles at Chang Wuhen and the others, which instantly penetrated their protective Qi and pierced their bodies, causing them to vomit blood once more.
"Hehehe." Lan Tze laughed and threw another talisman toward the cave's mouth, sealing it from inside.
"None of you can escape from this place now, and only the people of the Pang Clan can enter.
Moreover, those demons will invade this realm soon, and they will help us gain the power that we have long dreamed of."
"As for you guys, all of you will become their slaves, and you will not be able to do anything to stop them." Huang Shitian spoke as she moved towards Chang Wuhen and sealed his cultivation.
Qiao Fei and the others also moved to seal the cultivation of Liu Rong and the others, which put them in a tight spot.
"The poison from the Pang Clan is extremely strong, and no one but them can remove it.
Even so, the poison won't kill you because the demons still need you, so you can wait here until they arrive."
"You traitors!" Liu Rong shouted at them as she clutched her chest.
"Your actions have disgraced your ancestors!
In the past, they sacrificed their lives to save this realm from destruction, but you brought those demons back here instead."
"So what?" Guan Long replied with an indifferent shrug.
"They've been dead for so long, but we're still alive now.
We'll do anything to gain greater power, and the demons can help us with that."
"Hahaha!" Zhang Long suddenly laughed and smiled mockingly at them.
"You may have defeated us, but you were really stupid to side with the Pang Clan, and they didn't seem to tell you anything, so you were just their sacrifices."
Huan Jingtian immediately moved in front of Zhang Long and tamed his chest.
"What do you mean by that, Old Long?"
"Hahaha!" Zhang Long just laughed and did not answer Huang Jingtian's question.
"There is another sky above the sky, and your decision today will mark the end of your life.
You-Guah!"
"Stop it!" Lan Tze immediately stopped Huan Jingtian, who was about to kill Zhang Long.
"They will punish you if you kill him, and they might kill you, so you better stop it."
"Tch!" Huan Jingtian gritted his teeth and looked towards the demon portal.
"Why haven't those demons moved yet?
They ought to be aware that we have already destroyed this portal."

"I don't know because Pang Xiuwen didn't say anything, so we just have to wait for them to appear." Lan Tze then looked outside the cave because Zhang Long's words gave him a bad feeling, and he used his senses to check outside but found nothing outside. 'Could it be just my feeling?'
Oz the 1st immediately ordered the demons to move, but an item suddenly floated above the portal, and a barrier right away enveloped it.
In a split second, the first demon emperor disappeared from their sight, so they immediately stopped and looked at Shang Xishun, especially since they would only move at the command of their emperor.
Shang Xishun herself looked at the item with narrow eyes. 'How did that item appear here?
Could the mysterious person be part of that clan?
Only people from that clan could create such an item, but it should be impossible.
They never go to the middle realm, and they only focus on the upper realms.
If that person was from that clan, things would get really complicated.
We already dealt with the princess of the phoenix race, so we can't deal with that clan too.'
"Aunt Xishun, that item belongs to that clan, right?" Shang Yaolin inquired as she pointed her index finger upwards.

Shang Xishun nodded to Shang Yaolin before taking out a token and activating it, especially since he couldn't make a decision on his own regarding the matter, which surprised Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin.
In the following seconds, Shang Huaqiang's avatar appeared above them, so Shang Xishun and the two juniors immediately knelt before him.
Shang Chenguang and the other three who were fighting Feng Yao also immediately stopped their fight, and they joined the three of them in kneeling before him.
Feng Yao herself immediately floated in front of Shang Huaqiang's avatar, causing him to be shocked by her presence.
"Heh!
This is my first and last warning: Withdraw the people of your clan from this realm, or I will inform all the cultivators in the upper realms that you intend to attack a realm in the lower realm."
Shang Huaqiang's avatar frowned upon hearing Feng Yao's threat, but he did not respond to her directly.
Instead, he gazed at the items floating above the portal, pondering in his heart.
However, he swiftly waved his hand, sucked the items in, and caused the barrier to vanish.
He then looked at her and shot a red light at her, which immediately confined her.
"Young Miss Feng, I will not send my people to the Sky Jade Realm, but I will not allow you to thwart the plan that I have been preparing for hundreds of years.
You are indeed strong, but you are not my opponent, and even with just my avatar, I can still kill you.
However, I do not want to look for trouble with your race, so I will only keep you here until they have completed their task."
Feng Yao did not try to free herself, especially since she knew that her efforts would be in vain.

After all, the difference in strength at each level of the seven divine realms was a stark contrast, and Shang Huaqiang's cultivation was several major levels above hers, which was on par with her parents.
"My job is only to stop cultivators from the upper realms, like us, from invading the Sky Jade Realm, so I don't care about the invasion of these demons.
However, I can tell you that your efforts will not succeed, and your hundreds of years of planning will end in vain."
"Is that so?" Shang Huaqiang then turned to the demons.
"Go to that realm now, or I will slaughter you all."

chapters.title: Chapter 424 Fighting The Enemies I
paragraphs: "Are you sure you want to follow the orders of a human like him?" Feng Yao immediately asked the demons from the Netherworld Realm after she saw the hesitation on their faces.

Although they knew that the people from the Shang Clan were behind Oz the 1st, they were still outsiders to them, and they would never act without the direct orders of their demon emperor because he was their sole leader.

Feng Yao smiled faintly and spoke to them again. "To tell you the truth, the person who has been leading you all these years is not your true demon emperor, and this old man used him to impersonate your emperor."
"What?" Yhrer and the other demons looked at Feng Yao with shock.

Shang Huaqiang's avatar immediately frowned at that, and he looked at his subordinates, but all of them shook their heads, as they didn't know how Feng Yao knew that the current demon lord was not the real one.

"Just look at their expressions." Those demons immediately turned to Shang Huaqiang and the others, and their expressions proved that Feng Yao's words were true. "That old man held your demon emperor captive somewhere else, and he brought another demon from the upper realms to take his place.

He used a special technique to change the impostor's appearance and aura to be similar to your demon emperor, so you guys couldn't recognize the impostor's identity. After all, he couldn't invade the Sky Jade Realm on his own, so he wanted to use and sacrifice you all to accomplish it."

"Humph!" Shang Huaqiang's avatar snorted and released his aura to suppress those demons, causing all of them to fall to the ground without being able to move a single finger, let alone speak. "What can you guys do after knowing the truth? In my presence, all of you are just weaklings, and I can kill you all like ants.
If you guys still want to live, then you better obey my orders, or I will send you to hell, including your descendants."

Shang Xishun spoke directly to Shang Huaqiang's avatar. "Patriarch, I don't want to be presumptuous, but it would be better if you tried to find Oz the 1st's whereabouts first. Moreover, Feng Yao suddenly appeared in this realm out of nowhere, and there were several other mysterious people who attacked us before, but we couldn't sense their presence.
In fact, their cultivation was still at the ten mortal realms, but I'm afraid they belong to that clan, especially since they possess an item only that clan can create."

Shang Huaqiang's avatar immediately released his aura, enveloped the netherworld realm, and searched for Oz the 1st's whereabouts. However, he was unable to detect his presence, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already sent him into the Yin-Yang space, as he was afraid that his avatar could detect him.

'How is this possible? Could they really belong to that clan? Otherwise, their cultivation in the ten mortal realms would prevent them from evading my senses, but they could do so if they were wearing their items.' Shang Huaqiang's avatar then looked at Feng Yao, who relaxedly smiled at him. "Who are those people, Young Miss Feng? Are they part of that clan?"

"Don't you already have the answer to your question? Who else could create such an item other than the people from that clan?" Feng Yao calmly turned to question Shang Huaqiang's avatar, pointing to the item in his hand. "In fact, I am not alone in monitoring the Sky Jade Realm; several other clans in the upper realms have sent their juniors there, and one of them is a member of that clan."

"Hmm?" Shang Huaqiang's avatar thoughtfully looked at Feng Yao, but he seemed uncertain whether she was telling the truth or bluffing, especially since he had been preparing her plan for hundreds of years.

Moreover, none of the clans in the upper realms had interfered in the demons' invasion of the Sky Jade Realm in the past, but the item in his hand was enough to convince him that her words were true. 'Damn it! Their presence gives me a headache! What should I do now?
If they really sent their juniors to protect the realm, then my clan will be in trouble if they report this matter to their seniors, and they will definitely come to me to demand accountability."

The heretics had already arrived in an area slightly far from the demon cave, but Pang Xiuwen and the others immediately stopped moving as soon as they sensed something unusual in the area, and observed the surrounding area using their senses.

Gu Changsheng immediately released several Gu insects to help them check the situation, but they disobeyed his orders and moved in other directions instead. Naturally, he was aware of their actions due to his sister's influence, prompting him to issue a warning to the others. "Be careful! Jinglin seems to be under Zhang Fei's control, and she is using her Gu insects to lure my Gu insects to her."
"How could she do that?" Pang Wachun asked, as he didn't have much knowledge about Gu insects.

"Just like humans, Gu insects are also born in pairs. My insects are male, and Jinglin's insects are female, so she uses them to fish for mine." After saying that, Gu Changsheng immediately moved to follow his Gu insects, as he was sure that they would lead him to Gu Jinglin's hiding location.
"Wife! Let's follow our ancestors." The patriarch of the Gu Clan, Gu Kaizhi, spoke to the middle-aged woman beside him, who was none other than Mo Xingqing, before they moved to follow Gu Changsheng.
"Shall we follow them?" Xie Fanjing, the patriarch of the Xie clan, asked them.

"No need." Xie Zhengwu rejected Xie Fanjing's idea immediately before pointing towards the demon cave. "Our main task is the demon portal, and the seal is broken now, so we should hurry there to wait for the demons from that realm to come here."

"I agree with you, Uncle Zhengwu." Mo Changqiong, the Mo clan's patriarch, said with a nod. "Moreover, Lan Tze and the others have already managed to immobilize Chang Wuhen and the others, so no one will get in our way, and we will immediately attack those clans as soon as the demons arrive."

Mo Fengyi and the others agreed with that, but several huge fireballs suddenly rained down on them from the sky. However, those fireballs were not a significant obstacle for them, and they could easily counter them, but many questions were raised in their minds as they prepared for further attacks.
"It seems that the righteous cultivators already know about our actions, brother." Pang Wachun spoke to Pang Xiuwen.

Pang Xiuwen nodded slightly as he released the demon miasma that he had kept in his body for a long time, followed by Pang Wachun and the other ancestors. They spread it as far as possible so that the righteous cultivators would not dare to approach them directly. "Let's go! We have to arrive at the demon portal as soon as possible!
However, we have to be careful, especially since we don't know their numbers."

Several more fireballs immediately rained down on them enough again, followed by a strong earthquake, causing them to lose their balance. Despite this, their strength as cultivators prevented them from being significantly affected, and they quickly stabilized themselves to counter the fireballs.

Suddenly, four tornadoes assaulted them from four distinct directions, dispersing their demon miasma as the wind swept it away. However, Pang Xiuwen and the others immediately released their demon miasma again, preventing the sudden attack from the righteous cultivators.

The heretics did not have time to catch their breath because two huge sword formations suddenly appeared in the sky above them, which were the actions of Su Qingshi and Yang Ye, the elders of the Heavenly Sword Sect.

However, those two and the others didn't dare approach those heretics, especially since they already knew the horror of their demon miasma's effects. They didn't want to be exposed by it, so they used long-range attacks to attack them.
In an instant, countless Qi swords descended from the two sword formations, and they exerted quite a strong pressure on those people, forcing the heretics to spread further away from each other.

Those Qi swords immediately changed their trajectory and shot towards the heretics, but those attacks were not too difficult for their ancestors, especially since their cultivation had already reached 1 to 3 Star Sovereign Realm while the cultivation of the two sword masters was only at the Heaven Realm.

The situation was different with Mo Changqiong and the juniors, who appeared overwhelmed to repel those Qi swords, especially considering their cultivations at the Heaven Realm, like Su Qingshi and Yang Ye.
Even so, they were lucky because their seniors immediately helped them by repelling the Qi swords, so they could breathe a little easier.

Xie Zhengwu narrowed his eyes in a specific direction upon seeing something, instantly transforming into a shadow and moving away from the other heretics. However, Xie Fanjing immediately brought his wife, Lai Rouyu, to join him.

"Damn it! Why did he get provoked by them? They-" Mo Fengyi had not finished his words, but a huge wave of wind suddenly blew him and his clan members away. After that, several strong wind walls appeared between them and the other clans, and these wind walls suddenly moved towards them. Several Qi swords suddenly appeared and moved towards them, forcing them to retreat. "Fuck!
Xiuwen! They intend to separate us! It would be better if we took care of these rats first!"
After that, Mo Fengyi led his clan members to escape to another area, and he also ordered them to be aware of their surroundings.
"What if we both move straight to the demon cave, brother?" Pang Wachun questioned Pang Xiuwen as he looked toward the cave in a distant way.

Pang Xiuwen immediately agreed with that. "They don't seem to have any intention of attacking us because of our demon miasma, so we'll move there right away. However, I'm sure there are a lot of them waiting for us, so we'll use that technique to destroy them."
"All right!" Both of them quickly flew toward the demon cave.

"Hmm?" Gu Changsheng, Gu Kaizhi, and Mo Xingqing frowned as they arrived at another area. They saw Gu Jinglin standing in her spot, surrounded by many Gu insects, so they immediately stopped and looked around them.
Gu Changsheng then questioned his sister. "Why did you do this, Jinglin? Why did you betray us? Has Zhang Fei done anything to you?"

"I'm sorry, brother." Gu Jinglin apologetically replied to him. "You're right, Zhang Fei did do something to me. Although he didn't brainwash me, my life and will are no longer mine, and I can't go against his orders."
After she said that, Gu Jinglin immediately ordered the Gu insects to attack Gu Changsheng, but her action was of little use because they had the same abilities, so their fight was completely equal.

Gu Kaizhi and Mo Xingqing wanted to help Gu Changsheng, but Pang Gui and Pang Hong suddenly appeared and blocked them, and they attacked the two people from the Gu Clan, causing a fight between them to immediately break out.
Pang Gui directly engaged Gu Kaizhi, especially since their cultivation was equal, and their fight quickly became more intense, causing things around them to be destroyed by their fight.
Meanwhile, Pang Hong moved to attack Mo Xingqing, but she had a hard time because her strength was slightly above hers, and she was repeatedly pushed back by her attacks.
The people from the eastern region suddenly moved in to assist them, quickly turning their situation around. Liang Xian led people from the desolate sect to help Gu Jinglin deal with Gu Changsheng.
On the other hand, Luo Yigang assisted Pang Hong in fighting Mo Xingqing, and the combined attacks of the two of them overwhelmed her, resulting in her body being covered in wounds.
Pang Gui and Gu Kaizhi's previously balanced battle turned around, leaving the patriarch of the Gu Clan under pressure after Dong Fuxiang joined Zhang Fei's slave to attack him.

Since they continued to receive excessive pressure, which made their position even more desperate, Gu Changsheng immediately moved towards his two juniors and brought them away. He immediately summoned several Gu insects from within his body, and those insects swiftly rushed at them.

However, Gu Jinglin also did the same, especially since her Gu insects were the counter to her brother's Gu insects, and she also threw several bottles at the cultivators from the eastern region. "Drink them now!"
Actually, they were hesitant to drink it, but they remembered that Gu Jinglin was already under Zhang Fei's control, so they immediately drank it clean.
*Buzz.. Buzz... Buzz...*

All of them quickly heard the sound of the battle between Gu Changsheng and Gu Jinglin's Gu insects, but they were unable to see the insects' forms due to their small size, so they relied on their senses to detect them.

Zhang Fei, who was still inside the cave in an invisible state, touched the barrier that sealed its mouth. 'This barrier is too strong, so I can't possibly break it. I don't know if the natural races can do it, but I hope they can destroy it before the demons come here.'

Since he couldn't leave the cave, and the barrier also blocked sound transmission, Zhang Fei used his first clone to inform Oliver and the others about it, and he asked them to think of a way to destroy the barrier.

After that, Zhang Fei squatted down beside Chang Wuhen and the others, and he put a peak-grade healing pill into their mouths one by one without Lan Tze and the others knowing, which they immediately swallowed. 'I will release the seal on your cultivation, so you guys can stabilize your injuries, especially since those demons will be coming to this realm soon.
However, you must immediately suppress your auras, lest these traitors become suspicious and attack you again.'

None of them answered Zhang Fei, but they immediately suppressed their auras and cultivation as strong as possible once he released the seal on their cultivation, and they began to stabilize their injuries.
'Phew.' Zhang Fei let out a sigh of relief and walked towards the demon portal. 'The only way to stop those demons is to destroy this portal, but they must work and attack it together.'

[If they all work together, they should be able to destroy this portal, master. However, this portal is no ordinary portal, especially since it can connect two realms that are so far apart from each other, so I'm sure there will be a strong backlash if they destroy it, and it might even kill them instantly.]

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement and frowned, but he then looked at the traitors, who were eagerly awaiting the return of the demons to the Sky Jade Realm. Suddenly, he remembered something, and a slight smirk appeared on his face.

Despite this, their strength as cultivators prevented them from being significantly affected, and they quickly stabilized themselves to counter the fireballs.
Suddenly, four tornadoes assaulted them from four distinct directions, dispersing their demon miasma as the wind swept it away.
However, Pang Xiuwen and the others immediately released their demon miasma again, preventing the sudden attack from the righteous cultivators.

The heretics did not have time to catch their breath because two huge sword formations suddenly appeared in the sky above them, which were the actions of Su Qingshi and Yang Ye, the elders of the Heavenly Sword Sect.
However, those two and the others didn't dare approach those heretics, especially since they already knew the horror of their demon miasma's effects.
They didn't want to be exposed by it, so they used long-range attacks to attack them.
In an instant, countless Qi swords descended from the two sword formations, and they exerted quite a strong pressure on those people, forcing the heretics to spread further away from each other.

Those Qi swords immediately changed their trajectory and shot towards the heretics, but those attacks were not too difficult for their ancestors, especially since their cultivation had already reached 1 to 3 Star Sovereign Realm while the cultivation of the two sword masters was only at the Heaven Realm.

The situation was different with Mo Changqiong and the juniors, who appeared overwhelmed to repel those Qi swords, especially considering their cultivations at the Heaven Realm, like Su Qingshi and Yang Ye.
Even so, they were lucky because their seniors immediately helped them by repelling the Qi swords, so they could breathe a little easier.
Xie Zhengwu narrowed his eyes in a specific direction upon seeing something, instantly transforming into a shadow and moving away from the other heretics.
However, Xie Fanjing immediately brought his wife, Lai Rouyu, to join him.
"Damn it!
Why did he get provoked by them?
They-" Mo Fengyi had not finished his words, but a huge wave of wind suddenly blew him and his clan members away.
After that, several strong wind walls appeared between them and the other clans, and these wind walls suddenly moved towards them.
Several Qi swords suddenly appeared and moved towards them, forcing them to retreat.
"Fuck!
Xiuwen!
They intend to separate us!
It would be better if we took care of these rats first!"
After that, Mo Fengyi led his clan members to escape to another area, and he also ordered them to be aware of their surroundings.
"What if we both move straight to the demon cave, brother?" Pang Wachun questioned Pang Xiuwen as he looked toward the cave in a distant way.
Pang Xiuwen immediately agreed with that.
"They don't seem to have any intention of attacking us because of our demon miasma, so we'll move there right away.
However, I'm sure there are a lot of them waiting for us, so we'll use that technique to destroy them."
"All right!" Both of them quickly flew toward the demon cave.
"Hmm?" Gu Changsheng, Gu Kaizhi, and Mo Xingqing frowned as they arrived at another area.
They saw Gu Jinglin standing in her spot, surrounded by many Gu insects, so they immediately stopped and looked around them.
Gu Changsheng then questioned his sister.
"Why did you do this, Jinglin?
Why did you betray us?
Has Zhang Fei done anything to you?"
"I'm sorry, brother." Gu Jinglin apologetically replied to him.
"You're right, Zhang Fei did do something to me.
Although he didn't brainwash me, my life and will are no longer mine, and I can't go against his orders."
After she said that, Gu Jinglin immediately ordered the Gu insects to attack Gu Changsheng, but her action was of little use because they had the same abilities, so their fight was completely equal.

Gu Kaizhi and Mo Xingqing wanted to help Gu Changsheng, but Pang Gui and Pang Hong suddenly appeared and blocked them, and they attacked the two people from the Gu Clan, causing a fight between them to immediately break out.
Pang Gui directly engaged Gu Kaizhi, especially since their cultivation was equal, and their fight quickly became more intense, causing things around them to be destroyed by their fight.
Meanwhile, Pang Hong moved to attack Mo Xingqing, but she had a hard time because her strength was slightly above hers, and she was repeatedly pushed back by her attacks.
The people from the eastern region suddenly moved in to assist them, quickly turning their situation around.
Liang Xian led people from the desolate sect to help Gu Jinglin deal with Gu Changsheng.
On the other hand, Luo Yigang assisted Pang Hong in fighting Mo Xingqing, and the combined attacks of the two of them overwhelmed her, resulting in her body being covered in wounds.
Pang Gui and Gu Kaizhi's previously balanced battle turned around, leaving the patriarch of the Gu Clan under pressure after Dong Fuxiang joined Zhang Fei's slave to attack him.
Since they continued to receive excessive pressure, which made their position even more desperate, Gu Changsheng immediately moved towards his two juniors and brought them away.
He immediately summoned several Gu insects from within his body, and those insects swiftly rushed at them.
However, Gu Jinglin also did the same, especially since her Gu insects were the counter to her brother's Gu insects, and she also threw several bottles at the cultivators from the eastern region.
"Drink them now!"
Actually, they were hesitant to drink it, but they remembered that Gu Jinglin was already under Zhang Fei's control, so they immediately drank it clean.
*Buzz..
Buzz...
Buzz...*

All of them quickly heard the sound of the battle between Gu Changsheng and Gu Jinglin's Gu insects, but they were unable to see the insects' forms due to their small size, so they relied on their senses to detect them.
Zhang Fei, who was still inside the cave in an invisible state, touched the barrier that sealed its mouth. 'This barrier is too strong, so I can't possibly break it.
I don't know if the natural races can do it, but I hope they can destroy it before the demons come here.'

Since he couldn't leave the cave, and the barrier also blocked sound transmission, Zhang Fei used his first clone to inform Oliver and the others about it, and he asked them to think of a way to destroy the barrier.

After that, Zhang Fei squatted down beside Chang Wuhen and the others, and he put a peak-grade healing pill into their mouths one by one without Lan Tze and the others knowing, which they immediately swallowed. 'I will release the seal on your cultivation, so you guys can stabilize your injuries, especially since those demons will be coming to this realm soon.
However, you must immediately suppress your auras, lest these traitors become suspicious and attack you again.'

None of them answered Zhang Fei, but they immediately suppressed their auras and cultivation as strong as possible once he released the seal on their cultivation, and they began to stabilize their injuries.
'Phew.' Zhang Fei let out a sigh of relief and walked towards the demon portal. 'The only way to stop those demons is to destroy this portal, but they must work and attack it together.'
[If they all work together, they should be able to destroy this portal, master.

However, this portal is no ordinary portal, especially since it can connect two realms that are so far apart from each other, so I'm sure there will be a strong backlash if they destroy it, and it might even kill them instantly.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement and frowned, but he then looked at the traitors, who were eagerly awaiting the return of the demons to the Sky Jade Realm.
Suddenly, he remembered something, and a slight smirk appeared on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 425 Fighting The Enemies II
paragraphs: 'Back then, I thought about using this on Shen Haoran and his loyalists, but I decided not to, so I'll use it on them now.' Zhang Fei muttered as he took out a stalk of the desert nightshade herb that Zefyr had found in the eastern region. 'Hmm? What should I do, Mei? The effects of burning these herbs will also affect Liu Rong and the others.'

[Master, the only way is to injure them a little, and you can crush this herb into powder before sprinkling it on their wounds, so Liu Rong and the others won't be affected by its effects. However, it would be better if you didn't kill them and instead used them for something more important, such as destroying this demon portal.
That way, people in this realm no longer need to worry about the invasion of demons, and you can also live more peacefully with your family.]

'Yeah, you're right. This portal is too powerful, so I will use them as sacrifices to destroy it.' Zhang Fei stored the herbs again before walking behind the senior cultivators, and he immediately conveyed his plan to them. 'Seniors, I have a way to get rid of these traitors, but I can't do it by myself, and I need your help to fight them.
I know that you guys haven't fully recovered yet, but I will help you to distract them. However, I don't want you to kill them just so I can use them for something else.'

Chang Wuhen and the others wondered about Zhang Fei's plan, but they knew that they didn't have much time, especially since the demons from the netherworld realm could attack them at any time, so they immediately agreed with him.
After they agreed, Zhang Fei immediately used the plant generation ability to create several types of plants, one of which was man-eater plants.
"What the hell? Where do these plants come from?" Lan Tze and the others exclaimed in shock as the plants attacked them, but they immediately destroyed them.
*Slash... Slash...*

However, as Zhang Fei continued to use his abilities to create them, those plants continued to appear endlessly. The senior cultivators immediately opened their eyes, and Chang Wuhen turned to the others, who nodded slightly as a sign of understanding. Even though they had not fully recovered from their injuries, they immediately released their maximum strength and rushed to attack the traitors.

Lan Tze and the others were increasingly shocked to see the actions of Chang Wuhen and the others, especially since they had sealed their cultivations before, yet they were still able to use their strength. Those traitors wanted to attack them, but Zhang Fei couldn't possibly let that happen, so he created countless tree roots, which immediately tied their bodies tightly.
Zhang Fei also moved to Lan Tze's side, and he immediately grabbed his hand before using the demon-absorbing ability on him, causing him to scream in pain. "Argh!"
However, Zhang Fei had no intention of killing Lan Tze for the time being, so he did not absorb his soul.
Taking advantage of the opportunity, Chang Wuhen, Di Xiong, and Zhang Long immediately attacked Lan Tze, especially since he was the strongest among the traitors, so they wanted to defeat him first.

Meanwhile, Liu Rong and the others moved to attack the other traitors, and they also had the upper hand, especially since they outnumbered them, causing Huang Shitian and the others to be overwhelmed with their combined attacks.
*Boom*

Their combined attack immediately blasted Lan Tze backwards, slamming him into the cave wall very hard, and he spat blood out of his mouth before falling to the ground. Chang Wuhen did not waste the opportunity and moved to his side, sealing his cultivation immediately.

After that, Chang Wuhen, Zhang Long, and Di Xiong immediately moved to attack the other traitors. Even though they continued to destroy them, Zhang Fei's tree roots continued to appear and bind them, causing their movements to be limited to facing the attacks of the senior cultivators, and their fight became one-sided.
In the end, the senior cultivators managed to defeat the traitors, and immediately they sealed their cultivation, leaving them all lying helplessly on the ground as their situation had reversed.

After that, Zhang Fei immediately canceled his invisibility, causing Huang Jingtian and the others to be shocked by his sudden appearance. "Are you guys surprised to see me? Actually, I was already here before you sealed the cave's mouth, and I was waiting for the right time to get rid of you."

"Hahaha." Zhang Long suddenly laughed as he patted Zhang Fei's shoulder. "Brat! We all owe you a debt of gratitude! We wouldn't be able to reverse our position without you, and those demons would probably kill us."

"That's true." Zhang Wuji nodded in agreement with his father before speaking to Zhang Fei. "You are much younger and weaker than us, but all of your abilities are truly impressive, especially your invisibility, and none of us would have noticed your presence if you hadn't spoken to us."

Zhang Fei turned his head and shook his head. "Father-in-law and brother-in-law, I can't do everything by myself, even with my many abilities, and I still have to rely on a lot of people. The natural race leaders guarding the cave will stop the two Pang Clan ancestors, while the other cultivators work together to stop those heretics."

Unlike the senior cultivators who already knew all that, the traitors were completely shocked by Zhang Fei's words, and they finally realized why the heretics still hadn't come even though Pang Xiuwen had ordered them to move.
"What are your real plans for these traitors, Kid?" Liu Rong questioned Zhang Fei as he pointed to Guan Long and the others.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei watched those traitors as he rubbed his nose, but his gaze then fell on Qiao Ran's mother, Qiao Fei. He then took out the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackles and put them on the old woman's hands and feet. "Hehehe! I don't need these old men, but I need this old woman, and I will use her to increase my cultivation."

Liu Rong and the others looked at the shackles, seemingly curious about their effects. Zhang Fei touched Qiao Fei's body with his demon touch, causing the old woman to let out a loud moan. Her yin qi then flowed directly into the tube at the end of the chains, surprising them.

"As you can see, these chains absorb her yin qi and store it in this tube, which I can then directly absorb into my body." After he said that, Zhang Fei directly absorbed Qiao Fei's yin qi from the tube.
[You gained 7000 Yin Qi from Qiao Fei.]

"No wonder your cultivation can improve this fast; it turns out you have such an absurd item." Chu Hong said that as he shook his head. "The first time I met you, your cultivation was still at the 4-Star Body Realm, and you have reached the 6-Star Soul Realm in less than three months."
Zhang Fei just smiled listening to Chu Hong's remark, and he asked Mei to open the portal to Yin-Yang Space, but the portal did not appear, causing him to frown.
[Master, this sealing formation is preventing me from opening the portal; therefore, you must destroy it first before sending Qiao Fei in there.]
'I see.' Zhang Fei immediately stood up and walked towards the sealing formation. "Can any of you break this formation?"

"Let me try it, Kid." Di Xiong replied as he moved towards Zhang Fei, and he immediately touched the sealing formation to check it. A while later, he shook his head and expressed disappointment. "This sealing formation appears to be an ancient one, so I can't dispel it, and our combined strength may not be able to break it either.
However, the people from the Pang Clan may have the key to dispel it, especially since Lan Tze previously said that they could come in here."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and used his fourth clone to meet Boitata and the leaders of the natural races. He asked them not to kill the two ancestors of the Pang Clan. After that, he moved in front of the portal, and he immediately told them about his plan.

"This demon portal has existed for too long, and those cultivators from the upper realms created it with special materials, so we won't be able to destroy it just like that. However, I might be able to destroy it, but I need to make sacrifices to do so, so I will use these traits as sacrifices."
Not only Lan Tze and the traitors trembled after Zhang Fei said that, but Chang Wuhen and the others also took a deep breath, especially since his plan was truly vicious to use humans as sacrifices.

Zhang Fei naturally noticed their reaction, so he turned to the senior cultivators. "No matter what happens, these traitors will still die, right? Rather than them dying without a clear purpose, it would be better if they died for the safety of this realm and all its inhabitants, right?
If I sacrifice them in order to destroy this portal, then we will no longer have to worry about the demons invading this realm, and we can all live in peace with them all gone."

"I think Zhang Fei's idea is the best for us." Meng Qi suddenly spoke to them. "Back then, our ancestors sacrificed themselves to seal this demon portal because they couldn't destroy it, but our lives have never been peaceful, so I think it's time we end it all by destroying it once and for all."
"I agree with that too." Ye Yuan nodded, and the other senior cultivators also ultimately decided to follow Zhang Fei's plan.

Zhang Fei then told them again. "Anyhow, the destruction of this portal might cause a strong backlash, but that's still just my guess for now, especially since I've never done such a thing before. That's why we have to be careful, or we will also die like them."

After that, Zhang Fei immediately moved to plant his demon slave mark on Lan Tze and the others. He paused for a moment, glancing at Zhao Liang, before speaking to him via voice transmission. 'Patriarch Zhao, I didn't expect that you would join these traitors, especially since Hua'er told me that you were an honorable man.

Her opinion of you turned out to be wrong, especially since you are no different from them, and you fell into the demon's temptation. Anyway, you don't need to worry about Ziqin, because she will be my wife soon, and I will protect her forever.'

Without waiting for Zhao Liang's answer, Zhang Fei immediately planted his devil slave mark into his soul, so all those traitors were under his control now. He then stood up again and looked outside the cave. "For now, we just need to wait for them to clean up those heretics, and I will destroy this portal after we get out of here."

At the same time, a fierce battle broke out between the righteous cultivators and all the Mo Clan members in another area. However, Yang Ye, Su Qingzhi, and the others were quite overwhelmed to fight them, especially since Mo Fengyi's cultivation was at the 3-Star Sovereign Realm, which was much higher than theirs.
Moreover, the Mo Clan members were not weak either, and many of them had already reached the Heaven Realm, including Mo Changqiong and Gu Sanxi.
"Hmm?" Mo Fengyi, who was still fighting with Yang Ye and Su Qingzhi, suddenly glanced in another direction when he sensed the movements of several powerful cultivators.

Soon, Shen Xiya and Shen Huang landed in their battle area, and the two immediately moved to attack Mo Fengyi together. Yang Ye and Su Qingzhi did not pause, joining them to fight the Mo Clan's ancestor. The combined attacks of the four of them quickly forced him to continuously retreat.

Shen's mother and daughter, who had previously only watched from a distance, finally joined them. Shen Xueyi immediately helped the others to attack Mo Changqiong and Gu Sanxi, especially since their strengths were equal. On the other hand, Shen Yu joined the others to fight against members of the Mo Clan, whose cultivation was below the Heaven Realm.

In another area, a huge battle also took place between the righteous cultivators and the people of the Xie Clan. Zi'er appeared to be fighting fiercely with Xie Zhengwu, and Zhang Lingxue assisted her sister-in-law by using long-range attacks. Even so, the ancestor of the Xie Clan could easily repel all their attacks, and he repeatedly turned into shadows to counterattack them.

Xie Zhengwu repeatedly tried to target Zhang Lingxue, especially since her attacks were very disruptive, and she was much weaker than Zi'er. To his surprise, her speed surpassed his, despite the difference in their cultivation being on two different major levels.
Not far from their battle site, Yan Luan'er, Xi Zihua, and Shi Yue were working together to fight Xie Fanjing and Lai Rouyu. Additionally, people from the Zhang Clan assisted them.

However, the cultivation of the two people from the Xie Clan was much higher than theirs, and Xie Fanjing also has the shadow demon ability, like Xie Zhengwu. Lai Rouyu has a strong defense technique, and she was protecting her husband, making it difficult for them to take down their two enemis.

Liu Qingyu, who was in the distance, immediately flew into the sky, pulled out her white sword, and infused it with her light qi. She then thrust her sword upwards, creating a large circle of light in the sky that illuminated their battle site. Her action rendered the people of the Xie Clan unable to use their shadow demon ability.

Following that, Liu Qingyu made a bow-like gesture, akin to an archer using his sword as an arrow. Immediately, numerous light arrows shot towards the members of the Xie Clan, particularly Xie Zhengwu.

Although he could not use his shadow demon ability, Xie Zhengwu was still a cultivator in the sovereign realm, and he easily broke Liu Qingyu's light arrows. However, he was also annoyed because she and Zhang Lingxue kept attacking him from a distance, and Zi'er's charm technique repeatedly disturbed his mind.

In the end, Xie Zhengwu decided to activate his shadow demon bloodline, making his appearance change significantly, and his speed was also much faster than before. Moreover, he unleashed the demon miasma within his body, obstructing Zi'er's approach and neutralizing Liu Qingyu's light arrows.

Xie Fanjing also did the same thing as his father, and his appearance changed after he activated his shadow demon bloodline, forcing Yan Luan'er, Xi Zihua, Shi Yue, and the people from the Zhang Clan to stay away from him.

Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun had already arrived at the demon cave, but they immediately jumped back when an enormous fireball and waterball shot towards them, causing two loud explosions. Their expressions turned serious when they saw Boitata in her dragon-serpent form, and they became tense when they saw Oliver and the natural race leaders appear and surround them. 'Fuck!
That beast and these people are really strong!'

Shen Xueyi immediately helped the others to attack Mo Changqiong and Gu Sanxi, especially since their strengths were equal.
On the other hand, Shen Yu joined the others to fight against members of the Mo Clan, whose cultivation was below the Heaven Realm.
In another area, a huge battle also took place between the righteous cultivators and the people of the Xie Clan.
Zi'er appeared to be fighting fiercely with Xie Zhengwu, and Zhang Lingxue assisted her sister-in-law by using long-range attacks.
Even so, the ancestor of the Xie Clan could easily repel all their attacks, and he repeatedly turned into shadows to counterattack them.
Xie Zhengwu repeatedly tried to target Zhang Lingxue, especially since her attacks were very disruptive, and she was much weaker than Zi'er.
To his surprise, her speed surpassed his, despite the difference in their cultivation being on two different major levels.
Not far from their battle site, Yan Luan'er, Xi Zihua, and Shi Yue were working together to fight Xie Fanjing and Lai Rouyu.
Additionally, people from the Zhang Clan assisted them.
However, the cultivation of the two people from the Xie Clan was much higher than theirs, and Xie Fanjing also has the shadow demon ability, like Xie Zhengwu.
Lai Rouyu has a strong defense technique, and she was protecting her husband, making it difficult for them to take down their two enemis.
Liu Qingyu, who was in the distance, immediately flew into the sky, pulled out her white sword, and infused it with her light qi.
She then thrust her sword upwards, creating a large circle of light in the sky that illuminated their battle site.
Her action rendered the people of the Xie Clan unable to use their shadow demon ability.
Following that, Liu Qingyu made a bow-like gesture, akin to an archer using his sword as an arrow.
Immediately, numerous light arrows shot towards the members of the Xie Clan, particularly Xie Zhengwu.
Although he could not use his shadow demon ability, Xie Zhengwu was still a cultivator in the sovereign realm, and he easily broke Liu Qingyu's light arrows.
However, he was also annoyed because she and Zhang Lingxue kept attacking him from a distance, and Zi'er's charm technique repeatedly disturbed his mind.
In the end, Xie Zhengwu decided to activate his shadow demon bloodline, making his appearance change significantly, and his speed was also much faster than before.
Moreover, he unleashed the demon miasma within his body, obstructing Zi'er's approach and neutralizing Liu Qingyu's light arrows.

Xie Fanjing also did the same thing as his father, and his appearance changed after he activated his shadow demon bloodline, forcing Yan Luan'er, Xi Zihua, Shi Yue, and the people from the Zhang Clan to stay away from him.
Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun had already arrived at the demon cave, but they immediately jumped back when an enormous fireball and waterball shot towards them, causing two loud explosions.
Their expressions turned serious when they saw Boitata in her dragon-serpent form, and they became tense when they saw Oliver and the natural race leaders appear and surround them. 'Fuck!
That beast and these people are really strong!'

chapters.title: Chapter 426 Fighting The Enemies III
paragraphs: 'Brother-'

'I know.' Pang Xiuwen interrupted Pang Wachun as he nodded slightly, but then he looked towards the cave entrance. 'We can't possibly face them with just the two of us, so we should distract them and enter the cave, and we will strike back once the demons come to this realm.'

Pang Wachun nodded in agreement, and they immediately released their demon miasma before making their move. However, Boitata immediately shot her flames at them, and Oliver called on the wind, causing a huge tornado to descend from the sky before merging with her flames, creating a firestorm that headed straight for the two heretics.
The other leaders of the natural races also used their respective abilities to ask for help from nature, such as water, earth, thunder, and others.
When Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun saw this, they immediately threw two artifacts into the air, forming a large black shield above them that instantly repelled their attacks.
*Boom... Boom...*

Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun then spread their demon miasma further, forcing Boitata and the other leaders of the natural races to retreat because it would be bad for them if they were exposed to it. Additionally, they threw several ball-shaped items at them, which immediately exploded and created poisonous smoke.

"Retreat further!" Oliver shouted as he used his wind power to blow away the poisonous smoke, but Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun threw the same items at them once more as they dashed toward the demon cave, so all of them hurriedly moved back.
"These bastards! They only dare to use underhanded means!" Boitata cursed loudly as she fired her flames at those items, and the impact of their clash produced a huge explosion once again.
*Boom... Boom...*

Oliver immediately used his wind power again, and the black smoke was carried away by the wind. An ethereal demon claw suddenly descended from the sky to squash Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun, but the two of them snorted coldly and jumped towards it before shattering it. "Futile! You guys won't be able to stop us!"
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

Numerous tree roots quickly moved towards Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun, but both of them paid no attention to those roots, especially since they immediately disappeared as soon as they touched their demon miasma.

Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun also used two of the netherworld demon scripture's sub-techniques: the demon body to increase their strength and speed, and the demon corruption to weaken their enemies. However, they did not stop there; both of them unleashed their demon claws and demon king's roar at the same time.
*Roar... Roar...*

Affected by their demon king's roar, Boitata and the leaders of the natural races staggered and looked confused. Zhang Fei [1], who was already on standby, immediately flew towards them, taking them away from their previous spot. Having mastered the netherworld demon scripture, he is aware of the effects of their demon corruption, which will taint them with darkness and weaken them further.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4] was already in his demon form, and the demon extermination sword had appeared in his right hand. He took a fighting stance while holding the hilt of his sword with both hands, but he then imbued his light qi into his sword before swinging it upwards.
In an instant, two crescent-shaped light qi shot towards the two demon claws, and Zhang Fei [4]'s attacks directly hit both of them, shattering both.

'What the fuck? How can a demon use light element?' Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun, who were running towards the cave, screamed in shock after they saw Zhang Fei [4]'s demon form. 'Who is that demon? Why is he helping those people?'

Zhang Fei [1] immediately landed beside Zhang Fei [4], and both of them released their demon king's roar toward the two ancestors of the Pang Clan. Unfortunately, Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun immediately countered their attacks with their own demon king's roar, rendering them ineffective.
"Brother! Those two must be Zhang Fei's clones!" Pang Wachun shouted as he glared at Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [4].
Pang Xiuwen nodded in agreement with him, but he immediately ignored them. "Forget about them! We should hurry into the cave to summon those demons, so they can help us destroy these people."

With their speed increasing thanks to the demon body technique, Pang Wachun and Pang Xiuwen had already entered the demon cave. Boitata immediately returned to her human form and landed beside Zhang Fei's clones. "Those guys are really strong and cunning, husband."
"Yes." Both Zhang Fei's clones nodded to Boitata.

Oliver and the other leaders of the natural races also landed beside them, but they seemed to regret not being able to stop Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun, so Zhang Fei [1] spoke to them directly. "You guys don't need to mind them, especially since the situation inside is already under control, and those traitors are under my control now."

"Anyway, it would be better if we caught up with Liu Hua and the others, and we will destroy their clans along with all their descendants." Unlike Boitata, the leaders of the natural races were shocked by Zhang Fei [4]'s words. "They are heretics, so we don't need to be merciful to them; we must destroy them at their roots so that no other heretics will appear in the future."
"Let's go, Hubsand! We'll destroy those clans at once!" Boitata said that with an angry expression, especially after their failure to stop Pang Wachun and Pang Xiuwen.

The leaders of the natural races finally agreed, especially since they had already acknowledged Zhang Fei as their leader, so his orders were absolute. The two Zhang Fei's clones immediately took them away from the area using the nine cloud steps, but they also paid attention to all the battles between the righteous cultivators and those heretics.

They could see that the Mo Clan was being pushed back by Shen Xueyi and the others' combined attacks, and many of their members were dead. Moreover, Zhang Fei's slave, Mo Zifeng, had also joined them based on his order, which shocked Mo Fengyi and his clan members.

The battle situation in another area also seemed to be under control, especially after the cultivators from the southern region arrived, and the people from the Shen Clan immediately helped Shen Xueyi and the others to fight the people from the Xie Clan.

Meanwhile, the battle with the people from the Gu Clan had already ended, especially after Meng Guanqiu led cultivators from the southern region to come to the aid of Lian Xiang and the others. Since that clan had only three members, they couldn't fight such a large number of cultivators.

At first, Zhang Fei wanted to sacrifice Gu Jinglin, but he changed his mind, especially since he still needed her guidance to master the Gu Creation Technique, and she was the right person for that. Instead, he ordered her to finish off Gu Changsheng, Gu Kaizhi, and Mo Xingqing.
After that, Lian Xiang asked them to spread out to the other two battle locations so they could eliminate the heretics as quickly as possible.

Inside the cave, Chang Wuhen and the others had already suppressed their cultivation and aura as much as possible, and Zhang Fei himself had entered an invisible state so that Pang Xiuwen and Pang Wachun would not notice his presence. Meanwhile, Lan Tze and the others seemed to act naturally as if nothing had happened, so the two heretics were still unaware that they had become his slaves.
"Where is Qiao Fei? Why isn't he here?" Pang Xiuwen questioned Huan Shitian and Huan Jingtian, especially since the Huan and Qiao clan were related by marriage.

"Qiao Fei got some bad news from Qiao Ran about their clan, so he decided to go back and check." Huan Shitian's answer made Pang Xiuwen frown and turn to Chang Wuhen and the others, but they chose to ignore them while pretending to be miserable.
Lan Tze then questioned Pang Xiuwen. "Why haven't the demons come here yet? The seal on this portal was destroyed long ago."

Pang Xiuwen himself was curious about that, so he checked the demon portal. However, the portal suddenly glowed, and a male demon with a completely black body walked out of it, which excited both him and Pang Wachun.

Chang Wuhen and the others frowned at the demon's presence, but Zhang Fei asked them to remain calm, especially since he already knew Shang Huaqiang's plan through Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was still hiding in the demon emperor city.

They immediately kneeled down on one knee in front of the male demon, and Pang Xiuwen asked. "Why didn't the demon emperor lead his troops directly to this realm? These people are already helpless, and none of them are aware of our actions, so it is safe for them to come here."

"Is the situation really safe?" Pang Wachun and the others nodded to the male demon. "I see! I will go back now and inform my emperor about this, so he can immediately lead us to take over this realm."

The male demon immediately entered the demon portal again, making Pang Xiuwen breathe a sigh of relief. He then stood up and turned to those senior cultivators. "Hehehehe! You and your ancestors have defended this portal for generations, but the seal has been destroyed, and those demons will invade this realm once again, so this is our victory."
"Brother, we-Ugh!"
"Wachun!" Pang Xiuwen immediately shouted as soon as he saw a spear penetrate Pang Wachun's chest, but his expression turned furious when he saw the person holding the spear.
*Splurt.*
Lan Tze didn't respond to Pang Xiuwen, and he pulled his spear out of Pang Wachun's chest, causing him to collapse on the cold cave floor.

"Lan Tze! You-" Pang Xiuwen immediately swallowed his words as a sword suddenly pressed against his neck. The other senior cultivators, together with the traitors, released their auras to restrict his movements, immobilizing him.
"No matter how strong you are, you will not be able to fight against all of us." Ba Jiawen said it as he sealed Pang Xiuwen's cultivation.

'Fuck!' Pang Xiuwen cursed inwardly as he watched Chang Wuhen and the others stand up, but his attention was diverted to Zhang Fei, who had canceled his invisibility and appeared in front of him. "So you were the one who planned everything, huh?"

Zhang Fei smiled faintly in response. "In the past, I had no ties to this realm, but many of my wives were natives of this realm, and they loved this realm dearly, so I was forced to act to stop you."

"Hahaha!" Pang Xiuwen laughed out loud. "I didn't expect that the plan we had put together for years would be ruined in the hands of a snotty brat like you, and it all started when your appearance disrupted Pang Hong's plan. Unfortunately, you are too late because the seal has been broken, and the demons are about to invade this realm again.
Although I lost in your hands, I still emerged victorious with their return."

"Do you still not understand the situation? Why haven't the demons come here even though the seal has been broken?" Zhang Fei then changed into his demon form, causing the senior cultivators to frown. Even though they already knew about it, they still had a hard time accepting that he had a demon form. "As you can see, I am a demon myself, and I can go to their realm without any obstacles.
However, I don't want to talk much with you, and I will enslave you so that I can remove the sealing formation from this place."

"Heh!" Pang Xiuwen snorted at that. "Do you believe I have the key to removing the sealing formation? I got it from the demons, so only they can remove it. Like I said before, no matter what happens, even if I have to die in your hands, I will die as the winner."
Chang Wuhen and the others frowned after they heard that, but Zhang Long immediately said to Zhang Fei. "Kid, you can enslave this guy now, so we can know whether he is telling the truth or not."
"That's right, you can do it now." Chang Wuhen and others also said to Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei nodded and lightly touched Pang Xiuwen's chest, but he continued to smile triumphantly, unafraid of his enslavement. However, he couldn't immediately implant his demon slave mark, especially since his soul strength was still too strong, so he first used the demon-absorbing technique to weaken him.
"Gahh!" Pang Xiuwen's groan of pain immediately echoed in the cave, but Zhang Long and Zhang Wuji held him back from falling. "Gah! Hahahaha! Argh! It's useless! Hahaha!
All of you will die at the hands of those demons!"

Soon, Pang's groan of pain Xiuwen stopped, and his eyes went blank after Zhang Fei planted his slave mark into his soul. He then ordered him to remove the sealing formation, but he shook his head before answering him. "Master, I don't have the key, but one of the demons does, so you have to capture him to be able to remove the sealing formation."
All of them released heavy sighs, and Zhang Fei asked his new slave again. "Who is the demon's identity?"
Pang Xiuwen once again shook his head in response. "I don't know the exact identity of the demon, but he calls himself the blood demon, and he is one of the demon emperor's trusted men."
"Do you know anything about that demon, Kid?" Zhang Long asked Zhang Fei.

"Father-in-law, my strength is still too low, so I don't dare to explore the netherworld realm." Zhang Fei then paused for a moment and thought of something. "I have never met that demon, but I may know his identity, and he seems to be Elijah the vampire lord, especially since vampires are always related to blood.

Unfortunately, he is very strong because his demon rank is at the duke rank, and he also has senses that are no less powerful than cultivators, so I can't get close to him. As for Feng Yao, she is still holding back those cultivators from the upper realms, and Shang Huaqiang is locking her up now, so she can't do anything either."

After hearing that, Zhang Long and the others became deeply contemplative and considered venturing into the netherworld realm. However, they thought that it was too risky, especially since those cultivators would definitely detect their presence immediately.

Just as they were thinking about that, a giant demon hand suddenly came out from within the demon portal and swept towards them, but they immediately moved to avoid it. Despite their efforts, the attack still struck some of them, particularly Pang Xiuwen and the traitors, causing them to crash into the cave wall.
Zhang Fei quickly summoned the extermination demon sword, imbued his light element into it, and slashed the giant demon hand directly.
*Splurt*

A lot of fresh black blood gushed out from the severed hand, so they protected their bodies with Qi, especially since the blood soaked the entire area inside the cave, and it was swiftly pulled back by its owner. "They are starting to move, so we have no other choice left, and we have to destroy this demon portal now."
