A lot of fresh black blood gushed out from the severed hand, so they protected their bodies with Qi, especially since the blood soaked the entire area inside the cave, and it was swiftly pulled back by its owner.
"They are starting to move, so we have no other choice left, and we have to destroy this demon portal now."

chapters.title: Chapter 427 Destroy The Portal
paragraphs: "Kid, can you take us out of this cave?" Meng Qi questioned Zhang Fei.

"Unfortunately, the sealing portal restricts all kinds of things, and I can't use my abilities under its restrictions, so I can't take you all out." Zhang Fei then touched the demon portal. "At first, I thought of taking you to the netherworld realm before returning to this realm again, but we can't pass through this portal without the key, and only demons can enter and exit."
"What do you think will happen if we destroy this portal?" This time, it was Gu Tong who asked Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei shook his head in response. "I can't answer that, so we should prepare for risks."

Chang Wuhen and the others looked thoughtful after hearing that, and they thought it would be fine if they died as long as their realm and younger generations could live in peace, just like what their ancestors did for them in the past, so they immediately made up their minds. "Let's do it!
"No matter what happens to us, we have to destroy this demon portal to ensure the safety of this realm and all its inhabitants."

Zhang Fei led them away from the demon portal, but he ordered Pang Xiuwen and the traitors to line up in front of it. Additionally, he took out an item that Mei had prepared for him, and it immediately formed a transparent shield after he threw it to the ground.
"I don't know if this will be enough to protect us, but this is the best item I have right now, and all of you should use all your strength to protect yourselves."
"What about you, kid?" Zhang Long inquired as he and the other senior cultivator enveloped their bodies in qi.

"Father-in-law, I know your worries, but you really don't need to worry about me. Moreover, I have promised Lingxue and the others to take good care of myself, so I won't let them down." Zhang Fei then ordered his slaves. "Get ready! Use all your strength to destroy the demon portal! If your strength is insufficient, then each of you must detonate your cultivation cores."

Pang Xiuwen and the others stiffened after hearing Zhang Fei's order, but his demon slave mark in their souls forced them to obey his orders, so they immediately released their power to the maximum and waited for his signal.

"Hmm?" Shang Huaqiang's avatar and the members of the Shang Clan frowned upon seeing the giant demon's hand neatly cut off. They believed that the people from the Sky Jade Realm should not be able to hurt him, especially since his demon rank was at the archduke rank.

Feng Yao smiled at their reaction, and she tried to instill doubts in them. "As I previously mentioned, there are some young cultivators from the upper realms in the Sky Jade Realms, and we have a good relationship with them. Although we are not directly involved in their affairs, we will still help them indirectly.

That giant demon is indeed strong in the lower and middle realms, but he is still not our opponent. To tell you the truth, our seniors are already aware of the demon portal and the previous demon invasion, and some of them may have even informed them that you and your clan were responsible for that invasion.

Whether you continue with your plan or choose to become an enemy of many cultivators, the choice is yours now. We won't directly attack your clan because you haven't yet invaded that realm. However, we can excommunicate your clan from our circle and restrict the flow of all resources to your realm, which will negatively impact everyone in your realm."

'This little bitch! How dare she threaten me! If I hadn't been afraid of her parents and ancestors, I would have killed her by now!' Shang Huaqiang's avatar inwardly grumbled as he glared fiercely at Feng Yao, but he then snorted and ordered those demons. "Go! Attack that realm now!"
Feeling threatened by the aura of Shang Huaqiang's avatar, the demons immediately moved towards the portal, led by the demons at King and Queen rank.
Just as several demons were about to enter the portal, Shang Huaqiang's avatar, the people of the Shang Clan, and Feng Yao suddenly felt many strong auras radiate from behind the portal.
"Shit! Back off!" Shang Huaqiang's avatar immediately shouted at the demons, but his warning was a few seconds too late as the aura emanating from the portal grew stronger and stronger.

Feng Yao released a heavy sigh in her heart as she realized the intentions of the cultivators from the Sky Jade Realm. 'They intend to commit suicide to destroy the demon portal, huh? Sigh! I've lived with them for quite some time, so it would be a shame if they had to die. Unfortunately, they have no other choice but to do so, so they can stop the demon invasion of this realm for now and forever.'

The expressions of Shang Huaqiang's avatar and the members of the Shang Clan turned gloomy after they realized the intentions of the cultivators from the Sky Jade Realm, and they all hurriedly moved away from the portal, especially since the effects would be extremely detrimental if they were affected by its destruction.

Shang Huaqiang's avatar rushed to free Feng Yao, who immediately flew away from the area, but she continued to pay attention to the portal from a distance. She was a little surprised when someone touched her shoulder, but she immediately realized that it was Zhang Xiaolong [3], and a relieved smile appeared on her face after he told her about the situation inside the demon cave.

The portal suddenly shook violently, and the shaking could even be felt by the demons, who were running away from that location. A few seconds later, the portal glowed brightly before exploding, creating a powerful shockwave that threw them all back.

"Fuck!" Shang Huaqiang's avatar cursed loudly as he watched all the plans he had made for hundreds of years crumble in the blink of an eye. The members of his clan also reacted the same way as him, especially since creating a portal that connected two distant realms required an exorbitant cost, and the resources used were also quite rare, so they wouldn't be able to create another one anytime soon.

A black hole suddenly appeared from the former portal's location, sucking in everything around that area, causing many demons at marquis or marchioness rank and below to be sucked into it. The demons at duke or duchess rank and above can still defend themselves from being sucked into it.

Shang Huaqiang's avatar immediately protected the people of his clan to avoid it, and Feng Yao also returned to her beast form as she flapped her two wide wings to resist the suction of the black hole.

In the Sky Jade Realm, the demon cave began to collapse after Pang Xiuwen and those traitors detonated their cultivation cores, but Chang Wuhen and the others immediately blew away all the rubble, and the destruction of the demon portal caused throughout a loud explosion that was heard in the northern region, shocking the righteous cultivators outside.
The suicide of Zhang Fei's slaves and the portal explosion had destroyed his shield, leaving them without any protection other than their qi.
The black hole also appeared at the spot where the demon portal had been, and it immediately sucked in everything in the area, including the cultivators and the cave ruins.

Chang Wuhen and the others immediately took out their respective weapons and stabbed them to the ground to prevent themselves from being sucked into the black hole. They also unleashed their strength to the fullest to fight back against the suction.

"Hang on!" Zhang Fei shouted at them as he transformed into his complete fox form, shocking Chang Wuhen and the others. He immediately stood in front of them, extended his five tails in several directions, and tied them to the rocks in the surrounding area.

Additionally, he sent a voice transmission to all the righteous cultivators, warning them to flee as far as possible, lest the black hole swallow them. 'Shit! If only the sealing formation was destroyed, I could take them away from this place directly. Unfortunately, the explosions couldn't destroy it.'

Gradually, as the black hole expanded, the suction grew stronger and stronger, making it increasingly difficult for Zhang Fei and the others to resist it. The senior cultivators' expressions darkened as the black hole continued to draw them forward, and their Qi rapidly drained as they struggled to defend themselves. 'Damn it! We can't hold out much longer!
If it continues to expand, it will definitely suck us in!'

"Crap!" Zhang Fei cursed as his five tails were loosed on the rocks, causing him to be sucked towards the black hole. However, he immediately extended his tails to the end of the cave, and he also stabbed both of his claws into the ground.
"Zhang Fei!" Zhang Long and the others shouted loudly after seeing that.

Unfortunately, some of them could no longer resist the suction, and their grip on their weapons immediately loosened before they shot towards the black hole. Those people immediately collided with Zhang Fei, and all of them got sucked into the black hole.

"Shit!" Chang Wuhen and the others were shocked to see that, but they themselves found it increasingly difficult to hold back. The suction of the black hole immediately pulled them in one by one, and they seemed resigned to their fate. However, the black hole suddenly disappeared, and all of them immediately fell to the ground.
*Crumble... Crumble...*

"Move!" Di Xiong shouted as she used his last strength to dodge the cave debris that fell from above, and the other cultivators immediately followed suit, moving sideways to avoid them, leaving a huge hole above the cave.
"Damn it!" Chang Wuhen cursed as she stood up and then turned to the remaining people. The black hole swallowed Zhang Fei, Chu Hong, Ba Jiawen, Yan Zixiu, Meng Qi, Gu Tong, Zhang Wuji, and Chi Yan."
"What do you think will happen to them?" Di Xiong posed the question with a somber expression.

Zhang Long immediately took out a jade that belonged to his son, Zhang Wuji. "Wuji is still alive; they should all be alive. However, we don't know where the black hole took them, but I hope they can survive and return to us."
Liu Rong and Liu Ming looked gloomy, especially since Chu Hong and Zhang Fei were their relatives, and their wives would definitely be sad if they heard about their fate.

Ye Yuan then spoke to them. "Since the demon portal connects our realm directly with the netherworld realm, I believe the black hole might send them there. If that is true, Zhang Fei should be able to escape easily, and I am sure that he can find them and bring them back."

"No matter what, we must convey their situation to their respective families." Shen Wansan then looked at the hole above the cave. "My daughter will probably be sad if she finds out that Zhang Fei was sucked into the black hole, so I will go to her immediately to tell her about this matter."
"Yeah, I also have to tell Zi'er and Xiaoling about this matter, so let's go out." and meet them now." Zhang Long then flew out of the hole above them, and most of them followed him.

On the other hand, Chang Wuhen still stood in her spot as she stared at the spot where the demon portal used to be. 'Ancestors, the demon portal is gone now, so your sacrifices are not in vain, and those demons will not be able to invade our realm again. However, our realm is not completely safe, especially since there are people who are ambitious to invade our realm, and they are too strong for us.
Even so, we will never give up, and we will continue to improve ourselves to protect this realm from them.'
When they arrived outside, the righteous cultivators were already waiting for them. However, many of them immediately became anxious, especially since their families were not there.
Meng Guanqiu inquired directly. "Seniors, where is Big Sis Meng Qi? Why isn't she with you?"
"Fahter-in-law, where is my husband?" Zi'er also questioned Zhang Long.
"What about Big Sis Yan Zixiu, seniors? Did something happen to her and the others?" Yan Luan'er asked them after she couldn't find her big sister.

Although she couldn't find Chu Hong among them, Liu Qingyu did not look the least bit anxious. After all, Zhang Fei's clone was still around, and nothing bad had happened to him. He had already told her about the events in the demon cave and the black hole, so she was sure that he and her husband were still alive.
Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu also seemed relaxed about Zhang Fei's disappearance, especially since they knew his abilities very well, so they were sure that he would return to their side soon.
"Qingyu." Liu Rong called out as she and Liu Ming landed in front of Liu Qingyu. "Zhang Fei and your husband, they-"

"I already know, mother." Liu Qingyu interrupted Liu Rong. "Zhang Fei's clones did not disappear, so he and the others are still alive now. However, he doesn't know the location of his real body now, so he and the others are likely still trapped inside the black hole."
"Are they really fine, Qingyu?" Meng Guanqiu, Yan Luan'er, and Zi'er asked at the same time.

"Yes." Liu Qingyu then turned her head away. "Currently, two of Zhang Fei's clones are leading Hua'er and the others to exterminate those heretic clans, so I'm sure they are fine. However, we can't do anything now, and we can only pray for their safety while waiting for them to return to our side."

Meng Guanqiu, Yan Luan'er, and Zi'er let out heavy sighs and nodded to Liu Qingyu, but they couldn't shake off the unease in their hearts, so their eyes continued to look towards the demon cave, which had become an ordinary cave now.
Shen Wansan, who had just landed in front of Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu, immediately asked his daughter. "Aren't you worried about Zhang Fei, Yu'er?"

"What should I worry about him, father?" Shen Yu asked back as she smiled. "As Aunt Qingyu said just now, my husband is fine, and he is only trapped inside the black hole now. Moreover, I am quite familiar with his abilities, so I am sure that he can get out of that place soon and return to me."

"I see." Shen Wansan nodded in understanding before turning to Shen Xueyi, and he immediately noticed the change in his partner. However, he chose not to comment on that issue, especially since their relationship from the start was not based on feelings, and their relationship was just a mutually beneficial relationship for each other.
However, Shen Xueyi immediately told Shen Wansan the truth through voice transmission. 'You must have noticed, right? I've chosen Zhang Fei as my new partner, so we're no longer partners.'
Shen Wansan only smiled and nodded at Shen Xueyi, but he then turned to Shen Huang and Shen Xinya, who were standing behind the two women. 'They've also become Zhang Fei's partners, huh?'
Chang Wuhen then spoke to them. "We can't do anything to help them, but we can help Zhang Fei's clones and the others to get rid of those heretic clans, so let's all go after them now."

chapters.title: Chapter 428 Zhang Fei's Plans
paragraphs: In the netherworld realm, the demons stood frozen in their spots, and none of them dared to say a word, especially since Shang Huaqiang's avatar looked furious after the portal was destroyed. 'Damn it! I have to meet that guy again to create a new portal to connect the two realms again, but it will take decades to create one.

Furthermore, the younger generations of those upper realm clans, particularly the younger generations of those of the mythical beasts, reside in the Sky Jade realm. They will undoubtedly discover the legacy of the ten-tailed fox before me. "Xishun, lead them back to our realm, and I will think of a new plan to invade that realm again."
"Yes, Patriarch."

Shang Huaqiang's avatar then changed to Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin. "I sent you two here for an easy task, but you guys wasted the opportunity I gave you. As punishment, you two will go to our branch clan in the wasteland realm in the middle realm, and you will work there for a hundred years."

Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin were shocked by that, and they wanted to refute Shang Huaqiang's avatar, but Shang Chenguang immediately stopped them because he didn't want them to die at the hands of their patriarch, especially since they were still so young and their chances were still wide open in the future.

After that, Shang Huaqiang's avatar instantly disappeared from their sight, and Shang Xishun brought three of their clan members to rush back to the red sun realm. As for Shang Chenguang, he wanted to take Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin to the wasteland realm, so he could arrange the best for them in that realm.
"Brother, we-"

"Forget it." Shang Guangming immediately stopped his sister. "We have no choice but to accept our patriarch's decision, or he will sentence us to death if we contradict him. Moreover, a hundred years is not long for cultivators like us, so I am sure we can get through everything just fine, and we will return to the Red Sun Realm after our punishment is over."

"Yaolin, I know your worries, but I will help you two arrange everything, so you guys won't suffer in that realm. In addition, I will often come to visit you two there, and I will bring you the best resources for your cultivation." Shang Yaolin sighed helplessly and nodded at Shang Chenguang.

"Anyways, I recall you telling me about the black heavenly fox, so let's head to that forest now and bring him to the wasteland realm. Since he is still a child, I will help one of you make a contract with him, and he will be the key for you to gain a higher status after you return to our realm."

Both of them were overjoyed to hear that, especially since getting a heavenly fox as a contract beast was a rare opportunity. However, Shang Yaolin immediately told Shang Chenguang. "Uncle, I have gone to that forest to look for that kid, but he disappeared, and that old tree demon doesn't know his location."
"It's ok, we'll go there first, and I'll look for him later." Shang Chenguang immediately enveloped them with his aura and took them away from the demon emperor city for the ghostveil forest.
'What are you going to do now, Kid?' Feng Yao asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] via voice transmission.

'I'll send you back to the Sky Jade Realm now, and I'll go to the ghostveil forest to meet those three people.' Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer made Feng Yao frown, especially since Shang Chenguang and his two juniors were much stronger than him. 'Hehehe! You don't have to worry about me because they won't hurt me, and they will never be able to force me into a beast contract.

Since you are a phoenix, you should be familiar with my heavenly fox abilities, right? I don't have much information about the middle or upper realms, and I can only open the gate if I've been there before. paragraphs: [According to the system's data, this place should be a space rift, and it's connected to various realms, Master. However, I don't have detailed information about this place, so I don't know the way out of here.

As for the senior cultivators, they were all sucked out of this place while you were unconscious, and I believe they are now being sent to different realms, though I'm not sure which realm they're currently in.]
Zhang Fei released a heavy sigh, stood up, and checked the surrounding area once more. "Can you detect anything from this place, Mei?"

[I can't detect anything, Master. Actually, I myself am confused about your situation, especially since the senior cultivators have been expelled from this place, but you were left alone here for so long.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows. "Can you open the gate to those realms?"
[Yes, Master.] Mei immediately opened the gates to the Sky Jade Realm, Earth, and the Netherworld Realm. [There are no restrictions in this place, so you can leave here whenever you want.]
Zhang Fei let out a sigh of relief after seeing the three gates, but he then asked Mei to close them all. "Are there any other gates appearing in the system?"
[The system can't detect this place, so there are no new gates in it.]
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 10,200 Qi.]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 102 green jewels sent to the inventory.]

Zhang Fei ignored the notification and continued to look at several areas, thinking about which one he should go to first. "Somehow, I have a feeling that there is something in this place, or else I wouldn't be left alone here. Since I can't come back to this place again, I'll try to explore it first."

[Master, I don't have any information about this place, so I don't know if there are restrictions in other areas or not. Therefore, you must exercise extreme caution to avoid getting lost and accidentally entering a restricted area, from which you may not be able to return.]

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei suddenly frowned as he saw a bright light from one direction, and he hurriedly swallowed two Qi recovery pills before using the nine cloud steps to go in that direction.

Time continued to pass, but Zhang Fei still had not reached the location of the light even though he had used his ability dozens of times, and the light still seemed so far ahead. "What the hell with this place? I've traveled more than a thousand miles, but I haven't come one bit closer to that light."
[Master, based on my calculations, the distance from your current location to the light's location is still around ten thousand miles, so you can continue using the nine cloud steps to get there.]

"Ten thousand miles, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself as he continued to move toward the light's location. "Fortunately, I can move 125 miles in one fell swoop, so that distance isn't a big deal for me, but I'll have to swallow a few more QI recovery pills for that."

On the flying artifact, Shang Chenguang kept his eyes on Zhang Xiaolong [3], causing him to become tense as he worried that he could see through his disguise. However, his worries were unfounded, especially since the elder from the Shang Clan only checked his body.

"This fox kid's growth is truly astonishing; he's only 10 years old, but his cultivation is already at the 6-Star Soul Realm, and he looks like he'll break through to the 7-Star soon, which is something that other cultivators from the lower realms would never be able to do."

"Is it because he is a heavenly fox, Uncle?" Shang Guangming asked Shang Chenguang, as he himself was also in shock when he met Zhang Xiaolong [3] the first time. However, he was in a hurry to look for the other two heavenly foxes, so he didn't think too much about it.

"I don't think so." Shang Chenguang answered with a shake of his head. "You guys can't feel it, but I can feel that he has many types of yin qi in his body, which means he has been a dual cultivator since he was this young."

"Eh?" Shang Yaolin immediately lifted Zhang Xiaolong [3], looked at him in surprise, and rubbed his small dick. "How could you be a dual cultivator? You're still this small, and this thing can't get an erection yet, so you can't possibly do that."

'This woman is quite shameless! My dick can't get an erection your ass! I'm a grown man, and you'll be shocked to see my dick!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then made up a story for them. "Big Sis, my father said that he was a dual-cultivator, but he didn't have many wives, and he used to go out to buy a strange liquid in bottles, which he called Yin Qi."

"Oh ! That's right! One can also use such a method to become a dual cultivator." Shang Yaolin expressed her understanding by nodding. "Does that mean your father gave you the Yin Qi of many women? Didn't your mother scold him for teaching you to be a dual-cultivator?"

"Yes, my father frequently gave me that liquid, and he said that I could become stronger faster if I drank it often." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told them. "My mother also often drank strange liquids from the bottle, so she didn't scold him. I don't know what kind of liquid she often drank, especially since they forbade me from drinking it, and they told me that it was only for women."

"I see." Shang Yaolin then had an idea. "Since you are a dual cultivator, I will give you my yin qi, which will make you even stronger, especially since my yin qi is stronger than those female cultivators from the lower realms. However, you have to listen to my words, okay?"
'Tch! I will listen to you, but I will never obey you.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then nodded to Shang Yaolin. "Yes, big sis, I will listen to your words."

"Hehehe!" Shang Yaolin giggled as she kissed Zhang Fei's forehead and hugged him tightly in her arms. "You are such a cute and innocent fox, and I really like you, so I will keep you by my side forever."

"Hahaha." Shang Chenguang suddenly laughed and patted Shang Guangming on the shoulder. "Since your sister has a fondness for this fox kid, I think you should give him to her, and I will assist her in establishing a contract with him later."

Shang Guangming nodded to his uncle. "It doesn't matter which one of us makes a contract with this fox kid, especially since we are one family, and having him by our side will elevate our family's status."

paragraphs: The further he walked, the more statues Zhang Fei discovered, which made him curious and horrified at the same time, especially since all the statues in that place looked very ancient. "Dang! This place is really creepy, Mei! What kind of place is this? Why are there statues of all races here?
Look at those beasts' statues; their ranks vary from ordinary beasts to mythical beasts, and I can't recognize some of them, so I thought they were immortal rank beasts."
[I think so too, master. Those beast races are not registered in the system, so they are probably immortal rank beasts.]

Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh before his gaze shifted to the large room in front of him, so he quickly flew there. However, he immediately froze in place as he stared at the beast statue in the middle of the room, especially since it was a statue of the ten-tailed fox, and the statue was truly similar to his soul that he had encountered in the fairy forests.

Zhang Fei then looked at the statues of beasts that were lined up around the room, starting from a golden dragon, a phoenix, a vermilion bird, an azure dragon, a white tiger, a black tortoise, a heavenly fox, and so on.

Zhang Fei was not interested in the statues of other mythical beasts, but he was very interested in the statue of the ten-tailed fox. He then transformed into his half-fox form and approached the statue, immediately touching it and channeling his heavenly fox aura. "It appears that this statue is just an ordinary statue, and I can't sense the presence of the old fox in it."

After that, Zhang Fei continued to the next room, where he found many statues of demons. In the middle of the room, there was a statue of a giant male demon with two long horns on his forehead, and his entire body was covered in a black robe. Below the statue, there was a statue of a three-headed dog similar to a cerberus.
However, the appearance of the statue was very strange, and he felt that the male demon was a combination of several types of demons, especially since he also had the character of an incubus.
Zhang Fei then turned to the seven demon statues on the side of the room, five of which were male demon statues, and the other two were female demon statues, all of which also had giant bodies.
[Master, they seem to be ancient demons, and they should have lived in the distant past. The male giant demon in the middle is definitely their leader, but his appearance is truly unusual.]

"You're probably right, Mei." Zhang Fei then glanced at the third room and proceeded directly there, where he discovered statues representing a variety of natural races, including fairies, elves, centaurs, and more.

Zhang Fei was confused seeing those statues bowing towards the statue of a woman in the middle of the room, especially since it also had a giant body like the statues of the demons in the room previously. "Could this woman belong to the giant race? As far as I remember, there were no giant races in the fairy forest, and Grandpa Oliver led the natural races there.
However, this female giant seems to be the real leader of the natural races, and the other races seem to really respect her."

Zhang Fei then looked towards the fourth room, and he thought that the room should contain statues of humans. However, his thoughts were proven wrong when he entered the room, especially since it was filled with the demihuman statues, and the statue in the middle is a statue of a male demihuman, who has the appearance of a humanoid dragon, but his entire body is red.
"A demihuman with dragon bloodlines, huh? Dragons are one of the strongest mythical beasts, so it's natural for this man to lead the demihuman races."

In the next room, Zhang Fei finally found statues of humans, and he could see various human races like the humans living on earth. Some have white skin like westerners and Chinese, some have tan skin, some have black skin, and so on. However, all the statues were too old, so they were clearly humans from a distant era in the past.
Unlike the previous four rooms, there was no statue in the middle of the room, indicating that they had no leader.

After he looked at all the statues, Zhang Fei went straight to the last room, but he did not find any statues in it, so the room was completely empty, which confused him. "Why is there nothing in this place?"
[Master, there are only five races in this universe: humans, demihumans, beasts, natural races, and demons. So I think it's natural that this last room is empty.]

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei, but he immediately looked at the walls around the room, which surprised him a little, especially since every wall was covered in paintings. He then approached the right wall of the room, and he looked at the painting with the number 1, but his expression became serious when he realized the meaning of the painting.
"Mei, these are the painting of this universe, right?"

[It seems so, Master.] Mei then scanned all the paintings on the wall and saved them into the system. [Master, this first painting seems to be the beginning before this universe was formed, and there was only chaos at that time.]

"I think so." Zhang Fei then moved on to the second painting, which was divided into two: light and dark. Planets, sun, moon, and stars already exist in the painting. "This painting should be the beginning of the birth of this universe, and there were no living creatures at that time."
[Yes, you are right, Master.]

In the third painting, Zhang Fei discovered a depiction of mythical beasts. However, two beasts, whose appearances were ambiguous, towered over the others. One beast had a completely white body with two golden eyes, and it was in the light section. The other beast has a completely black body with bloodshot eyes, and it is in the dark section.

Zhang Fei then rubbed the beast in the dark section. "Mei, these two beasts should be the primordial beasts, but I didn't expect that there would be only two beasts. These ten beasts should be immortal beasts; below them are mythical beasts, divine beasts, heaven-rank beasts, and so on."

[Yes, master. However, I didn't expect that beasts were born before the other living beings, and humans were the last living beings to be born. However, their numbers are far greater than other living beings now; even the population of the earth is around 8.2 billion people now.]

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed when he heard that. "After all, humans are too active in producing offspring, and I myself am thinking of having so many children in the future, so it is natural that our numbers are much greater now."

[Tch! If you really wanted to have children from all your wives and partners, the number of your descendants would probably surpass the current number of humans, and your descendants would dominate this universe if that happened.]

Zhang Fei smiled to himself as he thought about the matter, but he thought it would be interesting if his descendants were spread across all realms throughout the universe. Unfortunately, that won't happen anytime soon, especially since he himself still doesn't want to have children.
Zhang Fei then proceeded to the fourth painting, where he was astonished to witness the phenomenon of demon birth, particularly given that the demon originated from a giant egg.

The first demon born was a male demon on the statue in the middle of the second room, and the second demon born was a female demon, whose appearance is not much different from the male demon, which makes them the ancestors of demons. "These two are the first and second demons, so they should be powerful, and they are probably no less powerful than the primordial beasts.
However, I'm confused why there are no statues of the two primordial beasts in the first room, and the statue of the ten-tailed fox is in the middle of the room instead."

In the fifth painting, Zhang Fei saw the birth process of the natural races, starting with the giant races, and various races were born after them. "Interesting! All natural races are born from all the elements in this universe, so it's no wonder that they are so friendly with nature, and they can also borrow natural power."
In the sixth painting, Zhang Fei sees various beasts transforming into humans, but they still retain their beast characteristics, indicating the birth of the demihuman races.

The seventh painting depicts the birth of the first male human from the earth, followed by the creation of a female human from one of his ribs. Zhang Fei was slightly taken aback upon witnessing this. "Oh? I'm not a religious person, but I didn't expect this painting to be similar to the story of the birth of humans that I often hear on earth.
These two are the ancestors of all humans, so I myself am one of their descendants."
After that, Zhang Fei went towards the left wall of the room, but he frowned because the paintings on that wall completely contradicted all the paintings on the right wall. "Mei, these paintings."

[Yes, Master. All the paintings on the left wall show the problems that arose after the creation of all living things. Not only humans, but demihumans, demons, and beasts have their hidden desire to dominate all races. Based on all these paintings, only the natural races do not have such desires, and they prefer to distance themselves from such matters.
Even so, the other living beings still disturb their peace, and they also slaughter too many members of the natural races.]

Zhang Fei took a deep breath and nodded slightly. "The chaos in this universe has started since the birth of living beings, huh? Billions of years have passed since their birth, but their ambition and greed have been ingrained in their souls, which is passed down to the next generations, including the current generations.
That's why this universe can never be peaceful, especially since there are too many ambitious and greedy living beings in it. I admit that I am like them, and I may be worse."
[It's good that you realize that you're like them, master.]

Mei's reply made Zhang Fei's lips twitch, but he then walked to see all the paintings on the left wall of the room, which all depicted chaos and destruction in different eras; even many realms had been destroyed due to the ambition and greed of the living beings.

However, Zhang Fei only found less than half of the paintings on the last wall, and they showed the current situation of the universe. "So this wall depicts the current era, huh? Since the current era is still ongoing, this painting is not complete, and it will probably be complete after this era ends."
{You're right, Zhang Fei}

"Eh?" Zhang Fei immediately turned to the voice owner, and a mature woman with a flawless appearance stood at the end of the room. He saw five other figures behind her, and he recognized them as the ancestors of all living beings. He then approached them and bowed slightly to them, but the woman immediately waved her hand and raised his head.

"It's my honor to meet all of you, the ancestors of all living beings." The five figures seemed to smile upon hearing him, but Zhang Fei then spoke to the woman. "Forgive me, but I cannot recognize you, especially since there are no clues about you in this strange place, Senior."

The woman smiled upon hearing that. {Naturally, you won't be able to find any clues about me in this place, especially since I'm not a living creature like all of you, and only living creatures will be recorded in this place.}

"Eh?" Zhang Fei stared at the woman in shock, especially since her form and appearance were no different from a female human. "If you're not a living being like us, then who are you, Senior? Moreover, what is this place actually? Why does this place record all of the events that have ever happened in this universe?"

{The universe and I are one, so I have no name, and I have no form. I used this form because I know you like women, so we can talk more easily.} The woman's answer made Mei laugh out loud in her master's mind, and Zhang Fei laughed bitterly because she thought he was a lecher who always thought about women.
{I call this place the Era of the Beginning, a place that records all occurrences in the universe, from birth to destruction.}

Zhang Fei nodded slightly before asking the woman again. "Why did you call me here, senior? Previously, there were several powerful people trapped inside this space rift, and they should be more worthy than me to meet you and see this place, right?"

{They are not worthy to set foot in this place, let alone meet me.} The woman then waved her hand, causing Zhang Fei to feel like his body was being split into several pieces. Soon, his incubus form and his fox form appear on both sides, shocking him. {In this universe, you are the only one who has three real forms, so you are the only living being worthy of coming here.}

Zhang Fei sighed heavily in his heart, especially since he never chose to have the other two forms, and it was the girl who killed and saved him that turned him into what he is now. However, he didn't expect that the events of that day would change his fate so much, and he now stands in front of the ancestors of all living creatures, as well as the embodiment of the universe.

{Zhang Fei, I know this is not your wish, but you are the chosen one, and you cannot escape your fate to unite all living beings. I hope you can accept your fate; otherwise, this universe will never be peaceful.}

"My fate?" Zhang Fei then said to the woman. "Honestly, I have accepted my fate, or else I would not be standing here now. Since you can read my mind, you should already know that I am a selfish human being, and I don't care about the fate of others."

{Is that so?} The woman then waved her hand again, and many images appeared on the room's ceiling, all of which were about Zhang Fei. {You said that you don't care about the fate of others, but all your actions say otherwise.

Moreover, you yourself know that deep down in your heart you care about others, but you keep trying to deny it because you think that caring about them will be your weakness, especially after Chen Xin betrayed you, and Zhang He kept bullying you.}

sentences.text: The further he walked, the more statues Zhang Fei discovered, which made him curious and horrified at the same time, especially since all the statues in that place looked very ancient.
"Dang!
This place is really creepy, Mei!
What kind of place is this?
Why are there statues of all races here?
Look at those beasts' statues; their ranks vary from ordinary beasts to mythical beasts, and I can't recognize some of them, so I thought they were immortal rank beasts."
[I think so too, master.
Those beast races are not registered in the system, so they are probably immortal rank beasts.]
Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh before his gaze shifted to the large room in front of him, so he quickly flew there.

However, he immediately froze in place as he stared at the beast statue in the middle of the room, especially since it was a statue of the ten-tailed fox, and the statue was truly similar to his soul that he had encountered in the fairy forests.

Zhang Fei then looked at the statues of beasts that were lined up around the room, starting from a golden dragon, a phoenix, a vermilion bird, an azure dragon, a white tiger, a black tortoise, a heavenly fox, and so on.
Zhang Fei was not interested in the statues of other mythical beasts, but he was very interested in the statue of the ten-tailed fox.
He then transformed into his half-fox form and approached the statue, immediately touching it and channeling his heavenly fox aura.
"It appears that this statue is just an ordinary statue, and I can't sense the presence of the old fox in it."
After that, Zhang Fei continued to the next room, where he found many statues of demons.
In the middle of the room, there was a statue of a giant male demon with two long horns on his forehead, and his entire body was covered in a black robe.
Below the statue, there was a statue of a three-headed dog similar to a cerberus.
However, the appearance of the statue was very strange, and he felt that the male demon was a combination of several types of demons, especially since he also had the character of an incubus.
Zhang Fei then turned to the seven demon statues on the side of the room, five of which were male demon statues, and the other two were female demon statues, all of which also had giant bodies.
[Master, they seem to be ancient demons, and they should have lived in the distant past.
The male giant demon in the middle is definitely their leader, but his appearance is truly unusual.]

"You're probably right, Mei." Zhang Fei then glanced at the third room and proceeded directly there, where he discovered statues representing a variety of natural races, including fairies, elves, centaurs, and more.

Zhang Fei was confused seeing those statues bowing towards the statue of a woman in the middle of the room, especially since it also had a giant body like the statues of the demons in the room previously.
"Could this woman belong to the giant race?
As far as I remember, there were no giant races in the fairy forest, and Grandpa Oliver led the natural races there.
However, this female giant seems to be the real leader of the natural races, and the other races seem to really respect her."
Zhang Fei then looked towards the fourth room, and he thought that the room should contain statues of humans.

However, his thoughts were proven wrong when he entered the room, especially since it was filled with the demihuman statues, and the statue in the middle is a statue of a male demihuman, who has the appearance of a humanoid dragon, but his entire body is red.
"A demihuman with dragon bloodlines, huh?
Dragons are one of the strongest mythical beasts, so it's natural for this man to lead the demihuman races."
In the next room, Zhang Fei finally found statues of humans, and he could see various human races like the humans living on earth.
Some have white skin like westerners and Chinese, some have tan skin, some have black skin, and so on.
However, all the statues were too old, so they were clearly humans from a distant era in the past.
Unlike the previous four rooms, there was no statue in the middle of the room, indicating that they had no leader.
After he looked at all the statues, Zhang Fei went straight to the last room, but he did not find any statues in it, so the room was completely empty, which confused him.
"Why is there nothing in this place?"
[Master, there are only five races in this universe: humans, demihumans, beasts, natural races, and demons.
So I think it's natural that this last room is empty.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei, but he immediately looked at the walls around the room, which surprised him a little, especially since every wall was covered in paintings.
He then approached the right wall of the room, and he looked at the painting with the number 1, but his expression became serious when he realized the meaning of the painting.
"Mei, these are the painting of this universe, right?"
[It seems so, Master.] Mei then scanned all the paintings on the wall and saved them into the system.
[Master, this first painting seems to be the beginning before this universe was formed, and there was only chaos at that time.]
"I think so." Zhang Fei then moved on to the second painting, which was divided into two: light and dark.
Planets, sun, moon, and stars already exist in the painting.
"This painting should be the beginning of the birth of this universe, and there were no living creatures at that time."
[Yes, you are right, Master.]
In the third painting, Zhang Fei discovered a depiction of mythical beasts.
However, two beasts, whose appearances were ambiguous, towered over the others.
One beast had a completely white body with two golden eyes, and it was in the light section.
The other beast has a completely black body with bloodshot eyes, and it is in the dark section.
Zhang Fei then rubbed the beast in the dark section.
"Mei, these two beasts should be the primordial beasts, but I didn't expect that there would be only two beasts.
These ten beasts should be immortal beasts; below them are mythical beasts, divine beasts, heaven-rank beasts, and so on."
[Yes, master.
However, I didn't expect that beasts were born before the other living beings, and humans were the last living beings to be born.
However, their numbers are far greater than other living beings now; even the population of the earth is around 8.2 billion people now.]
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed when he heard that.
"After all, humans are too active in producing offspring, and I myself am thinking of having so many children in the future, so it is natural that our numbers are much greater now."
[Tch!

If you really wanted to have children from all your wives and partners, the number of your descendants would probably surpass the current number of humans, and your descendants would dominate this universe if that happened.]
Zhang Fei smiled to himself as he thought about the matter, but he thought it would be interesting if his descendants were spread across all realms throughout the universe.
Unfortunately, that won't happen anytime soon, especially since he himself still doesn't want to have children.
Zhang Fei then proceeded to the fourth painting, where he was astonished to witness the phenomenon of demon birth, particularly given that the demon originated from a giant egg.

The first demon born was a male demon on the statue in the middle of the second room, and the second demon born was a female demon, whose appearance is not much different from the male demon, which makes them the ancestors of demons.
"These two are the first and second demons, so they should be powerful, and they are probably no less powerful than the primordial beasts.
However, I'm confused why there are no statues of the two primordial beasts in the first room, and the statue of the ten-tailed fox is in the middle of the room instead."
In the fifth painting, Zhang Fei saw the birth process of the natural races, starting with the giant races, and various races were born after them.
"Interesting!
All natural races are born from all the elements in this universe, so it's no wonder that they are so friendly with nature, and they can also borrow natural power."
In the sixth painting, Zhang Fei sees various beasts transforming into humans, but they still retain their beast characteristics, indicating the birth of the demihuman races.
The seventh painting depicts the birth of the first male human from the earth, followed by the creation of a female human from one of his ribs.
Zhang Fei was slightly taken aback upon witnessing this.
"Oh?
I'm not a religious person, but I didn't expect this painting to be similar to the story of the birth of humans that I often hear on earth.
These two are the ancestors of all humans, so I myself am one of their descendants."
After that, Zhang Fei went towards the left wall of the room, but he frowned because the paintings on that wall completely contradicted all the paintings on the right wall.
"Mei, these paintings."
[Yes, Master.
All the paintings on the left wall show the problems that arose after the creation of all living things.
Not only humans, but demihumans, demons, and beasts have their hidden desire to dominate all races.
Based on all these paintings, only the natural races do not have such desires, and they prefer to distance themselves from such matters.
Even so, the other living beings still disturb their peace, and they also slaughter too many members of the natural races.]
Zhang Fei took a deep breath and nodded slightly.
"The chaos in this universe has started since the birth of living beings, huh?
Billions of years have passed since their birth, but their ambition and greed have been ingrained in their souls, which is passed down to the next generations, including the current generations.
That's why this universe can never be peaceful, especially since there are too many ambitious and greedy living beings in it.
I admit that I am like them, and I may be worse."
[It's good that you realize that you're like them, master.]

Mei's reply made Zhang Fei's lips twitch, but he then walked to see all the paintings on the left wall of the room, which all depicted chaos and destruction in different eras; even many realms had been destroyed due to the ambition and greed of the living beings.
However, Zhang Fei only found less than half of the paintings on the last wall, and they showed the current situation of the universe.
"So this wall depicts the current era, huh?
Since the current era is still ongoing, this painting is not complete, and it will probably be complete after this era ends."
{You're right, Zhang Fei}
"Eh?" Zhang Fei immediately turned to the voice owner, and a mature woman with a flawless appearance stood at the end of the room.
He saw five other figures behind her, and he recognized them as the ancestors of all living beings.
He then approached them and bowed slightly to them, but the woman immediately waved her hand and raised his head.
"It's my honor to meet all of you, the ancestors of all living beings." The five figures seemed to smile upon hearing him, but Zhang Fei then spoke to the woman.
"Forgive me, but I cannot recognize you, especially since there are no clues about you in this strange place, Senior."

The woman smiled upon hearing that. {Naturally, you won't be able to find any clues about me in this place, especially since I'm not a living creature like all of you, and only living creatures will be recorded in this place.}
"Eh?" Zhang Fei stared at the woman in shock, especially since her form and appearance were no different from a female human.
"If you're not a living being like us, then who are you, Senior?
Moreover, what is this place actually?
Why does this place record all of the events that have ever happened in this universe?"
{The universe and I are one, so I have no name, and I have no form.

I used this form because I know you like women, so we can talk more easily.} The woman's answer made Mei laugh out loud in her master's mind, and Zhang Fei laughed bitterly because she thought he was a lecher who always thought about women.

Soon, his incubus form and his fox form appear on both sides, shocking him. {In this universe, you are the only one who has three real forms, so you are the only living being worthy of coming here.}
Zhang Fei sighed heavily in his heart, especially since he never chose to have the other two forms, and it was the girl who killed and saved him that turned him into what he is now.

I hope you can accept your fate; otherwise, this universe will never be peaceful.}
"My fate?" Zhang Fei then said to the woman.
"Honestly, I have accepted my fate, or else I would not be standing here now.
Since you can read my mind, you should already know that I am a selfish human being, and I don't care about the fate of others."

{Is that so?} The woman then waved her hand again, and many images appeared on the room's ceiling, all of which were about Zhang Fei. {You said that you don't care about the fate of others, but all your actions say otherwise.

Moreover, you yourself know that deep down in your heart you care about others, but you keep trying to deny it because you think that caring about them will be your weakness, especially after Chen Xin betrayed you, and Zhang He kept bullying you.}

chapters.title: Chapter 431 Return
paragraphs: Zhang Fei's face darkened after the woman mentioned the two people's names, especially since he had killed them and ended everything with his own hands, so he didn't want to remember them anymore. "Why? Why does it have to be me? I'm not interested in the peace of this universe; I just want to enjoy time with all my wives, partners, and family members."

{Aren't you already aware that all of you won't be able to enjoy your time in peace as long as this universe is still not at peace? The people of the Xian and Tian realms have the ambition to rule the four realms, and those humans on your home realm will suffer if they attack them.

You live in the Sky Jade Realm, and that realm is not free from powerful cultivators who target it because of the ten-tailed fox's legacies. Not to mention the problems in the Netherworld Realm, and the people from the Shang Clan might return there in the future to invade your current realm once again.

Even the two ancestors of the heavenly fox race targeted you because they were envious of you, especially since they were that fox's direct descendants, but you were chosen to replace him. In addition to this, numerous issues plague the middle and upper realms, inevitably drawing you into them.

Do you think you can provide peace for all your wives, partners, and family members as long as those problems exist?} The woman's words left Zhang Fei at a loss for words, prompting her to point out his two other forms. {Why were you chosen for that task? The reason should be clear before your eyes, right?
In this universe, you are the only living being who can connect and unite all races, so you can bring peace to those closest to you and other people.}

Zhang Fei stood still at his spot as he continued to stare at the woman, especially since he couldn't refute any of her words. He had long since realized that his three forms made him a unique living being within their universe. However, he had no interest in getting involved in those matters, but many troubles always came to him endlessly.

The woman spoke to Zhang Fei again. {You previously said that you didn't care about others, but you have helped the demons in the Diyu Realm so much, and you even helped them find their long-lost demon emperor. You also helped the residents of the Sky Jade Realm to stop the invasion of the demons from the Netherworld Realm, or else you wouldn't be here and talk to me now.

If you didn't help them, then you would never have gotten so many allies now, and you could face your problems thanks to their help. So you should already be aware that helping others will not weaken you, but it will actually make you stronger.}

"You're right." Zhang Fei replied as he released a heavy sigh. "If I didn't help Ying'er and Qing'er save Qingyu, and if I didn't help Hua'er break free from Pang Hong's control, I would never get the support of the Chu and Liu Clans, and they have already helped me a lot to solve my problems. If I didn't help Lingxue recover from her injuries, then I wouldn't have any ties with the Zhang Clan.

If I didn't help Janette and the others, then I wouldn't have any connection with the demons. They are my families and allies in solving my various problems, and they also helped me become as strong as I am now. However, that doesn't mean I will help everyone, and I will never help others without any reciprocation, especially since I am a selfish person."

{What do you want from me? I can't leave this place, especially since I am just an embodiment of this universe, so I can't give you anything. Otherwise, I wouldn't summon you here and ask you to sort things out to bring peace back, and I would do everything myself if I could.}
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei thought seriously while rubbing his chin. "Since you know all of the events in this universe, you should know where those elemental seeds are, right?"

The woman raised her eyebrows for a moment before nodding to Zhang Fei. {You're right, I can indeed find out the location of those elemental seeds, but I can't get them for you, so you have to go to each location of those seeds yourself to pick them.}
"I know that, and it's not a problem for me." The woman then flicked her finger, and a white light instantly entered Zhang Fei's forehead. 'What is that, Mei?'

[Master, that woman gave you the location of those elemental seeds, but their locations are far from the Sky Jade Realm or the Netherworld Realm, so you won't be able to pick them anytime soon. As for those high-level elemental seeds, you can only find them in the upper realms, so they are still too far out of your reach.]

Zhang Fei nodded slightly and didn't mind it, especially since he could look for those elemental seeds in the future. "Thank you for the information on those seeds; it is very useful to me. Also, do you know where the demon seeds are located in the Diyu Realm?"

{I do know their location, but you won't be able to find or take them.} Zhang Fei frowned at the woman's answer. {The demon seeds are not ordinary seeds, and they have their own will, so you will never be able to find them if they don't choose you.}

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding at that, especially since Oz the 1st and Lillea never looked for those demon seeds, and they summoned the two to come to them instead. "Then, where are those senior cultivators? Did you send them to other realms?"

{No.} The woman answered by shaking her head. {The space rift always moves on its own, and it's beyond my control. Moreover, those people still haven't arrived at their destination realms, so I can't track their whereabouts.}

Zhang Fei didn't care much about the other senior cultivators, but he cared about three out of the seven people, especially since they were family members of some of his wives and one of his partners. The three people were none other than Chu Hong, Zhang Wuji, and Yan Zixiu.
That's why he wanted to know their location, so he could save them and bring them back to the Sky Jade Realm, especially since they would be very sad if something bad happened to the three of them.
Zhang Fei then glanced at the five figures behind her. "What about them? Are they soul remnants?"
Once again, the woman shook her head at Zhang Fei. {They are just a small part of their consciousness, so they can't help you with anything.}
Zhang Fei looked disappointed to hear that, as he had hoped that the five of them could give him something, especially something related to souls.
However, the female giant's figure suddenly shot something towards Zhang Fei, which immediately entered his body, and Mei informed him directly that it was the location of her past relic.
"Thank you." The female giant just nodded to him, and Zhang Fei said to the woman again. "I think it's time for us to part, right?"
{You've been in this place too long, and it won't be good for you, so you can go back now.}
"Can I enter this place again in the future?"
{Yes, you can enter this place again if you have evolved into ten-tails, and this room will be yours if you succeed in bringing peace back to this universe.}

"I'm not interested in this place, so you can have it for yourself, and I will live with all my wives in a secluded place in the future." Mei immediately opened the gate to the Sky Jade Realm as soon as Zhang Fei ordered her. "Even if you say that I am the chosen one to bring peace back to this universe, I will not promise you anything for now.
I am still too weak, and countless people can kill me at any time, so you can wait for the results in the future."
After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately entered the gate and returned to the Sky Jade Realm, and the woman along with the five figures right away disappeared from the room.

Once he arrived at the Chu Clan, Zhang Fei immediately entered the training space and went to see several women, such as Zhang Xiaoling, Chu Ying, Chu Xing, and Chu Qing, before telling them about their father's situation.
Chu Qing immediately hugged Zhang Fei's arm. "Fei, please find them and save them; I really don't want anything to happen to our father."
"Can you find them, Fei?" Chu Ying asked with a worried look.

Chu Xing also immediately asked Zhang Fei. "Do you think the space rift sent them to the Netherworld Realm, brother-in-law? After all, the portal connects this realm to the demon realm, so they should have been sent there, right?"

Zhang Xiaoling also looked worried about her father's situation. "Zhang Fei, please send me back to the Central Region, especially since my mother will definitely be anxious with my father's disappearance, so I want to accompany her by her side."

"Currently, Zi'er and the others are still in the northern region, and my two clones are with them, so one of them will take you there." After Zhang Xiaoling agreed, one of Zhang Fei's clones took her to the region directly, and she then answered the three Chu sisters' questions. "I don't know their exact location, but Chu Xing is right that they might be sent to the netherworld realm.

Since Zhang Xiaolong [3] is away with the cultivators from the upper realms, I will send my fourth clone there, so he can find out directly whether your father was sent there or not. If he was really stranded in that realm, then he would immediately save him."

They sighed in relief and nodded to Zhang Fei, especially since they couldn't go to the Netherworld Realm, so they could only rely on him. Chu Xing suddenly asked him. "Why did your third clone go with those cultivators from the upper realms, brother-in-law? Wouldn't that put you in danger? Since they are powerful cultivators, they may see through your disguise."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled as he pinched Chu Xing's cheeks, causing both of them to turn red. "I know you're worried about me, but they can't see through my disguise, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] will be fine there. Furthermore, they didn't take him to their clan in the upper realms; they took him to a realm called the Wasteland Realm in the middle realms, so he wouldn't meet Shan Huaqiang.

Actually, I had long planned to take you guys to the middle realms, but I didn't have any information about all those places, so I decided to take the risk. For now, I will gather more information about that realm, and I will take all of you there immediately once we are all ready."

"The middle realms, huh?" The three women muttered to themselves, but their expressions looked a little anxious. After all, they had never been to any other realm besides the Earth, and they felt that they were still too weak to go to the middle realms, yet Zhang Fei had already prepared plans to take them there.

Zhang Fei then embraced them all. "You don't need to think too much about the middle realms, okay? Now that we've resolved all the issues in this realm, no one will bother us, allowing us to concentrate on our seclusion."

The three women agreed with that, but Chu Ying and Chu Qing immediately went to their room in the cloud mansion to cultivate manually, especially since Zhang Fei had been through a lot all day, so they wanted him to rest first. Meanwhile, Chu Xing began to practice again with the others, particularly since she had not fully adapted to the level three gravity.

Zhang Fei then checked his other women one by one, but all of them didn't seem to want to dual-cultivate with him, so he immediately returned to his room. However, he found Xu Ling'er sleeping on his bed, so he immediately joined her and hugged her.
Sensing that, Xu Ling'er opened her eyes and kissed Zhang Fei's lips, but she immediately curled up in her arms and continued sleeping again, leaving him amused by her behavior.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 10,700 Qi.]
[Reward: 107 green jewels.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 700 demons at Marquis rank or above.]
[Reward: 70,000 female essences.]

Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh after the two notifications appeared, especially since the day had changed again in the four realms. However, he immediately ignored both of them and accompanied Xu Ling'er to sleep.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] and the righteous cultivators in the northern region had succeeded in destroying an entire clan of heretics, and they did not spare any members of that clan.

Zhang Fei [1] then informed them about the situation of the senior cultivators who were sucked into the black hole, but some of them became restless and worried, especially Zi'er, Meng Guanqiu, and Yan Luan'er. "They had already disappeared when I opened my eyes, so I can't do anything for now.

My fourth clone has already gone to the Netherworld Realm, and I will inform you guys if he manages to find them there. However, I'm a bit doubtful about that, especially since the space rift will send them to random realms."
"I hope they end up stranded in the Netherworld Realm, so you can bring them back to us, Fei." Yan Luan'er uttered these words as she embraced Zhang Fei.

"Let's pray for the best for them." Zhang Fei [1] then turned to the other cultivators. "Since those heretics have been wiped out, and you guys have fought for so long, so I will send all of you back to your respective regions.

From today onwards, we can enjoy a peaceful life, but we also cannot be complacent because many cultivators from the upper realms are still eyeing this realm, so we must work even harder to increase our strength.
Otherwise, we will not be able to face the enemies that will come to this realm in the future, and they might send other pawns that are stronger than the demons from the Netherworld Realm."

All of them agreed with Zhang Fei [1], especially since the demons from the Netherworld Realm had already overwhelmed them, and they would be even more overwhelmed if those people sent even stronger people.

Zhang Fei [1] then opened portals to the eastern, western, and central regions. As for cultivators from the southern region, they could return to their region through the Chu Clan, especially since he no longer saved the location of the southern region.

Since they were all exhausted, Zhang Fei [1] asked his wives and partners to rest in their respective places, and Feng Yao immediately pulled him along with her. "Let's go to my sect, and we'll talk about many things there."
