"Hmm?" Zhang Fei thought seriously while rubbing his chin.
"Since you know all of the events in this universe, you should know where those elemental seeds are, right?"

The woman raised her eyebrows for a moment before nodding to Zhang Fei. {You're right, I can indeed find out the location of those elemental seeds, but I can't get them for you, so you have to go to each location of those seeds yourself to pick them.}
"I know that, and it's not a problem for me." The woman then flicked her finger, and a white light instantly entered Zhang Fei's forehead. 'What is that, Mei?'
[Master, that woman gave you the location of those elemental seeds, but their locations are far from the Sky Jade Realm or the Netherworld Realm, so you won't be able to pick them anytime soon.
As for those high-level elemental seeds, you can only find them in the upper realms, so they are still too far out of your reach.]
Zhang Fei nodded slightly and didn't mind it, especially since he could look for those elemental seeds in the future.
"Thank you for the information on those seeds; it is very useful to me.
Also, do you know where the demon seeds are located in the Diyu Realm?"

{I do know their location, but you won't be able to find or take them.} Zhang Fei frowned at the woman's answer. {The demon seeds are not ordinary seeds, and they have their own will, so you will never be able to find them if they don't choose you.}
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding at that, especially since Oz the 1st and Lillea never looked for those demon seeds, and they summoned the two to come to them instead.
"Then, where are those senior cultivators?
Did you send them to other realms?"
{No.} The woman answered by shaking her head. {The space rift always moves on its own, and it's beyond my control.
Moreover, those people still haven't arrived at their destination realms, so I can't track their whereabouts.}

Zhang Fei didn't care much about the other senior cultivators, but he cared about three out of the seven people, especially since they were family members of some of his wives and one of his partners.
The three people were none other than Chu Hong, Zhang Wuji, and Yan Zixiu.
That's why he wanted to know their location, so he could save them and bring them back to the Sky Jade Realm, especially since they would be very sad if something bad happened to the three of them.
Zhang Fei then glanced at the five figures behind her.
"What about them?
Are they soul remnants?"
Once again, the woman shook her head at Zhang Fei. {They are just a small part of their consciousness, so they can't help you with anything.}
Zhang Fei looked disappointed to hear that, as he had hoped that the five of them could give him something, especially something related to souls.
However, the female giant's figure suddenly shot something towards Zhang Fei, which immediately entered his body, and Mei informed him directly that it was the location of her past relic.
"Thank you." The female giant just nodded to him, and Zhang Fei said to the woman again.
"I think it's time for us to part, right?"
{You've been in this place too long, and it won't be good for you, so you can go back now.}
"Can I enter this place again in the future?"
{Yes, you can enter this place again if you have evolved into ten-tails, and this room will be yours if you succeed in bringing peace back to this universe.}

"I'm not interested in this place, so you can have it for yourself, and I will live with all my wives in a secluded place in the future." Mei immediately opened the gate to the Sky Jade Realm as soon as Zhang Fei ordered her.
"Even if you say that I am the chosen one to bring peace back to this universe, I will not promise you anything for now.
I am still too weak, and countless people can kill me at any time, so you can wait for the results in the future."
After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately entered the gate and returned to the Sky Jade Realm, and the woman along with the five figures right away disappeared from the room.

Once he arrived at the Chu Clan, Zhang Fei immediately entered the training space and went to see several women, such as Zhang Xiaoling, Chu Ying, Chu Xing, and Chu Qing, before telling them about their father's situation.
Chu Qing immediately hugged Zhang Fei's arm.
"Fei, please find them and save them; I really don't want anything to happen to our father."
"Can you find them, Fei?" Chu Ying asked with a worried look.
Chu Xing also immediately asked Zhang Fei.
"Do you think the space rift sent them to the Netherworld Realm, brother-in-law?
After all, the portal connects this realm to the demon realm, so they should have been sent there, right?"
Zhang Xiaoling also looked worried about her father's situation.
"Zhang Fei, please send me back to the Central Region, especially since my mother will definitely be anxious with my father's disappearance, so I want to accompany her by her side."

"Currently, Zi'er and the others are still in the northern region, and my two clones are with them, so one of them will take you there." After Zhang Xiaoling agreed, one of Zhang Fei's clones took her to the region directly, and she then answered the three Chu sisters' questions.
"I don't know their exact location, but Chu Xing is right that they might be sent to the netherworld realm.
Since Zhang Xiaolong [3] is away with the cultivators from the upper realms, I will send my fourth clone there, so he can find out directly whether your father was sent there or not.
If he was really stranded in that realm, then he would immediately save him."
They sighed in relief and nodded to Zhang Fei, especially since they couldn't go to the Netherworld Realm, so they could only rely on him.
Chu Xing suddenly asked him.
"Why did your third clone go with those cultivators from the upper realms, brother-in-law?
Wouldn't that put you in danger?
Since they are powerful cultivators, they may see through your disguise."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled as he pinched Chu Xing's cheeks, causing both of them to turn red.
"I know you're worried about me, but they can't see through my disguise, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] will be fine there.
Furthermore, they didn't take him to their clan in the upper realms; they took him to a realm called the Wasteland Realm in the middle realms, so he wouldn't meet Shan Huaqiang.
Actually, I had long planned to take you guys to the middle realms, but I didn't have any information about all those places, so I decided to take the risk.
For now, I will gather more information about that realm, and I will take all of you there immediately once we are all ready."
"The middle realms, huh?" The three women muttered to themselves, but their expressions looked a little anxious.

After all, they had never been to any other realm besides the Earth, and they felt that they were still too weak to go to the middle realms, yet Zhang Fei had already prepared plans to take them there.
Zhang Fei then embraced them all.
"You don't need to think too much about the middle realms, okay?
Now that we've resolved all the issues in this realm, no one will bother us, allowing us to concentrate on our seclusion."

The three women agreed with that, but Chu Ying and Chu Qing immediately went to their room in the cloud mansion to cultivate manually, especially since Zhang Fei had been through a lot all day, so they wanted him to rest first.
Meanwhile, Chu Xing began to practice again with the others, particularly since she had not fully adapted to the level three gravity.
Zhang Fei then checked his other women one by one, but all of them didn't seem to want to dual-cultivate with him, so he immediately returned to his room.
However, he found Xu Ling'er sleeping on his bed, so he immediately joined her and hugged her.
Sensing that, Xu Ling'er opened her eyes and kissed Zhang Fei's lips, but she immediately curled up in her arms and continued sleeping again, leaving him amused by her behavior.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 10,700 Qi.]
[Reward: 107 green jewels.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 700 demons at Marquis rank or above.]
[Reward: 70,000 female essences.]
Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh after the two notifications appeared, especially since the day had changed again in the four realms.
However, he immediately ignored both of them and accompanied Xu Ling'er to sleep.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] and the righteous cultivators in the northern region had succeeded in destroying an entire clan of heretics, and they did not spare any members of that clan.

Zhang Fei [1] then informed them about the situation of the senior cultivators who were sucked into the black hole, but some of them became restless and worried, especially Zi'er, Meng Guanqiu, and Yan Luan'er.
"They had already disappeared when I opened my eyes, so I can't do anything for now.
My fourth clone has already gone to the Netherworld Realm, and I will inform you guys if he manages to find them there.
However, I'm a bit doubtful about that, especially since the space rift will send them to random realms."
"I hope they end up stranded in the Netherworld Realm, so you can bring them back to us, Fei." Yan Luan'er uttered these words as she embraced Zhang Fei.
"Let's pray for the best for them." Zhang Fei [1] then turned to the other cultivators.
"Since those heretics have been wiped out, and you guys have fought for so long, so I will send all of you back to your respective regions.

From today onwards, we can enjoy a peaceful life, but we also cannot be complacent because many cultivators from the upper realms are still eyeing this realm, so we must work even harder to increase our strength.
Otherwise, we will not be able to face the enemies that will come to this realm in the future, and they might send other pawns that are stronger than the demons from the Netherworld Realm."

All of them agreed with Zhang Fei [1], especially since the demons from the Netherworld Realm had already overwhelmed them, and they would be even more overwhelmed if those people sent even stronger people.
Zhang Fei [1] then opened portals to the eastern, western, and central regions.
As for cultivators from the southern region, they could return to their region through the Chu Clan, especially since he no longer saved the location of the southern region.
Since they were all exhausted, Zhang Fei [1] asked his wives and partners to rest in their respective places, and Feng Yao immediately pulled him along with her.
"Let's go to my sect, and we'll talk about many things there."

chapters.title: Chapter 432 Talk With Feng Yao
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [1] was already sitting in front of Feng Yao, but Zhang Lingxue decided to join them, especially since she was very familiar with her husband's character, and she was sure that he would try to do something to the phoenix.
'Scan Feng Yao, Mei.'
[Alrighty.]
Name: Feng Yao
Gender: Female
Age: 1000+ years old
Race: Fire Phoenix
Rank: Mythical Rank
Cultivation: 10-Star Sovereign Realm [Suppressed]
Element: Fire [Peak stage]
Core: Peak-Rank Fire Core
Physique: Phoenix physique
Abilities: Phoenix nirvana, nirvana eyes, nirvana heart, and so on.
Strong: Fire
Weak: Water, Ice, Earth

As Zhang Lingxue expected, Zhang Fei [1] tried to use his demon charm on Feng Yao, but she showed no reaction. He then tried his demon pheromone, which was also useless against her. 'Are both of them useless because she's a phoenix, Mei?'

[Hehehe! Master, the phoenixes are indeed mythical beasts, but they are different from other mythical beasts, including the vermillion birds. Phoenix flames are the best in this universe, and they can neutralize almost anything, so you shouldn't be surprised if your demon abilities don't work on her.

That's why you have to work hard if you want to get Feng Yao, especially since her status in the phoenix race is not ordinary, and she is their princess. If you manage to get her as your wife, then you will have a powerful backer in the upper realms.]

Zhang Fei [1] nodded slightly before asking Feng Yao. "Can you tell me about the seven divine realms? I know about the existence of those seven stages, but I don't have any information about them, so I want to hear it from you."

"Seven divine realms: divine transcend, divine expansion, divine manifestation, divine fusion, divine transformation, divine ascendant, and divine ascension." After hearing that, Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows, prompting Feng Yao to begin explaining.

"When you break through to the quasi-divine realm, you will experience a baptism of the divine qi, and you are already half a step toward the divine realm. Divine Qi is different from ordinary Qi, but it is difficult for me to explain it to you, and you can feel it yourself when you reach it.
When you break through to the seven divine realms, the law of this world will reject you, and you will ascend to higher realms, but this only applies to cultivators in lower realms."
"Why is it only applicable to the cultivator in the lower realms?" Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue looked at Feng Yao in confusion.

"Yes." Feng Yao then continued. "The laws of the worlds in the lower realms are too fragile, so they won't be able to withstand the power of cultivators in the seven divine realms, and they will slowly disintegrate. If that happens, the balance in the lower realms will be broken, and the qi will become chaotic before disappearing.

That's why I had to suppress my cultivation to the ten mortal realms before I arrived at this realm, and it's also the reason why the two ancestors of the heavenly fox race only sent their younger generations to capture you.

The laws of the worlds in the middle realms are stronger than in the lower realms, so cultivators who break through to the seven divine realms will not be immediately rejected by them. Even so, they will still leave their realm and ascend to the upper realms, especially after they reach the middle stage of the seven divine realms."
"The laws of the world, huh?" Zhang Fei [1] muttered to himself. "If I'm not mistaken, all cultivators can learn and deepen their knowledge of the laws, especially the elemental laws, right?"

"Oh?" Feng Yao was surprised by Zhang Fei[1]'s question, especially since cultivators from the lower realms didn't know anything about the laws. "Actually, cultivators in the upper realms can not only learn the elemental laws, but also many other laws, including the laws of the worlds.
If you can learn and master them, then you will become one of the strongest there, especially since they can utilize the laws to increase their power."

Feng Yao then opened her palms, and an odinary phoenix flame immediately appeared on her right palm. Soon, a stronger phoenix flame appeared on her left palm, and Zhang Fei [1] could clearly see the difference between the two.
Zhang Fei [1] pointed to the phoenix flame on Feng Yao's left palm. "Did you use the fire law to strengthen this one?"

"Yes." Feng Yao responded by nodding. "Unfortunately, I haven't fully understood the fire law, so I can't use it perfectly yet. If you meet my parents, you will definitely realize that the elemental laws are extraordinary, especially since they can increase our elemental power severalfold. We divide the laws into five levels: initial, intermediate, advanced, half-perfection, and perfection.
I've only mastered the initial stage, especially since learning and understanding the laws is really hard, and you need extraordinary calmness to be able to merge yourself with nature."

"Merge ourselves with nature, huh?" Zhang Fei [1] murmured a faint smile, prompting Feng Yao to raise an eyebrow. "I don't think it's too hard to do, but it will leave us vulnerable, so we have to do it in a place that is completely free from disturbances."

"Hmm?" Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei [1] curiously, especially since she herself had always had difficulty merging herself with nature, which made her understanding of fire law still minimal. "Can you tell me how you did it?"

"Before that, I would like to study the fire law first, and I will show you how I can merge myself with nature." Feng Yao immediately flicked her finger, and a small fire phoenix swiftly entered Zhang Fei [1]'s body. He then crossed his legs and closed his eyes, and he quickly entered an immersive state, especially after he sealed all his senses.

Feng Yao immediately raised her eyebrows when she felt the change in Zhang Fei [1], so she moved beside him and tried to shake him hard. However, he didn't show any reaction, so she turned to Zhang Lingxue. "What exactly did he do?"

"Hehe." Zhang Lingxue chuckled at that. "Big Sis Yao, my husband did something that other cultivators would never dare to do by sealing off all his senses, so he wouldn't feel any disturbance, and his mind would be completely focused on his goal."

"I see." Feng Yao nodded in understanding and looked at Zhang Fei [1] again. "This kid is too bold to seal off all his senses, and he should at least leave his sense of hearing open! Even my parents would never dare to do such things, especially considering that people might attack us while we are in such a vulnerable state.

Zhang Lingxue agreed with Feng Yao, especially since she herself wouldn't be so crazy as to do it in a public place. Fortunately, her husband has several private spaces, where they will never get interference from other people, so they can freely do such things without having to worry about people attacking them.

Then, Feng Yao sat next to Zhang Lingxue again, but her attention was solely on Zhang Fei [1], particularly because she was deeply curious about whether or not he would be able to understand the fire law.
Minute after minute passed quickly, but Zhang Fei [1] still didn't show any changes, and Feng Yao thought that he must be having difficulty comprehending the fire law.

However, after an hour, Feng Yao began to notice changes in their surroundings, and she felt nature's energy begin to radiate from Zhang Fei [1]'s body. Gradually, a thin red aura began to envelop his body, and the air in the room began to rise to a hotter temperature, but it did not affect her or Zhang Lingxue much, especially since they both had fire elements in their bodies.

"Amazing! Your husband truly is a freak, Lingxue!" Feng Yao exclaimed in admiration. "It took me three months just to grasp the essence of the fire law, and I was only able to use it after another few months, but this kid was able to grasp it in just one hour."

Zhang Lingxue smiled upon hearing that, especially since Feng Yao didn't know anything about Zhang Fei's training space, let alone the comprehension feature. Furthermore, her husband already had a good comprehension, and it raised his comprehension even higher, especially since his fourth clone uses it every day to learn many things, so his speed in learning new things is better than other people.

Three hours later, the thin red aura had thickened to such an extent that Zhang Fei [1] appeared completely red, and the room's temperature had already escalated due to the strengthening of his fire element. However, Feng Yao immediately used her own power to control the heat, ensuring that nothing in the room would melt. "He has successfully mastered the initial stage of the fire law, huh?"
[Ding]
[Congratulations! The host has mastered the initial stage of the fire law.]
[Congratulations! The host's fire element has been upgraded to advanced stage.]

After the two notifications appeared, Zhang Fei [1] immediately unsealed all of his senses, opened his eyes, and stretched his right palm forward before using his fire element. "The law of fire is truly amazing! My fire element has now reached the advanced stage, and the power of my flames has increased significantly.
Unfortunately, it is not simple to comprehend the intermediate stage of the fire law, so I may still need some time to be able to understand it."

Zhang Fei[1]'s words shocked Feng Yao, especially since he had just reached the initial stage of the fire law, but he had already tried to comprehend the intermediate stage. If she hadn't witnessed the speed at which he did it with her own eyes, she would have laughed at him and thought that he was overconfident in his abilities.

Feng Yao then released a soft sigh before speaking to Zhang Fei [1]. "You don't have to be disappointed, right? The people in the upper realms have always considered my talent to be one of the best, but your speed in reaching the initial stage of the fire law makes me feel inferior to you, and you are the fastest cultivator to reach it.

Moreover, you are still 20 years old now, and the road ahead of you is still long, so you still have a long time to surpass them. Currently, you may be too weak, but I am confident that you will be able to reach the pinnacle of the cultivation world in the future. With your three identities, you have the potential to bring about significant changes in this universe."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed when he heard that. "To be honest, I have no interest in bringing change to this universe because I am neither a hero nor a villain, and I cultivate to become strong in order to protect myself and those closest to me.

However, I am truly interested in standing at the pinnacle of the cultivation world and becoming the strongest, especially since no one will be able to fight me at that time, so we can live in peace and quiet."

"In the world of cultivation, strength will determine everything, and you can only achieve the peace you desire by becoming the strongest." Feng Yao then asked Zhang Fei [1]. "What else do you want to know about cultivation and other realms?"
"How big is the difference in strength between cultivators in the seven divine realms and the ten mortal realms?"

"The difference in strength at each stage of the ten mortal realms is not that big, but the difference in strength at the seven divine realms is completely on a different level, and the strength of cultivators at the divine transcend realm is ten times that of cultivators at the quasi-divine realm." Feng Yao's answer caused Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue to take a deep breath.
"Unlike each major stage of the ten mortal realms, which has ten minor stages from 1 to 10 Star, each stage of the seven divine realms only has five minor stages."
"Only five minor stages?"
"From 1 to 5 Moon, advancing to each minor stage is significantly more challenging than reaching the quasi-divine realms.

Therefore, increasing our strength in the seven divine realms is extremely challenging, and breaking through each minor stage will require a significant amount of time." Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue were truly shocked to hear Feng Yao's answer, especially since breaking through each stage in the ten mortal realms was already quite difficult.

"My true cultivation is at the 3-Moon Divine Manifestation, so I still need several years to break through to the 4-Moon, whereas Shang Huaqiang's cultivation is at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant. As for my parents and the two ancestors of the heavenly fox race, their cultivation has already reached 1-Moon Divine Ascension.
This way, you should already have an idea about the strength of cultivators in the upper realms, right?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a heavy sigh. "Are there any cultivators who have reached 5-Moon Divine Ascension?"

"No." Feng Yao shook her head at Zhang Fei [1]. "My parents took a thousand years to break through from 5-Moon Divine Ascendant to 1-Moon Divine Ascension, and their cultivation is still far from 2-Moon. However, there is one cultivator who has reached 2-Moon Divine Ascension, and he is the leader of the cultivators in the upper realms."
"Who is that person?"

"He never gave his name, and we usually address him as the nameless one." Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue found that strange, but Feng Yao continued. "He can be the strongest not without reason, especially since he has mastered many laws, and he also has several elements, one of which is the Void element.
Your abilities as a heavenly fox are related to the space element, but the void element is on a different level, and it is one of the rarest elements in this universe."

Zhang Fei [1] nodded as he softly spoke. "This realm is formed because of the space law and element that surround it, and this realm cannot exist without both of them. Meanwhile, the void element is the emptiness outside the space, which is similar to outer space, but the two are not exactly the same."

"That's right." Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei [1]. "In this universe, there are only four extremely rare elements: void, time, life, and death. However, cultivators who possess the other three elements have never appeared, or else they would be able to rule over the upper realms easily."

Zhang Fei [1] didn't think much of it, and he wanted to focus more on what was in front of him. "Anyway, I heard from Shang Yaolin that the clans from the upper realms are using the Wasteland Realm as a punishment ground; does that mean your phoenix race is also sending members of your race there?"

Zhang Lingxue smiled upon hearing that, especially since Feng Yao didn't know anything about Zhang Fei's training space, let alone the comprehension feature.

Furthermore, her husband already had a good comprehension, and it raised his comprehension even higher, especially since his fourth clone uses it every day to learn many things, so his speed in learning new things is better than other people.

Three hours later, the thin red aura had thickened to such an extent that Zhang Fei [1] appeared completely red, and the room's temperature had already escalated due to the strengthening of his fire element.
However, Feng Yao immediately used her own power to control the heat, ensuring that nothing in the room would melt.
"He has successfully mastered the initial stage of the fire law, huh?"
[Ding]
[Congratulations!
The host has mastered the initial stage of the fire law.]
[Congratulations!
The host's fire element has been upgraded to advanced stage.]
After the two notifications appeared, Zhang Fei [1] immediately unsealed all of his senses, opened his eyes, and stretched his right palm forward before using his fire element.
"The law of fire is truly amazing!
My fire element has now reached the advanced stage, and the power of my flames has increased significantly.
Unfortunately, it is not simple to comprehend the intermediate stage of the fire law, so I may still need some time to be able to understand it."
Zhang Fei[1]'s words shocked Feng Yao, especially since he had just reached the initial stage of the fire law, but he had already tried to comprehend the intermediate stage.
If she hadn't witnessed the speed at which he did it with her own eyes, she would have laughed at him and thought that he was overconfident in his abilities.
Feng Yao then released a soft sigh before speaking to Zhang Fei [1].
"You don't have to be disappointed, right?

The people in the upper realms have always considered my talent to be one of the best, but your speed in reaching the initial stage of the fire law makes me feel inferior to you, and you are the fastest cultivator to reach it.
Moreover, you are still 20 years old now, and the road ahead of you is still long, so you still have a long time to surpass them.
Currently, you may be too weak, but I am confident that you will be able to reach the pinnacle of the cultivation world in the future.
With your three identities, you have the potential to bring about significant changes in this universe."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed when he heard that.
"To be honest, I have no interest in bringing change to this universe because I am neither a hero nor a villain, and I cultivate to become strong in order to protect myself and those closest to me.

However, I am truly interested in standing at the pinnacle of the cultivation world and becoming the strongest, especially since no one will be able to fight me at that time, so we can live in peace and quiet."
"In the world of cultivation, strength will determine everything, and you can only achieve the peace you desire by becoming the strongest." Feng Yao then asked Zhang Fei [1].
"What else do you want to know about cultivation and other realms?"
"How big is the difference in strength between cultivators in the seven divine realms and the ten mortal realms?"

"The difference in strength at each stage of the ten mortal realms is not that big, but the difference in strength at the seven divine realms is completely on a different level, and the strength of cultivators at the divine transcend realm is ten times that of cultivators at the quasi-divine realm." Feng Yao's answer caused Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue to take a deep breath.
"Unlike each major stage of the ten mortal realms, which has ten minor stages from 1 to 10 Star, each stage of the seven divine realms only has five minor stages."
"Only five minor stages?"
"From 1 to 5 Moon, advancing to each minor stage is significantly more challenging than reaching the quasi-divine realms.

Therefore, increasing our strength in the seven divine realms is extremely challenging, and breaking through each minor stage will require a significant amount of time." Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue were truly shocked to hear Feng Yao's answer, especially since breaking through each stage in the ten mortal realms was already quite difficult.
"My true cultivation is at the 3-Moon Divine Manifestation, so I still need several years to break through to the 4-Moon, whereas Shang Huaqiang's cultivation is at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant.
As for my parents and the two ancestors of the heavenly fox race, their cultivation has already reached 1-Moon Divine Ascension.
This way, you should already have an idea about the strength of cultivators in the upper realms, right?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a heavy sigh.
"Are there any cultivators who have reached 5-Moon Divine Ascension?"
"No." Feng Yao shook her head at Zhang Fei [1].
"My parents took a thousand years to break through from 5-Moon Divine Ascendant to 1-Moon Divine Ascension, and their cultivation is still far from 2-Moon.
However, there is one cultivator who has reached 2-Moon Divine Ascension, and he is the leader of the cultivators in the upper realms."
"Who is that person?"
"He never gave his name, and we usually address him as the nameless one." Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue found that strange, but Feng Yao continued.
"He can be the strongest not without reason, especially since he has mastered many laws, and he also has several elements, one of which is the Void element.
Your abilities as a heavenly fox are related to the space element, but the void element is on a different level, and it is one of the rarest elements in this universe."
Zhang Fei [1] nodded as he softly spoke.
"This realm is formed because of the space law and element that surround it, and this realm cannot exist without both of them.
Meanwhile, the void element is the emptiness outside the space, which is similar to outer space, but the two are not exactly the same."
"That's right." Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei [1].
"In this universe, there are only four extremely rare elements: void, time, life, and death.
However, cultivators who possess the other three elements have never appeared, or else they would be able to rule over the upper realms easily."
Zhang Fei [1] didn't think much of it, and he wanted to focus more on what was in front of him.

"Anyway, I heard from Shang Yaolin that the clans from the upper realms are using the Wasteland Realm as a punishment ground; does that mean your phoenix race is also sending members of your race there?"

chapters.title: Chapter 433 Blossom Heaven Realm
paragraphs: "No." Feng Yao then told Zhang Fei [1]. "We mythical beasts never punish our members by sending them to another realm, especially since every part of our bodies is too precious. We have our own punishment grounds to punish them, which we usually use to punish those who commit ordinary mistakes.
If they commit fatal mistakes, we will immediately execute them and bury their corpses in our burial grounds so no one else can take them."

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding to that. "Have you ever been to the Wasteland Realm? Yaolin was too lazy to explain it to me, so I wanted to find out information about that realm from you, especially since there are too many strong cultivators there."

Feng Yao swiftly retrieved a beast-skin parchment, set it on the table, and proceeded to open it. Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue immediately looked at the map of a realm painted there, which was a map of the Wasteland Realm. "Even though we don't send members of our race there, we still pay attention to that realm, particularly because there are too many villains living there.

The realm is divided into four main islands, separated by a mountain and four seas. Humans, including the Shang Clan, reside on the northern island, and upon your arrival, you will encounter several clans from the upper realms. The beast races reside on the eastern island, and their numbers outnumber humans.

The demihuman races live on the western island, but they always close themselves off from everyone, especially humans. The demon race inhabits the southern island, and most of them are far more cruel than the demons you've encountered before. However, I think it's fine for you to go to all four islands, especially since you have three forms, and they won't suspect your identity."
"What about this mountain, Big Sis Yao? Why is it so big? Moreover, this map shows that the mountain is also a fortress, which means there are people living in it, right?"

Feng Yao promptly provided them with another explanation. "You are not wrong about it, and this mountain is indeed a fortress, where the natives of the Wasteland Realm live. This mountain is surrounded by a high and thick wall, which was built by clans from the upper realms, and the nameless one ordered us to build it with special materials.

Aside from them, representatives of the cultivators in the upper realms also live on this mountain, and their main task is to watch over those outcasts. If they dare try to attack the natives, the representatives will immediately kill them."

"Are the natives from that realm really that many?" Zhang Fei [1] asked with a curious look, especially since he felt that the actions of the cultivators from the upper realms in protecting those people were unusual.

"No." Feng Yao shook her head at Zhang Fei [1]. "Back then, the Wasteland Realm had approximately 100 million natives, but their numbers paled in comparison to other realms; even the Sky Jade Realm has a significantly larger native population than them.

We already moved more than half of them to other realms, but the rest of them didn't want to leave their ancestral land, so the nameless one arranged it that way. In fact, we chose that realm as a place of exile because the circumstances were truly unpredictable, including the climate.

The temperature can sometimes be too hot, and it can sometimes be so cold that it can freeze everything, not to mention there are still frequent wind storms, snow storms, and sea storms. That's why your enemies in that realm will not only come from other living races but also from nature itself, so you must always be vigilant when your clone resides there."
Zhang Fei [1] nodded seriously to Feng Yao, but he then pointed at the eastern island. "Are there many divine beasts on this island?"

"Are you thinking of taming them?" Zhang Fei [1] did not hide his intentions from Feng Yao; he wanted to find a strong contract beast for his other wives. "Unfortunately, there is only one divine beast on that island, which is a Tiangou, and that guy is their leader."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] raised an eyebrow at that. "A Tiangou? Is this the black dog that, according to legend, has the ability to devour the sun and the moon?"

"Hehehe." Feng Yao chuckled and nodded to Zhang Fei [1]. "You are right about the Tiangou, and he is the largest dog in the universe; his size can even cover the sun and the moon. However, he has a split form and personality; one personality is very good, but the other personality is very evil. His black dog form shows his good personality, and his black fox form shows his evil personality."
"Did he use a transformation technique to turn himself into a fox, Big Sis Yao?" Zhang Lingxue asked in wonder.

"No." Feng Yao shook her head before explaining. "Actually, we mythical beasts don't know how Tiangou can have two forms, but all members of his race have been like that since the time of his ancestors. During the day, he will be in his dog form, but he will turn into a black fox once the sun sets."

"That's really weird; I've never met a beast with two forms before. However, I shouldn't be surprised by that, especially since my husband has three forms." Zhang Fei [1] laughed at that, but Zhang Lingxue followed up with a question. "You definitely won't let any of us make a contract with Tiangou, right?"

"Aren't you very familiar with my character?" Zhang Lingxue snorted softly at Zhang Fei [1]'s question. "I'm selfish and possessive, so I will never let any man get close to my wives, even if they are contract beasts. That's why I'm going to meet Tiangou, and I'm going to subdue him to become my contract beast."

"You better think twice about doing that now." Zhang Fei [1] immediately turned to Feng Yao. "You are indeed a mythical beast, but your cultivation is still far below Tiangou's, and your beast contract won't be able to help you fight him, especially with his cultivation at the 5-Moon Divine Transcend.

Your heavenly fox bloodline also won't have much effect on him, and he will kill you on the spot if he is in his black fox form. Moreover, I have heard that he has the ability to possess the bodies and souls of other beasts, but I don't know if it is true or not, and you will be putting all your wives and family in danger if he really has such an ability."

Zhang Fei [1] himself never took advice from his seniors lightly, so he seriously considered Feng Yao's advice, causing him to think twice about meeting Tiangou. "In that case, I will go to the island in the afternoon, but I will not approach him directly; I will investigate him from a distance first."

"I think it's fine if you want to do that, but you'd better not get too close to Tiangou, especially since he has a keen sense of smell, and he might be able to smell you even if you're in an invisible state." Feng Yao then rolled up the parchment and gave it to Zhang Fei [1] before telling him something else.

"Anyway, you can go to the western island to meet a demihuman named Old Ha Qingwa, and you can ask him about many things regarding that realm, especially since he has lived there for tens of thousands of years, so he is more familiar with the situation there than I am."
"All right, I will go to the island to meet him." Zhang Fei [1] immediately kept the parchment and asked Zhang Lingxue. "Do you want to accompany Zi'er?"
"Yes." Zhang Lingxue nodded at him. "Zi'er must still be worried about my big brother right now, so Xiaoling and I will accompany him for a few days, and I'll contact you when she's calmer."

"In that case, I will return to the Yin-Yang Pavilion to check on something, especially since I have been absent from the sect for a long time." After he said that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately returned to the Chu Clan, where he found the Liu Sisters talking with Liu Rong and Liu Ming, so he called the three Chu sisters out of the training space to join them.
However, he didn't join them and went straight to the southern region through the portal that connected the clan to the Liu Clan, and he went to the sect after that.

Zhang Lingxue immediately said goodbye to the phoenix before returning to the Zhang Clan, and Feng Yao leaned back in her chair as she thought about Zhang Fei [1]'s speed in comprehending and using the fire law. She then took out a red item, which is an interspatial communication device, and she sent a message to her parents, informing them of his existence.

Before long, Feng Yao had already gotten an answer from her parents, causing a faint smile to appear on her face as she stood up and left her room. 'As expected, they were interested in that kid because he was a heavenly fox, coupled with his speed in comprehending and using the fire law.'

In a distant realm, a black hole suddenly appeared, and it immediately spat out a woman who was none other than Meng Qi, the matriarch of the Meng Clan. However, he was still unconscious, and his face was very pale after he had been floating in the space rift for quite some time.
*Drap... Drap...*

Two winged horses galloped towards Meng Qi's location, while two young women rode on their backs. However, the appearance of both of them is a little strange, especially since they only wore two thin cloths to cover their private parts, exposing their smooth tan skin, and long bows hung over their shoulders.

When they arrived there, the two women immediately got off their beast and checked Meng Qi's condition. One of them immediately lifted her up, and she placed her onto her beast before riding it. "Let's go back, Ma Qinghua. We have to hand this woman over to our leader, especially since she seems to come from another realm."
Ma Qinghua nodded and rode her beast again, and they immediately flew away from the place. "Which realm do you think this woman is from, Ma Zhenxia?"

"I don't know." Ma Zhenxia shook her head at her friend. "This woman's dress is made of cheap materials, so I thought she came from the lower realms. However, I am confused because her cultivation is clearly still in the ten mortal realms, so she shouldn't be able to come to our realm by herself.
Moreover, her condition was quite bad, and the Yin Qi in her body was also very thin, so I thought something had happened to her before she ended up in our realm."
Ma Qinghua nodded as he watched Meng Qi. "Hey! This woman is quite old, but she's quite pretty, and our leader might like her."
"Haha." Ma Zhenxia laughed softly at that. "Our realm rarely has guests, and this woman is the first in decades, so it's natural that our leader would be interested in her."

Sometimes later, they have arrived at a floating island, and the island looks so vast. However, there are no men on the island, and all of the inhabitants are tan-skinned women whose appearance is similar to the two women.

The women around them looked surprised when they carried Meng Qi down from one of the beasts, but the two immediately reminded them not to approach her first and asked them to wait for their leader's decision first.

The two of them immediately took Meng Qi to a house in the middle of the island, where a middle-aged woman with long purple hair with the back in a bun was waiting for them, and two long bangs hung down beside her chubby cheeks.

The woman's face is alluring and mature, and her appearance is quite sensual, with purple cloth on both her private parts, highlighting her slim waist and plump breasts around E-Cup. She has two purple pupils in her eyes, but her nose is somewhat big, and her lips are thick and sexy.
She had tan skin like the other woman, a long neck with a beast core necklace around it, and legs that were slightly longer for her size.

"Hmm? A female cultivator with cultivation at 8-Star Heaven Realm, huh?" The woman muttered as she looked at Meng Qi, and she moved her finger slightly, causing her to quickly float towards her before being lowered onto her lap.
The woman then caressed Meng Qi's face while questioning her two subordinates. "Where did you find this woman, Zhenxia and Qinghua?"

Ma Qinghua promptly provided the woman with an explanation. "Big Sis Ma Mingxin, we found this woman in the lowlands in the south, and she was already in this condition when we found her, so we brought her to you right away."

"I see." Ma Mingxin immediately took out a bottle, poured the liquid into her mouth, then opened Meng Qi's mouth to help her drink it mouth-to-mouth. "I don't understand how she arrived at this realm with such a low cultivation, but we can find out after she awakens from unconsciousness."
"We will leave this woman with you, and we will go on patrol again, Big Sis." The two women immediately left the room.

Ma Mingxin then took Meng Qi to her bed, stripped her naked, and checked the wounds on her body. "Hmm? She only had minor injuries from the fight; her other injuries were caused by the space rift. It's no wonder she was able to come to my realm with such low cultivation; it turns out the space rift sent her here."
"Mhmm." Meng Qi suddenly groaned softly as her eyelids trembled, and she slowly opened her eyes before looking at the woman in amazement. "Who are you? Where am I now?"

"You don't have to be afraid, okay? You'll be safe here, and no one can hurt you under my protection." Ma Mingxin then pulled a water jug toward her, and she helped Meng Qi drink it. "My name is Ma Mingxin, and I am the leader of the Ma Clan. This realm is known as the Blossom Heaven Realm, which is part of the middle realms."

"Ma Clan? Blossom heaven realm? Middle realms?" Meng Qi muttered to herself before trying to sit up, but her body was extremely weak, so Ma Mingxin immediately helped her up. She was completely shocked when she found herself naked, but she was also relieved that there was no man by their side. "Were you the one who saved me?"
"My two subordinates found you unconscious, so they brought you to me." Ma Mingxin then asked Meng Qi. "What's your name? How did you get trapped in the space rift?"

Middle realms?" Meng Qi muttered to herself before trying to sit up, but her body was extremely weak, so Ma Mingxin immediately helped her up.

Meng Qi then explained to Ma Mingxin about the events in the demon cave, but she did not mention anything about Zhang Fei. She only told her about the demons from the Netherworld Realm, and the destruction of the demon portal, which trapped them in the space rift.

"The Netherworld Realm, huh?" Ma Mingxin muttered softly as she got out of bed, and she helped Meng Qi get dressed. "That demon realm is in the middle realms, and it will take us a week to get there. Although those demons cannot cultivate like us, they are still powerful, especially their demon emperor, so we dare not underestimate them.
However, I didn't expect that people from the upper realms would use them to invade your home realm, but the portal has been destroyed, so your realm should be safe now."
"Couldn't those guys create that portal again?" Meng Qi asked as Ma Mingxin helped her out of bed.

Ma Mingxin nodded to Meng Qi. "You're not wrong, but creating a portal to connect the lower and middle realms is no easy feat, and it requires a lot of special resources that cost the sky. Even if they come from the upper realms, I'm sure that they won't be able to create one in a short time, and they might need years or even decades to create it, so you don't need to think too much about it.
Anyway, you can stay in the realm for the time being, and you can improve your cultivation faster by taking advantage of the rich qi here."

Upon hearing that, Meng Qi let out a heavy sigh, thinking of her little sister, who must have been greatly panicked by her disappearance. Unfortunately, the distance between the lower and middle realms was too far, so she had no way to contact her family, let alone return to the Sky Jade Realm.

"It's okay; you'll get used to living in this realm, and you can think of a way to return to your home realm after your cultivation breaks through to the seven divine realms." Ma Mingxin said that as she supported her out of the house, but Meng Qi was surprised when she saw that there were only women on the flying island.
"Actually, there are many men in this realm, and they live in the lowlands, but they are just slaves for us women."
"Oh?" Meng Qi turned to Ma Mingxin in surprise.

"In fact, this flying island used to be part of the lowlands, but our ancestors discovered something special under it, which caused it to float high in the sky after they activated it." The women surrounding them continued to gaze at Meng Qi as Ma Mingxin guided her away, a situation that left her feeling awkward and uncomfortable.

"Those men used to treat us as trash, and they always forced us to do rough work like slaves. Fortunately, our ancestors discovered so many precious resources on this island, which accelerated their cultivation and allowed them to reach the seven divine realms.

Once they became truly strong, they immediately turned the situation around by fighting them, and they slaughtered the strongest among them, including their husbands. They also implanted slave marks into those who were still alive, so they couldn't fight back.
Since then, all the women in this realm have resided here, while the men have become our slaves, doing all the tedious labor in the lowlands, such as farming and mining.

Meng Qi looked completely shocked after hearing that, especially since the situation in the Blossom Heaven Realm did not align with its name, and it was significantly different from that in the Sky Jade Realm. "If they are all just slaves to you, then how do you guys produce offspring?"

"Haha." Ma Mingxin laughed at her question. "Naturally, we will choose the best of them to impregnate us, so we can still maintain our family lineage. If we give birth to sons, then we will immediately send them to the lowlands, and their father will raise them. If we give birth to daughters, then we will take care of them and raise them ourselves, and we will tell them that their father is dead.
Fortunately, male babies have a lower birth rate than female babies, so not many male babies have been born over the past few decades."

Meng Qi was at a loss for words after hearing Ma Mingxin's explanation, but her eyes glanced at those women in thought. 'These women are truly cruel! I know they did that because they had previously been oppressed by those men, but their actions were far more cruel than theirs, and they even treated their sons in the same manner.'
After that, Ma Mingxin took Meng Qi to several other areas, explaining to her about each area, including the rules that apply on the floating island.

Meng Qi herself kept listening to Ma Mingxin, but she repeatedly sighed in her heart, especially since she didn't like the life in the Blosson Heaven Realm. 'Sigh! I can't do anything for the time being, so I will stay here. It would be better if I followed their rules, especially since they are much stronger than me.
Otherwise, they will send me to the lowlands and treat me like those men, which will make me suffer.'

After some time, Ma Mingxin brought Meng Qi back to her house, and she then took out a bottle from behind a painting at the end of the main room. "You can drink this, and you will immediately feel the changes in your body, which will be of great benefit to your cultivation."
"Hmm?" Meng Qi accepted the bottle directly, but she seemed hesitant to drink it, especially since she still didn't know much about Ma Mingxin, let alone her character, which seemed so vile.
Seeing her continue to hesitate, Ma Mingxin took the bottle and poured the liquid into her mouth, and she immediately kissed Meng Qi while forcing her to drink it, causing her to be shocked.

'Damn it! Why did she do this to me?' Meng Qi grumbled in her heart as she forced herself to swallow the liquid, but her expression was a little surprised after she felt the slight changes in her body. 'What is this? How can this liquid strengthen my Yin Qi so quickly?'

"Have you noticed the effects?" Ma Mingxin asked after she separated their lips, to which Meng Qi nodded. She then rubbed her cheeks, causing her to shudder at her intimate action. "As I said before, the liquid will be beneficial for your cultivation, and your cultivation will be able to break through to the seven divine realms faster if you continue to drink it.
Once you have successfully reached that stage, it will not be difficult for you to return to your home realm, but I'm sure that you'll forget it after you stay here long enough."
Meng Qi neither agreed nor refused Ma Mingxin's words, and she immediately sat cross-legged on the floor, especially since she felt her Yin Qi starting to overflow and wanted to stabilize it first.

On the other hand, Ma Mingxin looked at Meng Qi with a faint smile on her face. 'Haha! You'll definitely beg me for that liquid after you become addicted to it, so you'll never be able to leave this realm, and no one will know about us.'
In another realm, another black hole opened there, and a middle-aged man shot out from it, who was none other than Ba Jiawen, the sect master of the Heavenly Sword Sect.
Unfortunately, Ba Jiawen's fate was not as fortunate as Meng Qi's, and he fell among a crowd of ferocious beasts who were enjoying their prey.

'Shit!' Ba Jiawen cursed in his heart as the ferocious beasts looked at him, especially since his body was in extreme pain from the space rift and the injuries he had sustained before, and his qi was already extremely thin from protecting himself before the demon portal exploded. 'What an unfortunate fate!
I managed to survive the traitors and heretics, but instead, I fell into the nest of ferocious beasts.'

The ferocious beasts slowly approached Ba Jiawen, and saliva dripped down their snouts, making him truly afraid that they would eat him alive. 'Hah! Maybe it's my fate to die today! Qingshi! Yang Ye! I leave our sect to you, and I hope you two can protect my Ba Clan.'
Exerting his last strength, Ba Jiawen decided to commit suicide by exploding his cultivation core, especially since he didn't want to die from being eaten alive by those ferocious beasts.
*Boom*
However, Ba Jiawen's suicidal action did not hurt the ferocious beasts in the slightest, especially since their cultivation was at the seven divine realms, and they only suffered minor injuries.
A middle-aged man was stranded in a dark forest, and his body seemed to be covered in wounds after he fell from the sky, and he had no protection due to the depletion of Qi in his body.

"Damn it! My body really hurts!" The middle-aged man was Gu Tong, the patriarch of the Gu Clan. He then looked around him, but he couldn't find anything there other than black trees, and he couldn't find the other senior cultivators either. "Sigh! It seems that the black hole that sucked us in has sent us to different places, and I don't know anything about this realm.
Moreover, I can't feel the presence of Qi in this realm, so I can't recover my Qi."

With great difficulty, Gu Tong took out a recovery pill and a healing pill from his storage ring and swallowed them directly, but the recovery pill could only recover a little of his qi. "It seems that this forest is not very dangerous, so I will take a break for now, and I will find a way out of this place after my body recovers enough."

Gu Tong immediately closed his eyes and quickly fell asleep due to being too exhausted, but a young man with long white hair and golden eyes suddenly landed beside him, and he immediately crouched down to examine him. 'A human, huh? Where did he come from? How could he be trapped in the space rift and stranded in this realm?'
The young man then lifted Gu Tong and placed him on his shoulders. He immediately took him away from the dark forest, but the numerous trees within continued to watch them.
In the same realm, but in a different location, Chi Yang, the sect master of the Desolate Sect, looked terrified at the male black wolf who was standing in front of him.

The black wolf kept staring at Chi Yang with saliva dripping as if he wanted to swallow him alive. He crawled backwards until he was stopped by a big tree behind him. 'Damn it! I didn't expect my fate to be this unlucky, and I have never felt so helpless in my life. If only I still had my qi, I would have killed him straight away.'
*Howl!*

After the black wolf howled, it immediately pounced towards Chi Yan, but he quickly shifted slightly. However, his sharp teeth bit his shoulder, causing him to scream in pain as blood flowed from the bite wound. "Argh!"
*Bam... Bam...*

"Fuck! Let me go!" Chi Yang tried to hit the black wolf's head, but he didn't budge an inch and continued to bite his shoulder, and his teeth pierced his shoulder deeper, causing his blood to flow even more. 'Shit! I will definitely die at the muzzle of this wolf. 'Damn it!'
*Howl!*
A loud howl suddenly sounded from a distance, and the black wolf immediately released its bite from Chi Yang's shoulder before looking in the direction where the howl came from.
The black wolf then looked at Chi Yang again before running away, and he rushed towards the direction of the howl, especially since the owner of the howl was his leader.

Perplexed by the black wolf's departure, Chi Yang immediately tore the bottom of his hanfu and used it to bandage the wolf's bite. However, the deep bite made it difficult to stop the bleeding, further weakening him. He immediately took out some pills before swallowing them, and he leaned against a tree while observing the area around him.
"The wolf just now was clearly a demon wolf, which means this realm is the realm of the demons. However, I don't know whether this is the Netherworld Realm or other demon realms."

After he had rested for some time, Chi Yang immediately got up and tried to find a way out of that place, but he still didn't realize that his body was starting to change due to the black wolf's bite.

A middle-aged man was panting heavily on the side of a black river, suffering from physical pain. He immediately took some pills to alleviate his pain and restore his Qi. He then looked towards the forest in front of him because the black hole was spitting him out from there, but he then looked in several other directions.

"It seems that this area is safe, so I can rest for a while. Zi'er must be worried about me now, but Lingxue and Xiaoling should be able to comfort her." The middle-aged man was none other than Zhang Wuji. "Where am I now? Why is there only darkness in this realm?
Moreover, there is no qi in this realm, and I can feel an unusual aura that seems to be a demon aura, so I'm sure this place is a demon realm."

Zhang Wuji suddenly remembered something. "Zhang Fei told us that there was no Qi in the Netherworld Realm, so the demons in that realm were not demon cultivators. Could it be that this place is their realm? If that is true, then he might come here to save me. I must stay alive so I can be with my family again."

Zhang Wuji's guess was correct that he was in a demon realm, but he forgot something very important, and the demon aura in that place quickly affected him, especially since he could not use his Qi to protect himself.
*Growl*

Zhang Wuji's stomach suddenly growled, making him laugh wryly. "Sigh! I have to find food to restore my strength, so I can go find a way out of this place, and I hope my guess is correct that this realm is the Netherworld Realm, so Zhang Fei can save me."

On a large spider web, a middle-aged man lay unconscious, his body no longer covered by a single thread, the web binding his hands and feet. By his side, a female spider demon kept watching him while licking his face repeatedly. "Hehehe!
I haven't seen humans in decades, but I didn't expect that you would suddenly appear in my nest in this state, so I won't waste this opportunity, and I will drain your life essence dry."

The female spider demon then moved to the middle-aged man's lower body and inserted his dick into his mouth, quickly absorbing his life essence, causing his face to slowly turn pale and his skin to wrinkle.

"Ugh." The middle-aged man groaned softly when he sensed that feeling, and he immediately opened his eyes. However, he was shocked to see himself in such a situation, and he was even more shocked when he saw the female spider. He tried to move his body, but it couldn't move an inch due to the spider web binding, and his body continued to weaken because her action absorbed his life essence. 'Shit!

Am I going to die today? Qingyu, Ying'er, Xing'er, and Qing'er. Apparently, I won't be able to accompany you guys anymore, so you all have to take good care of yourselves. Zhang Fei, I'll leave them to you, and you must protect them well.'

The middle-aged man was none other than Chu Hong, but his body grew weaker and dried up because the female spider demon absorbed his life essence faster and faster, and he ultimately met his death when his body completely dried up.

In a dungeon, the sound of whipping continued to resound, and a middle-aged woman hung naked on a wooden crossbar with an expression full of pain. Whip wounds covered her body, causing her blood to drip down from her body to the floor.

In front of the middle-aged woman, a female demon with straight black hair, two horns on the side of her head, and two pink wings on her back was enjoying whipping her with a leather whip that had a barbed tip.

The middle-aged woman was none other than Yan Zixiu, the sect master of the Yin-Yang Pavilion. She continued to gaze at the female demon, her vision blurring due to the extreme pain her actions had caused. 'Ugh! My luck is really bad! I immediately fell into the hands of this vile female demon as soon as I arrived in this realm!'
*Crack... Crack...*

"Hiss." Yan Zixiu groaned in pain as the barbed tip tore her skin, causing her blood to flow even more. Even so, the female demon did not stop torturing her, and she became even more eager to torture her after seeing her painful expression. "Hiss."

In front of their room, there was a female demon with ocean blue hair, whose hands and feet were tied by chains to the corners of the room. A blindfold concealed her eyes, while a ball gagged her mouth. Her face is quite attractive and charming, with a slim, straight nose combined with wide and thick lips.
She has a tall figure covered in a thin blue dress, a long and slim neck, a slim waist with wide hips, and her breasts are perfectly round even though they are not very big.
Unlike Yan Zixiu, the female demon with ocean blue hair looked fine even though she was in such a situation, and there were almost no injuries on her body except for her wrists and ankles.

'I don't understand how that female human could appear in this realm, but she was truly unlucky to fall into the hands of that crazy female demon, who won't stop torturing her until she goes insane. Sigh!

I shouldn't have thought about that female human's condition, especially since my own situation is still like this, and those three succubi duchesses have locked me up here for years or maybe decades.

My parents must think that I'm dead by now, especially since I've been missing for so long.' The female demon with ocean blue hair suddenly heard two footsteps, and she knew the owners of both very well, especially since she had been there for too long.
'Even though they've locked me up here for so long, these two are still much better than their crazy friend, and they never torture other demons like that crazy sucubus.'

The two succubi immediately entered Yan Zixiu's prison room, and one of them shouted at the succubus who was torturing him. "Hey, Thish! You better stop torturing that human woman! Otherwise, she will die, and we will lose her life essence!"
"Hmm?" Thish immediately turned to them before asking in annoyance. "Why are you bothering me, Orith? Didn't you have that dog demon to keep you company?"

"Nah! He can accompany me, but he's already turned into a demon and can't give us life essence anymore, so I don't want you to make this female human die." Orith replied as she walked towards Yan Zixiu. "Look at her; she's already fallen unconscious as a result of your torture, and she'll die for real if you keep torturing her, so you should stop now."

"You should listen to Orith." Thish immediately turned to the other succubus, named Ilsath. "We don't have many opportunities to obtain human life essence, so I don't want to miss out just because he died in your hands. Furthermore, she will eventually turn into a demon, so you can torture her again at that time."
"Humph!" Thish snorted coldly and immediately left Yan Zixiu's room, but she then looked at the female demon with ocean blue hair, eager to torture her.

"Forget about her! You will bring trouble for us if she dies, especially since she came from one of the demon realms in the upper realm like that impostor demon emperor." Thish did not say anything to answer them and hurriedly left the dungeon. Orith then took a bottle from her pocket, opened Yan Zixiu's mouth, poured the liquid into it, and forced her to swallow it.
"This liquid will keep this female human alive, but it will turn her into a demon faster."

Ilsath nodded to Orith as she supported her chin and watched Yan Zixiu with a curious look. "This female human suddenly appeared in our tower, just like those previous humans. Fortunately, she appeared in this dungeon, and the barier could conceal everything from outside. Otherwise, Yhrer would have noticed her presence and snatched her from us, and it will be a loss for us.
Anyway, do you still want to have fun with that dog demon?"

"That dog demon is too weak, so I don't want to have fun with him anymore. Moreover, I've already given him to our subordinates, so they can use him to their heart's content." Orith then walked out of Yan Zixiu's room.

"Anyway, I'm going to the Lust Hotel to meet Xenaya, especially since I heard that a wild incubus stayed there for the past few days, but he had no intention of joining the Incubus Tower, so I'm a little curious about his identity."
"Haha." Ilsath laughed softly in response. "Do you think I don't know your character? You must be planning to bring that wild incubus with you, right?"

Orith didn't hide it and nodded to Ilsath. "Since he didn't want to join Yhrer, so I thought he might be different from those incubi in the tower, especially since all the incubus always admired that stupid incubus lord, and they always had the ambition to join them."

"I didn't expect you to be so strong, especially with your demon strength far surpassing mine and my sisters'. We've locked you in this dungeon for decades, but you still haven't been willing to tell us about your identity or your origin realm."

The female demon snorted at Ilsath. "Do you think a lowly demon like you deserves to know my identity? The three of you managed to capture me only because I was in a weak state, and you guys ganged up on me."

"If I weren't afraid that your family would find out about your whereabouts in our realm, I would have killed you long ago. Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement with Shen Xueyi, but unfortunately, he could not find the names of the two women in the Netherworld Realm.
"However, I did not expect that Chu Hong would be dead, and we still do not know the whereabouts of Ba Jiawen."

Shen Wansan sighed heavily before speaking to them. "The deaths of Chu Hong and Ba Jiawen are truly disappointing, but their deaths were not in vain because the demon portal is now destroyed, and our realm can have peace for at least a while. As for us, we are still alive now, and we must work hard to build up our strength even more.
That way, we can ward off those who want to invade this realm again in the future, and none of our people will fall victim like them and our ancestors."

"Fei, send me and Zihua there so we can focus on our training, and I want to help you find my big sister." Zhang Fei [1] first sent Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu to the Chu Clan, especially since his other wives were already there to comfort Liu Qingyu and the three Chu Sisters, who were sad because of Chu Hong's death.
After that, he brought Yan Luan'er and Xi Zihua into the training space, leaving Shen Wansan behind.
Shen Wansan himself immediately left the main hall and went to his private quarters, where he began his isolation, especially since the deaths of Chu Hong and Ba Jiawen weighed heavily on his heart.

Although she had begun to forget Chu Hong because of her relationship with Zhang Fei, he was still her husband and the father of their three daughters, so Liu Qingyu was saddened by his death. Tears continued to flow from her tired eyes, and Liu Hua kept hugging her while rubbing her back.

The three Chu Sisters' feelings were also the same as their mother; they were devastated after learning of their father's death. Liu Rong and Liu Ming repeatedly sighed at the sight, and they tried to comfort the three by hugging them, but they were completely lost in their sadness.
Chu Liuxiang's face looked pale, and Yuan Manqiu continued to cry in his arms. After all, Chu Hong was their son, and hearing about his death was the saddest thing for them.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei stood in front of the main hall, looking up at the sky, and not a single word came out of his mouth; his two fists remained tightly clenched. Liu Qingyu's and the three Chu Sisters' heartbreaking cries cut his heart like a dagger, especially since he had promised to bring Chu Hong back to them. But what happened was the opposite: he died in the unknown realm. 'Fuck me!
I always said I would never make them all sad, but my weakness made the four of them sad like that.'

Zhang Chen, who was watching his grandson and the others from a distance, let out a soft sigh in her heart as she understood his feelings. She then walked over to Zhang Fei, stood by his side, and embraced him.
Zhang Fei immediately embraced Zhang Chen's waist and hugged his grandmother tightly. "I'm useless, grandma. I've made Qingyu, Ying'er, Xing'er, and Qing'er sad because of Chu Hong's death."

"Fei'er, I know you are disappointed because you didn't manage to save Chu Hong." Zhang Chen then lifted her grandson's face and cupped his cheeks. "Moreover, you already know the fact that the space rift sent him to the unknown realm, and you don't have the ability to find him, so I hope you don't keep blaming yourself or wallowing in disappointment.
Instead, you must focus on saving the remaining senior cultivators, especially the three in the Netherworld Realm, and bring them back to their families."

chapters.title: Chapter 436 Rescue Plan
paragraphs: "Your grandmother is right, Zhang Fei." Su Qingshi said this as she and Yang Ye approached them. "We both regret the deaths of our sect master and Chu Hong, but we cannot continue to dwell with those who are dead, and we must focus on those who are still alive.
You have already found three of the seniors who were sucked into the space rift, and they are in the Netherworld now, so you still have time to save them."

"Chu Hong and our sect master are my good friends, so I myself feel regretful about their deaths." Yang Ye then patted Zhang Fei's shoulder. "You may be disappointed that you were unable to save them, but you must remember that you are not omnipotent.

Even with your three identities, you are still an ordinary living being, and your strength is limited, so there are many things that are beyond your control. Besides, you not only saved some of those senior cultivators from heretics, but you also saved the entire population of this realm from those demons, so you don't need to blame yourself for their deaths."

Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh, letting go of Zhang Chen before turning to Su Qingshi and Yang Ye. "Currently, my fourth clone is on his way to my brother-in-law's place, but I don't know if I have time to save him, especially since his location is too far west, and my clone is in the east, so he will need at least seven to ten days to get there.

Gu Tong is in a city in the south, and he is with a demon cultivator from the upper realm in that city, so I doubt I can save him. As for Chi Yang, he is still surrounded by powerful demon beasts in the southern region, and they are much stronger than my current self."

The two seniors of the Heavenly Sword Sect frowned upon hearing that, but Yang Ye then asked Zhang Fei. "Can you take me to that realm? Although I am not as strong as Chang Wuhen, Zhang Long, or Di Xiong, I am confident that I can still save Chi Yang. However, I cannot possibly fight that powerful demon cultivator, especially since his cultivation should be in the seven divine realms now."

"I can indeed take you there, Senior." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "However, your cultivation is too low to withstand the demon aura in the Netherworld Realm, and my fourth clone is even further away from the southern region. You won't be able to reach Chi Yang's location, as your qi will exhaust before you can reach it.
Besides, I detected two King or Queen Rank demons in the southern region, and they will immediately notice your presence if you go there."

Yang Ye didn't dare take Zhang Fei's words lightly, especially since he himself would have difficulty fighting those heretics if he wasn't helped by the other cultivators, let alone if he had to face the demons.

Su Qingshi then put forward her idea. "Zhang Fei, could you please ask Sect Master Feng Yao to help you save them? After all, she went to the Netherworld Realm with you before, and the cultivators from the upper realms did not dare to do anything to her, so the demons definitely wouldn't dare to attack her either."

Instead, Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh because he still remembered Feng Yao's previous words that she would not help the cultivators from the Sky Jade Realm directly, and she would only help them to prevent the cultivators from the upper realms from attacking them.

Even so, he tried to contact the phoenix to ask for her help, but the result was as he had expected because she immediately rejected his request. "She was unwilling to help me and asked me to think of a way to save them myself."
"Why is she so selfish? She-"

"That's enough, Qingshi." Yang Ye immediately stopped his friend. "I know you are disappointed by Sect Master Feng's decision; I myself also feel the same as you. However, you have to remember that she is not a native of this realm, and she is also a mythical beast, so it is natural that she is unwilling to help us.
Moreover, she has already helped the seniors stabilize the demon portal; otherwise, the demons would have long invaded our realm, so you don't need to blame her."

Su Qingshi clenched her fists tightly after hearing that, but she also realized that Feng Yao had indeed helped them a lot. However, she was deeply disheartened by her unwillingness to rescue Chi Yang and the others, considering that she was the only person capable of saving them apart from Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei suddenly got a voice transmission from Zhang Lingxue, so he immediately opened a portal to the Blazing Phoenix Sect. Soon, people from the Zhang and Chang Clan walked out of it, and Zi'er immediately asked him. "Is it true that you've found my husband?"

"My fourth clone has already set off for the western region, but he will only arrive at my brother-in-law's location in seven to ten days." Zi'er and the people from the Zhang Clan looked relieved to hear that, but Zhang Fei's next explanation caused them to become tense.

"To tell you the truth, I'm not sure my brother-in-law can return to this realm again, especially since he lacks the Qi to protect himself from the demon aura in that realm, which could potentially affect him and turn him into a demon.

Besides, he might also sustain injuries because of the space rift, and there are quite a lot of powerful demons and demon beasts in his current location, so I'm not sure that he can protect himself from them."
After hearing that, Zi'er staggered back, but Zhang Xiaoling immediately supported her before speaking to Zhang Fei. "Please, you must save my father and bring him back to us."

"Zhang Fei, we don't care if Wuji becomes a demon, and I hope you can bring him back to us." Yang Yudie joined in begging him, especially since Zhang Wuji was his only son, so she didn't want to lose him.
Zhang Long also spoke to Zhang Fei. "Kid, take me to that realm, and I will help you save Wuji, so we can bring him back here."

"I will also go with you guys." They turned to Chang Wuhen, who immediately provided them with an explanation. "Wuji and Wentian have been friends since childhood, and I have always regarded him as my own son. That's why I can't possibly let him die in that realm, so I will take the risk to help you two save him."

"I have never faced those demons directly, but I have experienced the effects of the demon miasma from one of the blood demon trees, so I can tell you that the demon aura in that realm will have a significant impact on you two." Yuhe, the Undine race leader, also spoke to them.

Oliver then informed them. "That's why I brought Elmyra here, especially since she has a pure light element, and I have a strong wind element, so the two of us will go to the Netherworld Realm to help Zhang Fei's clone."
"Me too! I'm going to that realm too!" Yuhe said while raising her right hand.

"Are the three of you sure you want to go to that realm?" The three nodded to Zhang Fei, who immediately asked Mei to open a portal to his training space. "If that is the case, the three of you can go inside now, and my clone will take you out to that realm."

With no hesitation, the three of them immediately entered the training space, but Zhang Fei [4] took them directly to the Netherworld Realm. Zhang Fei then spoke to those people. "Grandpa Oliver's wind element can help me get to the western region faster, and Elmyra's light element can protect them from the demon aura.
For now, you should rest in this clan first, and we will bring my brother-in-law back soon."

Zhang Chen could naturally understand Zhang Fei's decision, especially since he did not have a close relationship with the two men, and Zhang Wuji was their family since Zhang Lingxue was his wife.

"Haha." Oz the 1st laughed and hugged Morgana's waist. "Do you want children from me that much?"

"That's for sure, right?" Morgana responded by hugging her husband's arm tighter. "We've been married for so long, so of course I want to have children from you.
