Oz the 1st turned and looked at Morgana with a smile full of tenderness, especially since she was the one who helped him recover his memories after Shang Huaqiang brainwashed him, and she had also accompanied him for so long that they finally became husband and wife. "If you really want that, then I will grant your wish, and we can have children soon."
"Hahaha." Morgana laughed softly after she heard that.
They suddenly sensed a lot of demon auras coming towards them, but the first to appear in front of them was Feltia [2] along with the Amaris Twins.
The Amaris Twins were immediately shocked upon seeing Oz the 1st, particularly the White Amaris, who had used an artifact given by the winged race to send him to another realm.

The white Amaris was really scared to see Oz the 1st, so she immediately hid behind Feltia [2]. 'Ugh! The first demon emperor is still alive! He has even returned to this realm, and he will definitely kill me.'

Even though the black Amaris was also shocked by the return of Oz the 1st, she didn't look the least bit afraid of him, especially since he never betrayed her like her twin sister, and longing actually appeared in her black eyes. "Demon emperor, you are still alive."

Oz the 1st immediately turned to the Amaris Twins, and a gentle smile appeared on his face unconsciously. However, Morgana glared at them sharply, especially the white Amaris, causing her to shiver in fear. After all, Tharnon had told her about her actions toward her husband, which had caused him to fall into Shang Huaqiang's hands.

Noticing this, Feltia [2] immediately spoke with Morgana. "She did make a big mistake towards your husband, but her fate is no different from his now, and she has completely submitted to me, so you don't need to do anything to her."

"I see." Morgana nodded in understanding before speaking to the white Amaris. "If it wasn't for him, I would have killed you right away. Since he and the phoenix princess saved my husband from the hands of those wicked guys, I would forget your mistakes for him."
As she swallowed her saliva, the white Amaris nodded repeatedly, and she could tell that Morgana was not joking with her words. 'Phew! I'm lucky I don't have to die today!'

Soon, Aries and the other demon rulers landed at their location, especially since Feltia [2] asked them to come. All of them were shocked to see Oz the 1st, but they immediately kneeled and saluted him. "Welcome back to this realm, Demon Emperor."

Oz the 1st let out a soft sigh and lifted them all to their feet with his demon aura, but he then pointed at Oz the 2nd. "He is the current demon emperor, so you guys should respect him. Moreover, I still don't remember you guys or this realm, and I don't want to be a demon emperor anymore. For now, I just want to live a quiet life with my wife, so I hope you all don't bother us."

Aries and the others looked confused about it, and Feltia [2] immediately explained to them about Oz the 1st's situation, causing them to let out heavy sighs and glare at the white Amaris, who still looked frightened. "Since you guys have gathered, let's go to the ancient floating castle, and we will discuss our next plans regarding the people from the Tian and Xian Realms."

chapters.title: Chapter 437 Alder And Gu Tong
paragraphs: After they arrived at the floating castle, Feltia [2] immediately told Oz the first and Morgana about the situation in the Diyu Realm, especially about the people from the Tian Realm, who had begun to prepare to invade their realm. He still had no information about the people from the Xian Realm, so he couldn't say anything about them.

However, he believed that their presence could bring peace and security to their realm, especially since both of them were demon cultivators, and the witch demon cultivation was in the seven divine realms. "I will hand over this realm to the two of you, and I will focus on increasing my demon power in my tower."

"It's not a problem for us. Furthermore, this realm is my husband's birthplace, and we will stay here for a long time, so we will protect it. Although I cannot kill those people due to the rules you already know, I still have many abilities that can destroy them indirectly, so you don't have to think about them.

You can focus on your personal affairs, especially since you will face people who are stronger than them in the future, and you need high strength to fight them." Morgana then turned her gaze to the other demons and extended her right hand towards them. Immediately, a black light shot out of her fingers and entered their bodies, causing them to experience a strange sensation.
"You guys have to accept it and spread it throughout your body, especially since it will gradually enhance your demon power, so you won't have any difficulty dealing with those people."

They immediately followed Morgana's words by absorbing and spreading them into their bodies. Although they couldn't feel the effects directly, they could already feel slight changes in their bodies. Morgana then gave them some demon items, all of which she brought from her origin realm. "You guys can go back to your respective places to use them, and all of you will like their effects very much.
Anyway, Zhang Fei, you should bring Ursula with you, especially since they are demon cultivators now, and your yang qi will help them even more when combined with my items."

Feltia [2] had indeed thought about it, especially since Ursula's female essence was the highest among all the female demons he knew; even the Amaris Twins' female essence couldn't match theirs, so he planned to take them to the tower.

Both Ursula themselves didn't mind Morgana's idea, and they were actually looking forward to it, especially since they had realized many things after becoming demon cultivators. Moreover, they had already swallowed Feltia[2]'s yang qi through the bottle several times, so they knew its potency."

After they talked about some other things, Feltia [2] immediately brought the Amaris Twins and Ursula away from the floating demon castle. However, she did not immediately bring them back to the tower, especially since he still had a daily quest to kill 700 demons or demon beasts, so he wanted to finish it first with their help.

Oz the Second, Zygoz, and the other demon rulers also hurriedly left the ancient floating castle. Meanwhile, Tharnon decides to return to the Endless Death, especially since he doesn't want to disturb his two masters from having fun.
Morgana then sat on her husband's lap and put her arms around his neck. "Shall we start making a baby now, husband?"
Oz the first laughed at his wife's impatience, but he immediately carried Morgana like a princess and took her to the main room in the floating castle, where they began their sexual activities.

Zhang Fei [4] repeatedly used his nine cloud steps as he enveloped the three leaders of the natural races, but his speed was much faster than usual, especially since Oliver used his wind power to enhance his speed. Beside them, the demon extermination sword continued to fly and cut down the flying demon beasts that kept attacking them.
He could have brought them away in an invisible state, but the daily quest required him to kill too many demons, and Feltia [2] would not be able to complete it alone.

Meanwhile, Elmyra used her pure light qi to protect the two leaders of the natural races, so the demon aura in the Netherworld Realm did not affect them too much, and she also helped Zhang Fei [4] to counterattack those demon beasts.
As for Yuhe, her abilities were related to water, so she couldn't do much to help them fight those demon beasts. "How long will it take us to arrive in the western region?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] thought for a moment as he asked Mei to calculate the distance to that region from their location, and he then answered Yuhe. "With my current speed, we should be able to arrive there in about five days.
Currently, my brother-in-law is not in a dangerous situation, but I don't know what will happen later, so I can only hope that he will be able to protect himself until we arrive at his location."
"Isn't five days more than enough for him to turn into a demon?" Yuhe once again asked Zhang Fei [4].

"No." Zhang Fei [4] responded with a shake of his head. "Even though my brother-in-law has no protection now, he won't turn into a demon that quickly. However, he will turn into a demon faster if he consumes the things in this realm, especially since they all contain demon energy."
The three nodded in understanding before Oliver asked. "Have you ever turned humans into demons before?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed before nodding at Oliver. "I've transformed quite a few humans into demons, both directly and indirectly, and all of them are my enemies. Anyway, can you increase my speed faster than this, Grandpa?"

Oliver responded to Zhang Fei [4] by borrowing more power from the wind, increasing his speed even further. "This way, we should be able to arrive at that region a day earlier than you estimated, and we can go directly to help the other two after we help your brother-in-law."
"Yes." However, Oliver's actions also caused Zhang Fei [4]'s qi to drain faster, so he started consuming qi recovery pills, especially since they didn't have time to rest.

At the Lust Inn, Orith sat in front of her subordinate with her chin propped up and her left leg crossed over the other. She looked enthusiastic as she listened to Xenaya's story about Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially about their sexual activities over several days. "Do you know where the young Incubus went?"
"My Lady, Elion told me that he wanted to train in the ghostveil forest, but he also said that he would go to another region after he finished training there, so I don't know where he is now."

"The ghostveil forest, huh? Isn't that where Uncle Arbeola lives?" Orith immediately rushed to leave the inn for the forest, making Xenaya laugh bitterly, especially since she had already guessed that he would be interested in Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Before long, Orith had arrived at the ghostveil forest and went directly to meet Arbeola, but the old demon tree was not surprised by her arrival, especially since he had already expected that she would come to him right away after she learned about Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Are you looking for that young Incubus?"
"En." Orith nodded slightly, then asked. "Do you know where he went, Uncle Arbeola?"
"That kid didn't tell me where he went, but he said that he will visit your city again soon, so you can wait for him there."

Orith was disappointed with Arbeola's answer, especially since she had never had a match in bed, so she was eager to meet Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Uncle, you must have known all the events in the demon emperor city, right? Do you have any guesses about the whereabouts of our demon emperor?"

"Over there." Arbeola pointed one of his tree branches toward the center of their realm, and Orith immediately looked in that direction. "I have communicated with all the trees in our realm, and the dead forest is the most suitable place for those people to hide our demon emperor, so I am confident that he is there.

However, you should not think to go there, especially since the formation they put in that place is powerful enough to mislead us, including demons at King or Queen rank can get out of there. You will never be able to get out of there, and you will get lost in there for the rest of your life."
"What if I tell those higher-ups about this matter?"

"No." Arbeola immediately rejected Orith's idea. "You should already know the strength of those people, right? Do you think they would allow us to find the demon emperor so easily? I'm sure they've put some other things in place to prevent that kind of thing from happening, so you'd better keep the information to yourself.
Furthermore, we cannot lose the demon higher-ups, as they will undoubtedly return to this realm in the future. They should concentrate on preparing themselves for their next arrival.
Orith nodded in agreement and faced Arbeola again. "Uncle, please let me know if that young incubus comes to you again."

'This little girl! Her mind is only filled with sex! After all, she is a lust demon, so it is only natural for her to behave like that.' Arbeola then nodded to Orith. "All right, I will let you know right away if that kid comes again, and I will ask him to meet you."
"Thank you, Uncle."

Arbeola looked at Orith, who immediately flew away from his location. "Compared to Ilsath and that crazy Thish, that little girl is much kinder than them, and that kid will probably like her when they meet later."

Meanwhile, Oxgroth and Zilvora had been waiting for Alder in Black Moon City for quite some time, but the wolf king had just returned to his city, and their expressions immediately changed as soon as they saw him carrying Gu Tong on his shoulders.

Naturally, Alder noticed their reaction, so he released a bit of his killing intent to deter them. "You two better not think anything of this human, especially since he is under my protection. Even though you two are King and Queen Rank demons, you guys are still not my match, and I will kill you immediately if you intend to attack him."
Oxgroth and Zilvora shivered as they sensed Alder's killing intent, and cold sweat dripped from their foreheads. 'Fuck! This guy is more terrifying than those human cultivators!'

After he placed Gu Tong on an empty table, Alder immediately sat down in front of the two demons and spoke to them again. "If you came here to ask for my help against those people, then you can forget about your intentions, especially since I will never help you."
"But-"

Alder interrupted Zilvora directly. "You two already know that I am not a native of this realm, and I came here specifically to protect my daughter, so I cannot care about the affairs of this realm. I protect these demon wolves because they are the same race as me, so you can leave my city right now and tell them to never come to me again."
Alder's answer made the two demons sigh heavily, but they themselves had already guessed that he would refuse to help them. "Do you know about the whereabouts of our real demon emperor?"

"Yes." Both demons were surprised by Alder's answer. "Those cultivators have imprisoned your demon emperor in another realm, and the portal to that realm lies deep within the dead forest. However, I do not recommend going there, as you will never escape their formation.

Even I don't dare approach that location because the formation is too strong, and they've also placed a powerful guardian to protect the portal. None of you will be able to face that guardian, especially since the guardian is no less powerful than their leader, so you will only die in vain if you go there.

Instead of thinking about your demon emperor, it would be better for all of you to be prepared to fight them if they return to this realm again. Otherwise, all of you will continue to be their puppets, and you will never be able to gain your freedom."

Although Oxgroth and Zilvora wanted to free their demon emperor, they did not dare underestimate Alder's advice, especially since they knew for sure about his and those people's strength. Since he had given them such advice, and he himself did not dare to go to that place, so they had to think twice about going there.

Zilvora then said to Alder. "I understand you don't want to interfere with our realm's affairs, and we will continue to increase our strength for the time being. However, we are still not as strong as you or them, so I hope you will still be willing to help us if those people come here again."
"I won't promise you anything." Alder then pointed towards the exit, disappointed the two demons once again, but they did not speak further and immediately left him.

Alder then approached Gu Tong and channeled a little of his qi into his body, making his condition slightly better than before. Soon, he opened his eyes, but he was immediately frightened by the presence of the wolf king. "Did you come from the Sky Jade Realm?"
"How... how did you know that?" Gu Tong asked stutteringly.

"So it's true, huh?" Alder then helped Gu Tong sit up. "The space rift will only appear for certain reasons, and one of them is the destruction of a portal. Yesterday, I sensed the destruction of a portal in the demon emperor city, and it connected this realm to your home realm, so I guessed that you came from that realm."
"Are... are you going to kill me?"

"If I wanted to kill you, then I wouldn't have rescued you from that forest and brought you here." Gu Tong was slightly relieved by the wolf king's answer. "You will indeed be safe by staying here, but you cannot continue to stay in this realm, especially since the demon aura in this realm will turn you into a demon.
Unfortunately, I don't have the ability to send you back to your realm, so I don't have a solution for you."

Even though he didn't want to turn into a demon, Gu Tong felt helpless about his situation. "The only person who can save me is Zhang Fei, especially since he has the ability to move between realms, and he has come to this realm before. Unfortunately, I have no way to contact him, so I can only accept my fate."
"Zhang Fei?" Gu Tong nodded to Alder. "Is he a heavenly fox?"
"How... how do you know about him?"

Alder nodded to himself after he remembered Tian Gongzhu. "Those heavenly foxes had already come to this realm, and I think they were after Zhang Fei. I don't know about the relationship between them or the reason they were after him, but they seemed intent on killing him.

Since they already knew that he had come to this realm before, I'm sure they're monitoring this realm and yours, so he probably won't be able to save you anytime soon. Anyway, I still have other things to do, so I'll be leaving now, and you don't have to worry about my subordinates because they won't attack you.
Besides, there's a young man who previously came from your realm, and I'll ask him to meet you."

After Alder left, Gu Tong immediately lay down again, staring at the ceiling and thinking about his son and wife. "Zhan'er and Mei'er, it's impossible for me to see or protect you two again, especially if I turn into a demon later, so you two have to take good care of yourselves."

sentences.text: After they arrived at the floating castle, Feltia [2] immediately told Oz the first and Morgana about the situation in the Diyu Realm, especially about the people from the Tian Realm, who had begun to prepare to invade their realm.
He still had no information about the people from the Xian Realm, so he couldn't say anything about them.

However, he believed that their presence could bring peace and security to their realm, especially since both of them were demon cultivators, and the witch demon cultivation was in the seven divine realms.
"I will hand over this realm to the two of you, and I will focus on increasing my demon power in my tower."
"It's not a problem for us.
Furthermore, this realm is my husband's birthplace, and we will stay here for a long time, so we will protect it.
Although I cannot kill those people due to the rules you already know, I still have many abilities that can destroy them indirectly, so you don't have to think about them.

You can focus on your personal affairs, especially since you will face people who are stronger than them in the future, and you need high strength to fight them." Morgana then turned her gaze to the other demons and extended her right hand towards them.
Immediately, a black light shot out of her fingers and entered their bodies, causing them to experience a strange sensation.
"You guys have to accept it and spread it throughout your body, especially since it will gradually enhance your demon power, so you won't have any difficulty dealing with those people."
They immediately followed Morgana's words by absorbing and spreading them into their bodies.
Although they couldn't feel the effects directly, they could already feel slight changes in their bodies.
Morgana then gave them some demon items, all of which she brought from her origin realm.
"You guys can go back to your respective places to use them, and all of you will like their effects very much.
Anyway, Zhang Fei, you should bring Ursula with you, especially since they are demon cultivators now, and your yang qi will help them even more when combined with my items."

Feltia [2] had indeed thought about it, especially since Ursula's female essence was the highest among all the female demons he knew; even the Amaris Twins' female essence couldn't match theirs, so he planned to take them to the tower.
Both Ursula themselves didn't mind Morgana's idea, and they were actually looking forward to it, especially since they had realized many things after becoming demon cultivators.
Moreover, they had already swallowed Feltia[2]'s yang qi through the bottle several times, so they knew its potency."
After they talked about some other things, Feltia [2] immediately brought the Amaris Twins and Ursula away from the floating demon castle.
However, she did not immediately bring them back to the tower, especially since he still had a daily quest to kill 700 demons or demon beasts, so he wanted to finish it first with their help.
Oz the Second, Zygoz, and the other demon rulers also hurriedly left the ancient floating castle.
Meanwhile, Tharnon decides to return to the Endless Death, especially since he doesn't want to disturb his two masters from having fun.
Morgana then sat on her husband's lap and put her arms around his neck.
"Shall we start making a baby now, husband?"
Oz the first laughed at his wife's impatience, but he immediately carried Morgana like a princess and took her to the main room in the floating castle, where they began their sexual activities.

Zhang Fei [4] repeatedly used his nine cloud steps as he enveloped the three leaders of the natural races, but his speed was much faster than usual, especially since Oliver used his wind power to enhance his speed.
Beside them, the demon extermination sword continued to fly and cut down the flying demon beasts that kept attacking them.
He could have brought them away in an invisible state, but the daily quest required him to kill too many demons, and Feltia [2] would not be able to complete it alone.

Meanwhile, Elmyra used her pure light qi to protect the two leaders of the natural races, so the demon aura in the Netherworld Realm did not affect them too much, and she also helped Zhang Fei [4] to counterattack those demon beasts.
As for Yuhe, her abilities were related to water, so she couldn't do much to help them fight those demon beasts.
"How long will it take us to arrive in the western region?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] thought for a moment as he asked Mei to calculate the distance to that region from their location, and he then answered Yuhe.
"With my current speed, we should be able to arrive there in about five days.
Currently, my brother-in-law is not in a dangerous situation, but I don't know what will happen later, so I can only hope that he will be able to protect himself until we arrive at his location."
"Isn't five days more than enough for him to turn into a demon?" Yuhe once again asked Zhang Fei [4].
"No." Zhang Fei [4] responded with a shake of his head.
"Even though my brother-in-law has no protection now, he won't turn into a demon that quickly.
However, he will turn into a demon faster if he consumes the things in this realm, especially since they all contain demon energy."
The three nodded in understanding before Oliver asked.
"Have you ever turned humans into demons before?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed before nodding at Oliver.
"I've transformed quite a few humans into demons, both directly and indirectly, and all of them are my enemies.
Anyway, can you increase my speed faster than this, Grandpa?"
Oliver responded to Zhang Fei [4] by borrowing more power from the wind, increasing his speed even further.
"This way, we should be able to arrive at that region a day earlier than you estimated, and we can go directly to help the other two after we help your brother-in-law."
"Yes." However, Oliver's actions also caused Zhang Fei [4]'s qi to drain faster, so he started consuming qi recovery pills, especially since they didn't have time to rest.
At the Lust Inn, Orith sat in front of her subordinate with her chin propped up and her left leg crossed over the other.
She looked enthusiastic as she listened to Xenaya's story about Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially about their sexual activities over several days.
"Do you know where the young Incubus went?"
"My Lady, Elion told me that he wanted to train in the ghostveil forest, but he also said that he would go to another region after he finished training there, so I don't know where he is now."
"The ghostveil forest, huh?

Isn't that where Uncle Arbeola lives?" Orith immediately rushed to leave the inn for the forest, making Xenaya laugh bitterly, especially since she had already guessed that he would be interested in Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Before long, Orith had arrived at the ghostveil forest and went directly to meet Arbeola, but the old demon tree was not surprised by her arrival, especially since he had already expected that she would come to him right away after she learned about Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Are you looking for that young Incubus?"
"En." Orith nodded slightly, then asked.
"Do you know where he went, Uncle Arbeola?"
"That kid didn't tell me where he went, but he said that he will visit your city again soon, so you can wait for him there."
Orith was disappointed with Arbeola's answer, especially since she had never had a match in bed, so she was eager to meet Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Uncle, you must have known all the events in the demon emperor city, right?
Do you have any guesses about the whereabouts of our demon emperor?"
"Over there." Arbeola pointed one of his tree branches toward the center of their realm, and Orith immediately looked in that direction.
"I have communicated with all the trees in our realm, and the dead forest is the most suitable place for those people to hide our demon emperor, so I am confident that he is there.
However, you should not think to go there, especially since the formation they put in that place is powerful enough to mislead us, including demons at King or Queen rank can get out of there.
You will never be able to get out of there, and you will get lost in there for the rest of your life."
"What if I tell those higher-ups about this matter?"
"No." Arbeola immediately rejected Orith's idea.
"You should already know the strength of those people, right?
Do you think they would allow us to find the demon emperor so easily?
I'm sure they've put some other things in place to prevent that kind of thing from happening, so you'd better keep the information to yourself.
Furthermore, we cannot lose the demon higher-ups, as they will undoubtedly return to this realm in the future.
They should concentrate on preparing themselves for their next arrival.
Orith nodded in agreement and faced Arbeola again.
"Uncle, please let me know if that young incubus comes to you again."
'This little girl!
Her mind is only filled with sex!
After all, she is a lust demon, so it is only natural for her to behave like that.' Arbeola then nodded to Orith.
"All right, I will let you know right away if that kid comes again, and I will ask him to meet you."
"Thank you, Uncle."
Arbeola looked at Orith, who immediately flew away from his location.
"Compared to Ilsath and that crazy Thish, that little girl is much kinder than them, and that kid will probably like her when they meet later."

chapters.title: Chapter 438 Wasteland Realm
paragraphs: After the three Chu Sisters calmed down, Zhang Fei brought them back to the Chu Clan before taking them to his room. Chu Ying and Chu Qing immediately laid down on the bed and closed their eyes, especially since they were mentally exhausted by their father's death.

Unlike them, Chu Hong's death actually spurred Chu Xing's spirit to become stronger. "Brother-in-law, please send me into your training space now. It's useless for me to grieve over my father's death, so I want to train to forget my sadness, and I will kill those people with my own hands in the future. Oh! Please give me your yang qi."

Zhang Fei was taken aback for a moment by Chu Xing's request, but he then gave her a few bottles of his yang qi, especially since he had already given her the flawless Yin-Yang Art a long time ago, and he immediately sent her into the training space.
Zhang Fei then checked on the Chu Clan and found that they had returned to their respective rooms, and Liu Qingyu was alone in her room, so he rushed there to meet her.
"Qingyu."

"Come here, Fei'er." Liu Qingyu spoke while patting her side, and as soon as Zhang Fei sat down beside her, she immediately rested her head on his broad shoulder. "I heard your conversation with Aunt Chen before, and I myself am really sad about my husband's death. However, I want you to know that I never blamed you for his death, so you can stop blaming yourself.

Moreover, you have seen for yourself the situation in the demon cave before, and they could do nothing to retaliate against those traitors. If you weren't there and helped them, the demons from the Netherworld Realm would have returned to this realm, and they would have enslaved not only the seniors but also all the inhabitants of this realm."

Zhang Fei immediately pulled Liu Qingyu into his lap and hugged him tightly. "Even though I know the facts, I still regret my weakness. Some of them, including Chu Hong, had to die because I couldn't do anything to save them. Moreover, I made a promise to all of you that I would never cause you any sorrow, but today, his death has left you sad and your daughters miserable."

"Fei'er." Liu Qingyu called out while looking at him. "Human life and death are arranged by fate, remember? You are not a god, so you have no control over the life and death of others. Even if you manage to reach the peak of the cultivation world in the future, you will still never be able to do so.

Therefore, you should stop regretting everything that has happened and look forward to the long future ahead of you. Otherwise, your regrets will always weigh on your heart and hinder your development, and we don't want to see you like that."
"I know that, but—"

Liu Qingyu instantly sealed Zhang Fei's lips to stop him from speaking, and they kissed for a while before she separated their lips. She then rubbed his cheeks as she softly spoke. "Forget it, okay? My daughters and I are sad now, but we'll get through it soon, and everything will be fine again.

The only thing we can do now is strengthen ourselves, and we will continue to help each other to become as strong as possible together. When we are truly strong, we will go to the Red Sun Realm to make a calculation against Shang Huaqiang and his Shang Clan, and we will eradicate them down to their roots, so no one else will suffer because of them."

"You're right." Zhang Fei then carried Liu Qingyu to lie down on the bed, hugging her head to his chest. "Sooner or later, all of us will become truly strong, and I will take you to the Red Sun Realm to settle accounts with Shang Huaqiang in the future. At that point, we will destroy them, and the four of you can kill him with your own hands to avenge Chu Hong's death.
Since we don't have the strength to do that yet, I will start everything from Shang Yaolin, and she will be our pawn to destroy that clan."

Liu Qingyu immediately looked up at Zhang Fei. "You have to be careful when doing that, okay? Shang Yaolin is much stronger than you, especially with her cultivation in the seven divine realms, and she might kill you outright if she notices your action."

"Don't worry, okay? I definitely won't act rashly, and I'll do it gradually. That way, she won't notice my actions, and it'll be too late for her by the time she realizes it." Liu Qingyu immediately curled up in Zhang Fei's embrace, and she immediately closed her eyes to rest her tired mind, especially since she had been through a lot in two days. 'Mei, where's the elemental seed's closest location?'

[Master, the closest elemental seed can be found in Cyanwood Mountain, located in the Nine Stars Realm, a planet within the middle realms. According to the information provided by the woman, the realm is a month's journey from the Netherworld Realm. If you want to go there, then you have to depart from that demon realm, and you can use the Pandora Odyssey for that.]
'The Nine Stars Realm, huh?' Zhang Fei muttered inwardly to himself as he contemplated various aspects. 'What about the Wasteland Realm? Is that realm closer to the Nine Stars realm?'

[Master, I don't have any data about the Wasteland Realm yet, so I can't calculate the distance between the two realms. That's why you should wait for Zhang Xiaolong [3] to arrive at that realm first, after which I will directly map it out and provide you with an estimate of the distance between the two realms.]

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, but he immediately contacted Feng Yao and asked her about the distance between the Wasteland Realm and the Nine Stars Realm. However, her answer disappointed him, especially since she had never visited that realm, so she did not know the exact distance between the two.
'Zhang Xiaolong [3] will arrive at that realm in two days, so you can immediately map it once he arrives there, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]
'Anyway, did that woman also provide information on which elemental seed is in the Nine Stars Realm?'
[A low-rank lightning elemental seed, master.]

'A low-rank lightning elemental seed, huh?' Zhang Fei then sighed softly, especially since his chance of obtaining a new element would be too small if he only used a low-rank seed, which was only about twenty percent. Back then, he managed to obtain the wind element because Zefyr helped him fuse with the low-rank wind elemental seed, which increased his chance to one hundred percent.
As for the lightning element, he didn't have any acquaintances who possessed that element, so no one could help him.

Zhang Fei then asked Oliver through his fourth clone, but the fairy race leader told him that none of the fairy race members possessed the lightning element, and they only had other basic elements. 'Sigh! No matter what, I have to get the low-rank lightning elemental seed first, and I'll think of a solution to get the lightning element from it later.'
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 700 demons at Marquis rank or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 70,000 female essences were added to the balance.]
Zhang Fei ignored the notifications and closed his eyes to accompany Liu Qingyu to sleep, but he couldn't really fall asleep, especially since his mind was constantly occupied by various things.

After he finished the daily quest, Feltia [2] immediately took the female demons back to his sub-realm. Once they arrived at the tower, he immediately took them to the top of the tower, and he gave Ursula more of his yang qi, especially since they were still unwilling to do such things with him.
After that, he told Eve and the others to get ready, which excited them, and they started dual cultivating.

One female demon, who was none other than You Han, kept grumbling in her heart, especially since she had to watch them have fun all the time. Although she disliked Fetlia [2] because he was the one who sent her to the Diyu Realm and turned her into a demon, she was still a living creature with lust.

Their actions always aroused her, but he never paid her any attention, let alone invited her to join them. 'Sigh! At least the twins are no longer absorbing my demon power, so my condition can slowly recover. That way, I can leave this room, and I don't have to watch them like now.'
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 11,200 Qi.]
[Reward: 112 green jewels.]

At dawn, Zhang Fei was awakened from his sleep by the appearance of the notification, and he immediately woke up Liu Qingyu, who was still sleeping in his arms. After all, she had planned to hold a simple funeral ceremony for Chu Hong, and she had also ordered the people from the Chu Clan to dig a grave behind their clan.
As usual, Zhang Fei ignored the quest notification, and he let one of his clones take care of it.

Although they could not find his corpse, especially since they did not know in which realm Chu Hong died. Liu Qingyu intended to hold a funeral for her husband, and she used some of his important personal belongings to replace his corpse.

All members of the Chu and Liu Clans had gathered in the main hall, except for Chu Xing, who preferred to continue her training in the training space. Liu Qingyu and the others didn't mind her wishes, especially since they were familiar with her character, so they started Chu Hong's funeral ceremony without her.

After the funeral was over, Liu Qingyu and the others immediately buried Chu Hong's personal belongings behind the clan, and they also put up a painting of him in front of his grave. Unlike their mother, Chu Ying and Chu Qing still grieved over their father's death, and both of them continued to kneel in front of the grave, crying.
Zhang Fei naturally wouldn't leave his two wives like that, so he ignored everything else just to accompany Chu Ying and Chu Qing, kneeling between them while hugging both of them.

Meanwhile, Liu Rong asked her son, Liu Ming, to return to the Liu clan, especially since they had been absent from their clan for too long, so he had to return there, but she herself remained in the Chu clan to accompany her daughter and grandchildren.

Chu Liuxiang decided to bring Yuan Manqiu back to the eastern region, especially since his wife would continue to be sad if they continued to stay in the Chu Clan. She did not reject his wishes because she was fully aware of her own feelings.

All of Zhang Fei's wives and family members decided to return to their own residence, especially since they had been training in the training space for quite some time. So they decided to rest for a few days, waiting for him to be ready to enter seclusion again.

However, Liu Hua did not join them, so she went with the Wen Twins to take care of the people from the Demon Fox Group. She decided to divide the group members into several small groups, and she asked them to spread out throughout the region, including the Northern Region, especially since that region had been completely secured with the disappearance of those heretic clans.

Unlike them, Zhang Fei [1] and his partners did not leave the training space, and they remained focused on improving their cultivation inside the portable mansion. Feltia [2], aided by his fellow female demons, continues to concentrate on enhancing his demon power, disregarding any events within the tower, particularly since no significant events occur.

Even so, some of the female demons, such as Naeth and Kyllia, continued to report to him. You Han, who can now walk on her own, decides to leave their room, and she begins to live her new life as a dryad.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4] and the three leaders of the natural races continued their journey towards the western region without stopping, especially since time was ticking, and they were worried that Zhang Wuji had turned into a demon.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 12,200 Qi.]
[Reward: 122 green jewels.]

Another two days passed quickly, and Shang Chenguang's flying artifact slowly flew closer to a realm. Shang Yaolin then carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the front of the flying artifact, and the two of them looked towards the Wasteland Realm. They could see a tall mountain rising from the center of the realm, and more than half of it was ocean, with four islands stretching on all four sides.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Wasteland Realm, and the host can access it through Gate in the future.]

As soon as the flying artifact entered the Wasteland Realm, Shang Yaolin immediately pointed her index figure to the front. "Can you see the mountain, Long'er? That is a fortress, but it is also the residence of the natives of this realm.

In the past, they inhabited almost all the islands in this realm, with the exception of the western island, which is home to the demihumans, who have a strong dislike for humans. However, the senior cultivators from the upper realms relocated most of them to other realms, with the intention of using this realm as a punishment ground for the members of their clans.
Since then, those who didn't want to leave stayed on that mountain, and the senior cultivators from the upper realms continued to protect them, including some people from my clan."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was no longer surprised by this, especially since Feng Yao had explained everything to him. However, he was curious about the eastern island, particularly Tiangou's existence there, and he was eager to meet him. 'Mei, start mapping this realm.'
[Yes, Master.]

Shang Yaolin then told Zhang Xiaolong [3] about each island, and she also told him about the people from the upper realms who lived on the northern island, especially about their identities and clans.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised because there were hundreds of clans living on the northern island, but the island itself was indeed very large, which was like the combination of the western and eastern regions in the Sky Jade Realm, so it was truly vast. "What about the island to the east, Big Sis?"
"Are you interested in the eastern island, Long'er?" Shang Guangming asked as he approached them. "You are a beast, so you should be able to feel the presence of many beasts on that island, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong[3] nodded to Shang Guangming. "Not only can I feel that there are so many beasts on the island, but I can also feel the presence of a powerful beast on the island, and it seems to be much stronger than my father."

"Haha." Shang Guangming laughed and rubbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s head. "You're still this small, but your beast instincts are really sharp. Anyway, you're right about that; a powerful beast named Tiangou lives on the eastern island, and he is the protector of the beast races on the island. That's the reason why humans, demihumans, and demons in this realm don't dare to approach the island.
However, you should refrain from going there, especially at night. During the day, he is very kind and will not attack anyone, but he will become fierce at night, and he will definitely attack you."

"En, I understand, big brother. I'm still young, so I don't want to seek death by going to the eastern island, and I'll spend my time with you two." Shang Yaolin smiled happily as he hugged him, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately tried to absorb the Qi in the Wasteland Realm. 'Dang!

The difference in quantity and quality of Qi between the lower and middle realms is truly significant, and if I stay in this realm, I can definitely cultivate faster. Unfortunately, I can't bring them to this realm now, but I'll find a way to bring them here soon.'

sentences.text: After the three Chu Sisters calmed down, Zhang Fei brought them back to the Chu Clan before taking them to his room.
Chu Ying and Chu Qing immediately laid down on the bed and closed their eyes, especially since they were mentally exhausted by their father's death.
Unlike them, Chu Hong's death actually spurred Chu Xing's spirit to become stronger.
"Brother-in-law, please send me into your training space now.
It's useless for me to grieve over my father's death, so I want to train to forget my sadness, and I will kill those people with my own hands in the future.
Oh!
Please give me your yang qi."

Zhang Fei was taken aback for a moment by Chu Xing's request, but he then gave her a few bottles of his yang qi, especially since he had already given her the flawless Yin-Yang Art a long time ago, and he immediately sent her into the training space.
Zhang Fei then checked on the Chu Clan and found that they had returned to their respective rooms, and Liu Qingyu was alone in her room, so he rushed there to meet her.
"Qingyu."
"Come here, Fei'er." Liu Qingyu spoke while patting her side, and as soon as Zhang Fei sat down beside her, she immediately rested her head on his broad shoulder.
"I heard your conversation with Aunt Chen before, and I myself am really sad about my husband's death.
However, I want you to know that I never blamed you for his death, so you can stop blaming yourself.
Moreover, you have seen for yourself the situation in the demon cave before, and they could do nothing to retaliate against those traitors.

If you weren't there and helped them, the demons from the Netherworld Realm would have returned to this realm, and they would have enslaved not only the seniors but also all the inhabitants of this realm."
Zhang Fei immediately pulled Liu Qingyu into his lap and hugged him tightly.
"Even though I know the facts, I still regret my weakness.
Some of them, including Chu Hong, had to die because I couldn't do anything to save them.
Moreover, I made a promise to all of you that I would never cause you any sorrow, but today, his death has left you sad and your daughters miserable."
"Fei'er." Liu Qingyu called out while looking at him.
"Human life and death are arranged by fate, remember?
You are not a god, so you have no control over the life and death of others.
Even if you manage to reach the peak of the cultivation world in the future, you will still never be able to do so.
Therefore, you should stop regretting everything that has happened and look forward to the long future ahead of you.
Otherwise, your regrets will always weigh on your heart and hinder your development, and we don't want to see you like that."
"I know that, but—"
Liu Qingyu instantly sealed Zhang Fei's lips to stop him from speaking, and they kissed for a while before she separated their lips.
She then rubbed his cheeks as she softly spoke.
"Forget it, okay?
My daughters and I are sad now, but we'll get through it soon, and everything will be fine again.
The only thing we can do now is strengthen ourselves, and we will continue to help each other to become as strong as possible together.

When we are truly strong, we will go to the Red Sun Realm to make a calculation against Shang Huaqiang and his Shang Clan, and we will eradicate them down to their roots, so no one else will suffer because of them."
"You're right." Zhang Fei then carried Liu Qingyu to lie down on the bed, hugging her head to his chest.
"Sooner or later, all of us will become truly strong, and I will take you to the Red Sun Realm to settle accounts with Shang Huaqiang in the future.
At that point, we will destroy them, and the four of you can kill him with your own hands to avenge Chu Hong's death.
Since we don't have the strength to do that yet, I will start everything from Shang Yaolin, and she will be our pawn to destroy that clan."
Liu Qingyu immediately looked up at Zhang Fei.
"You have to be careful when doing that, okay?
Shang Yaolin is much stronger than you, especially with her cultivation in the seven divine realms, and she might kill you outright if she notices your action."
"Don't worry, okay?
I definitely won't act rashly, and I'll do it gradually.

That way, she won't notice my actions, and it'll be too late for her by the time she realizes it." Liu Qingyu immediately curled up in Zhang Fei's embrace, and she immediately closed her eyes to rest her tired mind, especially since she had been through a lot in two days. 'Mei, where's the elemental seed's closest location?'
[Master, the closest elemental seed can be found in Cyanwood Mountain, located in the Nine Stars Realm, a planet within the middle realms.
According to the information provided by the woman, the realm is a month's journey from the Netherworld Realm.
If you want to go there, then you have to depart from that demon realm, and you can use the Pandora Odyssey for that.]
'The Nine Stars Realm, huh?' Zhang Fei muttered inwardly to himself as he contemplated various aspects. 'What about the Wasteland Realm?
Is that realm closer to the Nine Stars realm?'
[Master, I don't have any data about the Wasteland Realm yet, so I can't calculate the distance between the two realms.
That's why you should wait for Zhang Xiaolong [3] to arrive at that realm first, after which I will directly map it out and provide you with an estimate of the distance between the two realms.]
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, but he immediately contacted Feng Yao and asked her about the distance between the Wasteland Realm and the Nine Stars Realm.
However, her answer disappointed him, especially since she had never visited that realm, so she did not know the exact distance between the two.
'Zhang Xiaolong [3] will arrive at that realm in two days, so you can immediately map it once he arrives there, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]
'Anyway, did that woman also provide information on which elemental seed is in the Nine Stars Realm?'
[A low-rank lightning elemental seed, master.]

'A low-rank lightning elemental seed, huh?' Zhang Fei then sighed softly, especially since his chance of obtaining a new element would be too small if he only used a low-rank seed, which was only about twenty percent.
Back then, he managed to obtain the wind element because Zefyr helped him fuse with the low-rank wind elemental seed, which increased his chance to one hundred percent.
As for the lightning element, he didn't have any acquaintances who possessed that element, so no one could help him.

Zhang Fei then asked Oliver through his fourth clone, but the fairy race leader told him that none of the fairy race members possessed the lightning element, and they only had other basic elements. 'Sigh!
No matter what, I have to get the low-rank lightning elemental seed first, and I'll think of a solution to get the lightning element from it later.'
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 700 demons at Marquis rank or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 70,000 female essences were added to the balance.]
Zhang Fei ignored the notifications and closed his eyes to accompany Liu Qingyu to sleep, but he couldn't really fall asleep, especially since his mind was constantly occupied by various things.
After he finished the daily quest, Feltia [2] immediately took the female demons back to his sub-realm.
Once they arrived at the tower, he immediately took them to the top of the tower, and he gave Ursula more of his yang qi, especially since they were still unwilling to do such things with him.
After that, he told Eve and the others to get ready, which excited them, and they started dual cultivating.
One female demon, who was none other than You Han, kept grumbling in her heart, especially since she had to watch them have fun all the time.
Although she disliked Fetlia [2] because he was the one who sent her to the Diyu Realm and turned her into a demon, she was still a living creature with lust.
Their actions always aroused her, but he never paid her any attention, let alone invited her to join them. 'Sigh!
At least the twins are no longer absorbing my demon power, so my condition can slowly recover.
That way, I can leave this room, and I don't have to watch them like now.'
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 11,200 Qi.]
[Reward: 112 green jewels.]
At dawn, Zhang Fei was awakened from his sleep by the appearance of the notification, and he immediately woke up Liu Qingyu, who was still sleeping in his arms.
After all, she had planned to hold a simple funeral ceremony for Chu Hong, and she had also ordered the people from the Chu Clan to dig a grave behind their clan.
As usual, Zhang Fei ignored the quest notification, and he let one of his clones take care of it.
Although they could not find his corpse, especially since they did not know in which realm Chu Hong died.
Liu Qingyu intended to hold a funeral for her husband, and she used some of his important personal belongings to replace his corpse.
All members of the Chu and Liu Clans had gathered in the main hall, except for Chu Xing, who preferred to continue her training in the training space.
Liu Qingyu and the others didn't mind her wishes, especially since they were familiar with her character, so they started Chu Hong's funeral ceremony without her.
After the funeral was over, Liu Qingyu and the others immediately buried Chu Hong's personal belongings behind the clan, and they also put up a painting of him in front of his grave.
Unlike their mother, Chu Ying and Chu Qing still grieved over their father's death, and both of them continued to kneel in front of the grave, crying.
Zhang Fei naturally wouldn't leave his two wives like that, so he ignored everything else just to accompany Chu Ying and Chu Qing, kneeling between them while hugging both of them.

Chu Liuxiang decided to bring Yuan Manqiu back to the eastern region, especially since his wife would continue to be sad if they continued to stay in the Chu Clan.

All of Zhang Fei's wives and family members decided to return to their own residence, especially since they had been training in the training space for quite some time.

However, Liu Hua did not join them, so she went with the Wen Twins to take care of the people from the Demon Fox Group.

She decided to divide the group members into several small groups, and she asked them to spread out throughout the region, including the Northern Region, especially since that region had been completely secured with the disappearance of those heretic clans.
Unlike them, Zhang Fei [1] and his partners did not leave the training space, and they remained focused on improving their cultivation inside the portable mansion.
Feltia [2], aided by his fellow female demons, continues to concentrate on enhancing his demon power, disregarding any events within the tower, particularly since no significant events occur.
Even so, some of the female demons, such as Naeth and Kyllia, continued to report to him.
You Han, who can now walk on her own, decides to leave their room, and she begins to live her new life as a dryad.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4] and the three leaders of the natural races continued their journey towards the western region without stopping, especially since time was ticking, and they were worried that Zhang Wuji had turned into a demon.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 12,200 Qi.]
[Reward: 122 green jewels.]
Another two days passed quickly, and Shang Chenguang's flying artifact slowly flew closer to a realm.
Shang Yaolin then carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the front of the flying artifact, and the two of them looked towards the Wasteland Realm.
They could see a tall mountain rising from the center of the realm, and more than half of it was ocean, with four islands stretching on all four sides.

"Can you see the mountain, Long'er?
That is a fortress, but it is also the residence of the natives of this realm.
In the past, they inhabited almost all the islands in this realm, with the exception of the western island, which is home to the demihumans, who have a strong dislike for humans.
However, the senior cultivators from the upper realms relocated most of them to other realms, with the intention of using this realm as a punishment ground for the members of their clans.

chapters.title: Chapter 439 Shang Yingyue
paragraphs: Before long, they had landed in front of the fortress, especially since they had to report to their senior first. Shang Chenguang immediately brought the three of them down, storing his flying artifact before leading them into the fortress.

Unlike Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming, who looked calm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked anxious, especially since he could feel too many strong pressures from within the fortress, including the two young men who were in charge of guarding the gate.

From the system scan, he knew their names were Huang Fujian and Hao Shihai, and he could also see that their cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Expansion Realm, which was more than enough to fend off the cultivators who lived in the Wasteland Realm.

'People from the upper realms are truly terrifying! These two men's cultivation was already so high, but they were only hired to be gatekeepers, so the status gap of everyone there was really big.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly muttered as he checked the names of the people that appeared on his map, especially those who lived in the middle part of the mountain.

'They are people from clans in the upper realms, huh? All of them were truly strong, but the strongest among them had cultivation at the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm, and most of them were at the 5-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm, which meant that they were stronger than Feng Yao.'

The two guards allowed them to enter after Shang Chenguang showed them his identity, so he immediately led Zhang Shang Guangming and the others to the middle area of the mountain. However, the two men continued to look at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was in Shang Yaolin's arms, especially since he was still in his black half-fox form.

'Hey! Where did those people from the Shang Clan find that fox kid? Furthermore, the fox kid's appearance resembles that of a demon fox, and I sense a subtle demonic aura from him.' Huang Fujian asked his partner as he narrowed his eyes towards Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Hao Shiai shook his head in response, but he himself was also curious about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s identity, especially since he could also sense a faint demonic aura from him. 'I think we should convey that kid's presence to our clan members so they can investigate his identity, especially since we can't leave this gate.'
Huang Fujian agreed with that, and they immediately contacted several members of their clans, informing them about Zhang Xiaolong [3].

As they climbed to the middle of the mountain, the natives from the Wasteland Realm repeatedly glanced at them, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] could see the hatred in their eyes. After all, the realm was their ancestral land, and they had previously been able to live freely before the cultivators from the upper realm took over their realm by force.

They chose to stay because they genuinely loved their ancestral land and found it difficult to leave, unlike those natives who were willing to relocate. Although the cultivators from the upper realms allowed them to stay, they could no longer live freely like in the past, and they had to live in confinement behind high walls, especially since they kept sending evil people into their realm.

Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others had arrived at a large building in the middle area of the mountain, and Shang Chenguang immediately led them inside, where the representatives of all the clans lived together.
Shang Chenguang then led them into one of the rooms, where a young woman was already waiting for them, especially since she had already informed him of their arrival.

The young woman was not pretty, and her oval face was too ordinary, but she had an extraordinarily alluring tall figure covered by a bluish white dress. Her long black hair is left loose with the back held up by a white feathered hairpin, and her two side bangs hang down to her chest.

Her expression is too serious, her eyes are sharp with brown pupils, her cheeks are a bit chubby, and her chin is a bit pointy. Her neck is smooth and long, her F-cup breasts drape across her chest, her waist is slim, her hips are wide, and her buttocks protrude at the back.
'Scan this woman, Mei.'
[Alrighty!]
Name: Shang Yingyue
Age: 1000+ years old
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Manifestation
Elements: Earth [intermediate stage], Ice [advanced stage]
Core: Upper-Rank Earth Core, Upper-Rank Ice Core
Physique: Human physique
Special physique: None
Special bloodline: None
Partner: Wu Xueming
Likes: Wu Xueming, Wu Lianzhi, Shang Yinghao.
Dislikes: Shang Xishun, Shang Gaoting, Wu Qingxue.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took a deep breath after he read Shang Yingyue's status, especially since her cultivation was several minor stages above Feng Yao's, and she even had two elements. 'Tch! I have to be cautious around this woman, or she'll kill me if I act suspiciously.'
[Hahaha! You're not acting like you usually do, master. Normally, you're not afraid of women, but now, you're afraid of Shang Yingyue.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately protested to Mei. 'Hey! The women I've met so far aren't as strong as Shang Yingyue, so they can't compare to her, and she can kill me before I even blink.'

[Well, that's true. However, this woman is still an ordinary woman, and she is nothing special compared to a phoenix like Feng Yao. I am confident that your demon abilities will have an impact on her, so there's no need to fear her. Instead, you can use your demon pheromone to make her fall for you.
Unfortunately, the difference in your cultivation is like heaven and earth now, so her yin qi is too strong for the current you, and your body won't be able to absorb it.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head slightly after hearing that, but he did not refute Mei's words. Even so, he wouldn't act rashly by doing such things to Shang Yingyue, especially since she was too strong.

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked because Shang Yingyue was suddenly standing in front of him, and she immediately grabbed the back of his collar before lifting him from Shang Yaolin's embrace. "A mix breed between an ordinary fox beast and a demon fox, huh? Where did you find this kid? Why did you bring such a small kid to this realm? Have you forgotten about the climate in this realm?

I admit, this kid is special because his cultivation has already reached the 6-Star Soul Realm, but he will not be able to survive the unpredictable climate in this realm, and he will probably die in a few days."

Sheng Chenguang and the others laughed in their hearts because Shang Yingyue regarded Zhang Xiaolong [3] as an ordinary fox beast, but they also felt relieved because she couldn't recognize that he was a heavenly fox. "We found him in the Netherworld Realm, and Yaolin is very fond of this kid, so I purposely brought him here to accompany her in serving her punishment.
Anyway, you don't have to worry about him, and I'm sure he won't have any issues with the unpredictable climate in this realm."

"Up to you then." Shang Yingyue then returned Zhang Xiaolong [3] to Shang Yaolin. "I have heard of your failure in the Netherworld Realm, and our patriarch is truly furious that his hundreds of years of planning have miserably failed; even the portal connecting that realm with the Sky Jade Realm has been destroyed now.
That's why he asked me to punish you both severely, so you should be prepared to face it for the next hundred years, and I will never be merciful to you."

Shang Yingyue's words caused Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming to smile bitterly, but Shang Chenguang immediately tried to persuade her to give them some leeway, especially since they were his nephew and niece, and he didn't want them to suffer too severely.

Unfortunately, Shang Yingyue immediately rejected Shang Chenguang, and she even threatened him. "I know that they are your family, and I respect you as a senior. However, you know our patriarch's character, so I must reject your request and punish them according to his orders. If you want to beg for leniency for them, then you can beg him, and I will give them leniency if he agrees to it."

Shang Chenguang wanted to plead with Shang Yingyue again, but Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming immediately stopped him, especially since they were sure that he would report it to their patriarch, and he would punish him as well if he found out about it.
Shang Chenguang released a heavy sigh and nodded to Shang Yingyue. "In that case, I will entrust them to you, and I will return to the Red Sun Realm directly."

After that, Shang Chenguang immediately walked to the back room, especially since there was a portal there that connected the Wasteland to the Red Sun Realm directly, so he could return there directly.

Shang Yingyue then took Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming to the northern island because their Shang Clan residence was there, but they didn't need to leave the fortress to go there. They only needed to go to the northern part of the mountain, especially since the walls surrounded the entire mountain, and there were four gates connecting to each island on the four sides.

"Yow! Aren't you guys Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming? I didn't expect to see you two in this realm! It seems like you two have failed your task, huh?" A young man with spiky red hair immediately spoke to them sarcastically as soon as he saw them, but his gaze suddenly fell on Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Huh? You two even brought a demon fox kid from that realm, huh?
Unfortunately, he won't be able to last long in this realm, and I'm sure that he won't be able to see the sunrise tomorrow."

'Tch! This bastard underestimates me too much!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] cursed inwardly before asking Mei to scan his status. 'Shang Wuzi, huh? His cultivation is in the 5-Moon Divine Expansion realm, similar to Yaolin and Guangming, and he is definitely not a good person, so I have to be wary of him.'
*Smack*
"Ouch!" Shang Wuzi screamed loudly and looked at Shang Yingyue. "Why did you hit my head that hard, Senior Yingyue?"

"Shut up!" Shang Yingyue glared as she released a bit of her aura to suppress Shang Wuzi, and then she pointed in another direction. "You better go there quickly and help the others mine those crystals! Otherwise, I will increase your working hours, and you will work in the mine for a whole week without eating."
"No! Don't do that, Senior Yingyue! I'll help them right now!" Shang Wuzi immediately hastily fled away.

Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming laughed at that, but they immediately shut their mouths when Shang Yingyue glared at them, and they hurriedly followed her into their residence. She then explained to them the place's rules, including their duties and working hours.

Shang Guangming sighed heavily in his heart because Shang Yingyue ordered him to work in the crystal mine like Shang Wuzi and the others, but he did not dare to refuse her order, so he immediately took the tools and went into the mine.

Even though Shang Yingyue didn't order her to work in the mines like her brother, Shang Yaolin still felt annoyed because she ordered her to do household chores, such as sweeping and cleaning their residence. After all, her status in their clan was quite high, so she never did such rough work, and the servants usually did such works for them.

"Anyway, there are dozens of women from our clan in this residence, but most of them are much older and stronger than you, so you'd better listen to their words, especially Shang Xiaoyin." Shang Yaolin frowned immediately after Shang Yingyue mentioned that name. "You should still remember her character, right?
That brute girl doesn't like it when people contradict her, so you have to be careful of her, or she'll bully you endlessly, and you'll be the one to suffer."

After that, Shang Yingyue immediately left the residence and returned to her private quarters, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked Shang Yaolin, who led him to an empty room. "Who is that Shang Xiaoyin, Big Sis? Why do you seem afraid of her?"
"Honestly, I am not afraid of Shang Xiaoyin, especially since her cultivation is not higher than mine.

However, her status is higher than mine in our Shang Clan because she is our patriarch's niece, and she is also a body cultivator, so her physique is really strong." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised by Shang Yaolin's answer, especially since he had never met a body cultivator in the Sky Jade Realm. "Don't you know about body cultivators?"
"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Shang Yaolin. "My father hasn't explained too much about the cultivation world, so I still have little knowledge about many things."

"I see." Shang Yaolin then took Zhang Xiaolong [3] to sit on the bed. "In the world of cultivation, there are various cultivation paths: the ordinary path, the dual cultivation path, the sword path, the soul path, the body path, and several others. I am classified as an ordinary cultivator, particularly due to my lack of talent in other paths, while you are a dual cultivator.

Sword cultivators, who solely concentrate on swordsmanship, are those who follow the sword path. People who choose the soul path are soul cultivators, and all their abilities are related to the soul. Shang Xiaoyin chose the body path; therefore, she is a body cultivator."

"Do you know about how to become a body cultivator and the stages of body cultivation, Big Sis?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] curiously asked, especially since he had no information about them. Moreover, he felt that the body path would be very suitable for him, so he wanted to know how to become a body cultivator.

"Are you interested in body cultivation?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded to Shang Yaolin with a nod. "Unfortunately, I have never studied body cultivation, so I cannot tell you anything about it. Although my brother is not as expert as Shang Xiaoyin in that path, he is still a body cultivator, so he must have a lot of information about it, and you can ask him after he comes back from the mines."
"All right, I will ask Big Brother later."

Shang Yaolin smiled and walked over to the wardrobe in the room, and she immediately changed her dress into the worker's uniform that was already provided inside. "I will start working on my assignment, so you better not go anywhere and wait for me in this room. Do you understand?"

"Yes." After Shang Yaolin left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately laid on the bed, opened his map, and began searching for the locations of the Shang Clan members, particularly Shang Xiaoyin. He found her with many other women in a bathhouse, and he immediately checked their identities one by one.
After that, he directed his focus to the crystal mine, especially since he was curious about those crystals. 'Sigh! I'll wait for them to come back, and I'll try asking them about those crystals.'
