Shang Chenguang immediately brought the three of them down, storing his flying artifact before leading them into the fortress.

Unlike Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming, who looked calm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked anxious, especially since he could feel too many strong pressures from within the fortress, including the two young men who were in charge of guarding the gate.

From the system scan, he knew their names were Huang Fujian and Hao Shihai, and he could also see that their cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Expansion Realm, which was more than enough to fend off the cultivators who lived in the Wasteland Realm.
'People from the upper realms are truly terrifying!

These two men's cultivation was already so high, but they were only hired to be gatekeepers, so the status gap of everyone there was really big.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly muttered as he checked the names of the people that appeared on his map, especially those who lived in the middle part of the mountain.
'They are people from clans in the upper realms, huh?

All of them were truly strong, but the strongest among them had cultivation at the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm, and most of them were at the 5-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm, which meant that they were stronger than Feng Yao.'
The two guards allowed them to enter after Shang Chenguang showed them his identity, so he immediately led Zhang Shang Guangming and the others to the middle area of the mountain.
However, the two men continued to look at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was in Shang Yaolin's arms, especially since he was still in his black half-fox form.
'Hey!
Where did those people from the Shang Clan find that fox kid?
Furthermore, the fox kid's appearance resembles that of a demon fox, and I sense a subtle demonic aura from him.' Huang Fujian asked his partner as he narrowed his eyes towards Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Hao Shiai shook his head in response, but he himself was also curious about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s identity, especially since he could also sense a faint demonic aura from him. 'I think we should convey that kid's presence to our clan members so they can investigate his identity, especially since we can't leave this gate.'
Huang Fujian agreed with that, and they immediately contacted several members of their clans, informing them about Zhang Xiaolong [3].
As they climbed to the middle of the mountain, the natives from the Wasteland Realm repeatedly glanced at them, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] could see the hatred in their eyes.
After all, the realm was their ancestral land, and they had previously been able to live freely before the cultivators from the upper realm took over their realm by force.
They chose to stay because they genuinely loved their ancestral land and found it difficult to leave, unlike those natives who were willing to relocate.

Although the cultivators from the upper realms allowed them to stay, they could no longer live freely like in the past, and they had to live in confinement behind high walls, especially since they kept sending evil people into their realm.

Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others had arrived at a large building in the middle area of the mountain, and Shang Chenguang immediately led them inside, where the representatives of all the clans lived together.
Shang Chenguang then led them into one of the rooms, where a young woman was already waiting for them, especially since she had already informed him of their arrival.
The young woman was not pretty, and her oval face was too ordinary, but she had an extraordinarily alluring tall figure covered by a bluish white dress.
Her long black hair is left loose with the back held up by a white feathered hairpin, and her two side bangs hang down to her chest.
Her expression is too serious, her eyes are sharp with brown pupils, her cheeks are a bit chubby, and her chin is a bit pointy.
Her neck is smooth and long, her F-cup breasts drape across her chest, her waist is slim, her hips are wide, and her buttocks protrude at the back.
'Scan this woman, Mei.'
[Alrighty!]
Name: Shang Yingyue
Age: 1000+ years old
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Manifestation
Elements: Earth [intermediate stage], Ice [advanced stage]
Core: Upper-Rank Earth Core, Upper-Rank Ice Core
Physique: Human physique
Special physique: None
Special bloodline: None
Partner: Wu Xueming
Likes: Wu Xueming, Wu Lianzhi, Shang Yinghao.
Dislikes: Shang Xishun, Shang Gaoting, Wu Qingxue.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took a deep breath after he read Shang Yingyue's status, especially since her cultivation was several minor stages above Feng Yao's, and she even had two elements. 'Tch!
I have to be cautious around this woman, or she'll kill me if I act suspiciously.'
[Hahaha!
You're not acting like you usually do, master.
Normally, you're not afraid of women, but now, you're afraid of Shang Yingyue.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately protested to Mei. 'Hey!
The women I've met so far aren't as strong as Shang Yingyue, so they can't compare to her, and she can kill me before I even blink.'
[Well, that's true.
However, this woman is still an ordinary woman, and she is nothing special compared to a phoenix like Feng Yao.
I am confident that your demon abilities will have an impact on her, so there's no need to fear her.
Instead, you can use your demon pheromone to make her fall for you.
Unfortunately, the difference in your cultivation is like heaven and earth now, so her yin qi is too strong for the current you, and your body won't be able to absorb it.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head slightly after hearing that, but he did not refute Mei's words.
Even so, he wouldn't act rashly by doing such things to Shang Yingyue, especially since she was too strong.
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked because Shang Yingyue was suddenly standing in front of him, and she immediately grabbed the back of his collar before lifting him from Shang Yaolin's embrace.
"A mix breed between an ordinary fox beast and a demon fox, huh?
Where did you find this kid?
Why did you bring such a small kid to this realm?
Have you forgotten about the climate in this realm?

I admit, this kid is special because his cultivation has already reached the 6-Star Soul Realm, but he will not be able to survive the unpredictable climate in this realm, and he will probably die in a few days."

Sheng Chenguang and the others laughed in their hearts because Shang Yingyue regarded Zhang Xiaolong [3] as an ordinary fox beast, but they also felt relieved because she couldn't recognize that he was a heavenly fox.
"We found him in the Netherworld Realm, and Yaolin is very fond of this kid, so I purposely brought him here to accompany her in serving her punishment.
Anyway, you don't have to worry about him, and I'm sure he won't have any issues with the unpredictable climate in this realm."
"Up to you then." Shang Yingyue then returned Zhang Xiaolong [3] to Shang Yaolin.

"I have heard of your failure in the Netherworld Realm, and our patriarch is truly furious that his hundreds of years of planning have miserably failed; even the portal connecting that realm with the Sky Jade Realm has been destroyed now.
That's why he asked me to punish you both severely, so you should be prepared to face it for the next hundred years, and I will never be merciful to you."

Shang Yingyue's words caused Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming to smile bitterly, but Shang Chenguang immediately tried to persuade her to give them some leeway, especially since they were his nephew and niece, and he didn't want them to suffer too severely.
Unfortunately, Shang Yingyue immediately rejected Shang Chenguang, and she even threatened him.
"I know that they are your family, and I respect you as a senior.
However, you know our patriarch's character, so I must reject your request and punish them according to his orders.
If you want to beg for leniency for them, then you can beg him, and I will give them leniency if he agrees to it."

Shang Chenguang wanted to plead with Shang Yingyue again, but Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming immediately stopped him, especially since they were sure that he would report it to their patriarch, and he would punish him as well if he found out about it.
Shang Chenguang released a heavy sigh and nodded to Shang Yingyue.
"In that case, I will entrust them to you, and I will return to the Red Sun Realm directly."

After that, Shang Chenguang immediately walked to the back room, especially since there was a portal there that connected the Wasteland to the Red Sun Realm directly, so he could return there directly.
Shang Yingyue then took Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming to the northern island because their Shang Clan residence was there, but they didn't need to leave the fortress to go there.
They only needed to go to the northern part of the mountain, especially since the walls surrounded the entire mountain, and there were four gates connecting to each island on the four sides.
"Yow!
Aren't you guys Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming?
I didn't expect to see you two in this realm!
It seems like you two have failed your task, huh?" A young man with spiky red hair immediately spoke to them sarcastically as soon as he saw them, but his gaze suddenly fell on Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Huh?
You two even brought a demon fox kid from that realm, huh?
Unfortunately, he won't be able to last long in this realm, and I'm sure that he won't be able to see the sunrise tomorrow."
'Tch!
This bastard underestimates me too much!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] cursed inwardly before asking Mei to scan his status. 'Shang Wuzi, huh?
His cultivation is in the 5-Moon Divine Expansion realm, similar to Yaolin and Guangming, and he is definitely not a good person, so I have to be wary of him.'
*Smack*
"Ouch!" Shang Wuzi screamed loudly and looked at Shang Yingyue.
"Why did you hit my head that hard, Senior Yingyue?"
"Shut up!" Shang Yingyue glared as she released a bit of her aura to suppress Shang Wuzi, and then she pointed in another direction.
"You better go there quickly and help the others mine those crystals!
Otherwise, I will increase your working hours, and you will work in the mine for a whole week without eating."
"No!
Don't do that, Senior Yingyue!
I'll help them right now!" Shang Wuzi immediately hastily fled away.
Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming laughed at that, but they immediately shut their mouths when Shang Yingyue glared at them, and they hurriedly followed her into their residence.
She then explained to them the place's rules, including their duties and working hours.

Shang Guangming sighed heavily in his heart because Shang Yingyue ordered him to work in the crystal mine like Shang Wuzi and the others, but he did not dare to refuse her order, so he immediately took the tools and went into the mine.

Even though Shang Yingyue didn't order her to work in the mines like her brother, Shang Yaolin still felt annoyed because she ordered her to do household chores, such as sweeping and cleaning their residence.
After all, her status in their clan was quite high, so she never did such rough work, and the servants usually did such works for them.

"Anyway, there are dozens of women from our clan in this residence, but most of them are much older and stronger than you, so you'd better listen to their words, especially Shang Xiaoyin." Shang Yaolin frowned immediately after Shang Yingyue mentioned that name.
"You should still remember her character, right?
That brute girl doesn't like it when people contradict her, so you have to be careful of her, or she'll bully you endlessly, and you'll be the one to suffer."
After that, Shang Yingyue immediately left the residence and returned to her private quarters, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked Shang Yaolin, who led him to an empty room.
"Who is that Shang Xiaoyin, Big Sis?
Why do you seem afraid of her?"
"Honestly, I am not afraid of Shang Xiaoyin, especially since her cultivation is not higher than mine.

However, her status is higher than mine in our Shang Clan because she is our patriarch's niece, and she is also a body cultivator, so her physique is really strong." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised by Shang Yaolin's answer, especially since he had never met a body cultivator in the Sky Jade Realm.
"Don't you know about body cultivators?"
"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Shang Yaolin.
"My father hasn't explained too much about the cultivation world, so I still have little knowledge about many things."
"I see." Shang Yaolin then took Zhang Xiaolong [3] to sit on the bed.
"In the world of cultivation, there are various cultivation paths: the ordinary path, the dual cultivation path, the sword path, the soul path, the body path, and several others.
I am classified as an ordinary cultivator, particularly due to my lack of talent in other paths, while you are a dual cultivator.
Sword cultivators, who solely concentrate on swordsmanship, are those who follow the sword path.
People who choose the soul path are soul cultivators, and all their abilities are related to the soul.
Shang Xiaoyin chose the body path; therefore, she is a body cultivator."
"Do you know about how to become a body cultivator and the stages of body cultivation, Big Sis?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] curiously asked, especially since he had no information about them.
Moreover, he felt that the body path would be very suitable for him, so he wanted to know how to become a body cultivator.
"Are you interested in body cultivation?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded to Shang Yaolin with a nod.
"Unfortunately, I have never studied body cultivation, so I cannot tell you anything about it.

Although my brother is not as expert as Shang Xiaoyin in that path, he is still a body cultivator, so he must have a lot of information about it, and you can ask him after he comes back from the mines."
"All right, I will ask Big Brother later."
Shang Yaolin smiled and walked over to the wardrobe in the room, and she immediately changed her dress into the worker's uniform that was already provided inside.
"I will start working on my assignment, so you better not go anywhere and wait for me in this room.
Do you understand?"
"Yes." After Shang Yaolin left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately laid on the bed, opened his map, and began searching for the locations of the Shang Clan members, particularly Shang Xiaoyin.
He found her with many other women in a bathhouse, and he immediately checked their identities one by one.
After that, he directed his focus to the crystal mine, especially since he was curious about those crystals. 'Sigh!
I'll wait for them to come back, and I'll try asking them about those crystals.'

chapters.title: Chapter 440 A Mad Man
paragraphs: [Master, I have finished mapping this realm, and the distance from this realm to the Nine Stars Realm is closer, about three weeks, so I think you should go to that realm from here. Moreover, the Pandora Odyssey has a stealth feature, and the cultivators in this realm will not be able to detect it, so it is fine if you do that.]

'Three weeks, huh?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately sat cross-legged on the bed to complete the daily quest. 'In that case, I'll start thinking of a way to go to the Nine Stars Realm as soon as possible, so I can take the lightning elemental seed. Anyway, keep an eye on the area around this residence, Mei.
I don't know why, but there's something in this realm that makes me uneasy, and I can't find the source.'
[Yes, Master. You can concentrate on your cultivation, and I will monitor the surroundings of this residence, including the members of the Shang Clan.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded slightly, closed his eyes, and began to absorb the Qi from the air. His expression clearly showed that he was excited about it, especially since the quality and quantity in the Wasteland Realm were superior to the Qi in the Sky Jade Realm.

Shang Guangming frowned as soon as he arrived at the crystal mine, especially since Shang Wuzi brought three men from their clans to surround him. He immediately took out his long spear and pointed it at them. "Even though our patriarch sent me here to serve my punishment, it doesn't mean that the three of you are on the same level as me, so you should think twice about going against me."

"Hahaha." Shang Wuzi laughed as he took out his own spear and pointed it at Shang Guangming. "Do you think your status is useful in this place? In this place, our status is all the same, and no one can help you, so you better submit it to me, or I will make you suffer."
The other three men also took out their respective spears, which they held in both hands with the spearheads pointed at Shang Guangming.

However, a powerful pressure suddenly radiated from within the cave, and it directly suppressed Shang Wuzi and the three men, causing the three of them to fall to their knees. Naturally, they knew who owned the aura, causing cold sweat to drip from their foreheads. 'Damn it! Why is that bastard meddling in my affairs?'

"Hey! Chicken Wuzi! Have you forgotten about my presence in this place?" Shang Wuzi's face darkened after hearing that, but a young man suddenly moved behind him before grabbing his right shoulder, causing his spear to fall to the ground, and his expression looked painful. "Guangming is my cousin, remember?
Since the four of you want to gang up on him, I have the right to intervene to stop you, right?"

"Argh!" Shang Wuzi screamed in pain as the young man squeezed his right shoulder so hard, and his fingers dug into his shoulder, causing blood to flow from his shoulder. "Damn it! Stop it, Shang Xiaojuan! You're going to cripple my right hand!"

"Humph!" Shang Xiaojuan coldly snorted and pulled his hand back, but he immediately kicked Shang Wuzi on the back, sending him tumbling under Shang Guangming's feet. "You are truly a disgrace to our Shang Clan! The cultivation of both of you is equal, but you are just a chicken wuzz who only dares to gang up on others. If your father wasn't my father's cousin, I would have killed you long ago.
Therefore, you must stop bothering Guangming, or else I will cripple both your hands and feet, and I will send you to the eastern island so those beasts can enjoy themselves to eat you alive."
Shang Wuzi looked trembling after hearing Shang Xiaojuan's threat, and he immediately grabbed his spear before running away like a fawn, frightened by a predator.

Shang Xiaojuan glared at the three men, and they shook their heads vigorously before running away as fast as rabbits, following Shang Wuzi. "Hahaha! I've heard all about your failure in the Netherworld Realm, Guangming.

I don't think it's the fault of the two of you, especially since the phoenix princess helped those weaklings to strengthen the seal, and you guys are definitely not her match; even our patriarch doesn't dare to fight her."

"No matter what, failure is still failure, Cousin. Moreover, you yourself know our patriarch's character, and we can't argue with him even if we are right." Shang Xiaojuan nodded in agreement with Shang Guangming, especially since Shang Huaqiang had always been like that. However, he was the strongest in their clan, so none of their members dared to argue with him.
"Anyway, when did you arrive in this realm? Why did you come here? Didn't you go with your master before?"

"Hey! Don't you already know the reason I came here?" Shang Xiaojuan then put his arm around Shang Guangming's shoulder and led him into the mine. "I returned to our realm three months ago, but I couldn't find you guys there, and I heard from my father that you two would arrive in this realm today.

Moreover, my master is currently away in another realm to settle her personal affairs, so I decided to come to this realm three days ago, and I will help Shang Yingyue to watch over these little delinquents for some time."
Shang Guangming immediately turned to his cousin. "Did you come to this realm specifically for my sister?"

"That's for sure!" Shang Xiaojuan did not hide her intentions from Shang Guangming. "Yaolin is a spoiled girl, and she is also a crybaby. Even so, I have always liked her, and I want her to be my wife in the future, so I will not allow anyone to bully or hurt her."

Shang Guangming shook his head helplessly, especially since he had long known that Shang Xiaojuan had always harbored feelings for his sister. Unfortunately, Shang Yaolin never liked him, so his feelings were one-sided. Even if she reciprocated his feelings, their fathers would still never approve of their relationship, especially since they were blood brothers and hated incestuous relationships.
"Cousin, you-"

"I know." Shang Xiaojuan immediately interrupted his cousin. "I wholeheartedly like Yaolin, and she's the only woman worthy of being my wife, so I don't care about our parents' opinions. For now, I am still weak compared to them, but I will definitely surpass them in the future, and they wouldn't be able to stop me from taking her as my wife at that time.
Instead of you thinking about me, it would be better if you thought about yourself, especially since that woman came here particularly for you."

"What?" Shang Guangming exclaimed loudly as he stopped in his spot, and his body seemed to tremble after Shang Xiaojuan mentioned the woman. "Are you serious about that? Why did that woman come here? Why didn't my mother forbid her from coming here?"

"Hahaha!" Shang Xiaojuan laughed in satisfaction at her cousin's reaction. "Do you believe Aunt Murong Qianying can stop that woman? In fact, she had already tried to stop Hong Xinxin, but she insisted on coming to this realm. Moreover, you yourself know that she always has a crush on you, so you should prepare yourself because she will come to you soon."

Shang Guangming hugged his own body as his trembling became stronger, and he felt dizzy thinking about Hong Xinxin's presence in the Wasteland Realm. "Where is she now? Why didn't Senior Yingyue tell me about her?"

"Did you forget about her concealment artifact? Even our parents couldn't see through it, let alone Shang Yingyue." Shang Xiaojuan's answer left Shang Guangming speechless. "Moreover, Hong Xinxin isn't bad, right? Even though she's much older than you, her face is quite pretty, and she's no less beautiful than women of our age.

Her body is voluptuous and ravishing, especially her massive milk bags and big ass. The most important thing is that she is still a virgin, and her status within the Hong Clan is higher than our parents' status in our clan. If you are willing to accept her, you can get a higher status, and you don't need to serve your 100-year punishment."
"Tch!" Shang Guangming gritted his teeth in response to that. "If you like Hong Xinxin that much, it'll be better if you marry her, so you can forget about my sister."

"Yaolin is the most attractive woman in my eyes, and Hong Xinxin pales in comparison, so I will never feel attracted to her." Shang Xiaojuan then pulled Shang Guangming to walk again. "Anyway, you don't have to worry about those brats, and I will always protect you from them."

Shang Guangming shook his head at him. "Actually, you don't need to protect me, and I can deal with them by myself. Instead, you have to protect Yaolin, especially since Shang Xiaoyin is also in this realm, and that brute woman will definitely always find trouble with her."
"Oh! That's right! I forgot about Shang Xiaoyin." Shang Xiaojuan then turned around. "In that case, I'm going to see Yaolin now, and I won't allow that brute woman to cause her trouble."

'This guy! He really went head over heels to my sister, and he was even willing to do anything to her.' Shang Guangming then went to another area in the mine, and the Shang Clan members inside the place repeatedly looked at him, but he paid them no attention.
However, he kept a close eye on Shang Wuzi and his subordinates, especially since he was sure that they would try to find trouble with him again.

Soon, Shang Xiaojuan arrived at their residence, and his arrival caused Shang Yaolin to raise her eyebrows. "Why did you come here? I've told you many times that I will never like you, so you should stop stalking me because your attitude is really making me uncomfortable."

"Yaolin, you have the right to reject me over and over again." Shang Xiaojuan suddenly moved in front of Shang Yaolin, then lifted her chin. However, I have the right to approach you and not give up, even if you reject me a thousand times."

"Shameless!" Shang Yaolin wanted to slap Shang Xiaojuan, but he immediately grabbed her right hand and pushed her against the wall, and he raised both of her hands up. "Let me go! I never liked you, and I will never accept you, even if you are the only man left in this universe."

In response, Shang Xiaojuan smiled, but he then brought his face closer to Shang Yaolin's ear. "I don't care how many times you reject me, and I don't care how long I have to wait to get you. If other men dare to try to get close to you, then I will torture and kill them. If our parents dare to stop me from getting you, then I will fight them as well, and I will never hesitate to kill them too.
You will eventually become my wife, and no one will be able to stop me at that time."
"You've gone completely crazy!" Shang Yaolin shouted in frustration, especially since Shang Xiaojuan always acted like a madman regarding her.

"Haha." Shang Xiaojuan chuckled and rubbed Shang Yaolin's cheeks. "Do you realize that you're the one driving me crazy? I've liked you for hundreds of years, but you always reject me, which frustrated me. I'm not the old me, and the current me will do anything to get you. Even so, I'm not a villain, so I will never violate you by force.
I will make you realize the depth of my feelings for you, even if I have to kill many people to do so."

Shang Xiaojuan suddenly sealed Shang Yaolin's cultivation before taking out a pill from his storage ring, and he forcefully opened her mouth before shooting it into her mouth, which she reluctantly swallowed.
"Cough... Cough..." Shang Yaolin coughed hard as she tried to spit out the pill, but she was too late because it had dissolved quickly, and she hatefully glared at Shang Xiaojuan.

"Haha." Shang Xiaojuan laughed at that, unsealing Shang Yaolin's cultivation and releasing her hand from his grasp. "Don't worry, I will never give you poison or an aphrodisiac, but I am sure that you will enjoy the effects of the pill. Anyway, my master concocted the pill specifically for you, so no one else has the antidote except me.
I will give you the antidote after you accept me, so you better start thinking about my feelings, or you will continue to suffer from its effects."

"Heh!" Shang Yaolin coldly snorted at Shang Xiaojuan. "Even if its effects torture me for the rest of my life, I will never accept you as my husband!" If I can no longer bear the effects, I'll explode my cultivation core, and you'll regret my death for the rest of your life!"

Shang Yaolin's threat made Shang Xiaojuan's face darken, and he thought of eating her directly. However, he immediately suppressed his desire and smiled at her. "You can say that now, but I believe you will beg me soon, so I just need to wait for you to come to me."
Shang Xiaojuan then turned to leave, but she did not leave the residence, and she continued to monitor Shang Yaolin from outside.

'Damn it! What kind of pill is that exactly? Is that pill really not an aphrodisiac?' Shang Yaolin suddenly remembered that an aphrodisiac pill would usually take effect quickly, but she still did not feel the slightest change in her body, making her wonder about the true effects of Shang Xiaojuan's pill.
'Forget it; I will know the effects after the pill takes effect, and I hope I can hold back the effects, especially since I don't want to go see that madman, let alone beg him.'
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 12,200 Qi.]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 122 green jewels sent to the inventory.]
"Phew." Zhang Xiaolong [3] exhaled as he opened his eyes. "The Qi in this realm is indeed incomparable to the lower realms, and I can complete the daily quest much faster than usual."
[Master, you should be careful when you are with Shang Yaolin, especially since there is a mad man who is crazy about her. He even forced her to swallow a pill, and the effects are still unknown.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised his eyebrows, and Mei explained to him about Shang Xiaojuan, so he immediately opened his map to check him. "Hmm? His cultivation is on par with Feng Yao at the 5-Moon Divine Manifestation, huh? He is a simp and head over heels for Shang Yaolin, so I have to be careful of him, or he will kill me because of his jealousy."

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly ignored Shang Xiaojuan and closed his eyes again to continue his cultivation, especially since Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming were still busy with their punishments, and he wanted to make use of his time to absorb as much Qi in the Wasteland Realm as possible.

Shang Xiaojuan glared at the three men, and they shook their heads vigorously before running away as fast as rabbits, following Shang Wuzi.
"Hahaha!
I've heard all about your failure in the Netherworld Realm, Guangming.

I don't think it's the fault of the two of you, especially since the phoenix princess helped those weaklings to strengthen the seal, and you guys are definitely not her match; even our patriarch doesn't dare to fight her."
"No matter what, failure is still failure, Cousin.

Moreover, you yourself know our patriarch's character, and we can't argue with him even if we are right." Shang Xiaojuan nodded in agreement with Shang Guangming, especially since Shang Huaqiang had always been like that.
However, he was the strongest in their clan, so none of their members dared to argue with him.
"Anyway, when did you arrive in this realm?
Why did you come here?
Didn't you go with your master before?"
"Hey!
Don't you already know the reason I came here?" Shang Xiaojuan then put his arm around Shang Guangming's shoulder and led him into the mine.
"I returned to our realm three months ago, but I couldn't find you guys there, and I heard from my father that you two would arrive in this realm today.

Moreover, my master is currently away in another realm to settle her personal affairs, so I decided to come to this realm three days ago, and I will help Shang Yingyue to watch over these little delinquents for some time."
Shang Guangming immediately turned to his cousin.
"Did you come to this realm specifically for my sister?"
"That's for sure!" Shang Xiaojuan did not hide her intentions from Shang Guangming.
"Yaolin is a spoiled girl, and she is also a crybaby.
Even so, I have always liked her, and I want her to be my wife in the future, so I will not allow anyone to bully or hurt her."
Shang Guangming shook his head helplessly, especially since he had long known that Shang Xiaojuan had always harbored feelings for his sister.
Unfortunately, Shang Yaolin never liked him, so his feelings were one-sided.
Even if she reciprocated his feelings, their fathers would still never approve of their relationship, especially since they were blood brothers and hated incestuous relationships.
"Cousin, you-"
"I know." Shang Xiaojuan immediately interrupted his cousin.
"I wholeheartedly like Yaolin, and she's the only woman worthy of being my wife, so I don't care about our parents' opinions.
For now, I am still weak compared to them, but I will definitely surpass them in the future, and they wouldn't be able to stop me from taking her as my wife at that time.
Instead of you thinking about me, it would be better if you thought about yourself, especially since that woman came here particularly for you."
"What?" Shang Guangming exclaimed loudly as he stopped in his spot, and his body seemed to tremble after Shang Xiaojuan mentioned the woman.
"Are you serious about that?
Why did that woman come here?
Why didn't my mother forbid her from coming here?"
"Hahaha!" Shang Xiaojuan laughed in satisfaction at her cousin's reaction.
"Do you believe Aunt Murong Qianying can stop that woman?
In fact, she had already tried to stop Hong Xinxin, but she insisted on coming to this realm.
Moreover, you yourself know that she always has a crush on you, so you should prepare yourself because she will come to you soon."
Shang Guangming hugged his own body as his trembling became stronger, and he felt dizzy thinking about Hong Xinxin's presence in the Wasteland Realm.
"Where is she now?
Why didn't Senior Yingyue tell me about her?"
"Did you forget about her concealment artifact?
Even our parents couldn't see through it, let alone Shang Yingyue." Shang Xiaojuan's answer left Shang Guangming speechless.
"Moreover, Hong Xinxin isn't bad, right?
Even though she's much older than you, her face is quite pretty, and she's no less beautiful than women of our age.
Her body is voluptuous and ravishing, especially her massive milk bags and big ass.
The most important thing is that she is still a virgin, and her status within the Hong Clan is higher than our parents' status in our clan.
If you are willing to accept her, you can get a higher status, and you don't need to serve your 100-year punishment."
"Tch!" Shang Guangming gritted his teeth in response to that.
"If you like Hong Xinxin that much, it'll be better if you marry her, so you can forget about my sister."
"Yaolin is the most attractive woman in my eyes, and Hong Xinxin pales in comparison, so I will never feel attracted to her." Shang Xiaojuan then pulled Shang Guangming to walk again.
"Anyway, you don't have to worry about those brats, and I will always protect you from them."
Shang Guangming shook his head at him.
"Actually, you don't need to protect me, and I can deal with them by myself.
Instead, you have to protect Yaolin, especially since Shang Xiaoyin is also in this realm, and that brute woman will definitely always find trouble with her."
"Oh!
That's right!
I forgot about Shang Xiaoyin." Shang Xiaojuan then turned around.
"In that case, I'm going to see Yaolin now, and I won't allow that brute woman to cause her trouble."
'This guy!

He really went head over heels to my sister, and he was even willing to do anything to her.' Shang Guangming then went to another area in the mine, and the Shang Clan members inside the place repeatedly looked at him, but he paid them no attention.
However, he kept a close eye on Shang Wuzi and his subordinates, especially since he was sure that they would try to find trouble with him again.
Soon, Shang Xiaojuan arrived at their residence, and his arrival caused Shang Yaolin to raise her eyebrows.
"Why did you come here?
I've told you many times that I will never like you, so you should stop stalking me because your attitude is really making me uncomfortable."
"Yaolin, you have the right to reject me over and over again." Shang Xiaojuan suddenly moved in front of Shang Yaolin, then lifted her chin.
However, I have the right to approach you and not give up, even if you reject me a thousand times."
"Shameless!" Shang Yaolin wanted to slap Shang Xiaojuan, but he immediately grabbed her right hand and pushed her against the wall, and he raised both of her hands up.
"Let me go!
I never liked you, and I will never accept you, even if you are the only man left in this universe."
In response, Shang Xiaojuan smiled, but he then brought his face closer to Shang Yaolin's ear.
"I don't care how many times you reject me, and I don't care how long I have to wait to get you.
If other men dare to try to get close to you, then I will torture and kill them.
If our parents dare to stop me from getting you, then I will fight them as well, and I will never hesitate to kill them too.
You will eventually become my wife, and no one will be able to stop me at that time."
"You've gone completely crazy!" Shang Yaolin shouted in frustration, especially since Shang Xiaojuan always acted like a madman regarding her.
"Haha." Shang Xiaojuan chuckled and rubbed Shang Yaolin's cheeks.
"Do you realize that you're the one driving me crazy?
I've liked you for hundreds of years, but you always reject me, which frustrated me.
I'm not the old me, and the current me will do anything to get you.
Even so, I'm not a villain, so I will never violate you by force.
I will make you realize the depth of my feelings for you, even if I have to kill many people to do so."

Shang Xiaojuan suddenly sealed Shang Yaolin's cultivation before taking out a pill from his storage ring, and he forcefully opened her mouth before shooting it into her mouth, which she reluctantly swallowed.
"Cough...
Cough..." Shang Yaolin coughed hard as she tried to spit out the pill, but she was too late because it had dissolved quickly, and she hatefully glared at Shang Xiaojuan.
"Haha." Shang Xiaojuan laughed at that, unsealing Shang Yaolin's cultivation and releasing her hand from his grasp.
"Don't worry, I will never give you poison or an aphrodisiac, but I am sure that you will enjoy the effects of the pill.
Anyway, my master concocted the pill specifically for you, so no one else has the antidote except me.
I will give you the antidote after you accept me, so you better start thinking about my feelings, or you will continue to suffer from its effects."
"Heh!" Shang Yaolin coldly snorted at Shang Xiaojuan.

"Even if its effects torture me for the rest of my life, I will never accept you as my husband!" If I can no longer bear the effects, I'll explode my cultivation core, and you'll regret my death for the rest of your life!"
Shang Yaolin's threat made Shang Xiaojuan's face darken, and he thought of eating her directly.
However, he immediately suppressed his desire and smiled at her.
"You can say that now, but I believe you will beg me soon, so I just need to wait for you to come to me."
Shang Xiaojuan then turned to leave, but she did not leave the residence, and she continued to monitor Shang Yaolin from outside.
'Damn it!
What kind of pill is that exactly?

Is that pill really not an aphrodisiac?' Shang Yaolin suddenly remembered that an aphrodisiac pill would usually take effect quickly, but she still did not feel the slightest change in her body, making her wonder about the true effects of Shang Xiaojuan's pill.
'Forget it; I will know the effects after the pill takes effect, and I hope I can hold back the effects, especially since I don't want to go see that madman, let alone beg him.'

"The Qi in this realm is indeed incomparable to the lower realms, and I can complete the daily quest much faster than usual."

"Hmm?
His cultivation is on par with Feng Yao at the 5-Moon Divine Manifestation, huh?
He is a simp and head over heels for Shang Yaolin, so I have to be careful of him, or he will kill me because of his jealousy."

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly ignored Shang Xiaojuan and closed his eyes again to continue his cultivation, especially since Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming were still busy with their punishments, and he wanted to make use of his time to absorb as much Qi in the Wasteland Realm as possible.

paragraphs: In the main hall of the Chu Clan, Zhang Fei was sitting together with all his wives and family members, including Ye Lian's parents, Ye Yuan and Yan Huan'er. Even members of the Zhang, Liu, and Chang clans joined in. He told them about the difference in Qi between the lower and middle realms, making them eager to go to the Wasteland Realm, but he had no intention of taking them there yet.

"My third clone just arrived in that realm today, so I still don't know the exact situation there. Moreover, that realm is a punishment ground for cultivators from the upper realms, and all of them are truly strong, with the strongest among them having cultivation at the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm, so I have to be very careful there.

Additionally, my third clone is currently residing at the Shang Clan's residence, which limits his ability to freely explore and gather clear information about the realm. Once I find a suitable location for our residence, I will definitely take you guys there, so please be patient for the time being."
"What do you mean by 1-Moon, kid?"

Zhang Fei immediately told them all about Feng Yao's explanation, especially about the stages of cultivation in the seven major stages and five minor stages in the seven divine realms. "Unfortunately, the quality and quantity of Qi in this realm is too low, and we even have difficulty reaching the sovereign realm, let alone the quasi-divine realm.

However, the situation will be different if we go to the middle realms or the upper realms, and our cultivation will skyrocket if we go to one of the planets there, so we can reach that stage faster."
Zhang Long and the others nodded in understanding, but Chang Wuhen then asked. "Do you intend to enter seclusion again?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei then looked at his wives. "Look at them; all of them are so eager to improve their cultivation, so I plan to take them into seclusion again, and we won't come out before I reach the heaven realm."

"The heaven realm, huh?" Chang Wuhen muttered softly, but she did not doubt that Zhang Fei could reach that stage soon. With many women by his side and one of his clones in the Wasteland Realm, he had many advantages in reaching it faster than other cultivators.

"Since those heretics are gone, and there is no longer any danger threatening this realm for the time being, then I will also enter seclusion. My cultivation has long been stuck at the 4-Star Sovereign Realm, so this is the perfect time for me to concentrate on my cultivation again."

Chang Wentian nodded in agreement with his mother, especially since the previous incident was still lingering in his mind. He did not want such an incident to happen again in the future, so he felt the need to improve his own strength as quickly as possible.

"I think that's a good idea, and you can hand over your clan affairs to your caretaker." Zhang Fei suddenly remembered Cai Qiu, so he asked Shen Xueyi to return to the Yin-Yang Pavilion to pick her up, and she immediately rushed there.

Chang Wuhen sighed heavily after remembering that her daughter-in-law and her Cai Clan were traitors to their realm, but Zhang Fei and the others had destroyed her clan. Chang Wentian also felt the same way as his mother, and he couldn't wait to see his wife again.

Chang Wenjie, who was sitting beside her father, also looked impatient to see her mother again. Even so, she no longer considers Cai Qiu as her mother, especially since she has the same ideology as her father and grandmother that traitors cannot be forgiven.

Minutes later, Shen Xueyi had returned to the Chu Clan together with Cai Qiu, who was already looking a little crazy, especially since the death of her entire clan dealt a heavy blow to her mind and soul.

"Bring her with us, Wentian." Chang Wentian nodded to Chang Wuhen and received Cai Qiu from Shen Xueyi, but her gaze was already completely blank. "Please send us back to the central region, Zhang Fei."

After Zhang Fei opened the portal to that region, Chang Wuhen immediately led her family into it. Chang Wenjie did not directly enter the portal, but instead, she gazed at Zhang Fei for a moment before letting out a sigh and returning with her family to their region.

After he closed the portal, Zhang Fei immediately spoke to the members of the Zhang Clan. "I know you guys are worried about my brother-in-law, but he's still fine now because no demons or demon beasts have approached him, and my fourth clone will arrive there tomorrow or the day after."
All the members of the Zhang Clan seemed relieved by the information, but not Zi'er, who was worried that her husband had turned into a demon, especially since he had been there for four days.

Zhang Xiaoling immediately grabbed her mother's hand and rubbed the back of her palm. "Mother, I'm also worried about my father, but at least he's alive and well now. Moreover, Zhang Fei's clone will arrive at his location soon, so we just need to wait another day or two, and we'll be able to reunite with him again after that."
"En." Zi'er responded only with a nod to her daughter.

Zhang Fei then conveyed his idea to them. "How about the four of you join the others to train in my training space for the time being? That way, I can keep you all informed about my brother-in-law's situation, so you guys won't be as anxious as you are now.
Moreover, Xiaoling has already experienced the benefits of training there, and you all have the opportunity to reap these benefits, which will significantly increase your physical strength."

"That's right." Zhang Xiaoling then persuaded them. "Grandpa! Grandma! Mother! I can tell you that the benefits of training in Zhang Fei's training space are truly extraordinary, especially the gravity feature. For now, you all should join us while waiting for him to bring my father back to us, and he can join us later."

"I think it's okay if we do that." Zhang Xiaolong then sent a voice transmission to his Zhang clan members, and he asked their clan caretaker to take care of matters there. "Kid, you can send us there now, and we will train very hard to catch up to you guys."
Zhang Fei immediately asked Liu Rong. "What about you, mother-in-law? Do you want to join us, too?"

"Sure." Liu Rong immediately agreed with it because she didn't want to continue being weak, and she herself could see the changes in her two daughters and three granddaughters after they trained with Zhang Fei for so long, so she was also eager to undergo training like them. "Is it okay if I ask Ming'er to join us?"

"Yeah, you can call my brother-in-law now, and I'll send you all in there as soon as he comes." Liu Rong immediately contacted his son, and Liu Ming arrived among them a few minutes later, so Zhang Fei immediately sent the people from the Zhang and Liu Clans into his training space. "Are you two calmer now, Qing'er and Ying'er?"
Both women nodded to Zhang Fei. "We've experienced enough sadness over the past three days, and we refuse to let sorrow consume us further, so we can now retreat back into our seclusion."

"That's good." Zhang Fei then turned to Dou Luotian and Wang Zetian. "Currently, Oz the first has returned to the Diyu Realm, and Morgana is also very powerful. Moreover, there are still Oz the second and the others, making their strength truly great now, so the people from the Tian and Xian Realms will not have the chance to attack them."

Even so, Dou Luotian did not seem relieved after hearing the news. "Zhang Fei, they may not be able to invade the Diyu Realm anymore, but I believe the people from the two realms will not stop. If they fail to invade the demon realm, they will likely target humans, and earthlings will be powerless to stop them, so I hope you can think of something to protect them."

Fortunately, Zhang Fei still had interests on Earth, especially since he needed Earth money to buy things in the modern shop system. Otherwise, he wouldn't care about that planet anymore, especially since it would just waste his time. 'Mei, upgrade my demon body double to the last level.'
[Yes, master.]
{The demon body double has upgraded to level five.}
{1,000,000 female essences have been deducted from your balance.}

Zhang Fei immediately summoned his fifth clone, surprising them all. "Actually, I wanted to send my fifth clone to the Wasteland Realm, but the Earth is still important to me, so I will send him there. This way, I can monitor the movements of the people from the two realms, so I can send reinforcements there if they dare directly attack those Earthlings.
Even if I have to break the balance there, I will slaughter them all without a single one remaining."

Dou Luotian looked at Zhang Fei with complicated feelings, especially since she herself was a mixed breed of a human and a winged race, so she didn't want him to slaughter the people of the Tian Realm. However, she didn't say anything about it, especially since she knew that he wouldn't budge on his decision.
"In that case, you can send me and your clone back to earth, so I can send a message to my father through Micah."

"I will accompany you back there, wife." Wang Zetian then spoke to his two grandchildren. "Xiaofeng, Zhuxian, you two can stay here. We will tell your parents that you guys are fine, so they won't worry about you two."
"Yes, Grandfather."
After that, Zhang Fei sent his fifth clone and the two people back to earth, and he brought them all into the training space afterward.

Zhang Fei immediately brought all his women into the Cloud Mansion, but Liu Qingyu did not join them as usual, so she joined Zhang Chen and the others. After all, Liu Rong, Liu Ming, and the three Chu Sisters still did not know about her relationship with him.
Moreover, Chu Hong had only been dead for four days, so she was still not willing to reveal their relationship to them, especially since she was afraid that they would be disappointed in her.

Inside the Cloud Mansion, Zhang Fei's two slaves, Mei Xiang and Qiao Ran, were already waiting for him. There was one addition among them, who was none other than Qiao Fei, the ancestor of the Qiao Clan. As for Xie Jingxian and Ba Shuxiang, both of them were Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s partners, so he let them train outside.
His other slave, Gu Jinglin, stayed inside the Yin-Yang Space, and he intended to give her to his third clone as well.
Zhang Fei asked them all to wait for him in the main room, and he himself took Zhao Ziqin away to his room, especially since he still hadn't discussed his father and grandfather's deaths with her.
Upon arrival, Zhang Fei immediately carried Zhao Ziqin to lie down on the bed and hugged her. "Do you want to talk about my father and grandfather?"
"Yes."

"Actually, Aunt Hua and the others told me about their deaths, and you used them as sacrifices to destroy the demon portal." Zhang Fei wanted to say something, but Zhao Ziqin placed her index finger to his lips, signaling him not to interrupt her.

"Even though I'm sad about their deaths, I can also understand your reasons for using them for that, especially since they were traitors to this realm, so I don't blame you. At least their deaths were not in vain because they died for the sake of many people, and the demon portal has been destroyed now, so the residents of this realm can live more peacefully."
"Do you really not blame me, Ziqin?"

Zhao Ziqin immediately pushed Zhang Fei to roll to the side so she could lie on top of him, and she briefly kissed his lips. "If I blamed you, then I wouldn't be here talking to you, right? Moreover, I have long decided to leave them, and I have already chosen you to be my future husband, so I will always support your decision if it is the best for the sake of the people."

"Thank you for your understanding, Ziqin." Zhao Ziqin smiled and laid her head on Zhang Fei's chest. "Anyway, your mother and big brother still live in the netherworld realm, but both of them have become demons now."
"What kind of demons are they now?"

"Your mother turned into a gargoyle, and Zhao Yun turned into a dog demon." Zhang Fei then touched and shared a picture of their demon form with Zhao Ziqin, but he was horrified after seeing Huan Ning's demon form. "Your mother lives with those incubi, and your brother lives with those succubi."

Hearing that, Zhao Ziqin was sure that her mother's fate was really bad, especially since she already knew enough about Zhang Fei's demon character, and those demons were of the same race as him. As for her big brother, she actually felt that his situation was really funny, especially since Zhao Yun only loved Chu Ying when he was human, but he had to spend his time with many succubi.
"At least they are still alive now, and they live their own lives in the netherworld realm, so I don't want to remember them anymore."

Zhang Fei suddenly reversed their positions by pinning Zhao Ziqin under him, and he also held both of her hands above her head, causing her heartbeat to become extremely fast. "Are you ready to be my wife now?"

"En." Zhao Ziqin shyly nodded. In fact, she had long been ready to become Zhang Fei's wife, but her previous cultivation was still too low, so she focused on improving it first. Since her cultivation had increased by several minor stages with the help of his yang qi, she did not want to delay their relationship any longer.

However, the door of the room was suddenly opened from the outside, and they could see Ye Lian's head peeking out from behind the door, so Zhao Ziqin immediately called her. "Join us, Sister Lian. You can't wait to become his wife, too, right?"

"Haha." Ye Lian laughed softly as she entered the room, and she immediately joined Zhang Fei and Zhao Ziqin on the bed. "Actually, I still wanted to wait for us to get married first, but my parents knew that I couldn't wait for it, so they blessed me to be his wife today."

"Isn't that great? After all, we've been with him for quite some time, and we decided long ago to be his wives." Ye Lian nodded in agreement with Zhao Ziqin, followed by a question to Zhang Fei. "Who will you choose first between us?"

Instead, Zhang Fei lay between them and used his hands as cushions, causing Zhao Ziqin and Ye Lian to raise their eyebrows. "I know that you two have learned a lot from each other, and Lin'er has poisoned your minds with many things. That's why I want to see how you guys will satisfy me, and I will satisfy you two afterwards."

Both women laughed wryly at that, especially since Zhang Lin was the youngest among them, and she had never dual-cultivated with Zhang Fei before. However, they felt that she was more experienced than them, and she also possessed a wealth of unusual knowledge about sex.
Both women exchanged glances for a moment before quickly moving to strip Zhang Fei naked, but their faces immediately turned as red as tomatoes at the sight of his dick.
Unlike Zhao Ziqin, who had never been intimate with her, Ye Lian had done it with him many times, so she took the initiative to grab his dick.
Ye Lian then grasped Zhao Ziqin's hand and placed it on Zhang Fei's dick. They then began to jerk it, causing it slowly to erect.

paragraphs: In the dark forest, a half-demon man was relishing the corpse of a demon beast. His face, adorned with black fur akin to that of a wolf, was incredibly fierce, and his bloody mouth resembled the snout of a wolf. Furthermore, his ears were like wolf's ears, his nails were like wolf claws, his feet also looked like wolf feet, and a black tail hung down from his hips.

The half-demon man was none other than Chi Yang, the sect master of the desolate sect. He had quickly transformed into that state after being bitten by a black demon wolf four days ago, and he had also consumed the food available in the forest to quench his hunger.
*Thud*

Chi Yang's ears twitched upon hearing the sound, and he immediately turned his head back before howling towards Alder, who had just landed behind him. However, he no longer looked like the old him, and he looked savage because he was controlled by his wolf instincts.
As Chi Yang dashed towards him, the wolf king remained calm, and he casually flicked his finger, causing him to bounce and roll on the ground a few times before crashing into a boulder.

In an instant, Alder had moved in front of Chi Yang, who continued to glare at him while howling in pain. He immediately grabbed his collar and lifted him up. "What a pity! Although your friend in my city has also begun to transform into a demon, your fate is far worse than his, as you were bitten by a demon wolf and consumed everything in our forest.

As a result, your transformation into a full-fledged demon wolf is imminent, and your beast instincts will take complete control over your mind. Fortunately, I managed to find you first, or else you would die at the hands of other demons."
*Howl*
Once again, Chi Yang howled loudly as he tried to bite Alder, but the wolf king immediately grabbed his snout, causing him to struggle to break away.

Even though he had transformed into half a demon wolf and his cultivation was in the heaven realm, Chi Yan was still not an opponent for a strong demon cultivator like Alder, especially with his cultivation having reached the seven divine realms. The wolf king let out a soft sigh before punching his abdomen, causing him to quickly lose consciousness.
"Since you are a demon wolf, I will take you to my city and teach you to control your instincts, so you will not act blindly like now."

Alder immediately jumped into the air before flying at high speed towards Black Moon City, and he was able to arrive there in just a few minutes, especially since the distance between the two places was not that far. When he brought Chi Yang to his private residence, a young wolf girl was already waiting for him, and her appearance resembled that of a teenage girl around 17 or 18 years old.

The wolf girl had curly white hair that fell down to her hips, and her golden eyes were pretty, but her expression was slightly childish. Two white wolf ears kept moving above her head, and her nose twitched as she sniffed the strange smell coming out from Chi Yang.

"I found him in the swamp forest, and he is actually human, like Gu Tong. Unfortunately, his fate is really unlucky, so he's halfway to becoming a demon wolf now." Alder then placed Chi Yang on an empty table. "Why are you here, Tasha?"

Tasha immediately walked up to Alder and hugged his arm in a spoiled manner. "Father, I know you want to protect me, but I'm bored of staying in my cave. That's why I decided to come out and meet you, and those demon wolves didn't notice my presence thanks to the artifact you gave me. Anyway, when are we going to leave this realm?
You said that we wouldn't stay here too long, but it's been five hundred years since you brought me here, and you still don't seem to plan to take me away."

Alder let out a soft sigh before crouching down on one leg in front of his daughter, and he grabbed her shoulders. "Tasha, I really want to take you away from this realm, but I'm afraid that those people will find us. If they do, they'll definitely capture you, and your grandparents' sacrifices to help us escape our realm will be in vain.
That's why I hope you can be patient to stay in this realm, especially since I'm sure they won't come here, so you'll always be safe here."

Tasha lowered her head in disappointment and tightly clutched her skirt. She never liked life in the netherworld realm, especially since it was too dark compared to their origin realm, and Alder kept forcing her to live in her cave for her own safety.

"Tasha, I-" Alder didn't finish his words and pressed the gold necklace on his daughter's chest, and she immediately disappeared as if she had entered an invisible state. He then turned to the man who walked into his house, who was none other than Gu Tong, pointing at Chi Yang. "I found one of your friends in the swamp forest, but he's half demon now."

Gu Tong was taken back for a moment before rushing to the side of the table, and his expression turned to pity. "I didn't expect him to have turned into this in just four days, but at least he is still alive now. His name is Chi Yang, and he is the sect master of the desolate sect."

Tasha, who was in an invisible state, kept shifting her gaze between Gu Tong and Chi Yang. She seemed curious about their origins, especially since her father said that both of them were previously humans.

"You are lucky that I found you as soon as you arrived in this realm." Gu Tong nodded to Alder, who was already standing beside him. "Your friend was not as lucky as you because he was stranded in the swamp forest, and there were so many powerful demon beasts there.

His fate was even worse because he was bitten by one of my subordinates, so his transformation into a demon happened faster, and he will completely transform into a wolf demon in a week. Anyway, I will confine him for a while, particularly since he is still unable to control his beast instincts, and I will send him to you once he is able to do so."

Gu Tong could only agree with Alder's plan for Chi Yang, especially since he himself was powerless to deal with his own situation, and he had also started to turn into a demon like him. "Did you manage to locate my other colleagues?"

"No." Alder picked up Chi Yang while glancing at Tasha, who immediately nodded at him. "I've ordered my subordinates to spread out to all regions, but none of them have given me any news about the presence of other humans, so I'm not sure whether they're also stranded in this realm like you two or not. Anyway, where's that Yin Tong kid? Why isn't he with you?"

"I was really shocked when that kid told me that Zhang Fei sent him to this realm, but I'm sure he had a specific reason for doing that to him. Anyway, he's half crazy now, and he decided to leave this city while you were gone." Alder frowned at Gu Tong's answer. "I tried to stop him, but he wouldn't listen to me, so I let him go."

"Since Kid has already made that decision, I won't waste my time looking for him." Alder then took Chi Yang to the room behind his residence, and Tasha followed behind them, but she repeatedly stole glances at Gu Tong while thinking about something.

Zhang Fei [4]'s expression looked disappointed after hearing all that, and he then looked into the distance. 'No matter whether I'm late or not, I have already promised Yan Luan'er and Zi'er to bring them back, so I will immediately return to the ghostveil forest after I save my brother-in-law, and I will find a way to save Yan Zixiu from Thish.'
"What happened?" Elmyra, the leader of the elf race, suddenly asked Zhang Fei [4].

"I just found Yan Zixiu's location, and she is in Lust City now." Elmyra and the other two were shocked to hear that, especially since they had previously departed from that region. "Unfortunately, she is in the hands of one of the succubi duchesses, and she is really strong.
Once we have rescued my brother-in-law, I will send the three of you back to the Sky Jade Realm, and then I will proceed directly to that city."
After that, Zhang Fei [4] immediately took the three of them to continue their journey to Zhang Wuji's location, especially after he saw a large red dot not far from his location.

Meanwhile, Zhang Wuji was leaning on a large rock by the black river, and he kept looking at his hands that were covered in black scales similar to fish scales. He then took out a mirror from his storage ring to look at his head that had changed to look like a fish's head, and his ears looked like fish fins.

He then threw the mirror into the black river before taking out two paintings of his wife and daughter, and he rubbed them both with a melancholy expression. "Damn it! Why did I have to turn into a fish demon so soon? This way, I can't possibly return to the Sky Jade Realm again, let alone meet Zi'er and Xiaoling with my form like this."
*Drip... Drip...*

Suddenly, water dripped from above and wet the two paintings, causing Zhang Wuji to freeze. He slowly looked up, but his eyes instantly lost their focus as he stared at the face of the female demon with blue hair above him.
The female demon looked seductive, and her upper body was not covered by a single thread, so her large breasts were exposed before Zhang Wuji's eyes, but her lower body was like a fish tail.

The female demon then descended before Zhang Wuji, cupped his cheeks, and brought her face closer to his. However, she didn't kiss him, and a thread of demon energy came out of his mouth, which was immediately sucked in by her.
The female demon's actions caused Zhang Wuji's body to slowly wither, especially after she sucked his demon power. Her sucking speed increased as she became impatient to suck him dry.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Several white arrows suddenly shot towards them, causing the female demon to immediately jump away from Zhang Wuji. Her once-pretty face turned incredibly ugly as she stared far away.
*Bam... Bam...*

Those white arrows immediately stuck a stick in front of Zhang Wuji before exploding, bringing him back to his senses; however, he felt that his body became extremely weak, and he couldn't even move his fingers after the female demon sucked too much of his demon power, let alone that he was just a lesser demon.
"Who dares to disturb me to absorb my prey's demon energy? Come out now!" The female demon bellowed loudly, startling Zhang Wuji.

Soon, Zhang Fei [4] and the three leaders of the nature races landed at the location, but they immediately let out a heavy sigh after they saw Zhang Wuji's demon form. "Are you all right, brother-in-law?"
"Zhang Fei? Is this you?" Zhang Wuji asked in a weak voice, but he was immediately sure that he was his brother-in-law, especially after he saw Oliver and the two women.
"Forgive me for being late here, brother-in-law." Zhang Fei [4] then summoned the demon extermination sword to attack the female demon.
However, Oliver and the two women stopped Zhang Fei [4]. "Leave her to us, and you can help Zhang Wuji, especially since he looks so weak and could die at any moment."

"All right, I'll leave her to you three." Oliver and the two women immediately moved to attack the female demon, and Zhang Fei [4] crouched in front of Zhang Wuji before putting two pills into his mouth. "Swallow them, brother-in-law. This way, your condition will recover immediately, so I can take you to see Zi'er and Zhang Xiaoling."

sentences.text: In the dark forest, a half-demon man was relishing the corpse of a demon beast.
His face, adorned with black fur akin to that of a wolf, was incredibly fierce, and his bloody mouth resembled the snout of a wolf.
Furthermore, his ears were like wolf's ears, his nails were like wolf claws, his feet also looked like wolf feet, and a black tail hung down from his hips.
The half-demon man was none other than Chi Yang, the sect master of the desolate sect.
He had quickly transformed into that state after being bitten by a black demon wolf four days ago, and he had also consumed the food available in the forest to quench his hunger.
*Thud*
Chi Yang's ears twitched upon hearing the sound, and he immediately turned his head back before howling towards Alder, who had just landed behind him.
However, he no longer looked like the old him, and he looked savage because he was controlled by his wolf instincts.
As Chi Yang dashed towards him, the wolf king remained calm, and he casually flicked his finger, causing him to bounce and roll on the ground a few times before crashing into a boulder.
In an instant, Alder had moved in front of Chi Yang, who continued to glare at him while howling in pain.
He immediately grabbed his collar and lifted him up.
"What a pity!
Although your friend in my city has also begun to transform into a demon, your fate is far worse than his, as you were bitten by a demon wolf and consumed everything in our forest.
As a result, your transformation into a full-fledged demon wolf is imminent, and your beast instincts will take complete control over your mind.
Fortunately, I managed to find you first, or else you would die at the hands of other demons."
*Howl*
Once again, Chi Yang howled loudly as he tried to bite Alder, but the wolf king immediately grabbed his snout, causing him to struggle to break away.

Even though he had transformed into half a demon wolf and his cultivation was in the heaven realm, Chi Yan was still not an opponent for a strong demon cultivator like Alder, especially with his cultivation having reached the seven divine realms.
The wolf king let out a soft sigh before punching his abdomen, causing him to quickly lose consciousness.
"Since you are a demon wolf, I will take you to my city and teach you to control your instincts, so you will not act blindly like now."

Alder immediately jumped into the air before flying at high speed towards Black Moon City, and he was able to arrive there in just a few minutes, especially since the distance between the two places was not that far.
When he brought Chi Yang to his private residence, a young wolf girl was already waiting for him, and her appearance resembled that of a teenage girl around 17 or 18 years old.
The wolf girl had curly white hair that fell down to her hips, and her golden eyes were pretty, but her expression was slightly childish.
Two white wolf ears kept moving above her head, and her nose twitched as she sniffed the strange smell coming out from Chi Yang.
Her body is not tall and a bit chubby covered by a white dress, but she has a nice waist combined with wide hips and bouncy buttocks, and medium breasts around C-Cup hanging on her chest.
"Where did you find this demon wolf, father?"
"I found him in the swamp forest, and he is actually human, like Gu Tong.
Unfortunately, his fate is really unlucky, so he's halfway to becoming a demon wolf now." Alder then placed Chi Yang on an empty table.
"Why are you here, Tasha?"
Tasha immediately walked up to Alder and hugged his arm in a spoiled manner.
"Father, I know you want to protect me, but I'm bored of staying in my cave.
That's why I decided to come out and meet you, and those demon wolves didn't notice my presence thanks to the artifact you gave me.
Anyway, when are we going to leave this realm?
You said that we wouldn't stay here too long, but it's been five hundred years since you brought me here, and you still don't seem to plan to take me away."
Alder let out a soft sigh before crouching down on one leg in front of his daughter, and he grabbed her shoulders.
"Tasha, I really want to take you away from this realm, but I'm afraid that those people will find us.
If they do, they'll definitely capture you, and your grandparents' sacrifices to help us escape our realm will be in vain.
That's why I hope you can be patient to stay in this realm, especially since I'm sure they won't come here, so you'll always be safe here."
Tasha lowered her head in disappointment and tightly clutched her skirt.
She never liked life in the netherworld realm, especially since it was too dark compared to their origin realm, and Alder kept forcing her to live in her cave for her own safety.
"Tasha, I-" Alder didn't finish his words and pressed the gold necklace on his daughter's chest, and she immediately disappeared as if she had entered an invisible state.
He then turned to the man who walked into his house, who was none other than Gu Tong, pointing at Chi Yang.
"I found one of your friends in the swamp forest, but he's half demon now."
Gu Tong was taken back for a moment before rushing to the side of the table, and his expression turned to pity.
"I didn't expect him to have turned into this in just four days, but at least he is still alive now.
His name is Chi Yang, and he is the sect master of the desolate sect."
Tasha, who was in an invisible state, kept shifting her gaze between Gu Tong and Chi Yang.
She seemed curious about their origins, especially since her father said that both of them were previously humans.
"You are lucky that I found you as soon as you arrived in this realm." Gu Tong nodded to Alder, who was already standing beside him.
"Your friend was not as lucky as you because he was stranded in the swamp forest, and there were so many powerful demon beasts there.
His fate was even worse because he was bitten by one of my subordinates, so his transformation into a demon happened faster, and he will completely transform into a wolf demon in a week.
Anyway, I will confine him for a while, particularly since he is still unable to control his beast instincts, and I will send him to you once he is able to do so."
Gu Tong could only agree with Alder's plan for Chi Yang, especially since he himself was powerless to deal with his own situation, and he had also started to turn into a demon like him.
"Did you manage to locate my other colleagues?"
"No." Alder picked up Chi Yang while glancing at Tasha, who immediately nodded at him.

"I've ordered my subordinates to spread out to all regions, but none of them have given me any news about the presence of other humans, so I'm not sure whether they're also stranded in this realm like you two or not.
Anyway, where's that Yin Tong kid?
Why isn't he with you?"
"I was really shocked when that kid told me that Zhang Fei sent him to this realm, but I'm sure he had a specific reason for doing that to him.
Anyway, he's half crazy now, and he decided to leave this city while you were gone." Alder frowned at Gu Tong's answer.
"I tried to stop him, but he wouldn't listen to me, so I let him go."

"Since Kid has already made that decision, I won't waste my time looking for him." Alder then took Chi Yang to the room behind his residence, and Tasha followed behind them, but she repeatedly stole glances at Gu Tong while thinking about something.
Gu Tong himself immediately came out of Alder's residence, looked at the starless night sky, and sighed repeatedly as he remembered his wife and son.
"I miss them so much, but I have started to become a demon, so I will never be able to meet them again.
I hope Mei'er can accept reality and continue her life without me, and I also hope that Zhan'er will become a more mature and responsible man."
Unfortunately, Go Tong still did not know that Gu Zhan had long been dead, eaten by Boitata alive, and Xing Mei was imprisoned by Zhang Fei in the Yin-Yang Space along with several other women.

Inside one of the prisons in the dungeon, Yan Zixiu, who was still hanging on the wooden crossbar, had also turned into a demon, especially since Thish repeatedly forced her to eat demon beast meat, which accelerated his transformation into a demon.

Ilsath and Orith were completely annoyed by Thishhh's actions because they could no longer obtain life essence from Yan Zixiu, and the demon power of a lesser demon like her was completely useless to them.
Unlike them, Thish was actually happy with it, especially since he was eager to torture Yan Zixiu, and he had been waiting for several days to be able to do it.

Thish immediately rushed to the dungeon to release Yan Zixiu, and she took her to her private room at the top of the tower, where she began to torture her using various torture equipment available there.
No matter how loudly Yan Zixiu screamed in pain, Thish continued to torture her relentlessly.
Her screams of pain only encouraged Thish to torture her even harder, causing her to slowly lose her will to live. 'Luan'er...
I'm sorry...
I promised to accompany you forever, but I was forced to break my promise, and I hope you will have a better life even without me by your side.'
