chapters.title: Chapter 448 Reunion
paragraphs: "Zi'er, Xiaoling." Zhang Wuji muttered softly before raising both hands. "Zhang Fei, I have become a demon like this, so I can't possibly meet them again, and they will definitely be frightened by my demon form."

With a shake of his head, Zhang Fei [4] refuted him. "You underestimate their feelings too much, brother-in-law. I have heard stories about how you met Zi'er and how you two got married, so I know her feelings for you are strong and deep. Xiaoling also loves you very much, and she has always respected you, so I'm sure they will never reject you, even if you have become a demon.
Moreover, you are a demon cultivator, and you can use the transformation technique to return to your original form, so I'm sure everything will be fine."
Zhang Wuji did not refute Zhang Fei [4], but fear had already filled his heart, and he was truly afraid that his family would not be able to accept him with his current status as a demon.

Zhang Fei [4] immediately spoke to him again. "Brother-in-law, all my wives and families know my identity as a lust demon, and they are willing to accept me even though some of them hate demons, so you don't have to worry about that, okay?"

Zhang Wuji just nodded and looked at the leaders of the natural races, and he could see that the female demon was being pushed back by their attacks. Even black blood had already covered her body, especially since Elmyra's light element was too strong and pure, and not many demons could face her head-on.
Additionally, Oliver helped the elf leader to increase her speed, and Zuhe, the druid leader, also assisted her by using the water in the black river.

"That female demon is a marchioness rank demon, but it's not a big deal for them." Zhang Fei [4] immediately stood up. "However, I can't just let her die like this, especially since her demon power is quite useful to me."
After he said that, Zhang Fei [4] immediately disappeared from Zhang Wuji's sight, and he instantly moved behind the female demon before strangling her neck.
Seeing that, Oliver, Elmyra, and Zuhe immediately stopped attacking the female demon, waiting for Zhang Fei [4]'s next action.

"Please, don't kill me! I have no intention of killing him, and I just need a little bit of demon energy." The female demon begged as she changed her form into a beautiful one again, and fake tears dripped from her eyes.
"Oh, really?" Zhang Fei [4] gripped the female demon's neck tighter. "You might be able to deceive others with your fake tears, but you won't be able to deceive me."
"No! Argh!" The female demon screamed in pain as Zhang Fei [4] activated his demon-absorbing ability to absorb her demon power and life force. "Argh! Please! I don't want to die!"

Zhang Wuji and the three leaders of the natural races took a deep breath as they watched Zhang Fei [4]'s cruelty, particularly as the female demon's body began to dry up and the skin all over her body wrinkled rapidly. This eventually led to her death, leaving only her dried skin and skeleton.
Zhang Fei [4] immediately threw the female demon's skeleton into the black river. "Phew! Her demon power isn't bad, but it's not enough for me."
"Your demon technique is terrifying, Zhang Fei." Elmyra said so with a soft sigh. "Can you also use that technique on other living creatures?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] nodded at Elmyra. "If I use it on cultivators, not only can I absorb their soul and life force, but I can also absorb their understanding and attainment in cultivation."

Elmyra nodded slightly in response and reminded Zhang Fei [4]. "You should be careful in using your techniques, especially since not all techniques are without consequences, and such a technique definitely has serious consequences.
You may not be able to feel the effects now, but that doesn't mean there aren't any, and you might be able to feel them in the future, so you have to control yourself when using it."

"Thank you for your advice, and I will be more careful in using it." Zhang Fei then looked at Oliver and Zuhe, who were helping Zhang Wuji walk towards them. "Since we have managed to find my brother-in-law, I will send the three of you back to the Sky Jade Realm."
"What about Gu Tong and Chi Yang? Aren't you going to save them?" Oliver asked Zhang Fei [4].

Zhang Fei [4] sighed heavily at that. "Chi Yang has already completely turned into a demon, and Gu Tong has also begun to become one. Unfortunately, they are in Alder's hands, and we won't be able to defeat him even if we combine our strengths, which will only put us in danger.

Moreover, they are not that important to me, and Yan Zixiu is much more important because she is the big sister of one of my partners. Currently, she is in the hands of that cruel succubus, and she really likes torturing other demons, so I have to save her as quickly as possible, or she will die in her hands."
"What about the other seniors, Zhang Fei?"

Zhang Fei [4] shook his head at Zhang Wuji. "Meng Guanqiu told Shen Xueyi that Meng Qi's jade is still intact, so she should be fine. Unfortunately, Ba Jiawen and Chu Hong are dead, and they probably died in other realms because I couldn't find them in this realm."
Zhang Wuji released a heavy sigh after hearing that, especially since Ba Jiawen and Chu Hong were quite strong, and their deaths were a huge loss to their realm.

"All right, you don't have to think about that, especially since everything has already happened, and we can't turn back time to save them." A gate and portal immediately appeared in front of them after Zhang Fei [4] ordered Mei. "This gate will lead the three of you to the Chu Clan, so you guys can go back there directly.
Brother-in-law, Zi'er and the others will be waiting for you, so you can enter this portal to meet them."

Unlike the three leaders of the natural races who immediately entered the gate, Zhang Wuji seemed hesitant to enter the portal. After all, all cultivators in the Sky Jade Realm, including his family, harbored deep hatred for demons, so he was truly afraid that they would reject him.
Seeing him continue like that, Zhang Fei [4] quickly put his arm around Zhang Wuji's shoulders and brought him directly into his training space.
"Husband!"
"Father!"
"Wuji!"
"Brother!"
As soon as they appeared, Zhang Long, Yang Yudie, Zhang Lingxue, Zi'er, and Zhang Xiaoling immediately shouted and ran towards them.

Instead, Zhang Wuji took a few steps back once they arrived in front of him, and he also lowered his head in fear of the reality that he was about to face. However, Zi'er did not care about her husband's appearance, and she immediately jumped towards him before hugging him directly. "Sob... Sob... I'm glad you're still alive; I don't know what I would do if you died."

"Father." Zhang Xiaoling called softly as she hugged her parents, and she cried happily, feeling the warmth of her father's body. "Sob... Thank goodness you managed to survive, and Zhang Fei managed to bring you back to us; otherwise, we would have been miserable if you had died in that realm."

Zhang Long immediately walked to his son's side and put his hand on his shoulder. "I understand how you feel, Wuji. No matter whether you are a human or a demon, you are still our family. Although we feel a little strange seeing you look like this now, we just need some time to adapt to the situation, and everything will be back to normal after some time."
"Your father is right, Wuji." Yang Yudie then hugged her son's other side. "Give us time to adapt to it, and everything will be fine as before."

Zhang Lingxue also spoke to Zhang Wuji directly. "Brother, you know that my husband is a demon, but we've never had a problem with his identity, and we completely accept him as he is. Moreover, you are not an ordinary demon but a demon cultivator, and he can teach you a transformation technique, so you can use it to return to yourself and gather with us again."

Zhang Fei [4] directly touched Zhang Wuji's forehead and imparted a transformation technique to him. "You can learn it now, brother-in-law. This way, you guys can get together again without worrying about yourself or them."

Zhang Wuji nodded to Zhang Fei before hugging them all, and joyful tears began to flow from his eyes. However, the feelings of anxiety and fear persisted in his heart as he continued to contemplate his status as a demon.

"All right, you guys can reunite now, and I will return to the netherworld realm to find a way to save Yan Zhixiu." Zhang Long and the others were surprised to hear that, especially since Zhang Fei [4] had previously told them that he couldn't find the sect master of the Yin-Yang Pavilion in that realm.

"I once checked the succubi tower, and there were several areas in that place covered by concealment barriers. At first, I couldn't find her because she was probably locked up in one of those areas, and I only found her today after she was taken out of the area, so I will find a way to infiltrate there to save her."
"Husband, you better be careful when doing that, especially since the strength of the three succubi duchesses is still higher than yours."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Zhang Lingxue. "I will be careful there, and you can return to our mansion once you've had enough reunions with my brother-in-law."

After that, Zhang Fei [4] immediately left them and returned to the netherworld realm, and Zhang Lingxue remained standing beside her family with a relieved expression, especially since Zhang Wuji had returned to their side.

Upon returning to the Netherworld Realm, Zhang Fei [4] immediately made his way back to the ghostveil forest. He proceeded to see Arbeola while contemplating a strategy to infiltrate the succubi tower.

"You managed to find your brother-in-law, right?" Zhang Fei [4] was not surprised by Arbeola's question, especially since the old demon tree could communicate with all the trees in the realm. "The two men are in Alder's hands, and they are doing well there, so you don't need to worry about them.

However, you must rescue the woman from Thish's grasp as soon as possible, as she will lose her sanity if she keeps torturing her. Your only way to enter the tower is to go to the Lust Inn to meet Xenaya, and she will help you meet Orith."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [4] looked at Arbeola with surprise, as he just remembered about Orith.

"Hahaha." Arbeola laughed and told Zhang Fei [4] again. "Xenaya had already told her about you, and Orith came here once to look for you. She even asked me to let her know when you returned, so you wouldn't have any trouble entering their tower if she brought you there, and the other two succubi wouldn't reject you.
However, Thish is very dangerous, so you have to keep an eye on her, or she will do something to you if you let your guard down."
"In that case, I'll go to Lust City right now to meet Xenaya, Old Demon."

"Wait a minute, kid." Arbeola immediately stopped Zhang Fei [4] as he was about to leave. "Orith is the kindest of the three, and I have known her since she first came to Lust City, so I hope you won't hurt her. Ilsath is actually not bad either, but she is quite vicious even though she is not as vicious as Thish, so you can decide for yourself about her."
"All right, I'll look at the situation first, Old Demon."

In a few minutes, Zhang Fei [4] had arrived in front of the Lust Inn, but he didn't find Xenya there, and a maidservant told him that Orith had summoned her to the tower. He immediately decided to go there, but he also checked the mansion in the north of the city with his senses, where he found Cain together with Yu Xixuan and Lu Xin. 'That guy's back, huh?
I'll enter the succubi tower first, and I'll think of a way to meet him after.'

However, Zhang Fei [4] did not immediately get the succubi tower, especially since he would not have been able to enter by himself, so he decided to wait in a restaurant-like building a little way in front of the tower and check it through his map.
He was annoyed because he found Thish still with Yan Zixiu, and he was sure that she was still torturing her, making him impatient to immediately save her.

Zhang Fei [4] then checked other areas, and he found Ilsath in the throne room talking to about 200 succubi. However, he immediately looked for Orith and discovered her in a room that looked like a warehouse, with Xenya and other succubi.

Since he didn't want to wait any longer, Zhang Fei [4] decided to speak to Xenaya using telepathy, which surprised the succubus. He immediately informed Orith of his return, which made the succubus duchess rush out of the place, and she followed her master behind.
Before long, Orith and Xenya had arrived in front of Zhang Fei [4], and the succubus duchess immediately squinted her eyes as she closely observed him.

Then Orith sat on a side chair, propped her chin with her hand, and spoke to Zhang Fei [4]. "Elion, right? My subordinates have already told me a lot about you, especially about your strength in bed, and you even exhausted her when you two had sex before. That's why I've been waiting for you for several days and looking forward to meeting you, so I'm glad you're back in town."
[Hahaha! This woman is much more shameless than you, Master! She didn't even beat around the bush and went straight to the point with his goal of meeting you.]

Zhang Fei [4] ignored Mei and faced Orith. "My lady, Xenaya has also told me a lot about you, so I was looking forward to meeting you. Unfortunately, you were still busy in the demon emperor city before, so I decided to go train first, and I came back today to check if you have returned.
However, you are much better than what she told me, and you still look so young; even your face is extraordinarily charming."

Xenaya and the demons around them took a deep breath as they listened to Zhang Fei [4] speaking to Orith so casually. After all, she was one of the four leaders of their city, and her status was far above theirs, so they all always spoke to her with respect, but he spoke to her as if he had known her for a long time.
Beyond their expectations, Orith wasn't angry with Zhang Fei [4], but instead laughed out loud. "Hahaha! Do I really look so young, Elion?"

sentences.text: "Zi'er, Xiaoling." Zhang Wuji muttered softly before raising both hands.
"Zhang Fei, I have become a demon like this, so I can't possibly meet them again, and they will definitely be frightened by my demon form."
With a shake of his head, Zhang Fei [4] refuted him.
"You underestimate their feelings too much, brother-in-law.
I have heard stories about how you met Zi'er and how you two got married, so I know her feelings for you are strong and deep.
Xiaoling also loves you very much, and she has always respected you, so I'm sure they will never reject you, even if you have become a demon.
Moreover, you are a demon cultivator, and you can use the transformation technique to return to your original form, so I'm sure everything will be fine."
Zhang Wuji did not refute Zhang Fei [4], but fear had already filled his heart, and he was truly afraid that his family would not be able to accept him with his current status as a demon.
Zhang Fei [4] immediately spoke to him again.
"Brother-in-law, all my wives and families know my identity as a lust demon, and they are willing to accept me even though some of them hate demons, so you don't have to worry about that, okay?"
Zhang Wuji just nodded and looked at the leaders of the natural races, and he could see that the female demon was being pushed back by their attacks.
Even black blood had already covered her body, especially since Elmyra's light element was too strong and pure, and not many demons could face her head-on.
Additionally, Oliver helped the elf leader to increase her speed, and Zuhe, the druid leader, also assisted her by using the water in the black river.
"That female demon is a marchioness rank demon, but it's not a big deal for them." Zhang Fei [4] immediately stood up.
"However, I can't just let her die like this, especially since her demon power is quite useful to me."
After he said that, Zhang Fei [4] immediately disappeared from Zhang Wuji's sight, and he instantly moved behind the female demon before strangling her neck.
Seeing that, Oliver, Elmyra, and Zuhe immediately stopped attacking the female demon, waiting for Zhang Fei [4]'s next action.
"Please, don't kill me!
I have no intention of killing him, and I just need a little bit of demon energy." The female demon begged as she changed her form into a beautiful one again, and fake tears dripped from her eyes.
"Oh, really?" Zhang Fei [4] gripped the female demon's neck tighter.
"You might be able to deceive others with your fake tears, but you won't be able to deceive me."
"No!
Argh!" The female demon screamed in pain as Zhang Fei [4] activated his demon-absorbing ability to absorb her demon power and life force.
"Argh!
Please!
I don't want to die!"

Zhang Wuji and the three leaders of the natural races took a deep breath as they watched Zhang Fei [4]'s cruelty, particularly as the female demon's body began to dry up and the skin all over her body wrinkled rapidly.
This eventually led to her death, leaving only her dried skin and skeleton.
Zhang Fei [4] immediately threw the female demon's skeleton into the black river.
"Phew!
Her demon power isn't bad, but it's not enough for me."
"Your demon technique is terrifying, Zhang Fei." Elmyra said so with a soft sigh.
"Can you also use that technique on other living creatures?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] nodded at Elmyra.
"If I use it on cultivators, not only can I absorb their soul and life force, but I can also absorb their understanding and attainment in cultivation."
Elmyra nodded slightly in response and reminded Zhang Fei [4].
"You should be careful in using your techniques, especially since not all techniques are without consequences, and such a technique definitely has serious consequences.
You may not be able to feel the effects now, but that doesn't mean there aren't any, and you might be able to feel them in the future, so you have to control yourself when using it."
"Thank you for your advice, and I will be more careful in using it." Zhang Fei then looked at Oliver and Zuhe, who were helping Zhang Wuji walk towards them.
"Since we have managed to find my brother-in-law, I will send the three of you back to the Sky Jade Realm."
"What about Gu Tong and Chi Yang?
Aren't you going to save them?" Oliver asked Zhang Fei [4].
Zhang Fei [4] sighed heavily at that.
"Chi Yang has already completely turned into a demon, and Gu Tong has also begun to become one.
Unfortunately, they are in Alder's hands, and we won't be able to defeat him even if we combine our strengths, which will only put us in danger.
Moreover, they are not that important to me, and Yan Zixiu is much more important because she is the big sister of one of my partners.
Currently, she is in the hands of that cruel succubus, and she really likes torturing other demons, so I have to save her as quickly as possible, or she will die in her hands."
"What about the other seniors, Zhang Fei?"
Zhang Fei [4] shook his head at Zhang Wuji.
"Meng Guanqiu told Shen Xueyi that Meng Qi's jade is still intact, so she should be fine.
Unfortunately, Ba Jiawen and Chu Hong are dead, and they probably died in other realms because I couldn't find them in this realm."
Zhang Wuji released a heavy sigh after hearing that, especially since Ba Jiawen and Chu Hong were quite strong, and their deaths were a huge loss to their realm.

"All right, you don't have to think about that, especially since everything has already happened, and we can't turn back time to save them." A gate and portal immediately appeared in front of them after Zhang Fei [4] ordered Mei.
"This gate will lead the three of you to the Chu Clan, so you guys can go back there directly.
Brother-in-law, Zi'er and the others will be waiting for you, so you can enter this portal to meet them."
Unlike the three leaders of the natural races who immediately entered the gate, Zhang Wuji seemed hesitant to enter the portal.
After all, all cultivators in the Sky Jade Realm, including his family, harbored deep hatred for demons, so he was truly afraid that they would reject him.
Seeing him continue like that, Zhang Fei [4] quickly put his arm around Zhang Wuji's shoulders and brought him directly into his training space.
"Husband!"
"Father!"
"Wuji!"
"Brother!"
As soon as they appeared, Zhang Long, Yang Yudie, Zhang Lingxue, Zi'er, and Zhang Xiaoling immediately shouted and ran towards them.
Instead, Zhang Wuji took a few steps back once they arrived in front of him, and he also lowered his head in fear of the reality that he was about to face.
However, Zi'er did not care about her husband's appearance, and she immediately jumped towards him before hugging him directly.
"Sob...
Sob...
I'm glad you're still alive; I don't know what I would do if you died."
"Father." Zhang Xiaoling called softly as she hugged her parents, and she cried happily, feeling the warmth of her father's body.
"Sob...
Thank goodness you managed to survive, and Zhang Fei managed to bring you back to us; otherwise, we would have been miserable if you had died in that realm."
Zhang Long immediately walked to his son's side and put his hand on his shoulder.
"I understand how you feel, Wuji.
No matter whether you are a human or a demon, you are still our family.
Although we feel a little strange seeing you look like this now, we just need some time to adapt to the situation, and everything will be back to normal after some time."
"Your father is right, Wuji." Yang Yudie then hugged her son's other side.
"Give us time to adapt to it, and everything will be fine as before."
Zhang Lingxue also spoke to Zhang Wuji directly.
"Brother, you know that my husband is a demon, but we've never had a problem with his identity, and we completely accept him as he is.
Moreover, you are not an ordinary demon but a demon cultivator, and he can teach you a transformation technique, so you can use it to return to yourself and gather with us again."
Zhang Fei [4] directly touched Zhang Wuji's forehead and imparted a transformation technique to him.
"You can learn it now, brother-in-law.
This way, you guys can get together again without worrying about yourself or them."
Zhang Wuji nodded to Zhang Fei before hugging them all, and joyful tears began to flow from his eyes.
However, the feelings of anxiety and fear persisted in his heart as he continued to contemplate his status as a demon.

"All right, you guys can reunite now, and I will return to the netherworld realm to find a way to save Yan Zhixiu." Zhang Long and the others were surprised to hear that, especially since Zhang Fei [4] had previously told them that he couldn't find the sect master of the Yin-Yang Pavilion in that realm.
"I once checked the succubi tower, and there were several areas in that place covered by concealment barriers.

At first, I couldn't find her because she was probably locked up in one of those areas, and I only found her today after she was taken out of the area, so I will find a way to infiltrate there to save her."
"Husband, you better be careful when doing that, especially since the strength of the three succubi duchesses is still higher than yours."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Zhang Lingxue.
"I will be careful there, and you can return to our mansion once you've had enough reunions with my brother-in-law."

After that, Zhang Fei [4] immediately left them and returned to the netherworld realm, and Zhang Lingxue remained standing beside her family with a relieved expression, especially since Zhang Wuji had returned to their side.

Upon returning to the Netherworld Realm, Zhang Fei [4] immediately made his way back to the ghostveil forest.
He proceeded to see Arbeola while contemplating a strategy to infiltrate the succubi tower.
"You managed to find your brother-in-law, right?" Zhang Fei [4] was not surprised by Arbeola's question, especially since the old demon tree could communicate with all the trees in the realm.
"The two men are in Alder's hands, and they are doing well there, so you don't need to worry about them.
However, you must rescue the woman from Thish's grasp as soon as possible, as she will lose her sanity if she keeps torturing her.
Your only way to enter the tower is to go to the Lust Inn to meet Xenaya, and she will help you meet Orith."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [4] looked at Arbeola with surprise, as he just remembered about Orith.
"Hahaha." Arbeola laughed and told Zhang Fei [4] again.
"Xenaya had already told her about you, and Orith came here once to look for you.
She even asked me to let her know when you returned, so you wouldn't have any trouble entering their tower if she brought you there, and the other two succubi wouldn't reject you.
However, Thish is very dangerous, so you have to keep an eye on her, or she will do something to you if you let your guard down."
"In that case, I'll go to Lust City right now to meet Xenaya, Old Demon."
"Wait a minute, kid." Arbeola immediately stopped Zhang Fei [4] as he was about to leave.
"Orith is the kindest of the three, and I have known her since she first came to Lust City, so I hope you won't hurt her.
Ilsath is actually not bad either, but she is quite vicious even though she is not as vicious as Thish, so you can decide for yourself about her."
"All right, I'll look at the situation first, Old Demon."
In a few minutes, Zhang Fei [4] had arrived in front of the Lust Inn, but he didn't find Xenya there, and a maidservant told him that Orith had summoned her to the tower.
He immediately decided to go there, but he also checked the mansion in the north of the city with his senses, where he found Cain together with Yu Xixuan and Lu Xin. 'That guy's back, huh?
I'll enter the succubi tower first, and I'll think of a way to meet him after.'

However, Zhang Fei [4] did not immediately get the succubi tower, especially since he would not have been able to enter by himself, so he decided to wait in a restaurant-like building a little way in front of the tower and check it through his map.
He was annoyed because he found Thish still with Yan Zixiu, and he was sure that she was still torturing her, making him impatient to immediately save her.
Zhang Fei [4] then checked other areas, and he found Ilsath in the throne room talking to about 200 succubi.
However, he immediately looked for Orith and discovered her in a room that looked like a warehouse, with Xenya and other succubi.
Since he didn't want to wait any longer, Zhang Fei [4] decided to speak to Xenaya using telepathy, which surprised the succubus.
He immediately informed Orith of his return, which made the succubus duchess rush out of the place, and she followed her master behind.
Before long, Orith and Xenya had arrived in front of Zhang Fei [4], and the succubus duchess immediately squinted her eyes as she closely observed him.
Then Orith sat on a side chair, propped her chin with her hand, and spoke to Zhang Fei [4].
"Elion, right?
My subordinates have already told me a lot about you, especially about your strength in bed, and you even exhausted her when you two had sex before.
That's why I've been waiting for you for several days and looking forward to meeting you, so I'm glad you're back in town."
[Hahaha!
This woman is much more shameless than you, Master!
She didn't even beat around the bush and went straight to the point with his goal of meeting you.]
Zhang Fei [4] ignored Mei and faced Orith.
"My lady, Xenaya has also told me a lot about you, so I was looking forward to meeting you.
Unfortunately, you were still busy in the demon emperor city before, so I decided to go train first, and I came back today to check if you have returned.
However, you are much better than what she told me, and you still look so young; even your face is extraordinarily charming."
Xenaya and the demons around them took a deep breath as they listened to Zhang Fei [4] speaking to Orith so casually.

After all, she was one of the four leaders of their city, and her status was far above theirs, so they all always spoke to her with respect, but he spoke to her as if he had known her for a long time.
Beyond their expectations, Orith wasn't angry with Zhang Fei [4], but instead laughed out loud.
"Hahaha!
Do I really look so young, Elion?"

chapters.title: Chapter 449 Zhang Wuji's Decision
paragraphs: "Yes, you are still so young, and your figure is truly attractive, my lady." Zhang Fei [4]'s answer caused the demons to facepalm, and they waited for Orith's reaction, but his next words made them feel annoyed with him, especially the female demons. "There are so many young and sexy female demons in this city, including Xenaya, but all of them pale in comparison to you.

You look much younger than them, and your red night dress perfectly hugs your curvy body, making you look graceful and sensual at the same time. That's why I came back to this city because I was curious about you, and I wanted to meet you in person, but the real you were completely beyond my imagination."
Xenaya massaged her forehead. 'This brat! How dare he say such things to Lady Orith? She may be the kindest of the three duchesses, but she will not hesitate to kill him if he offends her!'

"Haha." Orith let out a soft chuckle before speaking. "I like you, Elion. Xenaya told me that you were not interested in joining the Incubi Tower because you wanted to live freely without being restrained, but you wouldn't refuse if I invited you to join me, right?"

"My lady, I would certainly be delighted to join such an amazing woman as you." Zhang Fei [4] then glanced towards the Succubi Tower before continuing. "Unfortunately, there are only succubi in your place, so I would feel strange if I were the only man there, and all of them would probably eat me.
Additionally, the other two ladies might not be willing to accept me, and they will kick me out right away, so I'm not sure about accepting your offer."

"Hey! You are an Incubus, and we come from the same demon race, so you shouldn't be afraid of our subordinates, right?" Orith then pointed to the tower's top. "As long as I'm the one who brought you there, Ilsath won't mind your presence. However, Thish might dislike you, especially since she's more interested in women, and she has always considered men to be nothing more than tools.
Even so, you don't need to be afraid of her, and I will protect you from her."

"I believe that you will protect me, but I will think about your offer first, My Lady." Zhang Fei [4]'s refusal caused the demons to curse him and call him stupid, especially since Orith had personally invited him, and she was even willing to protect him. "Actually, I still have something to settle, so I can't go with you right now."

Rather than feeling disappointed, Orith immediately stood up and pulled Zhang Fei [4] up with her. "What matter do you want to settle? I will help you settle it, so you can come with me to my place right away."
'This woman! She can't wait to eat me, huh?' Zhang Fei [4] then told Orith. "I have to train every day to kill hundreds of demon beasts, so I want to go to the forest to fight them first."
"Hundreds of demon beasts?" Not only Orith was shocked to hear that, but Xenaya and the other demons also looked shocked.

Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Orith. "As you already know, I am a wild Incubus, so I need to keep increasing my strength, and I can only rely on myself to become strong. Otherwise, other stronger demons will bully me, and I don't want that to happen to me.'

"I see." Orith immediately took Zhang Fei [4] flying towards the city gate, leaving Xenaya and the demons dumbfounded. "In that case, I will accompany you to training because I am also curious about your fighting ability, so I will watch you from the side and only help you when you are in danger."

Once they vanished from view, Xenaya hurried back to the Lust Inn with a disappointed expression, certain that Orith would not share Zhang Fei [4] with her. The other demons also immediately dispersed from the place, but two male demons rushed to the Incubi Tower to report about his presence in their city.

Orith did not take Zhang Fei [4] to the ghostveil forest, and she took him to a valley a little far from the forest, especially since the demon beasts in that area were stronger and more ferocious, so she wanted to test his fighting skills by fighting against them.

Zhang Fei [4] didn't really care about it, especially since his bloodline was superior to those demon beasts, and his demon rank was also higher than theirs, so it wasn't a big deal for him to face them. However, he was unable to use his light element due to Orith's presence, and he didn't want to reveal the demon extermination sword to her.
Therefore, he opted to use his body modification ability to transform both of his hands into weapons.

Orith, who was sitting on a huge boulder, smiled as she looked at Zhang Fei [4]. She wasn't surprised by his action, especially since all lust demons could also turn any part of their body into a weapon.

"What? No way!" Orith screamed in shock as soon as Zhang Fei [4] disappeared from her sight, and her eyes couldn't follow his movements. However, she was even more shocked when he suddenly appeared in front of a giant plain behemoth and punched its head directly, exploding it into pieces instantly. 'What the hell?

His demon rank is only at marquis rank, but his speed surpasses Ilsath, and his raw attacks also surpass Thish. Where did Elion actually come from? How could he hone his speed and strength to become so fast and strong? Furthermore, Xenaya informed me that he possesses exceptional stamina and endurance, potentially matching or even surpassing mine.

If he has the special abilities of the three of us, then it would be great if he sided with us, and he could overthrow Yhrer's position as the Incubus Lord. Tch! No matter what, I must succeed in drawing him to our side, so we can get rid of that idiot and have full control over Lust City.'

Zhang Fei [4] himself realized that it was not easy to impress Orith, so he deliberately used his full strength to deal with those demon beasts. He fully believed that his actions would give him a lot of leeway to facilitate his movements in the Succubi Tower later, so he could free Yan Zixiu from Thish as soon as possible.

'Impressive!' Orith screamed inwardly as she watched Zhang Fei [4] manage to kill so many demon beasts in such a short time, and she was sure it wouldn't be difficult for him to kill hundreds of them, causing her sensual lips to spread into a seductive smile. 'Haha! Before I bring him to our tower, I want to have some fun with him first, so I can prove his strength in bed firsthand.'

Meanwhile, two male demons had arrived at the top floor of the Incubi Tower, and they saw Yhrer having fun with a female gargoyle, who was none other than Huan Ning. They immediately reported to him about Zhang Fei[4]'s presence in their city, and they also told him that Orith took him away with her. "What's that incubus' name? Why didn't he register for this tower?"

"My lord, I heard that his name is Elion, and he wants to live freely without any restraints, so he doesn't want to join us." Yhrer immediately released his familiar to search for Orith and Zhang Fei [4]. "My Lord, I think that kid is very arrogant, and he is looking down on us by refusing to join us, so I think we should teach him a lesson, but we have to do it behind Lady Orith's back.
Otherwise, the other incubi will act the same as him, and they might not want to join us anymore."

Yhrer did not answer the male demon as he concentrated on searching for Orith and Zhang Fei [4] through his familiar, and he soon found them in the valley. However, the succubus duchess noticed his actions and destroyed his familiar immediately, causing him to frown at her actions.

'That bitch! How dare she destroy my familiar!? I will definitely teach her a lesson the next time I come to their tower.' Yhrer did not want to give up and sent several other familiars to the valley, but Orith and Zhang Fei [4] had already disappeared from the place, so he immediately spread them out to search for the two in other areas.

However, he had difficulty finding them, especially since the eastern region was quite large, so he ordered his subordinates directly. "Order some of our members to watch over the city, and tell them to bring that brat to me as soon as possible. However, I don't want to have any problems with the three succubi duchesses, so they have to do it carefully."
"Yes, My Lord!"

After the two left, Yhrer immediately pulled Huan Ning into his lap and started to fuck her. She was no longer arrogant like when she was still living in the Sky Jade Realm as a human, and instead she looked so docile and lustful due to the Incubus lord's abilities.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] noticed a rapid drop in temperature in the Wasteland Realm, along with the onset of windstorms and heavy snow in some areas, which resulted in an extremely cold air temperature at the mountain's peak. 'Zefyr, I will send you back to the training space right now, especially since this place will get colder later, and you will definitely have a hard time enduring the cold.'

Zefyr, who was still enjoying absorbing the natural energy from the colorful rocks, immediately opened her eyes. After all, she was a fairy, and she was very familiar with the power of nature, so she could tell that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was right. 'All right, you can send me back there now, but you have to bring me here again, okay?'

'Sure! If I get the chance, I will definitely bring you here again.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] took Zefyr to a different area and sent her into the training space. He then looked at Shang Yingyue, who was already starting to feel the cold. He immediately used his teleportation to return to the Shang Clan residence, and he quickly returned to Shang Yaolin's room.

Not long after Zhang Xiaolong [3] left, Shang Yingyue immediately opened her eyes and stood up, and she looked in several directions before descending from the mountain peak to return to her private quarter at the fortress.

However, Shang Yingyue heard a strange voice the moment she arrived at the area reserved for her clan members, so she decided to check the room where the sound came from. She found Shang Xiaojuan was completely naked in his room, and he acted like he was fucking a woman. 'This crazy bastard!
I knew he was crazy about Shang Yaolin, but her repeated rejections seemed to have driven him mad, and he was even acting like a horny beast now.'
Unfortunately, Shang Yingyue misjudged Shang Xiaojuan, especially since he acted like that because of Zhang Xiaolong [3]. She immediately ignored him and returned to her own room.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already returned to Shang Yaolin's room, and he immediately lay down beside her while hugging her. However, she didn't show any reaction, especially since her subconscious was still trapped in a sweet dream. 'You're lucky that I'm by your side, you know?

Otherwise, you would have definitely fallen under the influence of the pill your cousin gave you, and you would have begged him to take you as his own. Anyway, Mei, I will seal all my senses for cultivation, so I'll leave the monitoring of the surrounding area to you.'
[Yes, Master. I will definitely protect you, so you can cultivate in peace.]

Inside the training space, Zhang Wuji was sitting side by side with Zi'er, who was resting her head on his shoulder while hugging his right arm tightly. They watched their parents, who seemed to have difficulty practicing using the level one gravity feature, but Zhang Xiaoling could move freely because she was used to that level.
Meanwhile, Zhang Lingxue had returned to the Cloud Mansion, especially since Zhang Fei had started dual-cultivating with her other sisters, so she wanted to join them.

Zhang Wuji rubbed Zi'er's right arm while talking to her. "No wonder Zhang Fei can be so terrifying even though he's still young; it turns out he has such an amazing training place. Moreover, he has three identities, and each identity has unusual abilities, such as his ability to move between realms.
If it weren't for him, we would never succeed in destroying the demon portal, and I would probably already die in the Netherworld Realm."

"Yeah, you're right." Zi'er replied with a slight nod. "Zhang Fei's sudden appearance brought many changes not only to our clan, but he also brought changes to all the inhabitants of our realm. If it weren't for him, Lingxue might have died from her injuries. If it weren't for him, Xiaoling and I would have lost you, and we would have fallen into a pit of misery."
"Wife." Zi'er immediately looked up at Zhang Wuji. "Even though I can use the transformation technique to return to myself, I am no longer a human but a demon, so—"
"Are you thinking of leaving us?" Zi'er interrupted Zhang Wuji while seriously looking at him.

Zhang Wuji immediately lifted Zi'er and grabbed her shoulders. "I don't want to leave you all, but I'm different from Zhang Fei, who still has his human and beast forms, and I'm a complete demon now. The Sky Jade Realm is no longer suitable for me, and a demon realm like the Netherworld Realm is the best place for me.

Moreover, you know that the people in our realm hate demons very much, and they will find out about me sooner or later. If they find out that I've become a demon, I'm sure they will unite to attack our clan, and we won't be able to deal with them all at once. That's why I decided to ask him to take me back to that realm, and I will stay there forever."

Zi'er naturally realized the problem, but she didn't want to be separated from her husband, so she made up her mind right away. "In that case, I will accompany you into that realm, and I don't care if I have to turn into a demon as long as I can be by your side. As for Xiaoling, she can stay in our realm with our parents, and we can ask Zhang Fei to bring us back if we miss her."
"No." Zhang Wuji immediately rejected Zi'er's wishes. "I don't want to see you become a demon like me, and Xiaoling still needs you, so you should stay here to accompany her."
"Why- Mhm"

Zhang Wuji immediately stopped Zi'er by sealing her lips, but she didn't kiss him back because she didn't like his decision, so he separated their lips again. "I know my decision is selfish, but I can't bear to see you become a demon, and I want you to remain human forever. Moreover, I'm doing this for the safety of all of you and our clan, so I hope you can understand my decision and stay here."
Zi'er didn't say anything in response to her husband's words, but she continued to stare at him with sadness and disappointment filling her heart.

Zhang Wuji let out a heavy sigh and pulled Zi'er into his arms. "Please understand my decision, okay? Even though we have to live in two different realms, we can still meet each other with Zhang Fei's help, so I hope you can let me stay in that realm."

"I believe that you will protect me, but I will think about your offer first, My Lady." Zhang Fei [4]'s refusal caused the demons to curse him and call him stupid, especially since Orith had personally invited him, and she was even willing to protect him.
"Actually, I still have something to settle, so I can't go with you right now."
Rather than feeling disappointed, Orith immediately stood up and pulled Zhang Fei [4] up with her.
"What matter do you want to settle?
I will help you settle it, so you can come with me to my place right away."
'This woman!
She can't wait to eat me, huh?' Zhang Fei [4] then told Orith.
"I have to train every day to kill hundreds of demon beasts, so I want to go to the forest to fight them first."
"Hundreds of demon beasts?" Not only Orith was shocked to hear that, but Xenaya and the other demons also looked shocked.
Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Orith.
"As you already know, I am a wild Incubus, so I need to keep increasing my strength, and I can only rely on myself to become strong.
Otherwise, other stronger demons will bully me, and I don't want that to happen to me.'
"I see." Orith immediately took Zhang Fei [4] flying towards the city gate, leaving Xenaya and the demons dumbfounded.
"In that case, I will accompany you to training because I am also curious about your fighting ability, so I will watch you from the side and only help you when you are in danger."
Once they vanished from view, Xenaya hurried back to the Lust Inn with a disappointed expression, certain that Orith would not share Zhang Fei [4] with her.
The other demons also immediately dispersed from the place, but two male demons rushed to the Incubi Tower to report about his presence in their city.

Orith did not take Zhang Fei [4] to the ghostveil forest, and she took him to a valley a little far from the forest, especially since the demon beasts in that area were stronger and more ferocious, so she wanted to test his fighting skills by fighting against them.

Zhang Fei [4] didn't really care about it, especially since his bloodline was superior to those demon beasts, and his demon rank was also higher than theirs, so it wasn't a big deal for him to face them.
However, he was unable to use his light element due to Orith's presence, and he didn't want to reveal the demon extermination sword to her.
Therefore, he opted to use his body modification ability to transform both of his hands into weapons.
Orith, who was sitting on a huge boulder, smiled as she looked at Zhang Fei [4].
She wasn't surprised by his action, especially since all lust demons could also turn any part of their body into a weapon.
"What?
No way!" Orith screamed in shock as soon as Zhang Fei [4] disappeared from her sight, and her eyes couldn't follow his movements.
However, she was even more shocked when he suddenly appeared in front of a giant plain behemoth and punched its head directly, exploding it into pieces instantly. 'What the hell?
His demon rank is only at marquis rank, but his speed surpasses Ilsath, and his raw attacks also surpass Thish.
Where did Elion actually come from?
How could he hone his speed and strength to become so fast and strong?
Furthermore, Xenaya informed me that he possesses exceptional stamina and endurance, potentially matching or even surpassing mine.
If he has the special abilities of the three of us, then it would be great if he sided with us, and he could overthrow Yhrer's position as the Incubus Lord.
Tch!
No matter what, I must succeed in drawing him to our side, so we can get rid of that idiot and have full control over Lust City.'
Zhang Fei [4] himself realized that it was not easy to impress Orith, so he deliberately used his full strength to deal with those demon beasts.
He fully believed that his actions would give him a lot of leeway to facilitate his movements in the Succubi Tower later, so he could free Yan Zixiu from Thish as soon as possible.

'Impressive!' Orith screamed inwardly as she watched Zhang Fei [4] manage to kill so many demon beasts in such a short time, and she was sure it wouldn't be difficult for him to kill hundreds of them, causing her sensual lips to spread into a seductive smile. 'Haha!
Before I bring him to our tower, I want to have some fun with him first, so I can prove his strength in bed firsthand.'
Meanwhile, two male demons had arrived at the top floor of the Incubi Tower, and they saw Yhrer having fun with a female gargoyle, who was none other than Huan Ning.
They immediately reported to him about Zhang Fei[4]'s presence in their city, and they also told him that Orith took him away with her.
"What's that incubus' name?
Why didn't he register for this tower?"

"My lord, I heard that his name is Elion, and he wants to live freely without any restraints, so he doesn't want to join us." Yhrer immediately released his familiar to search for Orith and Zhang Fei [4].
"My Lord, I think that kid is very arrogant, and he is looking down on us by refusing to join us, so I think we should teach him a lesson, but we have to do it behind Lady Orith's back.
Otherwise, the other incubi will act the same as him, and they might not want to join us anymore."
Yhrer did not answer the male demon as he concentrated on searching for Orith and Zhang Fei [4] through his familiar, and he soon found them in the valley.
However, the succubus duchess noticed his actions and destroyed his familiar immediately, causing him to frown at her actions.
'That bitch!
How dare she destroy my familiar!?

I will definitely teach her a lesson the next time I come to their tower.' Yhrer did not want to give up and sent several other familiars to the valley, but Orith and Zhang Fei [4] had already disappeared from the place, so he immediately spread them out to search for the two in other areas.
However, he had difficulty finding them, especially since the eastern region was quite large, so he ordered his subordinates directly.
"Order some of our members to watch over the city, and tell them to bring that brat to me as soon as possible.
However, I don't want to have any problems with the three succubi duchesses, so they have to do it carefully."
"Yes, My Lord!"
After the two left, Yhrer immediately pulled Huan Ning into his lap and started to fuck her.
She was no longer arrogant like when she was still living in the Sky Jade Realm as a human, and instead she looked so docile and lustful due to the Incubus lord's abilities.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] noticed a rapid drop in temperature in the Wasteland Realm, along with the onset of windstorms and heavy snow in some areas, which resulted in an extremely cold air temperature at the mountain's peak. 'Zefyr, I will send you back to the training space right now, especially since this place will get colder later, and you will definitely have a hard time enduring the cold.'
Zefyr, who was still enjoying absorbing the natural energy from the colorful rocks, immediately opened her eyes.

After all, she was a fairy, and she was very familiar with the power of nature, so she could tell that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was right. 'All right, you can send me back there now, but you have to bring me here again, okay?'
'Sure!
If I get the chance, I will definitely bring you here again.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] took Zefyr to a different area and sent her into the training space.
He then looked at Shang Yingyue, who was already starting to feel the cold.
He immediately used his teleportation to return to the Shang Clan residence, and he quickly returned to Shang Yaolin's room.

Not long after Zhang Xiaolong [3] left, Shang Yingyue immediately opened her eyes and stood up, and she looked in several directions before descending from the mountain peak to return to her private quarter at the fortress.
However, Shang Yingyue heard a strange voice the moment she arrived at the area reserved for her clan members, so she decided to check the room where the sound came from.
She found Shang Xiaojuan was completely naked in his room, and he acted like he was fucking a woman. 'This crazy bastard!
I knew he was crazy about Shang Yaolin, but her repeated rejections seemed to have driven him mad, and he was even acting like a horny beast now.'
Unfortunately, Shang Yingyue misjudged Shang Xiaojuan, especially since he acted like that because of Zhang Xiaolong [3].
She immediately ignored him and returned to her own room.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already returned to Shang Yaolin's room, and he immediately lay down beside her while hugging her.
However, she didn't show any reaction, especially since her subconscious was still trapped in a sweet dream. 'You're lucky that I'm by your side, you know?
Otherwise, you would have definitely fallen under the influence of the pill your cousin gave you, and you would have begged him to take you as his own.
Anyway, Mei, I will seal all my senses for cultivation, so I'll leave the monitoring of the surrounding area to you.'
[Yes, Master.
I will definitely protect you, so you can cultivate in peace.]
Inside the training space, Zhang Wuji was sitting side by side with Zi'er, who was resting her head on his shoulder while hugging his right arm tightly.
They watched their parents, who seemed to have difficulty practicing using the level one gravity feature, but Zhang Xiaoling could move freely because she was used to that level.
Meanwhile, Zhang Lingxue had returned to the Cloud Mansion, especially since Zhang Fei had started dual-cultivating with her other sisters, so she wanted to join them.
Zhang Wuji rubbed Zi'er's right arm while talking to her.
"No wonder Zhang Fei can be so terrifying even though he's still young; it turns out he has such an amazing training place.
Moreover, he has three identities, and each identity has unusual abilities, such as his ability to move between realms.
If it weren't for him, we would never succeed in destroying the demon portal, and I would probably already die in the Netherworld Realm."
"Yeah, you're right." Zi'er replied with a slight nod.
"Zhang Fei's sudden appearance brought many changes not only to our clan, but he also brought changes to all the inhabitants of our realm.
If it weren't for him, Lingxue might have died from her injuries.
If it weren't for him, Xiaoling and I would have lost you, and we would have fallen into a pit of misery."
"Wife." Zi'er immediately looked up at Zhang Wuji.
"Even though I can use the transformation technique to return to myself, I am no longer a human but a demon, so—"
"Are you thinking of leaving us?" Zi'er interrupted Zhang Wuji while seriously looking at him.
Zhang Wuji immediately lifted Zi'er and grabbed her shoulders.
"I don't want to leave you all, but I'm different from Zhang Fei, who still has his human and beast forms, and I'm a complete demon now.
The Sky Jade Realm is no longer suitable for me, and a demon realm like the Netherworld Realm is the best place for me.
Moreover, you know that the people in our realm hate demons very much, and they will find out about me sooner or later.
If they find out that I've become a demon, I'm sure they will unite to attack our clan, and we won't be able to deal with them all at once.
That's why I decided to ask him to take me back to that realm, and I will stay there forever."
Zi'er naturally realized the problem, but she didn't want to be separated from her husband, so she made up her mind right away.
"In that case, I will accompany you into that realm, and I don't care if I have to turn into a demon as long as I can be by your side.
As for Xiaoling, she can stay in our realm with our parents, and we can ask Zhang Fei to bring us back if we miss her."
"No." Zhang Wuji immediately rejected Zi'er's wishes.
"I don't want to see you become a demon like me, and Xiaoling still needs you, so you should stay here to accompany her."
"Why- Mhm"
Zhang Wuji immediately stopped Zi'er by sealing her lips, but she didn't kiss him back because she didn't like his decision, so he separated their lips again.
"I know my decision is selfish, but I can't bear to see you become a demon, and I want you to remain human forever.
Moreover, I'm doing this for the safety of all of you and our clan, so I hope you can understand my decision and stay here."
Zi'er didn't say anything in response to her husband's words, but she continued to stare at him with sadness and disappointment filling her heart.
Zhang Wuji let out a heavy sigh and pulled Zi'er into his arms.
"Please understand my decision, okay?
Even though we have to live in two different realms, we can still meet each other with Zhang Fei's help, so I hope you can let me stay in that realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 450 Tianguo
paragraphs: "Why did you have to make this decision, Wuji?" With a disappointed look, Yang Yudie posed the question. Although she was aware of her son's situation, it was still difficult for her to part with him, let alone letting him live in the Netherworld Realm alone.
Zhang Long also looked disappointed with his son's decision. "Are you sure about your decision? Look at Zi'er; she is completely saddened by your decision, so I think you should reconsider it."

"Father." Zhang Xiaoling called softly as she grabbed her father's right arm, and tears also flowed from both of her eyes. "Please... reconsider your decision... My mother and I need you by our side the most, so we can't lose you."

Unlike them, Zhang Lingxue fully understood her big brother's character, and she knew that he would never change his mind once he had made a decision. She was also saddened by his decision, but she tried to accept it. Moreover, her husband could bring him back to them whenever they wanted, and he could also find a safe place for him to stay, so she wasn't too worried about him.

"Silly girl." Zhang Wuji immediately pulled Zhang Xiaoling into a hug. "Although we live in two different realms, it doesn't mean you will lose me, and we can still meet often with Zhang Fei's help, remember? If we miss each other, we just need to ask him to help us meet, so it's not a big deal for us, right?"

Zhang Xiaoling immediately hugged her father tightly and cried even harder, making Zhang Wuji feel awful in his heart. However, he did not intend to change his decision for the safety of his family members, especially since he was certain that the people of the Sky Jade Realm would turn hostile towards them if they knew that he was a demon.

Zhang Long and Yang Yudie let out heavy sighs because their son was unwilling to change his decision, and Zi'er also looked increasingly disappointed with her husband because Zhang Wuji still insisted on leaving them despite their persuasion.

"Do you really not want to rethink your decision, brother-in-law? Zhang Fei [1] asked as he exited the portable mansion, especially since his main body was still dual-cultivating with one of his wives.

Zhang Wuji immediately turned to him and nodded. "You know more about the lives of demons like us, and we need not only Qi but also demon aura to strengthen ourselves. Aunt Wuhen is indeed close to our family, but I know for sure about her deep hatred for demons, and she may turn against us.

The cultivators in our realm are no different from her, and not everyone can accept our status as demons like your wives or partners. You are indeed strong with extraordinary abilities, and you have some private spaces. However, the current you is still weak, and you will not be able to help us face all the cultivators in our realm, so I made this decision for everyone's sake."

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding. "Since you have decided like that, I will return you to the Netherworld Realm and bring you to Arbeola's place, and he will help you absorb the demon aura in that realm. I will also bring you here often since there is no Qi there, so you can only cultivate here and meet them often."
"Thank you." Zhang Wuji then looked at Zi'er. "Wife, you have heard his words yourself, so I hope you stop being sad because we will still meet often in the future."

Although she still couldn't accept her husband's decision, Zi'er eventually tried to accept it. She then walked in front of Zhang Wuji and hugged him along with their daughter. "Be careful and take good care of yourself there, and you should come here often to see us."
"I promise, I will definitely see you guys often." Zhang Wujie then spoke to his parents. "Father! Mother! I'll entrust Zi'er and Xiaoling to you two."

Zhang Long and Yang Yudie reluctantly agreed to their son's decision, and Zhang Fei [1] promptly brought Zhang Wuji back to the Netherworld realm some time later, leaving Zhang Xiaoling truly saddened by his departure.

In the end, the four people from the Zhang Clan chose to busy themselves with their training so they could forget their sadness a little. Moreover, they would not be separated from Zhang Wuji forever, and they were determined to bring him back to their side again, but they needed strength to do so.

After all, their potential enemies were all the inhabitants of the Sky Jade Realm, and their numbers were simply too numerous, so they wanted to take advantage of Zhang Fei's facilities to improve themselves.

When they arrived at the Netherworld Realm, Zhang Fei [1] immediately brought Zhang Wuji to Arbeola. He explained the situation to him, and the old demon tree did not object. "All right, I will teach him how to absorb the demon aura in this realm, and you don't have to worry about his safety as long as he is under my protection."
"Thank you, Old Demon. I'll leave my brother-in-law with you."

"Wait a minute." Zhang Fei [1] immediately turned to Zhang Wuji. "I will strive hard to increase my strength in this realm, but we don't know what will happen in the future. If something terrible happens to me in the future, I hope you are willing to protect my wife and daughter."

"Haha." Instead, Zhang Fei [1] laughed and patted Zhang Wuji on the shoulder. "Why are you acting like this, brother-in-law? I'm sure you'll be safe staying here because Arbeola will protect you, and not many demons can fight him, so I'm certain nothing bad will happen to you. Moreover, Zi'er and Xiaoling are my family, so I will definitely protect them without you having to ask me."
Zhang Wuji then thought for some time before asking. "Do you like my daughter?"

"Eh?" His question took Zhang Fei [1] aback. "Xiaoling is a beautiful and clever girl, and I love it when she plays her flute. It would be hypocritical of me to say I'm not interested in her, but I don't have that kind of feeling for her yet, and you must be aware that she doesn't have any feelings for me either."

"I know." After all, Zhang Wuji knew his daughter's character very well. "I want you to take her as one of your wives, but you have to try hard to win her heart, especially since she is similar to her mother and won't fall for you so easily."
Zhang Fei [1] shook his head directly at Zhang Wuji. I'll not promise anything, brother-in-law, and we'll see what happens."

After that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately returned to the training space to continue his seclusion with his partners, causing Zhang Wuji to let out a soft sigh. He immediately sat down in front of Arbeola, who began explaining to him about how to absorb the demon aura in the realm, especially since he was completely inexperienced as a demon.
"Now you can start trying to absorb the demon aura."
"Yes, Senior."

Meanwhile, in the Wasteland Realm, several men and women were gathered in a place, and they were discussing about Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially after they got information about him from the two gatekeepers of the fortress.
Even some members of the Shang Clan, such as Shang Wuzi and a few others, joined them.
"Hey, Wuzi! Is that kid really a demon fox?" A young woman, with short black hair and a slightly chubby figure sat on another young woman's lap, inquired.

Shang Wuzi responded by shrugging his shoulders. "Huang Qianghua, I only met them briefly because Senior Yingyue was with them, so I didn't pay attention to that kid. However, they found him in the demon realm, and those guys could also sense a faint demon aura from him, so I thought he was indeed a demon fox."
"What do you think about that, Hao Jianxiu?" Huang Qianghua asked the young woman who was holding her.
Hao Jianxiu nodded slightly in response. "I believe that Huang Fujian and Hao Shihai would not be mistaken in sensing that kid's demon aura, so I agree with Wuzi that he is indeed a demon fox.

However, I cannot understand Shang Yaolin's reason for bringing him to this realm, especially since his cultivation is only at the 6-Star Soul Realm, so he will have no use for her, and he will have difficulty dealing with the unusual climate in this realm with his low cultivation."

"Hahaha!" A young man with spiky red hair suddenly laughed. "Jianxiu, I heard that Shang Yaolin is no different from you two, and he also has a deep interest in adorable things. I haven't seen that kid, but I have seen other fox kids, and they were indeed adorable when they were still small, so she probably brought him here for that reason."

"Why do I feel that you are a strange man, Murong Yi?" The young man with spiky red hair frowned at the straight black-haired young man in front of him, but his appearance was really unusual because he was wearing a woman's dress. "I wouldn't feel strange if such words came out of Jianxiu or Qianghua's mouth, but you are a man, and you seem to have an interest in cute things like them."

"So what?" Murong Yi then mocked the man back. "I'm much better than you, Deng Shicang! Look at you; you're a man, but you act like an effeminate, and you're even shameless enough to wear women's dresses in public."
"You-"

"Enough!" A man with short brown hair and a stocky body immediately stopped the two of them, especially since they always acted like a cat and a mouse and quarreled with each other. "We're gathered here to discuss that fox kid, so you two should stop fighting."
"Humph!" Murong Yi and Deng Shicang immediately snorted while looking away, making the two women laugh at their behavior.
Huang Qianghua suddenly asked the man. "What do you think about that fox kid, Brother Qiao Xuan?"

"We don't need to think too much about that fox kid, right?" Qiao Xuan asked back while shaking his head. "Everyone has long known that the Shang Clan uses the demons from the Netherworld Realm to do things, so I don't think they would mind his presence. Otherwise, Senior Yingyue and the others would have already made a move to kill him, so we don't need to bother with him.

Moreover, his cultivation is only at 6-Star Realm, so he is not a threat to us. Instead, you should think about yourself and don't look for trouble with Shang Yaolin; especially since Shang Xiaojuan is also in this realm, and he will do something to you if you dare to harass her."
"Tch! That guy is really a madman!" Huang Qianghua spoke in a tone filled with profanity. "He-Mhmm."
Hao Jianxiu immediately prevented Huang Qianghua from speaking by covering her mouth. "Be careful with your words; otherwise, Shang Xiaojuan will hear you, and you will be the one who suffers."

Huang Qianghua nodded and pulled Hao Jianxiu's hand down. "Anyway, I'm curious about that fox kid, and I want to see him in person, so you have to accompany me to the Shang Clan's residence after we finish our duties."

"All right." Hao Jianxiu immediately agreed to Huang Qianghua's request, especially since she knew her character very well, so she couldn't let her meet Shang Yaolin by herself. "You have to control yourself when you meet him later, okay?"
"Hehe." Huang Qianghua laughed and briefly kissed Hao Jianxiu's lips. "Didn't I have you? You'll definitely stop me if I lose control when I meet Shang Yaolin, right?"
Hao Jianxiu let out a soft sigh and nodded to Huang Qianghua, and she immediately put her down from her lap. "It's already late at night, so we should rest now, and we'll meet Shang Yaolin later."

After the two women left, Qiao Xuan turned to Shang Wuzi directly. "What is your plan for gathering us? Are you thinking about getting our help to fight Shang Guangming? Shang Xiaojuan is also protective of him, so you better forget about it because we will never help you."

"I won't be so crazy as to fight a madman like Shang Xiaojuan, especially since his cultivation is above us." Murong Yi then took a sip of wine from his jug before continuing. "Moreover, Aunt Qianying will beat me up if I fight with him, so I won't help you either."

Deng Shicang also rejected Shang Wuzi, even though he still had not said anything. "You may not know it, but Aunt Xinxin is also in this realm now, and we all know that she chose Sheng Guangming as her future husband."
"Are you kidding me? How come I didn't know about her arrival in this realm?" Shang Wuzi exclaimed in shock.

"If you really want to suffer, then you can try to attack Sheng Guangming." Deng Shicang then pointed towards the Shang Clan residence. "Aunt Xinxin came together with Shang Xiaojuan, but she used her concealment artifact, so not many people knew about her arrival, and she should be in his room now."
*Bam*

"Damn it!" Shang Wuzi cursed after banging on the table. "I've wanted to beat up that bastard for a long time, but Shang Xiaojuan always protected him every time I wanted to attack him, so I never got around to it."

The three men ignored Shang Wuzi's anger and stood up from their seats, but Qiao Xian spoke directly to him. "You'd better refrain from attacking Shang Guangming while Aunt Xinxin is in this realm, or she will report you to Uncle Huaqiang, and he will definitely extend your sentence in this realm."

Shang Wuzi's face darkened as he watched the three men leave. "Sigh! My sentence only has 10 years left, and I'm fed up with this realm, so I don't want to stay here any longer. I can't beat Shang Xiaojuan and Aunt Xinxin, but I think those other guys can help me do something about them, so I have to find time to meet them.
Otherwise, I won't have the chance to beat Shang Guangming up once we return to our realm, so I'll settle things between us here."

A large beast with black fur all over his body lay curled up on the ground inside a dark cave, his bloodshot eyes staring out and his sharp teeth exposed as he grinned. "Those foolish humans still don't realize that fox kid is not a demon fox. Although I can smell a faint demonic aura emanating from his body, he is actually one of the mythical beasts, the heavenly fox.

He can deceive them by disguising himself as a kid, but he will never be able to deceive me, Tianguo! Based on his beast aura, he should have reached four to five tails, so he is definitely a teenager. I don't know what your purpose is in coming to this realm, but you better not disturb my peace. Otherwise, I will eat you alive, and I will absorb your beast essence to increase my strength."
After that, Tianguo closed his eyes again, but his senses continued to be focused on the northern island, especially to keep an eye on Zhang Xiaolong [3].
